store_data.detailed_description:
Game Overview

Battle Marine Advance! is a single-screen shooter where you fight using horizontal movement, jumps, rapid-fire shots, and a powerful laser.

Keep landing your shots, build combos without taking damage, and collect medals to increase your score multiplier. Accuracy matters, but so does knowing when to use your laser—which makes you temporarily invincible—or jump to automatically collect items.

Battle Marine Advance! supports Steam Achievements and online leaderboards.

You can also watch replays submitted to the leaderboards.

Controls

This game is optimized for use with a game controller.

Keyboard controls are also supported.

Shots and Score Multiplier

Repeatedly press the Shot button to fire.

Keep hitting enemies to increase your score multiplier, up to a maximum of ×16. Missing a shot or taking damage makes it harder to maintain your multiplier.

Aim carefully and destroy your enemies without wasting a shot.

Laser

Hold the Shot button to charge your laser, then release it once fully charged to fire.

You are invincible while firing the laser, and all medals on the screen are collected automatically.

Use it not only as a powerful attack, but also as a defensive tool for breaking through enemy fire.

Jump

Press the Jump button to jump.

While jumping, you automatically collect all medals on the screen. However, health items are also converted into medals, so choose your timing carefully.

Medals and HIT Combos

Enemies release medals when destroyed.

Collecting medals increases the Medal Rate displayed in the upper-left corner of the screen.

  • Collect a standard medal directly: Medal Rate +2

  • Collect a medal automatically by jumping or using the laser: Medal Rate +1

  • Collect a gold medal: Medal Rate +3

Keep destroying enemies within the time limit without missing a shot or taking damage to build your HIT combo. Once you reach 100 HIT or more, standard medals turn into gold medals and are collected automatically.

Your score is determined by your Medal Rate and Score Multiplier. However, missing a shot or taking damage reduces your Medal Rate by 21.875%.

Maintain your accuracy, avoid enemy fire, and aim for a high score.

Life and Recovery

Battle Marine Advance! uses a life-based health system.

Taking damage reduces the Life gauge in the lower-right corner of the screen. The game ends when the gauge is completely depleted.

When your Life gauge is not full, destroying an enemy causes a health item to appear. Collect it directly to recover Life. If you jump, however, the health item is converted into a medal and collected automatically.

Decide whether recovering Life or earning more points is more important in each situation.

There are no invincibility frames after taking damage. If you touch another enemy projectile during the damage animation, you will lose additional Life. Finding a safe position is especially important during the final stage, where enemy fire becomes particularly dense.

Ranks

When the game ends, you receive a rank based on your performance.

  • E1–E9: Enlisted (Beginner)

  • W1–W5: Warrant Officer (Intermediate)

  • O1–O6: Officer (Advanced)

  • O7–OB: Flag Officer (Expert)

  • Special Rank: Legendary Seaman (Normal/ALL)

  • Special Rank: Poseidon (Master/ALL)

Skill Score

Ranks W1 and above are generally determined by your Skill Score.

Your Skill Score is calculated as follows:

  • 1 point per stage reached (maximum 10 points at All Clear)

  • 1 point per 100 HITs in your highest combo (maximum 20 points at 2,000 HITs)

  • 1 point for every 10 seconds a combo of 100 HITs or more is maintained (maximum 20 points at 200 seconds)

  • 1 point per 25 successful hits (maximum 20 points at 500 hits)

  • −1 point per missed shot (no maximum penalty)

  • 1 point per 30 enemies defeated (maximum 20 points at 600 enemies)

  • 1 point per 100 points in your highest Medal Rate (maximum 20 points at 2,000)

  • 1 point per 300 points in your cumulative Medal Rate (maximum 10 points at 3,000)

  • −1 point per 5 recovery items collected (no maximum penalty)

  • If the calculated score is below 0: 0 points

  • If the calculated score exceeds 120: 120 points

If your Skill Score is below 30, you will instead be awarded a rank from E1 to E9 based on the stage you reached.

How to Achieve a High Rank (Experts Only)

For experienced shooter players, simply clearing the game—unlocking Legendary Seaman and Poseidon—will probably feel relatively easy.

However, the difficulty jumps to an entirely different level when you aim for a high rank.

That is where this game reveals its true form.

You can do it...

Here are some tips for conquering every rank:

  • First, ignore ranks entirely and clear Normal Mode (ALL) to unlock Master Mode.

  • Master Mode is not a “high-difficulty mode”; it is a mode that makes high ranks easier to achieve:

    • No recovery items appear, so you cannot lose rank from recovering Life!

    • Missing a shot also causes damage, so the missed-shot penalty is finite!

    • You have more frames before your combo breaks, making it easier to reach 2,000 HIT (the maximum score)!

  • The laser is powerful, but relying on it too heavily reduces the number of shots fired per unit time, which you need to increase the successful-hit portion of your Skill Score. If you have fired fewer than 500 shots by the time you clear Master ALL, revise your route to be more selective about when you use the laser.

  • The position of the first crab that appears in Stage 6 is determined by the direction pressed on the very first frame immediately after Stage 1 begins. (Left input = appears on the left; right input = appears on the right; no input = randomly appears on the left or right.)

  • A perfect Skill Score of 120 is impossible with even one missed shot, so finish with 0 missed shots if you are aiming for Rank 29 (the highest rank). (Be sure to fire at least 500 shots, however.)

  • Using a rapid-fire controller is not recommended:

    • Missed shots are more likely.

    • You are more likely to get caught in secondary explosions.

    • You do not need to keep 16-shot rapid fire going throughout the run to reach 500 shots by ALL; relaxed bursts (around three shots per attack) are enough.

  • With a perfect score of 120, Rank 29 takes priority over Legendary Seaman (Rank 27) and Poseidon (Rank 28), even if you clear ALL, so it is fine to complete the game.

  • If you are aiming for Fleet Admiral (Rank 26), avoid clearing ALL and achieve a Skill Score of at least 100.

  • E1/E2 are easy to unlock in Master Mode.

  • E3–E9 are easy to target in Normal Mode by intentionally missing shots or collecting recovery items.

Steam Version Features

Battle Marine Advance! is based on the GBA version of Battle Marine included with Battle Marine, with additional features developed specifically for Steam.

  • Steam Achievements

  • Online leaderboards

  • Leaderboard replay playback

  • In-game switching between fullscreen and windowed modes

  • An Exit Game option on the title screen

About the GBA Version

The GBA ROM that can be used with original hardware or emulators remains included with Battle Marine.

Battle Marine Advance! does not include a ROM file for use with external hardware or emulators.

If you require the ROM file, please purchase Battle Marine.

Streaming and Content Usage Policy

You may create and publish videos, livestreams, gameplay commentary, articles, social media posts, fan works, and other content featuring this game without prior permission.

This applies to both commercial and non-commercial use, regardless of whether the content is monetized.

However, individual assets from the game—including images, sound effects, and music—may not be redistributed or reused as standalone content.

store_data.about_the_game:
The belt is rich. The belt is hostile. You have six gun arms.

Gunmetal Orbit is a fast 2.5D space-mining arena roguelite. Pick your spacer, launch into the asteroid field, and survive escalating waves while your weapons fire on their own — your job is to fly: kite the swarm, dodge the bolts, crack the rocks, and scoop the ore before something else does.

MINE UNDER FIRE

  • Ore is money, and money is guns. Pop asteroids, haul the chunks home, and sell at the dock — every run funds the next fight.
  • The field fights back: shooters, kamikaze poppers, splitters, armored heavies, ore-stealing salvage scarabs, and gravity-well Magnetars that drag you off your line.
  • Every few waves the belt shifts sectors — amber Scrap Drifts thick with rock, electric Ion Storms that scorch whole zones of the arena.

BUILD ABSURD LOADOUTS

  • Stack up to six auto-firing weapons — six SMGs screaming at once is a legitimate strategy.
  • Level-up picks and the rotating Outfitter shop snowball damage, attack speed, lifesteal, drones, and dashes into a screen full of bullets.
  • Combine duplicate weapons into higher tiers; recycle what doesn't fit the build.

GROW THE OUTPOST

  • Secured waves earn station blueprints — sentry spires, refinery annexes, cargo drone hangars. Your dock becomes a base that fights and earns alongside you.

RUNS SHAPED LIKE YOUR SESSION

  • Pick a mode — Standard, Endless, Mining Rush, or a challenge preset — and a hazard level 0–5: H0 is a quick patrol, H5 is a 30-wave campaign with mid-bosses.
  • Death is real: a hull breach ends the run and archives it to your Service Record.
  • Docking saves. Suspend anytime. Three slots hold three separate runs.

BUILT FOR THE DECK

  • Gamepad-first twin-stick controls with native button prompts; keyboard and mouse fully supported.
  • Native 1280×800, tuned for a locked 60 fps on Steam Deck hardware.
  • A dubstep soundtrack keeps the belt moving.

store_data.about_the_game:
Orbisphere is a cozy idle-arcade game about a small astronaut, named Orbi, with a big job: collect stardust to wake a sleeping station and find your way home.

Ride the orbit - the active loop

Drift through space, using your jetpack to speed up. Orbi can't change directions with his jetpack. Instead, utilise the gravitational pull of planets to change directions and slingshot your way through space. Collect stardust as you go and return to your station to upgrade your equipment. 

Feed the machines - the idle loop

Stardust feeds machine. Machines feed upgrades. Use the lab, 3D printer, solar wings and drone dock. Then let your OrbiBot collect stardust while you're afk. 

Upgrades let Orbi reach further into space in hopes of finding his way home.

Risk & Reward

Stardust is plentiful in the asteroid belt, but so are the hazards. What you gather only counts once you carry it home.

Build your garden oasis

Past the hazardous asteroid belt there is a light that shouldn't be there. Follow it and you might find something worth planting. 

Beware the wormholes!

  • Hands-on arcade sling-shotting with real momentum

  • A deepening idle economy that runs while you're away

  • Machines, gardens and upgrade trees to wake one by one

  • A quiet, lonely corner of space to make your own

  • Mini-games to boost your economy

  • Full controller support

  • No internet required, no accounts, no in-app purchases

Hyper Trigger is a fast-paced rocket-jumping platformer set in a unique digital world.

Welcome to HyperNet, Agent! { name: ######, id: 64, codename: "typhoon", tool: "anchor-12" }

  • Race against your friends' best times and climb the leaderboard to show your superiority.

store_data.about_the_game:
An atmospheric 2D stealth-action platformer set inside an abandoned gothic castle. You are a lone assassin sent into the ruins to end the reign of the vampire lord who dwells within. Every hall is dark, every guard is a threat, and the shadows are your only ally.

Move like a shadow. Run, leap, and climb through crumbling zones of the castle — from the outer walls to the depths beneath. Read the environment, time your movement, and choose when to slip past danger and when to strike.

Two ways to kill. Close the distance for a fast melee finish, or line up a ranged shot to take enemies down before they ever see you. Chain your movement into your attacks and keep the pressure on.

Solve the castle's mechanisms. Hidden switches, moving platforms, and destructible walls block your path forward. Trip the right mechanism, break through the right wall, and unlock the route deeper into the keep.

Face the Vampire Lord. Reach the heart of the castle and confront a multi-phase boss that grows more dangerous as the fight goes on. Learn its patterns, survive its assault, and end the curse.

Never lose your progress. Checkpoints and an on-screen minimap keep you oriented as you push through each zone, so every death is a lesson — not a setback.

store_data.about_the_game:
Reaching For The Star is a life simulation and role-playing game set in the modern entertainment industry.

You play as a young woman taking her first steps into show business. Beginning as an unknown newcomer, you will plan your daily schedule, improve your abilities, pursue new opportunities, meet people from across the industry, and gradually discover what kind of star—and what kind of person—you want to become.

Study acting, singing, and dancing. Audition for television dramas and films. Record music, appear on variety shows, attend promotional events, or take time away from the spotlight to rest and connect with the people around you.

Every appearance under the spotlight may become a turning point in your career. Every decision behind the scenes may change your relationships and lead your story in a different direction.

Will you become a beloved idol, an acclaimed actress, a versatile all-around entertainer, or choose a life you never expected when your journey began?

Your career is yours to shape.

Plan Each Day of Your Career

Time is one of the most valuable resources in show business.

Plan your schedule week by week and decide how to balance work, training, rest, and your personal life.

Take acting lessons, practice your vocals and dancing, improve your stamina and elegance, or step away from work to recover from mounting stress and exhaustion.

A demanding schedule may help you improve quickly, but pushing yourself too far can affect both your health and your performance. How you spend your limited time will influence your abilities, condition, and future opportunities.

Become the Artist You Want to Be

There is no single path to success.

Throughout your career, you can develop a wide range of attributes, including:

  • Acting, Singing, and Dancing

  • Charisma, Elegance, and Fashion

  • Confidence, Eloquence, and Intelligence

  • Stamina, Creativity, and Talent

  • Fame, Popularity, and Industry Influence

Different jobs and career paths require different strengths.

Devote yourself to acting and become a performer capable of taking on challenging roles. Develop your singing and dancing skills and command the stage as an idol. Strengthen your confidence, humor, and communication skills to show a different side of yourself to the public.

The choices you make will shape a career that is uniquely your own.

Pursue New Opportunities

Begin with small and often overlooked jobs before working your way toward major productions.

Take part in television dramas, films, music projects, commercials, variety shows, and other entertainment activities. Each opportunity has its own genre, cast, requirements, and potential rewards.

Your abilities, reputation, public image, and relationships within the industry may all influence which opportunities become available to you.

Prepare for auditions, compete for the roles you want, and prove yourself through every performance. One successful project may transform you into an overnight sensation, while a disappointing result may still become an important step in your growth.

Meet the People Behind the Spotlight

During your journey, you will meet actors, singers, idols, directors, writers, and many others working throughout the entertainment industry.

Each person has their own personality, history, ambitions, and private struggles. Some may become close friends or professional rivals. Some may offer support when you need it most, while others may gradually become someone special.

Spend time together through work, invitations, and everyday encounters. Your decisions about ambition, friendship, and romance will shape your relationships and open different stories and possibilities.

Face the Pressure of Fame

Popularity brings more than applause.

As your name becomes more widely known, you will face demanding schedules, public expectations, media attention, professional competition, and growing physical and emotional pressure.

Fatigue and stress can affect your performance, while difficult decisions may cause you to miss valuable opportunities. Learning when to push forward and when to slow down is an important part of building a sustainable career.

There is no single definition of success.

You may become a superstar celebrated for countless performances and awards. You may discover the field you truly love and build a future with the people who matter to you. Or you may realize that the life you want is different from the dream you once chased.

Write Your Own Story of Stardom

Within a limited number of years, every week, every job, and every encounter will become part of your unique journey through show business.

Rise from an unknown newcomer to a star shining beneath the spotlight.

How far will your dreams take you?

The answer is in your hands.

store_data.about_the_game:
Yolings™ is a 2.5D single-player puzzle platformer built around one core question:

How many are you willing to sacrifice to save the rest?

Explore the mysterious world of the Yolings through more than 50 handcrafted puzzles. Take direct control of an individual Yoling to either guide them through to the goal, or to self sacrifice them.

Every Yoling has the potential to become the solution. Blast them apart, petrify them, make them into portals, or supercharge them. Every sacrifice changes the puzzle, and every survivor improves your score.

Developed by a solo creator, Yolings™ combines physics-driven puzzles and dark humor into an experience that's easy to understand but increasingly difficult to master.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Mihtgast Empire, celebrating peace for the first time in centuries, is thrust back into turmoil with the death of their leader and disappearance of his heir. As the world experiences an alchemical revolution, a new age of war is on the horizon, and the Wyrd, a vast and dangerous wilderness once thought uninhabitable, is trapped in the eye of the storm. Will its people rise to face these new challenges, or will they become a footnote in the annals of history?

Wyrdwic: At the Heart of a New World is a narrative-driven puzzle management game that follows the newest members of the Guardians’ guild, an organisation dedicated to the people of the Wyrd. Surrounded by dangerous creatures of all kinds, it falls to you as the guild’s manager to lead its members as they fight to protect, guide and aid those around you in an ever changing world on the brink of war. 

  • Experience the story of Aefre, rightful heir to the Mihtgastian throne as she leads the Guardians’ guild, making allies, friends and enemies in her fight to reclaim her home.

  • Lead and befriend a wide cast of characters from several unique locales, both from within the Wyrd and beyond its borders.

  • Determine which of your guild members are best suited to the tasks before you, and guide them as they tackle challenges both great and small.

  • Rely on the people of the Wyrd when you need them, just as they do to you.

  • Make decisions that determine the future of the continent at large.

  • Build the future you want to see.

store_data.about_the_game:
John is spending another quiet monthly shift inside ZUCH, an automated flak machine protecting a factory in rural New Zealand. The machine normally identifies and destroys incoming drones without human involvement. John is only there to supervise - until an unusual request forces him to make a decision the system will not forget.

Flak Duty is a short, linear science-fiction visual novel told through illustrated filmstrip-style pages. There are no combat sections, puzzles, or branching choices. Progress through the story at your own pace, move backward and forward between pages, hide the text to view the artwork, and adjust the presentation for comfortable reading.

Features

  • A complete standalone science-fiction story

  • Illustrated filmstrip-style presentation

  • A linear narrative designed to be completed in one sitting

  • Previous and next page navigation

  • Hideable text and adjustable text size

  • Light and dark reading modes

  • Keyboard and mouse support

  • Atmospheric soundtrack

Flak Duty is the third title in the emagnetic Filmstrip Stories series. More stories are on the way.

store_data.about_the_game:
Larithea is a cozy anime RPG about friendship, trust, revenge, and finding

your way back from the darkness. A team of young mages is sent out into the

world — each of them with their own road ahead. Others have walked it before. Few

found their way back.

Meet the team

  • Maya — the heart of the party. A caring healer, the steady hand who holds everyone together.

  • Tara — fast, fierce, and direct. She acts before others have finished thinking, and rarely apologizes for it.

  • Nell — throws himself into every situation with open-eyed enthusiasm, even when the danger is real and closing in fast.

  • Grey — outspoken and razor-sharp. Joins early and quickly becomes the one everyone turns to when things get complicated.

  • Dart — self-contained, careful, harder to read than the others.

Build your spells

Craft your own spells from the materials you gather — combine sigils to make the

attacks and support your team runs on.

Lead the team

Turn-based encounters on a grid. Place your spells, plan your positions, watch

the fight unfold.

The world

Something is off at the edge of the desert. Strange lights, old spells waking up,

water gone from where it always was. Ormron sits at the border of a Veil no one

crosses — and whatever's stirring out there was buried a long time ago, on

purpose.

In this chapter

  • A five-member party, each with their own school of magic

  • Spell crafting from sigils

  • Dozens of turn-based battles across a branching path through the Ormron desert

  • A story told in chapters, released one at a time

store_data.about_the_game:
Last Ascender is a 1st-person turn-based strategy RPG that combines the progression of classic RPGs with the tension of roguelikes and the deep strategy of deckbuilding. In a world shrouded by the Demon King’s darkness, you must end this desperate journey armed only with your unique builds and strategic choices.



Dynamic turn-based combat

Become an 'Ascender' to save the world and dive into the battlefield. With intuitive controls, leave behind the boredom of traditional turn-based combat and experience both strategic depth and the thrill of dynamic action!


Unique class-specific skills

Defeat enemies faster and more satisfyingly by utilizing the unique skills of your characters! With distinct skills for each class, you can experience a completely different style of combat every time. Embark on a new journey and discover your own unique combat strategy with every run.


Craft your own build with relics.

Collect and combine over 100 unique and distinct relics on your journey. Upgrade them to enhance their power, or synthesize them to forge even stronger relics. Make the best choices at every moment to complete your ultimate build!


Diverse enemies that put your strength to the test.

Advance by defeating enemies with diverse abilities. As the difficulty increases, enemies not only grow stronger but also gain new abilities to put you to the test. Devise a more powerful build to overcome the trials posed by these formidable foes.

New characters and events will be continuously added throughout Early Access, alongside ongoing balance updates. The power to enrich this journey lies in your hands! Don't wait—embrace the power of your journey and become the Ascender who saves the world.

Game Overview

Argent Cocoon is a story-driven GL adventure featuring full English voice acting for all characters and scenes.

Travel through the rainforest with four romanceable characters, or choose to walk your own path alone. Each companion has a unique storyline, and your choices will shape your relationships and lead to different endings.

Explore the world by interacting with the environment, collecting items and key evidence, and discovering hidden clues. Unlock character bonds, uncover branching narratives, and experience a story with over 200,000 words of script and 23 CG illustrations.

Featuring 8 original tracks, including one licensed collaboration with FourTuneAudio, the music of Argent Cocoon brings its mysterious world of evolution and transformation to life.

Embark on your journey in Argent Cocoon, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the path of evolution.

Story

Humanity has fallen, and the ruins of the old world have become a breeding ground for the Insecta.

Through the Argent Cocoon, they rewrite their genes and embrace new life.

In the humid rainforest, Evolution is the only faith—and the only law that cannot be questioned.

You are a gifted Eularva, one of the rarest among the Insecta.

You were meant to enter the Argent Cocoon, surrender your soul to the Great Collective Consciousness, and become one with your kind.

But the deeper you explore, the more you begin to question that destiny.

After being transported into a dark fantasy novel, she finds herself caught in a world filled with demons, dangerous missions, hidden identities, and complicated relationships. To survive, she must complete the tasks assigned to her while finding a way to approach the mysterious Shen Run.

Follow Lin Tangtang through a choice-driven narrative where your decisions influence character relationships, story developments, and the ending you reach.

Journey through a world of demon hunters, supernatural mysteries, hidden identities, and dangerous encounters inspired by Chinese fantasy storytelling.

BUILD YOUR RELATIONSHIP

store_data.about_the_game:
Starting from a single egg, your very own Lulu Rabbit moves right onto your desktop. It will sit obediently at the edge of your screen, swinging its long ears, and keep you company through every day.

Together, you can run a little farm—plant crops, water flowers, go fishing. Take your harvest and catch to the market to sell for shell coins. Even as you type or click, Lulu Rabbit helps you save up extra shells on the side. Once you've saved enough shell coins, head to the shop to buy all kinds of pretty outfits and handy tools—puffy skirts, straw hats, hair clips, watering cans... You can dress up Lulu Rabbit in a new look every day.

When you need to focus on work or study, just start the Pomodoro timer, set your work and rest intervals, and let Lulu Rabbit share the same routine as you.

No complicated goals, no stressful pace. Farming, dressing up, and companionship—a simple pastoral life, all starting with one fluffy Lulu Rabbit.

store_data.about_the_game:
Everyone has a price. What's yours?

Football made you famous. The syndicate made you rich. THE FIXER is a narrative career sim where you live both lives at once: the rising star chasing titles on Saturday, and the fixer selling pieces of the match all week long.

ONE WEEK IN THE LIFE OF A FIXER

  • Monday, wake-up. Headlines, rumours, the fallout of what you did.
  • Tuesday, network. Lifestyle, family, contacts: grow the web that protects you.
  • Wednesday, fixing. The syndicate's offers arrive: a provoked yellow card, a missed sitter, a thrown match for a fortune.
  • Thursday, cover-up. Bets and sabotage on one side; laundering fronts and damage control on the other.
  • Friday, prep. Sharpen your legs, or your alibi.
  • Saturday, match. Play it live, minute by minute, or take the express result. Same consequences either way.
  • Sunday, debrief. The week's bill arrives. All of it.

MATCHES YOU CAN BEND

Live text matches with real stakes: tactical calls with visible success odds, fixes to pull off in the moment, a live betting window priced by an honest bookmaker, and momentum that swings with every duel. Pay the referee and the whistle goes quiet: a penalty, a red card for the opposition, and total impunity on the pitch. But the cameras see what the referee will not.

THE WORLD CLOSES IN

Suspicion is a gauge with a number, and at 100 the number wins. Press conferences turn into traps. Investigative journalists build files on you. A nemesis takes it personally. Buried cases reopen, referees burn, trials end careers. Every dirty euro under the mattress is a question you will have to answer one day.

A REAL FOOTBALL CAREER, TOO

Titles, the captain's armband, transfers, awards ceremonies, and a Cup of Nations every four seasons. Dialogue choices resolve with visible dice rolls. You can try to play it clean. The game will tempt you anyway.

BUILD YOUR LEGEND ACROSS LIVES

13 retirement verdicts, 8 ways to lose everything, a Hall of Careers that archives every life, and a legacy system: each finished career unlocks starting perks, backgrounds and mandates for the next one. The world remembers who you were.

Build a legend, or burn it all down.

store_data.about_the_game:
When Heaven Falls Silent, Hell Finds a Voice.

The world of Sanctum Wars is dying.

For centuries, humanity endured beneath the protection of divine light. Then, without warning, the prayers ceased to reach Heaven. The sacred resonance that once bound mankind to God fell silent, leaving the world vulnerable to ancient horrors long imprisoned beneath reality itself.

Now corruption spreads across kingdoms. Faith is fading. Civilization is collapsing. And Hell no longer waits beyond the veil.

You are Thalor, an elite knight of the Ordo Aeternum Lux, dispatched to investigate the once-prosperous city of Valensbrück, where an entire population has vanished beneath an unholy silence.

What begins as a mission to uncover the city's fate soon reveals a conspiracy that threatens not only humanity, but the very order of creation.

Every step deeper into Valensbrück brings you closer to a truth the world was never meant to uncover.

EXPLORE A FALLEN CITY

Journey through the cursed lands of Valensbrück, from abandoned villages and forgotten mines to towering cathedrals, plague-ridden districts, ruined fortresses, and ancient catacombs hidden beneath the city.

Every location tells the story of a civilization consumed by corruption, where every ruin, every corpse, and every forgotten prayer reveals another piece of the world's downfall.

MASTER TACTICAL MELEE COMBAT

Every duel is a test of discipline.

Master deliberate, weighty melee combat inspired by historical martial traditions. Learn weapon-specific movesets, chain precise attacks, manage your stamina, and exploit enemy openings in battles where reckless aggression is punished and every strike matters.

HOLD FAST TO YOUR FAITH

As Heaven grows silent, your faith becomes your greatest weapon.

Discover sacred relics, forgotten prayers, and ancient rites that strengthen your resolve while resisting the corruption spreading throughout the world. Every decision shapes both your journey and the fate of those who still endure.

FACE THE INFERNAL

Confront corrupted humans, twisted abominations, and infernal entities born from humanity's broken connection to the divine.

Each enemy presents unique behaviors, strengths, and tactical challenges that reward observation, patience, and mastery.

A CINEMATIC DARK FANTASY EXPERIENCE

Immerse yourself in a handcrafted medieval world brought to life through cinematic storytelling, richly detailed environments, atmospheric lighting, and an original orchestral soundtrack.

Every ruined chapel, abandoned battlefield, forgotten village, and whispered prayer serves a larger mystery waiting to be uncovered.

FEATURES

  • Explore the first chapter of the Sanctum Wars universe.

  • Experience a dark medieval world inspired by Gothic architecture and historical Europe.

  • Master tactical third-person melee combat built around precision, timing, and weapon mastery.

  • Uncover the mystery behind God's Silence through exploration and environmental storytelling.

  • Face terrifying infernal creatures and unforgettable boss encounters.

  • Discover sacred relics, forgotten prayers, and powerful rites.

  • Traverse handcrafted villages, mines, castles, cathedrals, and underground catacombs.

  • Experience cinematic storytelling powered by next-generation visuals and immersive audio.

store_data.about_the_game:
- Plot -

In Jeff Quest, you'll follow the story of Jeff, who—due to a failed experiment—has shrunk to the size of an insect. His relationship with Mia is in crisis, and you'll have to try to find her so he can apologize. But many dangers await you, including death scenes if you take the wrong path, and so on—and toward the end, you’ll discover that Mia will love both of you.

- Details -

  • Jeff Quest features death scenes to make his adventure realistic—and even dangerous—as he sets out on his journey to find Mia.

  • The game does not currently include soundtracks, but we will be working on them in future updates.

  • The game doesn't have any RPG elements, but it's a story-driven game with dialogue and even some short cutscenes to make the whole experience as realistic as possible.

  • The goal of the game is to apologize to Mia, but there are dangers along the way.

  • Multiple endings: The game features a bad ending and the canonical happy ending.

- Credits -

Beta tester: SaruS / Anonymous tester

Artist: 6o6chitpos / SquishyDeer

Story: Mattia54 / SquishyDeer

Dialog: Mattia54 / tiny3dfan

Mattia54, Jeff, Mia and Angela are my property, and unauthorized reproduction is prohibited.

store_data.about_the_game:
Kiosk Hustle is a first-person shop management simulator about running a small roadside kiosk in a rough neighborhood.

Start with almost nothing, search the local flea market for cheap goods, bring supplies back to your kiosk, open crates, stock the shelves, and try to make enough money to survive another day.

BUY LOW, SELL HIGH

Visit the flea market and search for useful products, supply crates, equipment, and rare finds.

Every purchase is a risk. Some crates may contain valuable goods, while others may barely cover their cost.

RUN YOUR OWN KIOSK

Arrange products on the shelves, keep track of your stock, serve customers, and choose how much to charge for every item.

Fair prices keep customers happy.

High prices may scare them away.

Ridiculous prices might occasionally attract someone with more money than common sense.

DEAL WITH STRANGE CUSTOMERS

Not every visitor is here for a normal purchase.

Meet unusual customers, suspicious locals, lost visitors, thieves, troublemakers, and people who seem to have wandered into the wrong kiosk.

Some will buy.

Some will complain.

Some may need to be chased away with a mop.

SURVIVE EACH DAY

Rent, supplies, equipment, and bad decisions all cost money.

Manage your cash carefully, avoid falling too far into debt, and make enough profit to keep the business alive.

If your money drops below zero, you will have limited time to recover before everything falls apart.

EXPAND YOUR BUSINESS

Order new equipment, unlock additional products, experiment with production stations, prepare fermented drinks, and improve the way your kiosk operates.

Use the old laptop to manage prices, order equipment, and keep track of your growing business.

A SMALL BUSINESS WITH BIG PROBLEMS

Kiosk Hustle combines shop management, exploration, trading, physical interactions, and absurd neighborhood events.

Your kiosk may be small, but every day can turn into a completely different disaster.

BUILD

Start from nothing in a freezing, unforgiving wasteland. Construct and upgrade your camp step by step to keep your people alive in the harsh winter. Every structure you build is a vital piece of your colony's survival.

EXPLORE & CONQUER

Push your boundaries. Send your men out into the freezing unknown to scavenge for vital resources. Capture walls across the map to expand your safe zone, claim new territories, and gather the strength you need for the coming night.

CARDS & CHOICES

Take control of the battlefield and the fate of your colony through a dynamic, drag-and-drop card system. Pull cards from your hand and cast them directly onto the play area to turn the tide. Boost your farmers' work speed, heal your soldiers, or even freeze time when things get out of hand. Strike down the Diseased with lightning if they breach your lines. But survival isn't just about power; it is about sacrifice. You will face tough choices that shape the future of your people.

store_data.about_the_game:
Raise a guild, not just a single hero


The dead walk once more, and an ancient bell tolls beneath the earth. Take command of a fallen expedition guild, gather unproven adventurers, and hunt the calamity awakening below five sealed gates.

There is no single chosen hero in this story. Every expedition—and every adventurer who makes it home—builds the strength your guild needs to descend farther.

Plan short, perilous expeditions


The expedition board offers dungeons with different risks and rewards. Choose who to send, then explore a procedurally generated top-down grid where limited SP, rising encounter danger, and the road home all matter.

Reaching the exit is not enough. Defeat the elite party guarding the final path to complete the expedition. Press deeper for greater rewards, or withdraw while your party still has the strength to return.

Command classic row-based turn-based battles


Read formation, turn order, remaining SP, and enemy roles before you act. Guardians hold the front, damage dealers exploit openings, healers support the back line, and controlling enemies disrupt your plans.

More than 70 monsters and region-specific encounters await across six regions and eighteen expedition sites. Common foes wear down your resources; elites and gate bosses test the limits of the party you have built.

Build multiple parties—and keep them moving


Heroes need time to recover after an expedition. One powerful team cannot solve every problem. Raise second and third parties to take over while veterans rest, then reshape your lineup for the traits of the next dungeon.

  • A roster of adventurers with distinct classes and combat roles
  • Hundreds of skills and equipment options for character builds
  • Dungeon traits that alter both risk and reward
  • In-run ability and equipment drafts alongside permanent guild progression
  • A standard mode focused on roster management without permanent loss
  • A hard mode where fallen adventurers are gone for good

Uncover the truth beneath five gates


Descend from flooded crypts through echoing mines, a fogbound labyrinth, ember warrens, and a frozen abyss toward the Sunless Throne. Each broken gate reveals records of a dead kingdom through full-screen story scenes.

But not every victory saves the world. As the seals around the throne collapse, the power below awakens. Prepare every party in your guild to finish what you have begun.

store_data.about_the_game:
Once upon a time, a mischievous girl named Lua was at school with her friends. Then came a blinding flash… and every child was gone.

They wake in Everbloom — a bright realm gone grey, sick with a shadow called the Blight. To find their way home, and free the families the Blight has stolen, six kids must become something more: a squad of young mages, armed with elemental magic and whatever courage they can muster.

Command a squad, not a lone hero. Direct all six kids at once, form them into tactical formations, and counter each enemy's weakness with the right element — fire, ice, or lightning. Chain status effects, exploit formation bonuses, and adapt on the fly as fights escalate.

Every run matters. Explore ancient trial-grounds, a blighted marsh, a maze grown by the Mystic Trees, and a plain of black smoke-towers — each guarded by escalating waves of enemies and capped by a boss fight. Difficulty scales from a gentle Kids mode all the way to Hard, where permadeath is real and the minotaurs don't go easy.

A hub to call home. Between runs, return to a walkable garden hub — train in the glade, sit by the companion campfire, and pet the critters who live there.

A story that remembers what you did. How many families you're able to save — and at what cost — shapes the ending you get. Not every victory feels the same.

Features:

  • Command a squad of six kids, each with their own elemental magic and playstyle

  • Weakness-based elemental combat: fire, ice, and lightning, with burn/chill/chain status effects

  • Formation bonuses that reward smart squad positioning

  • Four difficulty modes, from family-friendly Kids mode to permadeath Hard mode

  • A hand-crafted story campaign across shifting seasonal biomes, plus a secret wave-survival mode

  • A living garden hub between missions

  • Full storybook narration with an ending that reflects how your run went

store_data.about_the_game:
The caverns are never the same twice

Beneath the old world, a wound in the earth swallows everyone brave — or foolish — enough to enter. Take up a class, step through the mouth of the cave, and descend floor by floor into a dark-fantasy roguelite where every run carves a new path through shifting biomes.

Every descent starts fresh

You enter with nothing but your class and your wits. Weapons, armour, reagents and gold are found — and lost — in the dark. Fall, and the caverns keep your gear... but the rare artifacts you drag back to the surface are yours forever, quietly making the next adventurer stronger.

Key Features

  • Roguelite descent — procedurally generated floors across distinct biomes; no two runs alike.
  • Pick your class — warrior, mage, rogue or alchemist, each with its own gear, skills and rhythm.
  • Spells & a skill tree — hurl firebolts, frost novas and chain lightning, and spend hard-won points to grow a build all your own.
  • Tier-scaled combat — monsters grow with the depths you reach, not a fixed clock; the deep floors are a real test.
  • Permanent artifacts — recover relics that persist between runs and unlock lasting power.
  • Loot and craft — gather reagents, brew potions, and forge your build from whatever the caverns give you.
  • A town to call home — return to the surface to spend gold, take on villager quests, and fill the Artifact Museum.
  • One more floor — permadeath runs tuned so a skilled delver reaches the depths, and the best keep chasing them.

How deep will you go?

store_data.about_the_game:
Every hand is a little bit of magic.

Bagatto is a pixel-art poker roguelike where every run hands you a fresh deck and a new plan to break the math. Play poker hands to score Chips, multiply them with a growing arsenal of Jokers, and blow past each blind's target by absurd margins. Cash out, hit the shop, buy the next piece of your engine — then do it all again, bigger.

The best trick is the one you build yourself.

Key Features

  • Score with poker — Pairs, Flushes, Full Houses and secret hands are your weapons. The better the hand, the bigger the base.
  • 100+ Jokers — Stack wild, synergistic effects that turn +Mult into ×Mult into "how is that number even real?"
  • Deckbuild your way — Enhance, seal and edition your cards, then warp your whole deck with Tarot, Planet and Spectral cards.
  • Chips × Mult juice — Every scoring hand erupts with escalating heat, glowing stat boxes and deeply satisfying count-ups.

store_data.about_the_game:
ROBOTEKA is a unique robot fighting action game where you battle using only left and right weight shifts and a turn button.

By simplifying the concepts of timing and distance, the game lets anyone enjoy the strategic depth of martial arts through intuitive controls.

Features

Simple Controls, Deep Combat

  • Experience deep and rewarding combat using only left and right weight shifts and a turn button.

  • Victory depends on timing and distance. Dodge enemy attacks at the last possible moment, then strike from the perfect range to unleash maximum power.

  • Combine the turn button with your attacks to perform spinning kicks, or activate MIKIRI Mode by perfectly reading an opponent's attack to deal massive damage. Despite its simple controls, the combat offers a variety of satisfying techniques.

  • ROBOTEKA is designed to capture the essence of martial arts—timing and distance—in an intuitive and accessible gameplay system.

Multiple Fighting Styles and Diverse Enemies

  • Complete stage missions to unlock a variety of punches and kicks, allowing you to customize your fighting style.

  • Every enemy has different attack timings and techniques. Choose the moves that best suit your strategy and overcome each challenge.

World

  • Explore a near-future world presented with detailed pixel art and a sense of depth across seven handcrafted stages.

  • Enjoy an original soundtrack created to complement the game's unique atmosphere.

Additional Information

  • Single-player

  • 7 stages

  • Controller support

  • Includes the complete original soundtrack as bonus content.

4977210.name: Stop The Fire: Apprentice Water Wizard

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

It's your very first day as an Apprentice Water Wizard.

Before you even have time to settle in, a mysterious wildfire erupts across the world. Every experienced wizard has already been dispatched, leaving only one person behind...

You.

Grab your wand and spellbook, extinguish the spreading flames, and uncover the truth behind the disaster.

Gameplay: Extinguish Every Fire

Your mission is simple:

Put out every fire.

From burning forests and blazing houses to smoldering streets, the flames have spread farther than anyone imagined. Rescue innocent townsfolk, save frightened woodland creatures, and restore the world one spell at a time.

Somewhere behind the catastrophe, an unseen force is pulling the strings. As the fire fades, so will the mystery.

Learn New Magic

Experience firefighting through first-person spellcasting.

Aim at the flames and cast powerful spells to extinguish the fire. As you restore the world, you'll earn Skill Points that can be used to unlock new abilities and expand your magical arsenal.

Master abilities such as:

  • Rainfall Spells to extinguish large areas at once

  • Wind Magic to reach difficult locations

  • Powerful Combo Spells with unique effects

Discover, combine, and master an ever-growing collection of spells to extinguish the impossible.

Restore a Living World

Every area you save comes back to life.

Burned landscapes gradually recover, special environmental animations appear, and the soundtrack evolves as the world heals. Friendly forest spirits may even join your firefighting efforts, rewarding your progress with delightful surprises.

There's always something new waiting to be restored.

Play Your Way

Whether you carefully extinguish every flame or rush to unlock the most powerful spells, your journey is yours to shape.

Estimated playtime: 4 to 8 hours, depending on your playstyle and spell choices.

4977250.name: One Thought Immortal / 一念修仙

store_data.about_the_game:
One thought to immortal, one thought to demon.

You've read a hundred cultivation novels. Now live one — a full cultivator's life, from the day the testing stone reads your spirit root to the day you ascend.

Why you'll love it

🧬 It all begins with your spirit root — Step onto the testing stone and learn your fate: a single-element root cultivates a thousand miles a day, while a mixed five-element root walks the hardest, most rewarding path. Your innate gift shapes the entire run.

🗺️ A cultivation world that is yours — Every world is a hand-painted-style tile map, procedurally generated — righteous and demonic sects, cities, markets, dens, ancient battlefields and secret realms. Or open the Map Atelier and build your own continent: place every sect, every city, every secret realm exactly where you dreamed it.

⚡ From Qi Refining to Ascension — Meditate, enter seclusion, and defy heaven's tribulation lightning at every breakthrough: Qi Refining, Foundation, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Spirit Severing — all the way to ascension. Lifespan ticks in real time; every year in seclusion is a year closer to your final calamity.

🏯 A real sect career — Start as an odd-jobs disciple and climb: outer, inner, core disciple, elder — even sect master. Run sect missions for contribution points, exchange them for techniques in the Scripture Pavilion, draw a monthly stipend, and study alchemy, forging and talismans across the sect's many peaks.

💞 Friends, rivals, and a dao companion — Every fellow disciple has a name, a temperament and a story. Chat them up, give gifts they actually like, adventure together — and when affection runs deep, confess and take a dao companion (they may refuse!). Cross the wrong cultivator and gain a nemesis who hunts you for years. Exchange jade slips to keep friends one message away.

💰 Fortuitous encounters everywhere — Delve free-roaming secret realms, loot storage bags off defeated foes and reveal treasures piece by piece, raid beast dens, flip goods between city markets, splurge at live auctions against AI bidders, and sip tea in the teahouse to hear which secret realm just opened. Equip a natal artifact and grow your hoard.

🧓 New to cultivation? Ask Grandpa Ring — A guardian spirit in your ring answers questions and nudges you along, a built-in cultivation encyclopedia explains every realm, herb and artifact, and an achievement wall of medals marks every first — your first beast slain, the day you reached Foundation Establishment.

🎲 Fall, reincarnate, ascend — A turn-based roguelite: death is permanent, but your Dao-insight carries into the next life as meta-progression. No two runs are alike — until at last, you ascend.

What you can do

  • Explore a procedural tile world map — or design your own in the built-in Map Atelier (terrain, rivers, roads, sects, cities, secret realms; import/export maps)

  • Join sects of named NPCs with traits, relationships and ranks; climb from odd-jobs disciple to elder and beyond

  • Fight turn-based battles with techniques, spells, talismans, a natal artifact, equipment and status effects

  • Cultivate, enter seclusion, and survive heaven-defying tribulations under real-time lifespan pressure

  • Brew pills in the alchemy room, forge artifacts on the Skyworks Peak, buy talismans at market

  • Delve free-roaming secret realms, raid beast dens and bandit camps, scavenge ancient battlefields, gamble on black-market blind boxes

  • Bid at live auctions against AI rivals; flip goods between city markets; hear rumors in the teahouse

  • Befriend, gift, party up, court a dao companion — or make a lifelong nemesis; trade jade slips with fellow cultivators

  • Learn as you play with Grandpa Ring's guidance, the in-game encyclopedia, and a medal wall of achievements

  • Die, reincarnate with Dao-insight meta-progression, and chase ascension across many lives

Built for

Readers of xianxia / cultivation novels who want to live that life themselves — test your spirit root, join a sect, chase fortuitous encounters, and ascend. Also for roguelite and turn-based RPG players who love deep, systemic games: fans of Amazing Cultivation Simulator, Slay the Spire and Loop Hero.

Languages & features

Playable in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. Fully offline, single-player — all saves and progress stay on your device.

store_data.about_the_game:
Raise Your Banner. Keep It Standing.

Mercenary Guild Manager is a text-driven management game where you command a mercenary guild in a medieval fantasy kingdom.

Hire warriors you may never fully trust, accept dangerous contracts, and try to keep your guild running for as long as you still have gold, soldiers, and reputation.

You can pause time, plan your decisions, and speed up the passing days. Meanwhile, unexpected events appear and change the course of your story.

Get to Know Your Team

Here, you will not find percentages or bars that give you all the answers.

A recruit may seem promising, experienced, or past their prime. A mission may be described as easy, risky, or extremely dangerous.

You discover who your mercenaries truly are over time by watching their actions, earning their trust, and dealing with the consequences of your decisions.

Knowing how to judge people is one of the most important skills a good captain can have.

Every Contract Tells a Story

Negotiate payments and conditions with clients, examine the risks, and choose the right mercenaries for each mission.

During the journey, new events may force you to make difficult decisions. Push forward through the night or wait until sunrise? Help an injured traveler or continue with the original plan?

Every choice puts your team to the test.

Success is never guaranteed, but neither is disaster.

Survive the Bills

Wages, headquarters maintenance, mission rewards, medical treatment, equipment, and personal ambitions all compete for the same money. As your company grows, so do the costs.

There is no traditional victory screen.

Your true score is how long your company can survive. A bad run of contracts may drive your guild into bankruptcy and leave its hall completely empty.

A World That Keeps Moving

Nobles, merchants, religious leaders, and criminals all have their own interests.

Every contract you accept helps someone and often harms someone else.

Build alliances, uncover secrets, make enemies, and watch rival guilds rise, weaken, or disappear.

The world reacts to your choices, even when you do not notice the consequences immediately.

Your Company, Your Legend

Create the banner and coat of arms of your guild. Choose your headquarters, set your rules, train new recruits, care for the wounded, and bury those who never returned.

Every decision, victory, and defeat is recorded in your company chronicle.

In the end, it is not only about how much gold you collected, but also about the story you managed to build.

Main Features

• A game played entirely through its interface

• Real-time progression with pause and multiple speed settings

• Procedurally generated mercenaries, missions, and events

• A different campaign every time you play

• Qualitative information that requires judgment and interpretation

• A political system that reacts to every contract you accept

• Financial management focused on survival

• A complete chronicle of your company’s history

Raise your banner. Build your reputation. And try to keep it flying for as long as possible.

4977360.name: Lowmoor Idle RPG: An Adventurer's Chronicle

store_data.about_the_game:
Sold matted tail x3 for 9 gold pieces. "The Guild buys by weight," says Master Pell. "The Guild has always bought by weight."

A zero-player RPG, after Progress Quest

Lowmoor is written in the voice of the old adventure modules. You enrol at the Adventurers' Guild of Mereward, sign the Roll, and keep the chronicle while your adventurer hunts, gains rank, hauls trophies to market, commissions better steel, and descends. Six floors below the town a dragon sleeps upon its hoard, and something older waits below the dragon.

Watch the descent, keep it in the corner of a second monitor, or close it altogether. Time passes in the deep while you are gone, and the Guild renders an account of your absence when you return, capped at four hours.

Your counsel is asked once

Choices arrive as sealed letters from the road. Leave one sealed and it settles itself safely. Break the seal and some go to the dice: a d20 against a difficulty class, rolled in the open.

Five arcs, complete and free from end to end

Arc I, The Way Down, is six floors, a plot told in sealed letters, staged bosses with their own phases, and an ending. The goblin king falls in the first half hour, and the wyrm is an afternoon of leaving it running.

Past the wyrm, Arc II opens the elder stair the dragon's weight kept shut, six deeper floors charted at about a day. Arc III opens under the quarry floor, six halls kept by a mage who has watched the whole descent through a thousand small eyes, charted at about two days. Two arcs wait below those: the offices behind the Court of the Lich, and, past the last door, the debt the Maw was dug to bury.

When an arc closes, the game writes your run out as a page of module prose to copy for whoever asks how the descent went.

What the chronicle holds

  • An illustrated bestiary of 132 beasts with the Guild's field notes. A mastery once entered stands for every chronicle after.

  • Twelve folks and twelve trades, each carrying one small gift stated in plain figures.

  • Seven schools of workings that fire themselves upon the road: spells for the lettered trades, knacks and the battle-fury for the martial ones.

  • Six bands of rarity up to the artefact. A Trophy Case and a Guildhouse that stand across every run, and treasures that keep their provenance cards.

  • 45 achievements at +1% speed apiece, a prestige Roll of Honour whose nine endowments change how the next run reads, and Guild titles at lifetime marks worth +3% speed for good.

  • Weather in the deep, tavern rumours composed from the true state of your run, a clerk with a voice for every floor, and a line of its own for every boss's fall.

You enrol at the Adventurers' Guild of Mereward, sign the Roll, and keep the chronicle while your adventurer hunts, gains rank, hauls trophies to market, commissions better steel, and descends. Six floors below the town a dragon sleeps upon its hoard, and something older waits below the dragon.

Watch the descent, keep it in the corner of a second monitor, or close it altogether. Time passes in the deep while you are gone, and the Guild renders an account of your absence when you return, capped at four hours.

Your counsel is asked once

Choices arrive as sealed letters from the road. Leave one sealed and it settles itself safely. Break the seal and some go to the dice: a d20 against a difficulty class, rolled in the open.

Five arcs, complete and free from end to end

Arc I, The Way Down, is six floors, a plot told in sealed letters, staged bosses with their own phases, and an ending. The goblin king falls in the first half hour, and the wyrm is an afternoon of leaving it running.

Past the wyrm, Arc II opens the elder stair the dragon's weight kept shut, six deeper floors charted at about a day. Arc III opens under the quarry floor, six halls kept by a mage who has watched the whole descent through a thousand small eyes, charted at about two days. Two arcs wait below those: the offices behind the Court of the Lich, and, past the last door, the debt the Maw was dug to bury.

When an arc closes, the game writes your run out as a page of module prose to copy for whoever asks how the descent went.

What the chronicle holds

  • An illustrated bestiary of 132 beasts with the Guild's field notes. A mastery once entered stands for every chronicle after.

  • Twelve folks and twelve trades, each carrying one small gift stated in plain figures.

  • Seven schools of workings that fire themselves upon the road: spells for the lettered trades, knacks and the battle-fury for the martial ones.

  • Six bands of rarity up to the artefact. A Trophy Case and a Guildhouse that stand across every run, and treasures that keep their provenance cards.

  • 45 achievements at +1% speed apiece, a prestige Roll of Honour whose nine endowments change how the next run reads, and Guild titles at lifetime marks worth +3% speed for good.

  • Weather in the deep, tavern rumours composed from the true state of your run, a clerk with a voice for every floor, and a line of its own for every boss's fall.

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into a dynamic martial arts world where every choice shapes your destiny. Combining classic MUD text commands with modern graphical interfaces, this is not just a game—it is a true simulation of the Jianghu.

️ Core Features: The Soul of the Jianghu

Tactical ATB Combat & Five-Element Mastery: Master a deep rock-paper-scissors克制 system. Brute Force crushes Underhanded, Softness deflects Brute Force, Righteous Yang purges Underhanded, and Unorthodox strikes bypass Softness. Combat is a fluid dance of interconnected passives: Counters, Parries, and Ambidexterity.

Dual-Track Social System: Forge your own path. Align with one of 8 Sects (e.g., Shaolin, Wudang, Tang Clan) and simultaneously pledge loyalty to a Faction (e.g., Six Doors, Ming Cult, Sun Moon Holy Cult). Sect Contribution and Faction Reputation operate on completely independent tracks.

Hyper-Realistic Environmental Combat: The world reacts to you. Fight across 12 double-hours, 4 seasons, and 9 dynamic weather conditions. Thunderstorms amplify Lightning arts, Sandstorms blind your strikes, and Fog obscures friend from foe.

Infinite Replayability: No two journeys are alike. Dive into 14 branching random encounters, conquer 8 treacherous dungeon realms, and participate in 6 massive world events (Sect Tournaments, Demonic Invasions, Heroes' Gatherings).

Reincarnation & Legacy: Death is merely a new beginning. Reincarnate at level 50+ to inherit a permanent +10% base stat boost per cycle. Unlock cross-run progression at 1, 2, 3, 5, and 10 reincarnations, carrying over Martial Arts, Talents, and Past-Life Memories.

Hybrid Control Scheme: Play your way. Seamlessly switch between point-and-click GUI and classic MUD text commands (look, north, attack, escort). Full English and Chinese synonym support included.

Main Gameplay Systems

Martial Arts, Meridians & Talents: A Trifecta of Power

Martial Arts: Master 4 disciplines (External, Internal, Movement, Ultimate) across 7 weapon types (Sword, Blade, Fist, Palm, Kick, Hidden Weapons, Exotic). Progress through Sect-exclusive chains from Beginner to Ultimate.

Meridians: Cultivate 12 Primary and 8 Extraordinary Meridians across 100+ acupoints. Align your Primary Meridians to unlock the Extraordinary. Fully unblocking your network grants massive bonuses (e.g., +200 Max HP) via an immersive Meridian Circulation mini-game.

Talents: Customize your build with 12 freely mixable talents across Combat, Life Skills, and Special categories. Reincarnation and achievements unlock legacy perks like Nine-Turn Golden Body.

Dual Affiliation: Sects & Factions

8 Major Sects: Experience unique philosophies—from Shaolin’s Zen Martial Arts and Wudang’s Daoist Arts to the Blood Knife’s Bloodlust and Tang Clan’s Hidden Weapons. At level 30 with 5,000 Gold, you can even Found Your Own Sect.

6 Major Factions: Navigate the strict Righteous and Evil alignments. Entry requires Karma thresholds. Earn Faction Contribution to unlock exclusive arsenals (e.g., Embroidered Uniform Sabers, White Lotus Firearms).

The Three Pillars of Adventure

Escort Missions: Navigate 4 dynamic routes across 4 quality tiers (Normal to Precious). Brace for random bandit ambushes. (3 daily attempts).

Dungeons: Clear 8 secret realms (e.g., Ancient Tomb Labyrinth, Ten Thousand Poison Swamp) across 4 difficulty tiers. Loot scales with your floor-clearing performance.

Encounters: Trigger 14 event types with branching narratives (Sword Demon Accepts Disciple, Stone Trough Transmits Power). Your Comprehension, Inventory, and past relationships actively shape the outcomes.

A Living, Breathing Ecosystem

6-Tier Reputation System: Balance your Karma across Righteous, Evil, Government, Greenwood (Outlaws), Sect, and Lone Wanderer. Reputation is a zero-sum game—gaining one side's favor will inevitably anger the other.

Dynamic Relationship Web: Build affinity to Apprentice (≥50), Sworn Brotherhood (≥70), or Marry (≥80). Relationships ripple through the world: Friend’s Friend, Friend’s Enemy, and Enemy’s Enemy all trigger chain reactions.

Earned Titles: Your deeds precede you. Automatically unlock 11 stat-boosting titles based on Karma and achievements, such as Lone Wanderer for a Thousand Miles, Timely Rain, Slaughter God, or Most Wanted.

Authentic NPC AI: NPCs live real lives. They sleep, patrol, gather, and trade on a 12-shichen clock. Defeated foes respawn after a set time, and hostile factions will clash autonomously on sight.

️ Life Skills & Mini-Games

7 Life Skills: Master Fishing, Mining, Logging, Farming, Cooking, Forging, and Alchemy (Max Level 100). Terrain validation applies (e.g., Fishing requires water).

4 Immersive Mini-Games: Test your reflexes and focus in Fishing, Alchemy Fire Control, Cooking Stir-Fry, and Meridian Circulation. Score ≥0.8 to double your crafting output!

A World in Constant Evolution

6 Recurring World Events: The Jianghu breathes with global events: Sect Tournament (90 days), Heroes' Gathering (180 days, 2x EXP), Merchant Caravan (30 days, 30% off), Secret Realm Opening (60 days, 3x drops), Demonic Cult Invasion (120 days), and Bandit Raids (45 days). Each follows a 3-phase schedule (Announcement → Active → Conclusion), globally impacting EXP, discounts, spawns, and loot.

Dynamic Time & Weather: 60 in-game days = 1 year of age. Actions cost time (Move: 1 ke, Combat: 1 ke, Gather: 2 ke). Harsh weather increases action costs.

Visual Weather Shaders: Experience 9 weather types (Clear, Cloudy, Overcast, Light/Heavy Rain, Thunderstorm, Snow, Fog, Sandstorm) with seasonal modifiers and nighttime fog brought to life via custom shaders.

True Offline Progression: Your journey never stops. 1 real-life minute = 1 in-game ke. Capped at 8 real hours (5 in-game days). Even when AFK, your character continues to grow!

store_data.about_the_game:
Less than a year after a deadly plague wiped out most of humanity, survivors still roam the country, each following their own personal journey. Along the way, they establish Safe Zones: temporary shelters where they can catch their breath, recover their strength, and prepare for whatever comes next. You are one of these Safe Zones.

Survivor stories

Survivors will come and go, each bringing their own stories, resources, and needs. Get to know them, discover where they've come from and where they're headed, and create a cozy place where they can rest and feel safe.

Some will stay for a while. Others will eventually move on, perhaps never to return. But every encounter matters, and the memories you make together will stay with you.

The end of the world can be comfortable

As survivors pass through your Safe Zone, they will bring more and more objects for you to use. Arrange and decorate your shelter, making it a place that is both beautiful and comfortable.

Customize your walls, arrange your rooms, and create comfy spaces for your survivors. There's no right way to build a Safe Zone, make it yours.

Apocalypse & Chill

In Safe Zone, there's no rush. Take all the time you need to accomplish your objectives, arrange your shelter, and make your survivors feel at home.

Sit back and watch them enjoy the Safe Zone you've built, or take a moment to look around and uncover more about the plague and the world it left behind.

You come to your senses in a late-night office building. You don't know why you're here, or since when. All you know is what's written on a single sheet of paper pinned to the bulletin board on the wall.

・Multiple endings and 16 Achievements
・One run takes roughly 15–60 minutes

store_data.about_the_game:
Human worth is measured by reputation.

Once, everyone was talking about you. Then they forgot you. When your reputation score dropped to zero, the Ministry of Social Harmony sent you to an isolated container suspended above the ocean.

In this world, visibility is a person's most valuable asset. When attention fades, so does reputation. Those whose reputation reaches zero are removed from society.

RepCell is a choice-driven, text-based dystopian experience about survival, reputation, and the cost of being seen.

Trapped inside a suspended container, you must survive each day while the system monitors your reputation and controls your access to society. Manage your limited supplies, keep yourself alive, respond to events and trending topics, and decide how you will react to the situations presented by the system.

Your choices have consequences.

The decisions you make can change your reputation, affect your physical condition, consume or preserve your limited resources, and influence the events that follow. Some choices may help you regain visibility, while others may push you further into isolation.

Not every consequence is immediately visible. Hidden variables track your behavior throughout the game, quietly shaping events and determining which outcomes become possible. The way you remain silent, respond to treatment, criticize the system, or seek approval can all influence your path.

Every day brings new situations and new decisions. There is no single correct way to play. You must decide what matters more: staying alive, maintaining your reputation, following the system's expectations, or refusing to become what it demands.

Sometimes, the price of becoming visible again is losing a part of yourself.

Features

• Choice-driven dynamic narrative with consequences that carry through your playthrough.

• Multiple endings determined by your decisions, behavior, and hidden variables.

• Reputation, health, and resource management that force you to balance survival against the demands of the system.

• Daily events and changing trends that present new situations and choices.

• Hidden behavioral variables that quietly influence events and create different playthroughs.

• A text-based gameplay experience focused on reading, decision-making, resource management, and consequence.

• A single-player dystopian story where your choices determine how your story ends.

In this world, people are not punished for breaking the law.

They are punished for being forgotten.

Manage your limited supplies, keep yourself alive, respond to events and trending topics, and decide how you will react to the situations presented by the system.

Your choices have consequences.

The decisions you make can change your reputation, affect your physical condition, consume or preserve your limited resources, and influence the events that follow. Some choices may help you regain visibility, while others may push you further into isolation.

Not every consequence is immediately visible. Hidden variables track your behavior throughout the game, quietly shaping events and determining which outcomes become possible. The way you remain silent, respond to treatment, criticize the system, or seek approval can all influence your path.

Every day brings new situations and new decisions. There is no single correct way to play. You must decide what matters more: staying alive, maintaining your reputation, following the system's expectations, or refusing to become what it demands.

Sometimes, the price of becoming visible again is losing a part of yourself.

Features

• Choice-driven dynamic narrative with consequences that carry through your playthrough.

• Multiple endings determined by your decisions, behavior, and hidden variables.

• Reputation, health, and resource management that force you to balance survival against the demands of the system.

• Daily events and changing trends that present new situations and choices.

• Hidden behavioral variables that quietly influence events and create different playthroughs.

• A text-based gameplay experience focused on reading, decision-making, resource management, and consequence.

• A single-player dystopian story where your choices determine how your story ends.

In this world, people are not punished for breaking the law.

They are punished for being forgotten.

Rocket Science is a fast-paced VR action sports game where players fly through futuristic arenas, fire rockets, blast opponents, and score goals by launching a physics-driven ball into the opposing team’s goal.

Victory requires more than accurate shooting. Control the ball, defend your goal, collect special powers, manage your ammunition, and work with your teammates to dominate the arena.

Move freely through the arena using intuitive VR controls. Chase the ball, intercept enemy attacks, and use your rockets to change the direction of the match at any moment.

Rockets can be used to attack opponents, defend your team, and send the ball flying toward the goal.

Collect powerful abilities during the match and use them at the right moment.

這是一款獸娘，機械妹，克蘇魯，福利拉滿的美少女養成遊戲（LSP專屬）；

新玩家送3650抽，限定角色也會添加到常駐池子，肯肝，白漂全角色無壓力；

超過100W字的劇情對白，可作為小說沉浸式體驗，非常適合休閒養老玩家；

【危機爆發，綠洲聯盟成立】

傳說冒險城有位學者名為希貝兒，在森林神秘遺蹟的祭壇旁發現了一隻死去的遠古寄生蟲，提取出一種罕見的“深淵病毒”，不僅能使生物體基因加速進化，並且擁有極強的生命力。

著名董事長卡特曾痛失女兒，為復活女兒，出資成立雪山生化科技公司，聘用希貝兒擔任公司高管，開始研究 “深淵病毒”。

卡特急於讓女兒復活，開始秘密進行人體試驗。一次試驗意外，發生病毒洩漏事故，工作人員和實驗生物體相繼被感染，並擴散到城市，整個世界陷入危機之中。

自此，危機爆發，人類數量驟減。

殘存的人類組織成立“綠洲”聯盟，建立基地應對危機，用高牆保護人類的安全。

【四大種族，聯合對抗行動】

信奉科技、知識的富有人類選擇用科技武裝自己的身體，成為的機械族，擁有基地內絕對的指揮權。機械族壓迫著一批善良、追求正義的人類，他們統稱為新人類。由於資源的稀缺，兩個勢力矛盾不斷被激化。

隱居在森林深處的原始半獸族生存受到威脅，為了維護自然和諧的信仰，出現在世人面前，與危機做鬥爭。

邪惡的進化種不斷進攻高牆，“綠洲”聯盟立法允許部分半獸族、稀少善良的進化種加入了綠洲聯盟基地，用來增加對抗進化種的隊伍。

【收集基因，抵抗進化威脅】

希貝兒利用雪山生化科技公司的財產，把在雪山的廢棄研發中心改造成為避難所，收集基因樣本以研究高級的病毒。

“綠洲”聯盟派遣冒險少女月歌一行人調查避難所，卻被敵人困住，以避難所為掩護，展開保障自身安全的戰鬥。

正當月歌正處於危難時刻，玩家指揮官意外地擊敗了它們，被少女們推選成為避難所的總指揮官，並決定留下來幫助她們收集基因樣本，完成“綠洲”聯盟研究免疫病毒所需要的數量。

而此時此刻開始，指揮官在故事中便不斷改寫著歷史.....

冒險世界的危機迫在眉睫，而新的生活也即將開始，那麼各位指揮官，你準備好帶領少女們開始冒險了嗎？

store_data.about_the_game:
Restore Order To The Last Video Store

The shelves are a disaster, the tapes are everywhere, and the store opens soon. As the new clerk of a retro video store, your job is simple to say and hard to master: pick up every scattered movie tape, read its title, figure out its genre, and place it on the right shelf. No labels, no hints — just your movie instincts. Your survival behind the counter depends not on speed alone, but on how well you read every title that lands in your hands.

Every Tape Belongs Somewhere

From Blood Cabin to Quantum Drift, hundreds of original movies — and their sequels — are waiting to be shelved. Horror, Sci-Fi, Comedy, Romance, Action, Thriller, Fantasy and many more genres each have their own dedicated shelves. Guess right and the shelf glows green. Guess wrong and it flashes red, and the mess wins another round. Some titles are obvious, some will make you stop and think, and a few will fool you completely.

Every Placement Matters

Efficiency is everything. Plan your route through the aisles, decide which tapes to grab first, and keep sequels together — Part 1, 2 and 3 of a series are scattered all over the store, waiting to be reunited on the same shelf. Complete a full shelf to lock in your progress and push the store one step closer to perfect order. Hasty guesses waste time; smart sorting wins the day.

Play Solo Or Team Up

Enjoy the calm, cozy satisfaction of sorting alone, or invite your friends into 2-4 player co-op and turn tidying into beautiful chaos. Split the aisles, call out genres, pass tapes down the line — teamwork gets the store spotless faster... in theory.

Grow Your Skills

Completing shelves and earning XP unlocks abilities that make you a sharper, faster clerk. Carry more tapes at once, spot genres quicker, move faster between aisles, and build your own strategy for turning a mountain of cassettes into perfect order.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cat Bar​ is a cozy bar simulation where you step into the paws of a professional mixologist. Craft unique cocktails tailored to each feline customer's mood and preferences! Master every step of the business—from sourcing rare ingredients to stocking shelves and serving drinks. Grab a friend for local co-op play and share the joy (and chaos) of managing your very own purr-fect tavern!

Ditch the recipe book—you are the master mixologist.

Leverage our nuanced "Emotion Mixology System"​ to read subtle facial cues and real-time moods, blending a vast library of spirits and mixers to perfection. From classic Mojitos to surreal dream concoctions, every shake triggers a unique chemical reaction. Listen closely, seize the spark of inspiration, and craft the flawless masterpiece that leaves every patron absolutely stunned.

Local Co-op: Double the Hands, Half the Chaos.

Grab a friend for seamless local split-screen action! Divide and conquer—while one of you shakes the tins, the other manages the till. Activate synergistic Buffs to watch your profits skyrocket! This isn’t just a job; it’s the ultimate test of teamwork where twice the synergy leads to twice the riches. Get ready for the purr-fect partnership!

More than just a bar—a sanctuary woven by humans and cats alike.

In Cat Bar, every pour is an act of healing, and every feline regular holds a story begging to be heard. Now, tie on your apron, turn the key, and step inside. Your leisurely escape is about to begin.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a dynasty across seven ages

Start with simple tools and a small settlement. Secure resources, establish an economy, and work

through an extensive technology tree that takes your civilization into the modern era.

Create your own civilization

Combine unit lines, building options, technologies, and modules to shape a civilization around your

strategy. Specialize in a powerful economy, fortified positions, mobile armies, or naval and aerial

dominance.

Fight on land, at sea, and in the air

Command infantry, cavalry, siege weapons, ships, submarines, and aircraft. Terrain, elevation, and

army composition influence the course of every battle.

Reshape a destructible voxel world

Buildings and terrain are part of the battlefield. Fire, smoke, craters, and terrain deformation

make the consequences of major battles visible.

Play alone or with others

Face AI opponents or play classic matches with up to eight players. Deterministic lockstep keeps the

same simulation running for every participant and continuously verifies the game state.

Take direct control in Hero Mode

Switch from the strategic view to direct control of an eligible unit while the rest of the battle

continues around you.

VoxelDynasties is developed by a solo developer using a custom Java engine.
