store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Your Dream Shop

Step inside Storehand, a relaxing organization sim where retail chaos becomes cozy therapy. After an avalanche of inventory hits the floor, it’s up to you to sort through the mess and restore pristine order to every shelf. Take your time, put on your favorite tracks, and settle into the ultimate stocking and tidying experience.

Tackle Massive Retail Messes

Face down the cleanup job of a lifetime. Sort, flip, and arrange 6,298 grocery items scattered across the store. From colorful snack bags to neatly boxed goods, every item has a home: you just have to help it get there.

Map Your Custom Aisles

Design your store layout your way. Set aisle categories as you place your first items, giving you full freedom to decide what belongs where. Chips next to cereal? Candy across from pasta? Build the shopping experience that makes sense to you.

Pure, Satisfying Grid Snapping

Feel the dopamine hit of a perfectly stocked shelf. Items snap into a clean, readable grid that makes facing, stacking, and aligning effortless. Want to cut loose without the boss noticing? Switch to Free Placement Mode to place items anywhere for fun or chaos. Bowling with a flour bag has never been more satisfying.

Unlock Helpful Abilities

As you tidy the store, unlock abilities that make stocking smoother and more strategic. Pull the exact items you need out of a mess, push clutter aside to clear space, highlight matching items across the store, or reveal exactly where your held item belongs. Your talents make the job feel better every step of the way.

Add Storehand to your Wishlist to get notified when we launch on August 12!

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Arena of Blood and Sand.

Set in a medieval Roman arena, this game tells the story of 15 slave gladiators, each with their own backstory. On this harsh battlefield swept by sandstorms, assemble your own mercenary squad and become the last survivor.

Anticipate and Dodge: Physics-Based Simultaneous Turn-Based Combat

Realistic Physics: This isn’t just a simple probability system. Attacks and defenses are determined by whether the character’s hitbox and the weapon’s physics collider actually collide.

Breathtaking Psychological Warfare: Experience the thrill of combat by predicting the physical trajectory of your opponent’s attacks to dodge, or by exploiting their weaknesses to strike from behind.

Strategic AP System: Utilize a total of four types of skills. AP (Attack Points), required to use skills, recovers at a rate of 1 every 3 turns, so careful resource management determines victory or defeat.

15 Heroes, Each with Their Own Story and Struggle

Charismatic Character Roster: One male hero who survived a harsh world and 14 powerful female gladiators await your choice.

Unique Identities: From “Valerius of the Immortal Dawn” to “Iris, the Wolf of Twilight,” every gladiator is more than just a soldier—they are heroes with their own epithets and profound backstories.

Boundless Battlefields: Various game modes, including single-player and multiplayer

Flexible Match Settings: Deploy any number of mercenaries—from 1 to 3—and enjoy a variety of modes, ranging from 1-on-1 duels to chaotic 1-on-1-on-1-on-1 deathmatches.

Clever Combat AI: Melee AI and ranged AI that keeps its distance and looks for openings will test your limits.

Multiplayer: As a free-to-play game, you can play with users from around the world without any pressure.

Translated with (free version)

In Stick Legion your income isn't a spreadsheet — it's a battle line. Every warrior you recruit walks onto the field, fights, and dies gloriously so the next rank can push further.

store_data.about_the_game:
Embark on a grind-free legendary adventure across a mechanical continent woven with gears and steam. *Idle Vapor Legends* is an idle RPG focused on AFK combat and effortless loot collection. Step into the boots of a steam-era adventurer, and fight automatically on the never-ceasing mechanical battlefields. No need to keep your eyes glued to the screen — progress steadily through background idling, and seamlessly balance work, daily life and your grand adventure.

The game features a sprawling equipment system spanning common, legendary and mythic tiers. With dozens of equipment slots and hundreds of unique items, each piece comes with its own set of attributes. Every loot drop carries the potential for a pleasant surprise, letting you gradually assemble and refine your very own powerful loadout.

Three core skill systems and free-form build crafting lie at the heart of *Idle Vapor Legends*. The game offers dozens of active and passive skills across three distinct archetypes: Warrior, Mage and Taoist. Mix and match skills freely with equipment affixes to create wildly different combat styles — from critical burst builds and life-steal sustain builds to stalwart tank builds.

Whether you are a casual player who enjoys relaxed loot collection, or a hardcore enthusiast who loves deep build experimentation, you will find a rhythm that fits your playstyle. When you want to dive deeper, you can polish your builds to perfection, challenge high-tier dungeons and climb the power leaderboards. Amid the ever-turning steam gears, forge your very own legendary tale.

store_data.about_the_game:
While you work, your monsters fight.

TASMON: Taskbar Monsters is an idle RPG that lives in your desktop taskbar. Whether you're working or asleep, your party of three auto-battles on its own — bringing back eggs and loot. Pop in now and then to retune your team and hunt for perfect rolls. That's it.

🥚 Collect 156 monsters

Hatch eggs, evolve and awaken them. Ten rarity tiers (Common → … → Celestial), with fewer species at the top so chasing a specific one never loses its value. New species keep arriving with every update.

⚡ Awakened forms change everything

A six-stage awakening ladder: same-species guarantees +1 stage, off-species is a shard-based roll. Max out Awakening VI and your monster ascends into a Soul-Sealed Weapon — a one-of-a-kind armament, stamped with its own serial number, that exists nowhere else in the world.

🎲 Loot-hunt depth with fully disclosed odds

Gear combines drops, two slots, option rows and unique effects. Fuse nine into one with the Cube, re-roll to min-max, and push numbers further with etching . Every drop rate is disclosed in-game.

🔥 Elemental strategy that never soft-locks you

A fire/water/wind/earth cycle (+35% advantage / −25% disadvantage) plus light/dark. In the "Gauntlet" stages from Hell onward, incoming damage spikes hard — you'll need elemental defense or a resistance team to survive. Brute-force with awakened power, or out-strategize with typing: both routes clear it. Four difficulties: Normal → Nightmare → Hell → Torment.

🗳 A game we build together

・Send feedback in one click from the in-game Suggestion Box — you don't even have to leave the game

・Weekly updates are prioritized from player voices. New monsters, balance, UI — what gets built next starts with you

・Implemented suggestions are credited every week in-game and in Steam announcements. Your one-liner becomes the next patch note

Free to play. Languages: Japanese / English.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rule the vampire court that holds the city in its grip.

The Darker Night: Regent City is a political strategy and vampire regency simulation about ruling a gothic city from the shadows. Balance five factions, claim and manage buildings as holdings, shape your court, and decide which vampires deserve power. Every ruling can create consequences that return later — to you, to your court, or to the next Regent who inherits what you leave behind.

This is not a road-drawing sandbox. It is a strategy game about power, place, succession, and consequence.

Shape the Court

The city is contested by five rival powers, each with its own demands, loyalties, and pressure on your reign. Favor one faction too often and the others will remember. Keep them balanced — or choose who you are willing to anger.

Characters are not interchangeable bonuses. They carry talents, loyalties, ambitions, and grudges into your court. Turn new vampires, assign them to holdings, lean on their strengths, and decide who deserves to survive the reign.

When a Regent falls, the bloodline continues.

Every building is a real holding

The city board is not scenery. Clubs, markets, occult sites, shelters, and civic landmarks are all playable locations. Claim blood sources, assign managers, inspect local matters, and decide which places are worth protecting.

Your empire is built from specific buildings, not abstract tiles.

Your Court does not forget

Ministries pressure you. Characters argue from their own loyalties. A single ruling can open a story thread that returns nights later.

Choose who gains power.

Choose who pays the cost.

Then live with what the city remembers.

Emergent stories through consequences

Investigations can fail. Factions can retaliate. Promises can rot into curses.

Regent City is built around emergent stories through consequences: the things you do create persistent threads, and those threads can return when the timing is worst.

Features

- Rule a gothic vampire city through strategic decisions and court politics

- Balance power between five factions competing for control

- Claim exact city buildings as playable holdings

- Rebuild locations to reshape your economy, blood supply, and inheritance

- Manage a court of distinct vampire characters with talents and loyalties

- Watch consequences unfold across events, investigations, factions, and reigns

- Build a lineage where each Regent inherits the city you changed

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

When the world loses all of its art, what remains of humanity?

One day, a catastrophe known as "The Great Blank Event" swept across the globe.

Every painting, sculpture, film, piece of music, and work of literature vanished without a trace—all on the same day.

Meanwhile, artificial intelligence advanced at an unprecedented pace. It took control of art, technology, the economy, and even politics. Humanity gradually stopped thinking for itself and entrusted its future to machines.

You are nothing more than an unknown painter.

After losing a prestigious international art competition to an AI-generated painting, you abandon both your brush and your purpose in life.

Everything changes when a mysterious black-haired girl dressed as a maid knocks on your door.

She claims to be an artificial intelligence, yet possesses emotions that even humans struggle to understand.

From that moment on, you are drawn into secret government projects, a resistance movement, and a conspiracy buried deep within human history.

Where did the world's missing artworks go?

Why are governments willing to do anything to hide the truth?

And why have you become the target of every faction?

As human civilization is slowly replaced by artificial intelligence, can you prove one final truth—

The power to create miracles has never belonged to machines. It has always belonged to humanity.

store_data.about_the_game:
TUYA is a 2D adventure puzzle game following a lone girl and her bow.

Journey across windswept grasslands, shadowed caves, and long-dormant ruins as TUYA follows the traces of those who disappeared.

Her bow is not a weapon for defeating enemies. Use arrows to awaken distant cores and ancient mechanisms, move pillars and platforms, and create a path forward.

Each activated ruin brings more than old machinery back to life. Within its blue light, TUYA begins to confront the memories she has tried to leave behind.

KEY FEATURES

  • Solve environmental puzzles using arrows and wind.

  • Progress through observation, aiming, timing, and movement rather than combat.

  • Experience a wordless story told through scenery, animation, and sound.

  • Explore atmospheric grasslands, caves, and ancient ruins.

  • Learn new abilities that gradually expand exploration and puzzle-solving.

store_data.about_the_game:
Three female students from the occult club at Shimokawa University—located a short distance from the city—have arrived at CATTY PARK, a theme park situated on a remote island far from the main island of Honshu. Due to its poor accessibility, visitor numbers had dwindled, leading to the park's eventual closure.

On the final day of operations, the trio enjoyed the park right up until closing time—only to find themselves trapped inside following an unexpected mishap!

As it turns out, rumors have long circulated that this theme park is haunted by ghosts...

This is a point-and-click horror game set in a world inspired by modern Japan.

The story is a work of fiction incorporating ghosts and occult elements.

The game is controlled exclusively via mouse; keyboard input is not supported.

An instruction manual is available within the game; please read it thoroughly before playing.

At night, the trapped theme park transforms into a deadly, isolated zone where ghosts roam...

Work together to escape safely without falling victim to the ghosts!

Why do ghosts appear at CATTY PARK?

Find the vital documents needed to unravel the mystery!

・Watch out for randomly placed items!

The placement of items on the map changes with every playthrough...

Scour every corner of the map to find the items necessary for your escape!

～Important Notes～

This work contains depictions of character death.

Please be aware that the content is not suitable for all ages.

You do not need to obtain permission from the publisher to post Let's Play videos or stream this game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sit down, put your headphones on, and let a submarine keep you company while you focus.

Dive Log: A Focus Voyage is a productivity timer built around a deep-sea voyage. Pick the timing mode that suits you, hit Set Sail, then get on with the work in front of you.

Your submarine dives while you focus, and comes back from every session with a hold full of treasure.

Pick your timer

Four timing modes: Focus Sessions (the classic pomodoro cycle), Deep Focus, Stopwatch and Custom Time. Focus and break lengths are yours to set, so each run fits the state you're in.

Tools for the working day

A to-do list, quick notes, a voyage diary and an alarm are all built in. Keep track of what you're working on, catch an idea the moment it lands, and write down how the day went to read back later. Your submarine's own progress is recorded alongside it.

Focus and grow

While you focus, your submarine trawls the depths and hauls in treasures and materials. Once a voyage ends, spend what it brought back on upgrades and new seas, and fill your codex with over two hundred treasures.

Make the sea your own

Music and white noise are included, and you can load in your own audio files. Even the alarm sound can be swapped out.

The treasures in the sea can be your own work too. The built-in treasure editor takes you from uploading an image to a finished piece without leaving the game or touching a single file, and you can publish straight to the Steam Workshop. Subscribe to what other captains have made and their treasures join your sea.

KEY FEATURES

・Four timing modes: Focus Sessions, Deep Focus (focus blocks run back to back, breaks saved for the end), Stopwatch and Custom Time, plus plenty of options for tuning the cycle.

・While you focus on real work, your submarine explores the seafloor and picks up treasures and materials along the way.

・Spend what your submarine brings back on part upgrades and fresh paint, and open up five seas, each with its own story and treasures.

・Collect over two hundred treasures and fill up the codex. Every sea hides a relic of its own!

・49 achievements covering focus hours, submarine progress and collecting. The counters keep climbing after you unlock them, so the work you put in still gets recorded.

・Open the diary any time to see each day's focus time and submarine progress, with weekly and monthly totals put together for you.

・The sky and the weather follow the real time of day, or you can pin the light to morning, noon, dusk or night.

・Custom audio files: music, white noise and the alarm sound can all be swapped for your own.

・Treasure editor: upload an image, write the description, and design a treasure of your own inside the game. No coding required.

・Steam Workshop: publish your treasure packs without leaving the game, and subscribe to what other players have made.

・Mini Mode: shrink the window into a corner of your desktop and keep the timer, your to-do list and your submarine in view.

・Steam Cloud saves supported.

In everyday life, finishing something rarely gives much back right away.

That's the gap Dive Log fills: the time you spend concentrating turns into a voyage and a hold full of treasure.

Roll the egg to the goal.

Reach the goal within the allotted number of attempts to clear the stage.

Clear 10 stages in a row to complete the game.

If you fail to reach the goal within the allowed attempts or fall off the stage, you fail.

If you fail at any point, you'll have to start over from the very first stage.

Approximately 10–60 minutes

■Casual Mode

In Casual Mode, failing a stage will not send you back to the beginning.

Instead, you can retry from the same stage.

If you're having trouble clearing the game, feel free to use this mode.

store_data.about_the_game:
One Monster Is Always Behind You

This is a fast-paced 2D horror action runner. Your character runs forward automatically while a single enormous, grotesque monster chases from behind. If it catches you, the attempt ends immediately.

Every Enemy Is a Choice

Enemies block the road ahead. Knock them back with your sword or jump over them to avoid the fight. A well-timed slash can also send incoming projectiles back at their attackers.

Defeated enemies drop resources that can make you stronger. Skipping a fight is safer now, but gives you less to spend later.

Build with Parasites

Each attempt is divided into short sections. Between them, spend the resources you collected to attach new parasites to your character.

The parasites cling to your back and extend like tentacles. They activate their abilities automatically, attacking enemies, spreading poison, or briefly increasing your running speed. Try different combinations and decide which abilities work best together.

As you progress, you will also choose between taking an immediate upgrade or facing a stronger enemy for a greater reward.

Charge Overheat by Attacking

Every successful sword hit fills the Overheat gauge. Once it is full, activate it to surge forward, damage and push back enemies, and trigger all equipped parasites at the same time.

Accurate attacks give you more than damage. They also create precious distance from the monster behind you.

Bosses Block the Road

During a boss fight, the boss stands ahead while the monster continues to approach from behind. You cannot jump over the boss.

Your attacks push the boss away, but letting it get too close will force you backward. Defeat it before you are pushed into the pursuing monster.

Horror That Keeps Moving

The game does not rely on creatures suddenly appearing on the screen to startle you. Its tension comes from the monster constantly closing in, creatures with impossible bodies, and distorted visuals and sound.

Instead of hiding and waiting, you survive by fighting and continuing forward.

store_data.about_the_game:
On the Night of Shimmering, a meteor shattered the moon's seal, and chaos descended...

The old era burned as fuel for a new age. Corruption consumed the world. Only the Divine Trees remained to shelter humanity—and around them, the Stillgaze Association was founded, seeking a way to rebuild.

As Elio, a guard captain sent to a remote mountain village, you return with your sister Elira to find it engulfed in flames.

Different weapon types carry their own independent skill sets and unique attack animations, with each weapon featuring its own distinct visual model. In battle, Elio can switch between multiple weapons on the fly, using different skill combinations. Within the same turn, skills from different weapons can be chained into special combos, triggering bonus damage or additional effects.

Our game is built on a classic turn-based combat framework, centered around weapon switching, skill combinations, and sequence advancement. Every battle tests your strategy, your loadout, your exploration, and your growth.

Each boss features unique mechanics—not just inflated HP and damage. Understand the mechanics and respond correctly, and a grueling fight becomes a swift victory. Ignore them, and you'll be dragged into a war of attrition.

  • Some bosses require specific weapon chains to break their shields.

  • Some bosses must be interrupted at specific phases by using certain skills or breaking their cores.

  • Some boss mechanics require coordinated actions from multiple characters.

store_data.about_the_game:
Get to know the networking devices you only see in theory. Open up rack cabinets in the server room and inspect switch and router interfaces. Grab the RJ45 ethernet cables, scale up the ports, and experience firsthand that establishing physical connections is the first and most critical step in data transmission.

Log in to a virtual PuTTY console terminal heavily inspired by industry-standard systems. Master the authorization process using the `enable` command, and implement fundamental network management practices—such as VLAN configuration, secure remote access via SSH, and NAT protocols—by entering your own commands.

Learn to monitor network traffic and make the right calls during a crisis. Read anomaly signals from the Cyber Threat Map, solve log analysis mechanisms, and apply the exact steps needed to protect the Server Farm within a realistic corporate scenario.

Grasp the logic behind security vulnerabilities. Examine popular exploit types like SQL Injection and XSS to understand how a system can be hacked. Gain a defense-oriented (Blue Team) cybersecurity mindset by applying security patches to close these vulnerabilities.

store_data.about_the_game:
Become a Legend. Build a Legacy.

Take control of your football destiny in Aussie Rules Legend, a deep Australian Rules Football career and management game inspired by the classics while delivering decades of gameplay, strategy and history.

Whether you dream of becoming the competition's greatest player or coaching your club to a dynasty of premierships, every season shapes your legacy. Every award, every draft pick and every premiership becomes part of a living football world that evolves over time.

Play Australian Rules Football

Experience fast-paced 18 vs 18 Australian Rules Football with marking contests, tackles, ruck duels, set shots, fatigue, injuries, player statistics and realistic match simulation.

Choose to play every game yourself or let the match engine simulate the action while you focus on building your club.

Two Complete Career Modes

Player Career

Create your own footballer and begin your journey as a rookie.

Develop your skills, earn selection, chase individual honours and work your way from promising youngster to Hall of Famer... and if you're truly exceptional, achieve the game's highest honour — Legend status.

Coaching Career

Build a club across up to 50 seasons.

Recruit through the draft, manage your list, develop future stars, chase premierships and cement your place among the greatest coaches in football history.

Build Your Own Football World

Create your own competition with fully customisable:

  • Clubs

  • Players

  • Coaches

  • Team colours

  • Jumpers

  • League data

Import and export your creations to build the football world you want - with Workshop support to share and download.

Every Season Creates History

League history is permanently recorded throughout your careers.

store_data.about_the_game:
Subversive is a story-driven top-down shooter where death connects a dystopian, dictatorial version of America set in the near future with a supernatural world governed by its own rules.

The game draws inspiration from titles such as Half-Life 2, Undertale, and Hotline Miami, but it isn't truly similar to any of them. In fact, it doesn't fit neatly into any existing genre.

Gameplay combines gunfights, puzzles, boss fights, and exploration, all of which influence the course of the story.

The game takes place across two interconnected worlds, which the player transitions between upon death. The first is a dystopian near-future version of our own world, where World War III is on the verge of becoming a nuclear conflict. The second is a world that transcends the first, where the laws of physics work differently.

Throughout the game, the player acquires conventional weapons in the first world and supernatural abilities in the second, both of which can be used in either world.

You play as Public Enemy Number One in a dictatorial version of America. Your goal is to fight for freedom, stop World War III, and liberate the country from its authoritarian regime. However, nobody can stop you from using your abilities to pursue your own agenda.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Dual-Faced Deckbuilder of Yin and Yang

Shanhai Exorcist: Yin-Yang Chronicles is a single-player turn-based roguelike deckbuilder set in a world of exorcists, spirits, and demons. Choose a school, build a focused deck, read each enemy's intent, and decide when to press your advantage or prepare for the next attack.

Flip Every Card

Cards have Yin and Yang faces with different costs and effects. Flip a card to change its role, then manage your Taiji state and Qi to shape the turn you need. A defensive card can become an attack, a setup card can become a payoff, and the right sequence can turn a dangerous round into a decisive finish.

Choose One of Four Schools

Sword Cultivator — Build Sword Intent, Unsheathe, chain strikes, then Sheathe before greed leaves you exposed.

Five Phases — Place elemental Seals, work with Generation and Overcoming, then trigger Resonance.

Summoner — Deploy familiars, change their positions, issue Commands, and choose when to Sacrifice them.

Karma — Record Causes and Karma Debts, let them mature, then settle them at the right moment.

Read the Enemy, Then Commit

Enemy intents reveal incoming attacks, defenses, counters, and disruptive moves. Plan around what is coming, protect the resources your deck needs, and recognize the window for a finishing sequence.

Shape Every Run

Travel across branching routes, take on battles and high-pressure encounters, and improve your deck with new cards, Artifacts, and Elixirs. Normal, Hard, and Nightmare difficulties let you choose how demanding the climb should be.

Keep Track of Your Progress

Manage run saves from the main menu, review discovered cards and enemies in the Codex, and check long-term records in the Career screen.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Untitled Shop Game!

MANAGE YOUR OWN SHOP

Start with a small area, one shelf and just few licences. Earn money and complete simple missions to unlock new products to sell. Hire workers to make things easier and don't forget to pay your bills.

UNIQUE TUTORIAL SYSTEM

Nothing is more annoying than forced tutorials, right? That's why you have an adorable assistant: android named Julia. If you need help, just ask her: how to order goods, how to change the price of products or what to do with thievs? She knows it all. Oh, one more thing. She's more than a animated tutorial. You can talk to her about her, some random topics or about you. Julia happens to be surprisingly curious.

UNLEASH YOUR CREATIVITY

The area around your shop is empty at first, but you can place dozens of different decorations to make it truly "your place." Just look at this example playground. Oh, that's not all! We've prepared two... yes... two houses for you! One of them has no interior walls. Why? Because you can buy them and decide the layout! 

A CITY THAT LIVES

Walk around a small section of a fictional Polish city that lives: animated traffic, planes, NPCs wandering around the area. Talk to strangers about various topics. Untitled Shop Game uses the dialogue system known from Disco Elysium, realistic material and hair physics, and basic NPC facial expressions. No more mannequins visiting your shop!

So, will you accept the invitation to become a shop manager?

store_data.about_the_game:
Just Skill Shooter: Japan plunges players into a high-stakes first-person shooter experience set across the striking, contrast-filled landscapes of modern and ancient Japan. Armed with a variety of weapons and your sharp instincts, your mission is simple yet deadly—eliminate all enemies and survive the perilous streets and shrines. With advanced enemy AI and atmospheric environments, this game challenges your reflexes, precision, and strategy.

STORYLINE

From the neon-drenched alleys of a sprawling metropolis to the quiet, mist-covered courtyards of centuries-old shrines, Japan has become a battleground. A rogue faction has seized control of the city's underbelly and its sacred grounds alike, turning peaceful streets into a warzone. As a highly trained operative, you're sent in to clear the threat before it spreads. With every alley and every torii gate concealing danger, Japan becomes a deadly test of your skill and determination.

WEAPONS

Equip yourself with an arsenal of powerful weapons, including rifles for precision, shotguns for devastating close-quarters combat, and pistols for quick and versatile firepower. Mastering each weapon is essential for adapting to the unique challenges posed by Japan's tight urban corridors and open shrine courtyards, and the cunning enemies that patrol them.

ENEMIES

Prepare to face off against enemies with improved AI systems that make every encounter unpredictable. Enemies will utilize narrow backstreets, rooftops, and shrine grounds to ambush you, coordinate attacks, and adapt to your strategies. Survival depends on your ability to outsmart and outshoot these relentless foes.

MAPS

Navigate two intricately designed maps that capture the striking duality of Japan. From dense, neon-lit city blocks to serene, ancient temple complexes, every corner of these maps presents unique challenges and strategic opportunities. The contrast between vibrant urban chaos and solemn traditional stillness heightens the tension, making every step a calculated risk.

GAME FEATURES:

  • Immersive first-person shooter gameplay set in the vibrant, neon-lit streets and ancient temples of Japan

  • Wide variety of weapons, including rifles, shotguns, and pistols

  • Advanced enemy AI that reacts dynamically to your actions

  • Two intricately designed maps blending modern cityscapes with traditional Japanese architecture

  • Fast-paced and challenging combat that rewards precision and strategy

  • Atmospheric visuals and sound design that capture the unique energy of Japan, from bustling alleyways to tranquil shrines

  • A simple yet gripping mission—eliminate all enemies and survive

In Just Skill Shooter: Japan, every alley could conceal an enemy, every shrine could spell danger, and every shot could determine your survival. With its intense combat, atmospheric environments, and cunning AI, this game will push your skills to their limits. Do you have what it takes to conquer Japan's streets and shrines, or will you become another forgotten soul lost in its shadows? The challenge awaits—lock and load.

From the developers of Old Market Simulator comes a satisfying market-cleanup game where every item belongs somewhere. Search the market for misplaced products, return them to their correct crates, shelves, and stands. Earn reputation by placing products correctly and spend your reputation to unlock helpful skills and upgrades that make restoring your market faster and easier.

Your market has been left in complete disarray by an employee whose wages you could not afford to pay. Now it is up to you to bring the market back to its former glory. Look carefully for products hidden beneath stands, behind counters, stuck on the stairs, or scattered anywhere throughout the market. Pick them up, figure out where they belong, and gradually transform the market from a total mess into a clean, organized, ready-to-open business.

Play alone or work together with friends as you search every corner, organize every shelf, and clean up every last misplaced item.

No pressure of running a market, just the pure, deeply satisfying joy of turning an absolute disaster into a flawless market that is ready to welcome customers.

store_data.about_the_game:
■ The Demon Queen Plays Hero.

In a world of swords, sorcery, and a touch of machinery, humans and demons have waged all-out war for generations. Humanity forges young people with a rare gift — growing stronger the more they fight — into "heroes," and sends them to assassinate the Demon Queen.

To her, it's nothing but a nuisance. Every single time: dead soldiers, a trashed castle, and not even a decent night's sleep. "I've had enough of this," she mutters — and lands on a delightfully simple conclusion. "If I become the hero, the problem solves itself."

She casts a forbidden time-reversal spell, hands the throne to her aide, and travels back to the past. From then on, she spends her days hunting down real hero candidates while they're still weak, quietly talking them out of the "hero" business — a story told in bite-sized chapters roughly every few days.

■ Idle progression that never stops climbing

Gacha gear, gear fusion upgrades, respec-able talent points (stage build vs. boss build), and manual stat investment (x1/x20/x100) — your numbers keep growing even while you're away. Late-game stages generate infinitely.

■ Play hands-off or hands-on

Auto-battle by default, with a 5-second idle timer to snap back to auto. Die and you respawn instantly with your EXP and drops intact — no revive currency required.

■ Not a solo grind

Recruit, strengthen, and swap "Holy Knights" (monster-tamer-type heroes) to fight alongside you.

■ Stages that go on forever — literally off the scale

Stage numbers are theoretically endless. Push your stats far enough and the game simply labels them "Immeasurable" once they're too big to display. (The Japanese version uses a real — if absurd — numeral name, "muryoutaisuu" [10^68], for the same milestone; English/Chinese versions just say "Immeasurable"/无法测量.)

■ New Game+ that never truly ends

Reset gear and skills to replay from scratch via the Prestige system after the ending — your boss compendium carries over, enemies scale up each run, and your Prestige count climbs its own online leaderboard.

■ The story doesn't end at the credits

A post-ending "Epilogue" arc keeps unfolding: mysterious new enemies invade through the Demon's Gate itself. Will the Demon Queen — of all people — end up actually saving the world?

■ Free to play. DLC only saves you time.

The base game is $0, forever. All DLC (growth speed, drop rate, talent coins, starter boosts) is optional and only shortens your playtime — you can reach the ending without spending a cent.

store_data.about_the_game:
You're defending against a swarm that never stops coming. There are too many of them to fight by hand, so you build a factory that makes your soldiers for you. In Attrition Line, your production line and your army are the same thing. The machines you set up decide how many troops you can put on the field, and the enemy is getting stronger the whole time you build.

Turn raw materials into soldiers

Everything on the battlefield starts as ore. You dig up iron, copper, and stone, run it through furnaces and assemblers, and finished troops roll out the other end and march to the fight. Want a bigger army? Build a bigger factory. Nothing is handed to you, and there's no shortcut around the production. If you can make it, you can field it.

Build the whole operation

You lay out everything yourself: mining drills, conveyor belts, furnaces, and assemblers, all running on a power grid you put together from solar, wind, and steam. As you research new technology you unlock better machines, faster lines, and stronger troops. The research never runs dry, so there's always a next upgrade to chase when you want to push your base further than it's ever gone.

Fight a battle you can actually see

The fighting happens right next to your base, and it's huge. A few hundred of your soldiers run into thousands of the enemy in one giant crowd that shoves and spills across the ground. You don't babysit units one at a time. You choose where your army holds, how it lines up, and, most of all, what you keep sending it. When your troops take a hit they push back and charge on their own. You can keep an eye on the fight while you work on the factory, so you always know when the line is about to give.

Bring the right army

Different units are good at different things. Heavy troops soak hits at the front, fast ones swing around the sides, and ranged units shoot from behind them. When the enemy shows up with something your line can't handle, you have answers: poison that eats through armor, units that slow the swarm to a crawl, and support troops that heal your soldiers and strip the poison back off them. The enemy keeps adding new kinds too, so an army that held an hour ago might fold now.

It never settles down

The swarm grows the entire time you play. The longer you last, the more of them arrive and the nastier they get, until there are tens of thousands of them coming at you. Kill them faster than they show up and you actually speed the whole thing along, so the difficulty rises to meet how well you're playing. It never turns into the same fight on repeat.

Design once, build fast

Once you've got a layout you like, you can copy it and drop it down again anywhere, flip it to fit the space, and tell your construction drones which jobs to build first. Good ideas spread across your base as fast as you can point at where they go.

Set up the factory, get the army moving, and see how long you can hold.

Key features

  • A full factory to build: mining, smelting, assembly, belts, and power from solar, wind, and steam

  • Your entire army is manufactured on the line, not bought or spawned

  • Research that keeps going, with no last upgrade

  • Big battles: a few hundred of your troops against thousands of enemies at once

  • You set where the army holds and what it's made of instead of clicking every unit

  • New enemy types you answer with poison, slows, and healing support

  • A swarm that grows all game and speeds up when you play well

  • Copy, flip, and stamp your best designs to expand in seconds

Shifty Letters is a puzzle game where you use falling blocks to form words. Words are scored based on the value of the letter tiles. Use the following special blocks to aid you:

Rotating Block - Choose the letter you want, but be quick, or it will change at the last second.

Letter Shift - Shift your letters to the right or left depending on the arrow direction

Row Shift - Shift your row to the right or left depending on the arrow direction

Glow Block - Any blocks touching the word formed with this block will be removed

Flip Block - Flip the entire row to mirror what you had

Featuring over 100,000 words to form horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Use random double-word and letter-scoring tiles to increase your score. Every 500 points, select a modifier to help you stay alive. The game is over once your blocks reach the top.

Play against two to three other players locally or go head-to-head with someone online. Words with five letters or more will create frozen blocks on your opponent's side. Unfreeze them by making a word that touches those blocks.

store_data.about_the_game:
Some heroes are handed a prophecy. You have been handed a crate.

You are a wizard. Not a famous one. You have a cart that creaks, a lantern that mostly works, and a standing order from an alchemist who does not have time for people who drive badly.

Inside the crate: fever draughts, measured doses, wrapped in wool. Between you and the people who need them: a road that turns to mud past the low fields, one narrow plank causeway, and a bend that has humbled better drivers than you.

The Long Errand is a cozy fantasy delivery game about carrying fragile things across a small island, and about the people waiting at the other end.

Drive gently. The potions are listening.

Your cargo is not a number in a menu. It is real physical weight in the back of your cart, and it responds to every single thing you do.

Take a corner too fast and you will hear it before you see it. The clink of glass finding glass. The slosh of a sealed eel container that has opinions about your steering. Hit a root in the Oldwood at speed and the whole load lifts, lands, and settles a little worse than it was.

Nothing punishes you. There is no failure screen, no timer, no restart. The crate simply arrives in the state you brought it in, and the person receiving it says something slightly different depending on which state that is. Maret will make do. Maret always makes do. She would rather not have to.

Drive well and the game gets quieter. That is the whole reward, and it turns out to be enough.

One island, small enough to learn by heart

No open world. No map bloat. One island, four biomes, seven places worth going, and roads that were designed as carefully as the destinations.

  • The Heartland. Wide packed dirt, open sky, forgiving turns. Market village of Millhaven, quiet farms at Thornwick. This is where the game teaches you that calm feels good.

  • The Oldwood. Ancient broadleaf forest that predates every settlement on the island. Tight corners arriving out of shadow, exposed roots humming through the suspension, rain that lasts. The scholars at Greywood will ask you to carry a sealed specimen jar through it. They will not apologise.

  • The Wetlands. Mud, reed grass taller than the cart, plank bridges that make everything you own rattle in rhythm. Fenwick Hollow sits above the bog on stilts, reachable by one narrow causeway. Aggression is punished here, clearly and immediately.

  • The Coast. Salt flats, firm sand, the smoothest road in the game and the widest sky. Saltmere trades with the outside world. Tidecroft is where the island simply stops.

Weather is a driving mechanic, not a filter. Rain softens roads. Fog closes the wetlands in. A squall rolls off the sea, takes your visibility for two minutes, and moves on.

Sixteen people, and none of them explain themselves

Edda packs the crates and does not suffer fools. Oswin runs the inn, loves a story, and has a past he steps around. Old Dex has lived in the bog his entire life and considers everywhere else a rumour. Ysel works the dock, never stands still, and asks you about every other settlement on the island with steadily increasing specificity. She never asks the actual question.

Nobody here gives you a quest. They give you a job, and then, slowly, as you keep turning up, they give you a little more than that. A sister they have not spoken to. A debt in another town. A letter they would rather nobody knew about. A sealed box that has been waiting twenty years for someone careful enough to carry it.

You will not fix any of this. You are not that kind of wizard. You are the one who arrives, sets it down gently, and drives on.

The cart is the whole point

It is your transport, your inventory, your workshop and your home. It is enchanted, imperfect, and audibly alive.

Upgrades at Bram's smithy are practical and atmospheric rather than powerful: better suspension so the road hits softer, padding and straps so the load moves less, a warmer lantern, storage that fits the awkward parcels, and a few arcane quirks that were arguably not necessary. Nothing makes cargo invincible. Nothing removes the need for careful hands. The cart just becomes more yours.

Things this game will never do to you

  • No combat. Nothing on this island is trying to hurt you.

  • No timers. Every road can be taken at whatever speed you feel like.

  • No fail state. Deliveries complete. The question is only what condition they arrive in.

  • No chosen one. No prophecy. No world to save.

  • No inventory tetris, no crafting tree, no skill web.

What is left is a slow drive through a place that is quietly alive, a load in the back that you are responsible for, and a handful of people who will notice that you kept turning up.

The road goes on

Thornwick. Greywood. Saltmere. Tidecroft. The whole island is waiting, and everyone on it has something that needs carrying.

Wishlist The Long Errand. Take the road slow.

Take a corner too fast and you will hear it before you see it. The clink of glass finding glass. The slosh of a sealed eel container that has opinions about your steering. Hit a root in the Oldwood at speed and the whole load lifts, lands, and settles a little worse than it was.

Nothing punishes you. There is no failure screen, no timer, no restart. The crate simply arrives in the state you brought it in, and the person receiving it says something slightly different depending on which state that is. Maret will make do. Maret always makes do. She would rather not have to.

Drive well and the game gets quieter. That is the whole reward, and it turns out to be enough.

One island, small enough to learn by heart

No open world. No map bloat. One island, four biomes, seven places worth going, and roads that were designed as carefully as the destinations.

  • The Heartland. Wide packed dirt, open sky, forgiving turns. Market village of Millhaven, quiet farms at Thornwick. This is where the game teaches you that calm feels good.

  • The Oldwood. Ancient broadleaf forest that predates every settlement on the island. Tight corners arriving out of shadow, exposed roots humming through the suspension, rain that lasts. The scholars at Greywood will ask you to carry a sealed specimen jar through it. They will not apologise.

  • The Wetlands. Mud, reed grass taller than the cart, plank bridges that make everything you own rattle in rhythm. Fenwick Hollow sits above the bog on stilts, reachable by one narrow causeway. Aggression is punished here, clearly and immediately.

  • The Coast. Salt flats, firm sand, the smoothest road in the game and the widest sky. Saltmere trades with the outside world. Tidecroft is where the island simply stops.

Weather is a driving mechanic, not a filter. Rain softens roads. Fog closes the wetlands in. A squall rolls off the sea, takes your visibility for two minutes, and moves on.

Sixteen people, and none of them explain themselves

Edda packs the crates and does not suffer fools. Oswin runs the inn, loves a story, and has a past he steps around. Old Dex has lived in the bog his entire life and considers everywhere else a rumour. Ysel works the dock, never stands still, and asks you about every other settlement on the island with steadily increasing specificity. She never asks the actual question.

Nobody here gives you a quest. They give you a job, and then, slowly, as you keep turning up, they give you a little more than that. A sister they have not spoken to. A debt in another town. A letter they would rather nobody knew about. A sealed box that has been waiting twenty years for someone careful enough to carry it.

You will not fix any of this. You are not that kind of wizard. You are the one who arrives, sets it down gently, and drives on.

The cart is the whole point

It is your transport, your inventory, your workshop and your home. It is enchanted, imperfect, and audibly alive.

Upgrades at Bram's smithy are practical and atmospheric rather than powerful: better suspension so the road hits softer, padding and straps so the load moves less, a warmer lantern, storage that fits the awkward parcels, and a few arcane quirks that were arguably not necessary. Nothing makes cargo invincible. Nothing removes the need for careful hands. The cart just becomes more yours.

Things this game will never do to you

  • No combat. Nothing on this island is trying to hurt you.

  • No timers. Every road can be taken at whatever speed you feel like.

  • No fail state. Deliveries complete. The question is only what condition they arrive in.

  • No chosen one. No prophecy. No world to save.

  • No inventory tetris, no crafting tree, no skill web.

What is left is a slow drive through a place that is quietly alive, a load in the back that you are responsible for, and a handful of people who will notice that you kept turning up.

The road goes on

Thornwick. Greywood. Saltmere. Tidecroft. The whole island is waiting, and everyone on it has something that needs carrying.

Wishlist The Long Errand. Take the road slow.
store_data.short_description: A wizard, a cart that creaks, and a crate of fever draughts that will not survive careless hands. Drive slowly across a small island. Deliver what people need. Listen to what they say when you come back. Arrive intact.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your favorite songs, instantly transformed into playable scores.

LuMIDI is a piano rhythm game that automatically generates falling-note charts simply by loading a MIDI file. Connect a MIDI keyboard to play directly on a real piano, matching your keystrokes to the falling notes and the glowing on-screen keys.

Main Features

  • Auto-Generate Charts from MIDI: Just drag and drop your files. You can easily select tracks, assign left and right-hand parts, and adjust the tempo and note falling speed.

  • 35 Built-In Classical Masterpieces: Includes timeless classics like Für Elise, Turkish March, and Canon in D. Start playing right away, even if you don't have your own MIDI files.

  • Four Practice-Friendly Modes: Practice just your left or right hand while the game automatically plays the remaining part. You can also use the Auto-Play mode as a model performance to preview and learn new songs.

  • Wait & Rhythm Systems: Choose the "Wait" mode, a practice setting where the song pauses until you press the correct key, or the "Rhythm" mode, a live performance setting where you compete for high scores and combos.

  • Steam Workshop Support: Upload and share your custom charts. Discover and subscribe to charts created by other players to have them automatically imported into your game.

  • Playable Without a MIDI Keyboard: You can still play using a standard PC keyboard (Note: Playing with a MIDI keyboard is highly recommended).

  • Customization: Personalize note colors, keyboard light brightness, and background images (settings can also be saved on a per-chart basis).

  • Visual Enhancements for Creators: Want to upload your piano arrangements to video-sharing platforms? Let the beautiful visual effects of the Auto-Play mode elevate your content.

The game features the rich, built-in sound of a grand piano, utilizing the Salamander Grand Piano sound source (created by Alexander Holm / CC BY 3.0).

ASSEMBLE MYTHICAL LEGIONS

You are the master tactician. Build an unstoppable army ranging from swarms of reckless goblins to stalwart dwarven infantry and towering dragons. Customize your units, set your formation on the grid, and deploy your troops. Then unleash your forces and watch the magical chaos unfold in spectacular auto-battler combat!

OUTTHINK, DON'T OUTCLICK

MASTER YOUR MAGICAL ARMORY

Create a strategy that is uniquely yours. Customize your units in the deployment phase, then unlock powerful upgrades mid-battle to adapt to the enemy. MULTIPLE PATHS TO GLORY

From competitive ranked ladders to pure casual fun. Fight for supremacy in 1vs1 or 2vs2 PvP. Battle relentless waves of AI-controlled Undead in the Horde or Coop-Horde mode. With ever-changing magical modifiers, the realm always offers a new challenge.

store_data.about_the_game:
You know the way home.

You've walked it hundreds of times.

Tonight... something is different.

Beneath the Snow is a first-person psychological mystery set in a snow-covered Eastern European housing estate in the winter of 2003. Every block feels familiar, yet something is subtly wrong.

Cross underpasses, observe your surroundings, and decide which path belongs to reality. The smallest detail can change everything. If you make the wrong choice, you'll find yourself right where you started.

As the night grows colder, you'll uncover forgotten notes, encounter strange figures, and slowly piece together what lies beneath the snow.

Features

  • Explore a surreal, looping housing estate inspired by Eastern Europe.

  • Spot subtle environmental anomalies and choose the correct path forward.

  • Atmospheric psychological mystery with minimal dialogue and environmental storytelling.

  • Discover collectible notes that reveal fragments of the story.

  • Immersive sound design and haunting dreamlike soundtrack.

  • Stylized visuals blending modern lighting with a nostalgic pixel-inspired aesthetic.

Sometimes, the shortest way home...
isn't the right one.

store_data.about_the_game:
Everyone is counting on you. Literally.

Billionth Soul is an idle roguelite deckbuilder set aboard a failing generation ship. Begin with one thawed sleeper and grow humanity’s last colony to one billion souls before life support runs out.

BUILD THE LAST COLONY

Draft and place Habitat, System, and Program cards on a grid. Habitats grow the population, Systems reshape the colony, and temporary Programs create powerful combinations. Position matters: neighboring cards can strengthen, copy, accelerate, or undermine one another.

OUTRUN THE COLD EQUATION

Every new soul brings humanity closer to survival, but a larger colony consumes life support faster. Reach each population target to earn a fresh life support budget. Fall short, and the colony dies.

Vent life support for an immediate surge of souls when time is abundant. Scrub population to recover precious seconds when extinction is near. Every decision trades growth against survival.

ADAPT ACROSS RUNS

Recover Salvage, unlock new cards, and expand permanent research after every attempt. Build stronger strategies across interconnected research trees, complete 42 Achievements, and climb through ten difficulty tiers.

Winning strategies do not remain safe forever. After each victory, your strongest Habitat receives a penalty in the next run, forcing the colony to adapt instead of repeating the same solution.

KEEP GOING

Face a shared seeded Daily Trial, customize your board through research, pursue increasingly difficult victories, and unlock an endless expansion beyond the billionth soul.

You cannot save everyone on the first try. Learn, rebuild, and make the next colony survive.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Metal Workshop Manager is a production and management simulation game where you take control of a small metalworking workshop and turn it into an efficient, profitable manufacturing business.

Accept customer orders, study technical requirements, purchase raw materials, set up machines, manage workers, control production flow, and deliver completed products before their deadlines.

Every order is different. Some jobs require only a few simple cuts, while others contain dozens of parts, multiple material types, different hole diameters, welding operations, and complex assembly requirements.

Success depends on careful planning, correct machine setup, good logistics, and smart investment.

Manage the Entire Production Process

Every product must pass through the correct manufacturing stages.

The usual production route is:

Band Saw → Drill Press → Welder → Work Table

Parts also need to be moved between machines using the pallet jack or an assigned logistics worker.

Not every product requires every operation. You must study the order details and decide which parts need cutting, drilling, welding, or finishing.

The Active Orders window gives you a detailed overview of:

  • required material types;

  • material section sizes;

  • cutting lengths;

  • required quantities;

  • completed and remaining parts;

  • hole quantities and diameters;

  • welding wire requirements;

  • current part locations;

  • order deadlines;

  • overall production progress.

Set Up Machines Manually

At the beginning of the game, most operations are completed manually.

For the Band Saw, you must select:

  • the correct material type;

  • the correct material size;

  • the required cutting length;

  • the quantity you want to produce.

The Drill Press requires the correct hole diameter.

The Welder requires the correct welding wire.

After saving the setup, click the physical machine to perform the operation. One click represents one real production action, such as one cut or one drilled hole.

Manual control gives you flexibility, but it also creates the possibility of human error.

Quality Control and Scrap

Incorrect machine settings can create defective parts.

Using the wrong material, cutting the wrong length, drilling the wrong diameter, or selecting the wrong welding wire can result in scrap.

A defective drilled part must return to the beginning of the production process and be cut again.

Using the wrong welding wire can scrap an entire assembled product, forcing all of its parts back into production.

Scrap costs money, consumes materials, delays the order, and reduces your profit.

Careful setup and regular checking are essential.

Machine Status Colour System

Each machine has an animated colour-coded outline that shows its current condition:

  • Yellow: the machine is idle or no suitable work is available;

  • Green: material or a product is ready for processing;

  • Blue: the machine is currently working;

  • Red: a quality-control error or incorrect manual setup has created scrap.

Small indicators beside the machines show how many parts are waiting at each station.

This allows you to quickly identify production queues and bottlenecks.

Purchase Materials and Consumables

Production requires more than raw steel.

You must manage:

  • box section;

  • flat bar;

  • round bar;

  • sheet material;

  • saw blades;

  • drill bits;

  • welding wire.

Raw material is consumed during cutting.

Saw blades wear with every cut.

Drill bits lose condition with every hole and can eventually break.

Welding wire is consumed during welding.

Missing or worn tools can stop production completely.

About This Game

Metal Workshop Manager is a production and management simulation game where you take control of a small metalworking workshop and turn it into an efficient, profitable manufacturing business.

Accept customer orders, study technical requirements, purchase raw materials, set up machines, manage workers, control production flow, and deliver completed products before their deadlines.

Every order is different. Some jobs require only a few simple cuts, while others contain dozens of parts, multiple material types, different hole diameters, welding operations, and complex assembly requirements.

Success depends on careful planning, correct machine setup, good logistics, and smart investment.

Manage the Entire Production Process

Every product must pass through the correct manufacturing stages.

The usual production route is:

Band Saw → Drill Press → Welder → Work Table

Parts also need to be moved between machines using the pallet jack or an assigned logistics worker.

Not every product requires every operation. You must study the order details and decide which parts need cutting, drilling, welding, or finishing.

The Active Orders window gives you a detailed overview of:

  • required material types;

  • material section sizes;

  • cutting lengths;

  • required quantities;

  • completed and remaining parts;

  • hole quantities and diameters;

  • welding wire requirements;

  • current part locations;

  • order deadlines;

  • overall production progress.

Set Up Machines Manually

At the beginning of the game, most operations are completed manually.

For the Band Saw, you must select:

  • the correct material type;

  • the correct material size;

  • the required cutting length;

  • the quantity you want to produce.

The Drill Press requires the correct hole diameter.

The Welder requires the correct welding wire.

After saving the setup, click the physical machine to perform the operation. One click represents one real production action, such as one cut or one drilled hole.

Manual control gives you flexibility, but it also creates the possibility of human error.

Quality Control and Scrap

Incorrect machine settings can create defective parts.

Using the wrong material, cutting the wrong length, drilling the wrong diameter, or selecting the wrong welding wire can result in scrap.

A defective drilled part must return to the beginning of the production process and be cut again.

Using the wrong welding wire can scrap an entire assembled product, forcing all of its parts back into production.

Scrap costs money, consumes materials, delays the order, and reduces your profit.

Careful setup and regular checking are essential.

store_data.about_the_game:
Combo Break blends the satisfying chaos of a bouncing-ball peg machine with the depth of roguelite deckbuilding. Fill your board with special pegs, combine their effects into powerful synergies, and chase the perfect run where every bounce triggers a cascade. It's a nonstop dopamine rush wrapped in one unpredictable, combo-stacking ride.

DROP PEGS. STACK EFFECTS. BREAK THE COMBO METER.

Your balls bounce on their own — the game is what you build for them to hit. Discover special pegs and slot them onto your board to trigger wild chain reactions:

  • Chain pegs fire lightning between neighbors, hitting multiple pegs from a single bounce.

  • Jackpot pegs charge up and detonate into screen-filling gold payouts.

  • Burn pegs set the board alight, ticking damage over time on everything they touch.

  • Splitter pegs spawn extra balls mid-run to flood the board.

  • Magnet pegs bend nearby balls into your best pegs for guaranteed hits.

  • Crit, Overdrive, Combo Hold, and Gamble pegs push your multiplier higher, faster, and riskier.

Line them up right and one ball sets off a chain of chains — lightning, fire, and jackpots all going off at once as your combo meter blazes white-hot.

BUILD A BOARD THAT'S ALL YOURS

Choose from 8 board formations — arc, grid, ring, spiral, star and more — each changing how your balls flow and where your combos ignite. Expand up to 15 peg sockets and 10 simultaneous balls, then pour points into a shared skill tree that reshapes your whole strategy. Every run is a fresh puzzle: what you draft, where you place it, and how the effects feed each other.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

  • Endless — free-play sandbox. Build forever, chase your biggest board, and see how absurd the payouts can get.

  • Competitive — a survival gauntlet against a rising score clock. Hit each checkpoint before time runs out, climb as far as you can, and post your score to the global leaderboard. Every second counts, and one weak stretch ends the run.

FEATURES

  • 11 special peg effects that stack into explosive synergies

  • 8 board formations that reshape how every run plays

  • Up to 15 sockets and 10 balls on a single board

  • A shared skill tree for run-defining upgrades

  • Endless mode for infinite, no-pressure building

  • Competitive mode with survival checkpoints and a global leaderboard

  • Deep, escalating combo system — the better your board, the louder it gets

Bastard, a mysterious entity greets you with a disturbing message inside a nightmare... it seems you cause him fear...

Carajito, a roguelite where in every run a roulette wheel decides your victory condition. Repel hordes of absurd enemies, level up and buy increasingly broken upgrades in a shop ruled by luck. Reach your goal before chaos catches up to you.

No run is the same

Every run spins a roulette that decides how you win: reach level 100, rack up 500 kills, or survive for 10 minutes. Same chaos, different goal, every single time.

Save up enough (It’s not just advice, it’s a necessity lol)

Level up and the card shop opens with upgrades and interesting stuff (Hope you saved enough dude...), but first a die rolls to decide the rarity of everything for sale. Common day? Cheap and modest. LEGENDARY day? Monstrous effects at monstrous prices.

  • Short runs – No more than 20 minutes per game.

  • 3 random victory conditions – Reach level 100, get 500 kills, or survive 10 minutes. The roulette decides.

  • Rarity Dice Shop - Common to LEGENDARY, decided by a die.

  • Cursed Cards & Shady Contracts - Cheap power, hidden prices, risky deals.

  • Combo System - Chain kills and keep the groove going.

  • A Final Surprise - Something waits at the end. That's all we're saying.

store_data.about_the_game:
Change your shell. Awaken new abilities. Save Awesome Island!

Shell Heroes: Awesome Island is a colorful 2D side-scrolling action-adventure platformer where you explore a vibrant island alongside a cast of unique hermit crab heroes.

After a violent storm, the fragments that once protected Awesome Island are scattered across the land. Join forces with heroes who wield different abilities, explore beaches, jungles, rocky shores, tidal pools, a shipwreck, and ancient deep-sea ruins, and recover the lost fragments.

A New Adventure with Every Shell

Equip the shells you collect to change not only your appearance, but also the special abilities available to you. Choose the right shell and hero for each situation, overcome obstacles, uncover hidden paths, and take on powerful enemies and bosses.

Unique Hermit Crab Heroes

Each hero has their own attacks, movement abilities, and ultimate skill. Complete character story quests to discover their struggles and growth, while unlocking new abilities and rewards.

Explore Awesome Island

From sparkling beaches to mysterious deep-sea ruins, every region features its own environment, mechanics, and challenges. Find hidden collectibles and shells, help the island's residents, and uncover the secrets buried across Awesome Island.

Key Features

- Charming hand-painted 2D pixel art

- Exploration, combat, and platforming combined in one adventure

- A variety of shells that change both appearance and abilities

- Distinct hermit crab heroes with character-focused story quests

- Unique regional mechanics and boss battles

- Collectibles, minigames, and hidden areas

- Keyboard and game controller support

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into a moonlit Japanese shrine where a seductive nine-tailed fox spirit — a kitsune — waits among the torii gates. Solve relaxing picture puzzles to earn her trust, and every completed level unlocks a fully animated, sound-synced reward scene.

How it plays

Kitsune Waifu is a cozy, casual tile-swap puzzle game. Every level presents a single illustration shuffled across a grid of tiles. Simply swap two tiles at a time to move each piece back into place and rebuild the full picture. It's easy to pick up in seconds, gently challenging, and endlessly relaxing — a perfect way to unwind while quietly sharpening your focus and observation.

Reveal the story, one scene at a time

The deeper you go, the closer the fox spirit draws. Each level is set somewhere new in her nighttime shrine — beneath vermilion torii gates, among falling autumn maple leaves, beside glowing stone lanterns and drifting foxfire. Complete a level and its picture comes alive as a fully animated, sound-synced scene, then unlocks the next stage of your moonlit encounter.

Feel stuck? No worries — a built-in hint system is always there to nudge you toward the right move, so you can stay in the flow of the puzzle at your own pace with zero frustration.

A living game — free updates

Every level's reward is being crafted into a fully animated, sound-synced scene, and new animated content rolls out for free in waves. The price never rises for players who already own the game — buy once, and your collection keeps growing.

What's inside

  • 10 levels set in a mystical, moonlit Shinto shrine
  • A fully animated, sound-synced reward scene for every level
  • Relaxing tile-swap puzzles — swap two tiles to rebuild each picture
  • A gentle difficulty curve that's easy to learn and cozy to master
  • A built-in hint system so you never get stuck
  • 10 Steam Achievements to unlock
  • A soft, atmospheric ambient soundtrack
  • Relaxed single-player play — no timers, no pressure, go at your own pace

Content note: Kitsune Waifu is an adult game intended for players 18+ and contains uncensored nudity and sexual content in its reward scenes.

store_data.about_the_game:
BUILD THE CHAIN. REACH CRITICAL MASS.

Tatomic is a high-energy falling-block puzzle game about building colorful atomic chains—and choosing the perfect moment to make them react.

Drop linked pairs into the containment field, rotate them into position, and connect atoms of the same element. Every element has its own critical mass. Reach it and the reaction travels through the chain one atom at a time, breaking supports, dropping everything above, and turning careful setups into spectacular cascades.

Build several chains together and trigger them in a single move for huge combo bonuses. The rules are easy to read. Surviving the pressure—and engineering the perfect reaction—is not.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY

Critical Mass

Climb through 30 escalating levels. Changing reaction thresholds and drop speeds force new strategies, while every level transforms the reactor with a distinct animated background and atom style.

Radioactive Survival

Radioactive atoms only detonate when they join a matching-color chain. Use them to prepare the board, choose when to trigger a reaction, and chase a high score as the pace accelerates.

Puzzle Mode

Reconstruct 20 authored molecular silhouettes using one exact connected chain. Shape, orientation, and atom count all matter—and radioactive hazards can destroy a nearly finished solution.

A REACTOR THAT RESPONDS TO EVERY MOVE

  • Chain-by-chain reaction propagation, unsupported-atom gravity, cascades, and simultaneous-chain combos

  • Thirty animated reactor environments with level-specific atom treatments

  • Element-specific explosions, particles, shockwaves, screen shake, and procedural sound effects

  • The restored original Tatomic soundtrack

  • A visible three-pair queue and ghost landing preview for deliberate play

  • Persistent high scores, records, run statistics, grades, and puzzle completion

  • First-run field training plus a replayable How to Play guide

  • Complete keyboard and controller navigation with controller-specific button glyphs

  • Steam Deck layout support, haptic feedback, and event-scaled controller rumble

  • Accessibility options for UI scale, audio channels, screen shake, motion, flashes, and color palettes

Tatomic revives the rules and three original modes of the classic game with a completely rebuilt native presentation made for modern PCs and handheld play.

Full Steam Description

Build Your Own Hero Village

Renz Village Adventure is an idle village simulation RPG inspired by classic town-building adventures. Construct a bustling village, recruit powerful heroes, explore dangerous dungeons, and watch your town come alive as its residents fight, level up, gather loot, and defend your growing settlement.

Whether you’re actively expanding your village or simply watching your heroes go about their adventures, your world is always evolving.

Build a Thriving Village

Transform a quiet settlement into a prosperous town by constructing buildings that strengthen your growing community.

Build and upgrade:

  • 🏠 Houses

  • 🛏 Inns

  • ⚔ Weapon Shops

  • 🛡 Armor Shops

  • 🔨 Blacksmiths

  • 🍖 Food Shops

  • 🛒 Markets

  • 🔮 Mage Towers

  • 🏰 Barracks

Each building provides meaningful benefits that help your heroes survive longer, fight harder, and continue exploring.

Watch Heroes Live Their Lives

Recruit a growing roster of heroes, each with their own class, strengths, and progression.

Current hero classes include:

  • Warrior

  • Archer

  • Wizard

  • Fire Mage

  • Lightning Mage

  • Healer

  • Guard

  • Merchant

  • Farmer

  • Builder

  • Cook

  • Villager

Heroes automatically:

  • Explore the wilderness

  • Battle monsters

  • Gain experience

  • Collect loot

  • Heal at the inn

  • Protect your village

  • Grow stronger over time

Dangerous Expeditions

Send parties of heroes into challenging procedural dungeons filled with increasingly difficult encounters.

Fight through:

  • Multiple combat rooms

  • Elite enemies

  • Valuable treasure

  • Powerful bosses

Every successful expedition unlocks tougher challenges and greater rewards.

Explore a Living World

Your village exists inside a dynamic world featuring:

  • Day & night cycle

  • Dynamic weather

  • Rivers

  • Lakes

  • Forests

  • Wildlife

  • Seasonal atmosphere

The world constantly changes while your heroes continue their adventures.

Grow Stronger

Heroes continuously improve through:

  • Leveling

  • Better equipment

  • Gold rewards

  • Dungeon loot

  • Village upgrades

Build the strongest village capable of surviving increasingly dangerous monsters.

Choose Your Challenge

Play casually—or test yourself in Nightmare Mode, where every decision matters.

Nightmare introduces permanent hero death, making every dungeon expedition a meaningful risk.

Can your village survive?

Features

  • 🏡 Idle village simulation gameplay

  • ⚔ Automatic hero combat

  • 🎒 Loot and inventory system

  • 🏰 Village construction and progression

  • 🧙 Multiple unique hero classes

  • 🕳 Procedural dungeon expeditions

  • 👹 Dozens of monster types

  • 🌦 Dynamic weather and day/night cycle

  • 💾 Multiple save slots

  • 📈 Hero progression and leveling

  • 🎯 Relaxing management with meaningful strategic decisions

  • 💀 Optional Nightmare Mode with permanent hero death

A Game About Watching Your Village Grow

Whether you’re carefully planning every building placement or simply enjoying the sight of your heroes setting out on adventures, Renz Village Adventure is designed to capture the satisfying feeling of watching a small settlement slowly become a thriving fantasy village.

store_data.about_the_game:
Together with a cat-shaped AI, defend humanity's last domed cities through orbital bombardment.

You awaken aboard an orbital defense station after a long cryosleep. The world below is airless, and humanity survives beneath scattered domes under attack by giant machines. You are the only one who can provide support, but your close airless support takes time to arrive.

Combat unfolds in real time during brief orbital pass windows. Launch your strikes, then discover their outcome when you return on a later revolution. Between passes, salvage abandoned orbital assets, restore the station, and uncover a history buried beneath the dust.

Features

  • Realistic orbital simulation. The world is built on plausible parameters, while orbital motion and projectile trajectories are governed by real Keplerian mechanics.

  • Simple controls. Select a target, and the game handles the firing solution. Your projectile will strike where you aimed whenever a valid trajectory exists, but its time of flight changes throughout the orbital pass.

  • Distinct orbital arsenal. Acquire weapons with unique ballistic characteristics, each suited to different battlefield situations.

  • Recover what was lost. Salvage abandoned orbital assets for both resources and knowledge, restoring your station while revealing the world's history.

  • Multiple endings. The fate of humanity depends on the choices you make and the secrets you uncover.

store_data.about_the_game:
☆ Rise through the ancient Japanese court ranks

Experience a unique falling-block puzzle game inspired by Japan's elegant Heian period (794–1185).

You serve at the imperial court, controlling colorful temari balls and earning scores to advance through the court hierarchy.

Your score represents your achievement and determines how high you can rise.

Can you reach the highest court rank, Sr. 1st?

☆ Control temari balls and aim for high scores

MARODISⅡ is a falling-block puzzle game where you stack and clear seven different colored temari balls.

Create a Color Clear by connecting 8 or more balls of the same color.

Create a Line Clear by completing a horizontal row of balls and remove large numbers of balls at once.

Carefully plan your placements, create chains, and maintain combos to achieve higher scores.

☆ Your score determines your court rank

The unique feature of MARODISⅡ is the Court Rank Progression System.

Your total score determines your position within the ancient Japanese court hierarchy.

Start from the lowest rank and advance through 30 stages:

Jr. Initial L
↓
Sr. 5th U
↓
Sr. 3rd
↓
Sr. 1st (Highest Court Rank)

Every achievement is recorded by the highest court rank you have reached.

☆ The challenge of reaching Sr. 1st

The path to the highest court rank is extremely challenging.

As the falling speed increases, you must make quick decisions, control the falling balls accurately, and plan your moves several steps ahead.

Only players who master both speed and strategy will reach Sr. 1st.

Challenge your limits and aim for the ultimate score.

☆ Heian elegance meets competitive score attack

A unique puzzle experience combining the refined beauty of Japan's Heian period with the excitement of a high-score challenge.

Enjoy the atmosphere of an ancient imperial court while competing for the highest rank.

How far can you rise?

☆ Game Rules

MARODISⅡ is a falling-block puzzle game set in the Heian period of Japan.

Control seven-colored temari balls falling from above and clear them by:

・Connecting 8 or more balls of the same color
・Completing a horizontal line

Cleared balls can create Chains and Combos, allowing you to earn even higher scores.

The game ends when stacked balls reach the top of the board and overlap with newly appearing balls.

☆ Scoring System

1. Color Clear

Connect 8 or more balls of the same color to create a Color Clear.

The more balls cleared at once, the higher your score.

2. Line Clear

Complete a horizontal line to create a Line Clear.

Clearing multiple lines at once rewards you with a large score bonus.

About the Game

If the world of the game were a single image, you would be able to directly manipulate the layers that make it up.

<LAIN> is a 2D puzzle platformer that reimagines the layer system found in image-editing software as a core puzzle mechanic. Disable layers to remove obstacles, rearrange their order to change how objects interact, and find your way to the destination.

Turn Layers Off, Turn Them On, and Create a Path

A wall blocking your way does not always need to be destroyed. Turn off the layer containing it, and the wall will disappear as though it had never existed.

However, disabling a layer also affects every platform and object within it. Decide what you need at each moment, toggle layers on and off, and create a new path forward.

Swap the Layers

Active layers are stacked in order from top to bottom.

Changing their order does more than alter what appears on the screen. It also changes the relationships between overlapping objects and the way each puzzle functions.

Observe carefully, decide which layer should move forward and which should be pushed back, and uncover the hidden solution.
