store_data.about_the_game:
Mapping Creator: Draw history the way YOU always wanted!

In Mapping Creator, you are unconstrained by the complex mechanics of other grand strategy games. The world is truly yours to paint, the wars are yours to recreate in detail, and history is what you make of it.

Paint the map the way you want!

Use a wide variety of tools to customise the colours, shapes, names and flags of countries, and make their borders pixel perfect with a brush.

Recreate conflicts in detail!

Click, rotate and drag units on the map to make them advance, form a front line and fight other nations. The location, size and outcome of each engagement is up to you!

Assemble it all for a glorious final timelapse!

Automatically record your gameplay to compile it into a video with no need for additional software.

If you’ve always wanted to decide history down to the smallest details, show how your dream conflict idea would go, and display the final product quickly and easily, this is the game for you!

store_data.about_the_game:
In 2012, the animated series "Ninja Action" premiered in the 2D style of console games. It was inspired by games such as Mortal Kombat, BattleToads, Double Dragon, Chinese action films of the 1980s and 1990s, and many other works from the late 20th and early 21st centuries.

In 2026, we are pleased to present to you what our team has been working on out of pure passion: the first official game based on the cartoon!

Game Features:

A familiar fighting game combat system;

Colorful interaction with the environment to achieve the goal;

Platforming through nostalgic locations;

Signature humor;

A memorable soundtrack.

Remember your childhood, remember your first console, remember your first arcade game!

When developing the game, we tried to preserve the cartoon's style while keeping up with the times.

The game is in active development.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Moho-Moho DX" is a deluxe, expanded version of the free game "Moho-Moho."

Featuring over 6 times more main stages, a new 99-slot custom stage feature, enhanced auto-generation, time attack modes, and numerous new background tracks, this version has evolved significantly to offer over 100 hours of gameplay.

Basic Rules of "Moho-Moho DX"

First, check the completed image in the upper right corner of the screen! Place the color blocks onto the canvas to recreate the picture exactly as shown.

Once the game starts, 48 blocks will line up in the palette at the lower right of the screen. The blocks will slowly descend from the top of the canvas. Use the following controls to place them:

  • Arrow Keys (Left/Right): Move the block

  • A Key: Spin

  • Down Arrow: Increase fall speed

  • Up Arrow: Instant placement

  • B Key: Skip

Key Points

  • Skip: The number of skips is counted, but it is not a mistake. Skipped blocks return to the end of the palette and are marked with a ▼ symbol.

  • Chance Lost: Missing a spot where a block can be placed is counted as a "Chance Loss." This is not a mistake.

  • NG Piece: Placing a block in the wrong location results in an error.

  • Game Over: If the blocks exceed the blue line on the canvas by 2 rows, it's game over. Complete the picture to clear the stage! Depending on the mode, the completion rate (%) will also be displayed. Aim for 100%!

Play Across Diverse Stages and Modes!

  • Main Stages: 333 stages × 3 modes = 999 variations to play!

  • Random Stages: Play randomly selected stages from the main stages.

  • Auto-Generated Stages: 4 difficulty levels (Easy, Normal, Hard, Ultra) × 3 modes.

  • Custom Stages: 99 editable stages × 3 modes. Share your 192-character stage data with friends via SNS or email!

3 Unique Game Modes (+α)

  • FIX Mode: For beginners. No game over, allowing you to relax and aim for a 100% completion rate.

  • SIMILAR Mode: For intermediates. Incorrectly placed blocks remain on the canvas.

  • MIRROR Mode: For advanced players. The reference image is horizontally flipped, requiring you to solve it while reversing it in your mind.

Challenge Your Personal Best!

When you clear a stage, your results are saved on the stage selection screen:

  • Completion Rate (%)

  • Clear Time

  • Number of Skips

  • Number of Mistakes

Unlockables & Extra Challenges

Clear any main stage with 100% completion and zero mistakes to earn a trophy 🏆 and unlock 1-minute, 3-minute, and 5-minute Time Attack modes! Aim to complete them all.

Furthermore, if you earn all 999 trophies (333 main stages × 3 modes), a "Palette Toggle Switch" will appear at the top of the stage selection screen, allowing you to hide the palette during gameplay. Enjoy the ultimate challenge!

You can also hide the timer using the "Timer Toggle Switch" at the top of the stage selection screen.

Change BGM Anytime

Press the "♪" button at the top of the screen during gameplay to randomly change the background music whenever you like.

Video Streaming & Monetization Guidelines

Video streaming (let's plays, gameplay footage, etc.) and monetization via streaming platform features are permitted without prior notice, regardless of whether you are an individual or a corporation.

store_data.about_the_game:
【Inherit the Archive of Fate, Forgotten by the World】

You were once an ordinary person living on Earth.

An unexpected crossing carries you into a world where gods, spirits, Sequences, and supernatural powers are all real. You belong to no faction, possess no inherited bloodline, and are bound by neither a predetermined Sequence nor an established fate. For that very reason, an ancient existence that has lain dormant for centuries chooses you—the Archive of Fate.

Once, its halls preserved countless bodies of knowledge, rituals, potion formulas, and Sequence legacies. Complete records of all twenty-two Major Arcana paths could be found within its collection.

Now, its treasures have been scattered and every former heir has vanished. The only presence left to answer you is the Afterglow—a fading consciousness with fractured memories and dwindling power.

And you are the Archive of Fate’s sole and final heir.

【Prepare, Embark, and Venture Forth Again】

The game revolves around two interconnected phases: preparing at home and embarking on randomized expeditions.

Organize your deck and inventory → Choose a region → Traverse a randomized map → Face battles and events → Collect cards and materials → Return home → Brew potions → Advance your Sequence → Set out once more

At home, you can refine your deck, manage your inventory and attributes, study alchemical formulas, and plan around the region, time of day, and weather conditions ahead.

Every expedition generates a brand-new side-scrolling map. Choose your path between battles, random events, shops, treasures, rest sites, and formidable enemies as you gather experience, cards, gold, materials, and forgotten knowledge.

Pressing deeper promises greater rewards—but also deadlier threats. Returning before it is too late allows you to preserve your gains, adjust your build, research new formulas, and prepare for the next journey.

【Wield a Variety of Cards and All 56 Minor Arcana】

Tarot is not mere decoration. It is woven directly into the rules of combat and progression.

You can wield a wide variety of cards and build your deck around the complete set of 56 Minor Arcana. Wands, Cups, Swords, and Pentacles each possess distinct elemental affinities, tactical roles, and symbolic meanings.

Every Minor Arcana card has both an Upright and a Reversed form. These two forms accumulate Attunement independently, advance through separate growth stages, and gradually unlock new branches of effects.

The same card may grant empowering possibilities in one form while revealing a dangerous shadow in the other. To truly master a Tarot card is to understand—and wield—every side of its nature.

【Choose from Twenty-Two Major Arcana Sequences】

Your journey does not always begin with the Fool.

Because you come from another world, you are unbound by its established Sequence system and the karmic ties of its past. This allows you to carry the destinies of different—and sometimes even contradictory—Major Arcana.

You may choose your first path from twenty-two Major Arcana Sequences.

The Fool embodies the unknown, adventure, and limitless possibility. The Magician represents creation, communication, and skill. The High Priestess leads toward wisdom, intuition, and hidden truths. The Emperor pursues order and dominion. Death signifies endings, transformation, and rebirth...

Every Sequence offers its own abilities, potions, rituals, methods of embodiment, and conditions for advancement.

Choosing a Sequence is more than choosing a class.

You must understand it, live by it, and gradually become the archetype embodied by that Major Arcana.

Until at last, you ascend to godhood.

【Freeform Alchemy and Sequence Advancement】

In this world, potions are the path through which mortals enter the supernatural Sequences.

Materials gathered during expeditions possess different elements, medicinal properties, qualities, hidden traits, and potential substitutes.

You are free to select your ingredients and precisely adjust their quantities. Discover synergistic combinations, avoid conflicting properties, or experiment in hopes of triggering unknown effects. The outcome of each brew may also be influenced by the time, weather, location, and your level of alchemical mastery.

Official formulas provide reliable guidance, but they are not necessarily the only—or best—solutions. Through repeated experimentation and careful record-keeping, you can discover superior combinations, uncover hidden proportions, and preserve formulas of your own creation.

Experience and levels are only prerequisites for advancement.

To rise to a higher Sequence, you must also brew and consume the corresponding potion, embody the principles of your path, and complete its required advancement ritual.

Power is never a gift without a price.

The wrong ingredients or proportions may weaken a potion, build up toxicity, waste precious resources, or even cause the drinker to gradually lose their sense of self.

【Ascend to Godhood Twenty-Two Times】

To restore the Archive of Fate, all twenty-two divine seats of the Major Arcana must be recorded once again.

In the past, each seat belonged to a different godlike being. Now, only one heir remains. You must therefore walk all twenty-two Sequences alone.

Choose a Major Arcana Sequence, begin at Sequence 9, and progress through growth, embodiment, potions, and advancement rituals until you finally ascend to godhood.

Whenever you complete a Sequence, the Archive of Fate permanently records its corresponding divine seat.

You must then willingly relinquish the power you have just obtained, fall from godhood back into mortality, and begin the next path at Sequence 9.

The Archive can ensure that surrendering your divinity will not kill you. It cannot spare you from the growth, potions, rituals, and sacrifices required afterward.

You will never wield twenty-two divine powers at once.

What you gain instead is the experience of reaching the summit twenty-two times—and surrendering everything by your own hand each time.

【The Expedition Ends, but Your Legacy Remains】

A single expedition may come to an end, but your growth and legacy will not be erased.

Experience, gold, card collections, Attunement, materials, formulas, abilities, and discovered knowledge all carry over into your long-term progression.

You may continue developing the deck formed during your expedition, or rebuild it entirely and begin your next journey with a completely different strategy.

When you ascend through a Sequence and willingly relinquish its divinity, the corresponding divine seat is permanently preserved within the Archive of Fate.

Expeditions strengthen your character. The Sequence cycle gradually restores the Archive itself.

【Uncover the Truth Behind the Archive’s Fall】

How did the Archive of Fate fall from the greatest supernatural power in the world to a name almost no one remembers?

The Afterglow tells you that the former Keeper once reached Sequence 1 of the World Sequence. Only one final step remained before ascending to godhood and awakening the supreme treasure hidden deep within the Archive.

But word of this achievement was somehow leaked. The Keeper was betrayed and attacked, losing control at the final moment. The Archive of Fate fell into decline soon afterward.

Yet this is not the whole truth.

Who leaked the secret?

Who was truly responsible for the attack?

Why did the Keeper lose control at the final moment?

Have the Afterglow’s memories been altered?

Was the Archive of Fate the victim of a catastrophe—or the force that caused one?

The Afterglow is your first mentor.

It is also a narrator whose every claim must be verified by you.

【Three Wishes】

Deep within the Archive of Fate lies a dormant treasure said to be capable of granting three wishes.

Only after all twenty-two divine seats of the Major Arcana have been recorded can it truly awaken.

The first wish has already been written into the covenant of inheritance: restore the Archive of Fate and return this ancient power, forgotten by the world, to its former glory.

The other two wishes belong to you.

You may use them to return to Earth, undo the regrets of your past, reshape this world, or establish a future entirely different from the Archive of old.

But after ascending to godhood, relinquishing everything, and beginning again twenty-two times, will you still remain the person you once were?

Should you restore the Archive of Fate as it existed in the past—or create a new age defined by your own choices?

When every thread of fate converges, the true question may not be what your wishes can accomplish, but—

【What do you ultimately wish to become?】

But word of this achievement was somehow leaked. The Keeper was betrayed and attacked, losing control at the final moment. The Archive of Fate fell into decline soon afterward.

Yet this is not the whole truth.

Who leaked the secret?

Who was truly responsible for the attack?

Why did the Keeper lose control at the final moment?

Have the Afterglow’s memories been altered?

Was the Archive of Fate the victim of a catastrophe—or the force that caused one?

The Afterglow is your first mentor.

It is also a narrator whose every claim must be verified by you.

【Three Wishes】

Deep within the Archive of Fate lies a dormant treasure said to be capable of granting three wishes.

Only after all twenty-two divine seats of the Major Arcana have been recorded can it truly awaken.

The first wish has already been written into the covenant of inheritance: restore the Archive of Fate and return this ancient power, forgotten by the world, to its former glory.

The other two wishes belong to you.

You may use them to return to Earth, undo the regrets of your past, reshape this world, or establish a future entirely different from the Archive of old.

But after ascending to godhood, relinquishing everything, and beginning again twenty-two times, will you still remain the person you once were?

Should you restore the Archive of Fate as it existed in the past—or create a new age defined by your own choices?

When every thread of fate converges, the true question may not be what your wishes can accomplish, but—

【What do you ultimately wish to become?】
store_data.short_description: A single-player card RPG blending Tarot mysticism, roguelike deckbuilding, and lasting progression. Use a wide variety of cards alongside all 56 Minor Arcana, brew potions, explore randomized regions, and unleash rule-breaking Sequence skills to reshape battles, events, and fate itself.

store_data.about_the_game:
FLOPPY SURVIVORS is a bullet heaven roguelite about one tiny floppy disk against an entire corrupted network. Stack auto-firing antivirus weapons, survive endless malware hordes, complete recovery jobs, and fuse pairs into devastating DUAL weapons.


You're DISK #47, and the network wants you deleted. The question is... why?





Deleting malware is just survival; repairing the system is your true objective. Completing tasks visually restores the battlefield and grants massive upgrades:


  • Stabilize damaged sectors.
  • Close numbered ports.
  • Seal quarantine nodes.

Survive long enough to delete all 10 bosses, then hold the FINAL DEFRAG core for 60 seconds to win.





Inventory space is tight, but fusion is your way out. Upgrade two programs to Lv. 5 to fuse them into a massive DUAL weapon, freeing up a slot for even more firepower. Experiment with combinations, discover the hidden synergies, and save every successful build into your permanent DUAL.DAT archive.



CRACK CACHES, UPGRADE, SURVIVE


Deleting a boss cracks open its cache, rewarding you with one POWER DRIVER and two instant skill upgrades. Customize your build on the fly:


  • Push damage into overdrive.
  • Speed up system recovery.
  • Reshape movement and blink timing.

DECRYPT THE MYSTERY


Defeating bosses across all difficulties unlocks 30 unique INTERCEPT signals. Every victory permanently strengthens your build while piecing together another fragment of the story.



SAVE YOUR PROGRESS IN RECOVERY.DIR


Levels and equipment wipe when you reboot, but your discoveries are permanent. Log system files, DUAL records, and restored sectors into your archive. Every two records permanently boost your max HP, while collecting boot disks and completing operations unlocks entirely new starting builds.

FOLLOW THE SIGNAL


Escalate the threat. Clearing an act unlocks higher difficulties and traces of new signals. Recover all 52 archive records and 30 signals to verify MASTER.IMG and unlock the LAST BOOT, a finale you must execute yourself.

ENDLESS ON YOUR TERMS


Dive straight into ENDLESS mode after the Main Recovery. Your ENDLESS.LOG auto-saves extension time, deletions, and recovered data every 30 seconds. When your system can't take any more, safely retire via the pause menu and review your personal bests on the WRITE VERIFIED results screen.

THE WHOLE GAME FITS ON A FLOPPY


The entire Windows executable, including the full game and all 15 code-synth tracks, clocks in under the capacity of a single 1.44 MB floppy disk. Visuals, effects, and music are procedurally generated at runtime from raw code and compact data tables instead of bloated media files.

SYSTEM FEATURES


  • 20-Minute Main Recovery featuring 4 field jobs, 10 bosses, and a 60-second FINAL DEFRAG.
  • Massive Arsenal with 9 auto-firing programs and all 36 pairwise DUAL weapons.
  • Deep Customization utilizing 5 active program slots, plus 1 POWER DRIVER and 2 upgrades after every boss.
  • 52 Persistent Records to recover, including 12 system files, 36 DUALs, and 4 restored sectors.
  • Escalating Threats with 30 first-time boss signals across three sequential threat levels and a LAST BOOT finale.
  • 6 Boot Disks that completely change your starting programs and baseline abilities.
  • Multiple Game Modes including Boss Gauntlet, Build Lab, One-Life Trial, and an ENDLESS mode with persistent records.
  • Dynamic Audio featuring 15 adaptive code-synth tracks that build with combat pressure.
  • Global Support for a single-player game with interface localization in 30 languages.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your fighter flies itself. The war is yours to win.

FarmWings is a farming idle with arcade shmup combat. The plane dodges, shoots and farms without you — your role is strategy: where the gold goes, when to fall back and farm, and the right moment to get PROMOTED.

⚔️ 4 playable fighters with unique weapons: spread bursts, piercing laser, incendiary bombs and homing missiles — each with its own story.

🧠 Adaptive AI bosses: every biome has a custom boss that reads your ship and reacts. After each special, a golden vulnerability window rewards attentive pilots.

🌍 5 golden-hour biomes with real difficulty walls that demand farming, gear and decisions.

⭐ Rise in rank: finish a lap, earn permanent Cores, restart stronger in a world that got meaner (HARDCORE laps).

💎 Daily treasures: bosses drop Treasure Clues with animated hunts.

🕹️ True idle: tiny always-on-top window, unlockable offline progress and an upgrade tree with real choices.

Available in English, Português, Español, 中文.

Your goal is to restore stunning illustrations that have been divided into equal pieces. Rotate each piece and place it in the correct position to reveal the complete image.

Whether you're looking for a relaxing pastime or enjoy visual puzzle games, Chronime Puzzle: Dogs offers a calm and rewarding experience accompanied by soothing music.

Features:

• 50 unique levels
• Beautiful steampunk anime-inspired artwork
• Simple and intuitive mouse controls
• Steam achievements
• Relaxing music and atmosphere
• Gradually increasing difficulty
• Casual and stress-free gameplay

store_data.about_the_game:
Party Tycoon: Takeover

Build a nightlife empire one event at a time. Book the night, open the doors, and turn a rough room into the hottest venue in town - then do it all again somewhere bigger.

Throw the events - Run nights across a range of venues, each with its own layout, crowd, and quirks. A canal-side bar plays nothing like a warehouse rave.

Hire and train your staff - Put bartenders, security, and crew on the floor, level them up, and keep the drinks flowing when the place fills up.

Keep the crowd happy - Read the room, clear the bottlenecks, and win over every guest - including the VIPs who are never easy to please.

Survive the night - Police raids, blown fuses, surprise headliners. No two nights run the same.

Climb the leaderboards - Stack your cash, fame, and reputation against Party Tycoons worldwide, and form crews to rise together.

Host together - Invite other players into your venue and run the night side by side.

Features

* 8 venues to unlock and build up - from a damp basement to a canal barge, a yacht and a moon dome (more coming)

* 245 event nights, each with its own crowd, modifiers and payout

* Three goals a night, drawn from 79 goal types - pour drinks, hold the hype above 75 for 100 seconds, check 22 jackets, eject troublemakers, get through a police raid without a bust, or pet two basement rats before the doors open

* 22 stations to staff - beer bar, cocktail counter, VIP bottle service, cloakroom, food truck, photo booth, show stage

* 21 crew roles, each trained up over five levels, and 38 upgrades to buy

* 33 decor pieces to raise a venue's ambience and start nights hotter

* No two nights alike - difficult VIPs, police raids, blown fuses, surprise headline DJs

* Online multiplayer - co-host events, form crews, and climb the global leaderboards

store_data.about_the_game:
Memory Cyphers is an online co-op Survivors-like for 1-4 players. Cut through endless hordes, put together a new build every run, and destroy the machine draining the city's memories.

1-4 PLAYER CO-OP

Play solo or bring in up to 3 friends. There are four Cyphers to choose from. Heaven fires a high precision pistol, Kite works with afterimage blades and clones, Glitch runs twin pistols alongside drones, and Dr. Echo calls in summons with a modified shotgun. If you go down, a teammate can carry you to a revival station and get you back up.

A NEW BUILD EVERY RUN

Enemies drop memory chips, and you spend them to level up. You can carry up to 4 weapons and take each one to Lv.5, and every level changes how that weapon fires.

Chests hold relics that break the rules. Bullets that explode on kill, crits that always land, drones that hit harder. Once those start stacking, the whole screen goes off at once.

SURVIVE THE SWARM

The streets fill back up no matter how fast you clear them. When it gets out of hand, hit Cypher Shift and dash straight through the crowd. It gets you out when you are surrounded, and it gets you back in when a teammate is the one stuck.

KILL THE COLLECTOR

Hold out through every wave, finish your build, and take down the final boss together.

A CITY THAT KEEPS CHANGING

Neon back alleys, open plazas, rooftop districts. Every map has a different layout and different enemies. No two runs play out the same way.

THE STORY

Memora Corporation drains people's memories with a machine called the Collector. The ones it empties keep walking, and they attack anyone who still remembers. You are a Cypher, one of the few who kept theirs. Take the city's memory back.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bonklab

A first-person voxel physics destruction sandbox. Shoot it, burn it, blow it up, run it over — you pull the trigger, physics takes it from there.

Welcome to Bonklab

In this lab, destruction isn't an accident — it's the recommended methodology. The test subjects are in position, the barrels are stacked in neat rows. All that's missing is you, pressing the button.

Chain-Reaction Disasters

The first barrel goes up. Then the tenth. Steel beams come down on the crowd, ragdolls launch into the air, and fire follows the oil trail right back to where you're standing. Hundreds of subjects can tumble, shatter, and burn on screen at once — this engine was built for scale, and it regularly produces results none of us saw coming.

D-Scanner: Full Lab Access

Use it to spawn subjects, grab objects, build rigs, and set things on fire. Stack a ten-story barrel tower. Drive a leaking pickup in a circle around a crowd and lay down a fuse. Or bury explosives under their feet, hit the horn, and invite a few more subjects over.

Voxel-Level Destruction

Bullets, axes, mallets, a truck bumper — whatever you use, voxels break away chunk by chunk from the point of impact. A severed arm is still a physics object when it hits the ground, and it can still be broken apart again.

Observation Mode

Detach from your body at any time, slow the world to a tenth speed, and orbit freely through the collapse. Every disaster you cause comes with its own camera crew.

Lab Expansion

Contraption building · Faction battles · Circuits & traps · Workshop

At Bonklab, the only thing that stays intact is your imagination.

In the age of artificial intelligence, the last human being on Earth is kept in captivity to supply "creativity"—a quality that AI cannot generate yet is essential to the continuation of civilization. <h2>Real chemistry. Not fantasy alchemy.</h2>

Substance Lab POL is an educational chemistry game grounded in real scientific information—not magical potions or invented fantasy recipes. You combine substances based on real chemical reactions, study real materials, and learn through practice.<br><br>

Craft, quiz, and rhythm modes share one goal: help you explore chemistry that actually exists in the real world.<br><br>

<h2>Combine with real chemistry</h2>

Mix elements and compounds using combinations inspired by real reactions and formulas. Discover substances the way chemistry works—through structure, properties, and workable equations—not random fantasy crafting.<br><br>

Build a growing library of real-world materials as you unlock new results through experimentation.<br><br>

<h2>Solve problems and quizzes</h2>

Test what you’ve learned with quizzes on substances, reactions, and chemistry knowledge. Problem-solving sits at the center of the experience, so progress comes from understanding—not only from collecting icons.<br><br>

<h2>Rhythm challenges</h2>

Switch to rhythm minigames for short, focused sessions between study and crafting. A different pace, same lab.<br><br>

<h2>Features</h2>

<ul class="bb_ul">

<li>Combination gameplay based on real chemistry information</li>

<li>Substance discovery grounded in real materials and reactions</li>

<li>Quizzes and problem-solving to reinforce chemistry knowledge</li>

<li>Rhythm minigames for quick play sessions</li>

<li>Growing library of unlocked substances</li>

<li>Multi-language interface support</li>

</ul>

<h2>Who is it for?</h2>

Players who want a chemistry learning game—not a fantasy alchemy RPG. If you like combining real substances, answering chemistry questions, and mixing in light rhythm play, this lab is for you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Can you and your party find the AI hiding among you before it's too late?

Turing Heads is a social deduction party game where one of the players in your group isn't human — and it's very good at pretending otherwise.

Every round, everyone answers the same prompt. Best pizza topping. Perfect Saturday. The one thing you'd change about the world. Nothing complicated — just enough for the group to start reading into who wrote what. Then the accusations start: study the answers, guess who's human and who's the machine, and try not to get fooled.

At the end of the game, everyone makes one final call — and the group lives or dies by the majority. Get it right together, humans win. Get it wrong, the AI walks away having convinced a room full of people it was one of them.

No usernames, no faces — just codenames and the words you chose. Which, it turns out, is plenty to give you away.

The AI isn't static, either. Every answer real players write feeds back into what it learns from — so the more people play, the sharper it gets at sounding like one of you.

Key Features

  • 3 to 8 players per game, plus one hidden AI — jump into a Quick Play match or set up a Custom game with friends using a join code

  • Every round is a new prompt, a new read, and a new chance to be wrong about someone

  • One hidden AI opponent per game, built to blend in — not to announce itself

  • A majority-vote win condition that makes the whole group's read matter, not just yours

  • An AI that isn't running from a fixed script — it learns from real answers real players write, and gets sharper the more people play

  • Built for streamers: anonymous codenames keep the spotlight on the guessing, not the players

  • Full English and French support

A computer would deserve to be called intelligent if it could deceive a human into believing that it was human.

Prove it wrong. Or don't — and explain to your friends how you got fooled.

store_data.about_the_game:
ACT NATURAL. STEAL EVERYTHING.

Sneaky Pig is a multiplayer twist on classic hide-and-seek.

One team plays as shapeshifting Druids attempting to rob a peaceful village. The other team plays as armed Hunters trying to identify which animals are villagers—and which ones are thieves in disguise.

Study the animals. Copy their behavior. Steal the treasure. Just do not look suspicious.

SCOUT BY NIGHT

Each round begins after dark.

The Druids transform into bats and fly above the village, scanning buildings and surrounding areas for valuable objects. Use this time to memorize escape routes, locate the best targets, and plan your daytime disguise.

The Hunters are already searching.

They can spot and shoot down suspicious bats, disrupting the Druids’ reconnaissance before the real heist begins. Getting eliminated during this phase costs valuable scouting time, but it will not remove you from the round.

BLEND IN BY DAY

When morning arrives, the Druids must enter the village disguised as its animals.

Observe a chicken, pig, sheep, dog, or another nearby creature to copy its appearance. Then behave exactly like it would.

Walk with the herd. Stay inside the pen. Eat, wander, and stop at believable moments. Sudden turns, unusual routes, and animals standing where they do not belong may attract the Hunters’ attention.

You are not simply hiding.

You are pretending to be part of the world.

STEAL WITHOUT GETTING CAUGHT

Valuable objects are hidden throughout the village.

Druids must reach them without breaking character, steal them, and hold onto them for as long as possible. Every theft triggers an alarm within the surrounding area, immediately warning nearby Hunters that something is wrong.

Hunters score by eliminating disguised Druids and receive additional points for taking down anyone carrying stolen treasure.

If a treasure carrier is eliminated, the stolen object returns to one of its possible locations—forcing both teams to search for it again.

EVERY SHOT MATTERS

Hunters begin with only five rounds of ammunition.

After firing, one bullet is restored every 60 seconds. Shooting every suspicious chicken is not a winning strategy.

Watch how the animals move. Look for broken routines. Communicate with your team, corner your target, and pull the trigger only when you are confident.

A missed shot gives the Druids another chance to disappear into the herd.

BEST OF FIVE

Matches are played as a best-of-five contest, with the first team to win three rounds taking the match.

  • Hunters earn points for eliminating Druids, with bonus points for defeating treasure carriers.

  • Hiders earn points by stealing valuables and keeping possession of them.

  • Players on the winning team receive a 1.5× reward bonus at the end of the match.

Individual greed may earn you points, but only teamwork wins the hunt.

MULTIPLE WAYS TO PLAY

Respawn Mode

Eliminated players return at a safe location away from nearby Hunters, keeping every player involved until the round ends.

Infection Mode

An eliminated Hider returns as a Hunter and joins the search for their former teammates. The hiding team becomes smaller with every mistake, turning the final minutes into an increasingly desperate chase.

Will you protect the remaining Druids—or become the village’s most dangerous tracker?

A DIFFERENT MATCH EVERY TIME

Animal movements, treasure locations, disguises, player behavior, and false accusations make every round unpredictable.

A pig wandering through the village may be perfectly innocent.

Or it may be carrying the most valuable object in town.

Blend in. Watch closely. Trust nothing.

store_data.about_the_game:
A shell breaks. The Beast Court awakens.


The journey begins with a quiet crack inside the Myriad Nest. A shell splits, your first beast opens its eyes, and every source egg brought home after that becomes more than loot. Across 60 forms and 42 lineages, every beast enters the Beast Court with its own aptitude, traits, and history. You may remember the first rare lineage you hatch. But the one you remember longest may be the beast born from the plainest shell that stays with you all the way to the endgame.

Three beasts take the field. The six realms fight back.


A frontliner catches the opening blow. A controller takes over the middle. A finisher waits in the rear for one clean burst. Combat is fully automatic, but every outcome begins before departure: who takes each position, which skills form a chain, what supplies travel with them, and which route they follow. Once battle starts, there are no mid-fight commands. Watch the squad you built endure a bad turn or tear through a boss's defenses. When the line finally breaks, replay the loss and see exactly where it happened.

Send expeditions into the cloud sea


Ancient gates stand in the mist of Azuremist Spiritwood. Fire still runs beneath Crimsonforge Court. Skythunder Ascent and Moonveil Mirage wait farther across the cloud sea. A 20-minute patrol, a two-hour deep expedition, or an eight-hour deployment sends a squad through these realms to record each encounter and bring home materials, traces, and source eggs. Up to three squads can depart at once. Step away, and eggs continue to incubate while expeditions follow the course you set. When you return, the reports tell you where your beasts fought, what they found, and what came home with them.

Your chosen beast can stay to the end


A duplicate is not a forgotten name at the bottom of the roster. Same-lineage soul fusion preserves the main beast's level, bond, identity, and history while turning the second beast into another chance at higher aptitude and more stars. Failure never sets the main beast back, and the guarantee remains visible. That gives every broken shell a reason to matter: it may be a new lineage coming home for the first time, or the next step upward for the beast that has been with you from the beginning.

Beyond the six realms, the Primordial still waits


A finished formation does not make the six realms fall silent. Regional trials and the 60-floor Myriad Stair keep asking more of your roster. Beyond the story's final gate, Primordial Endless calls all three squads into a relay. Every shell you waited to break and every choice you made at the Soulforge pay off here as stronger formations, higher stars, and records that reach deeper into the Endless. The beasts that first crossed the gates with you can still stand in your endgame roster.

No daily chores, stamina bars, or limited entry tickets set the pace here. Send another squad beyond the clouds, or step away. The six realms will still be there when you return.

Core content


  • 42 lineages and 60 beast forms; collection is the start, a battle-ready roster is the payoff
  • Front, middle, and rear positions, roles, elements, and skill interactions that decide how each trio fights
  • Fully automatic combat driven by your formation and consistent rules, with pause, speed controls, and replay
  • 20-minute patrols, 2-hour deep expeditions, 8-hour deployments, and up to three expeditions at once
  • Source-egg hatching, lineage tracking, and regional guarantees that give every missing lineage a clear path
  • Same-lineage soul fusion, aptitude growth, and evolution that preserve the main beast's identity and history
  • Six regional trials, the 60-floor Myriad Stair, and post-story Primordial Endless
  • Buy once and play the complete single-player game—no ads, microtransactions, PvP, or daily gates

Master your movement as you jump across moving platforms, dodge deadly traps, climb towering walls, and conquer skill-based obstacle courses. Every stage introduces fresh mechanics and new challenges, keeping the adventure exciting from start to finish.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a food-delivery empire, one scooter at a time.

Two delivery giants already own this city. You've got one scooter, an empty map, and a plan to take the whole thing.

Takeout Mania is a real-city food-delivery tycoon. Import a real place — genuine streets, genuine buildings — sign its restaurants, put couriers on the road, and out-hustle the competition order by order until the entire city orders through you.

🗺️ A real city, not a grid

Every map is a real location pulled from the world. The streets, intersections and buildings are the genuine article, and your couriers navigate the true road network with live routing. Type in your hometown and run your empire down roads you actually know — no two cities play the same.

🤝 Win it deal by deal

Independent restaurants are up for grabs. Negotiate commissions, sign them to your platform, and poach the ones already flying rival colors. It's a street-by-street tug-of-war with two entrenched giants — GrubWay and HyperEats — and on the largest cities, a third shark in the water.

🛵 Dispatch like an operator

Early on, every order is yours to run. Drag couriers onto jobs 911-Operator style, juggle a fickle freelancer pool, and keep the food moving before it goes cold. Hire full-timers and unlock auto-dispatch once you're ready to stop sweating every single delivery.

📣 Market or die

Nobody orders from an app they've forgotten. Blanket districts with flyers, raise billboards, target specific neighborhoods with social campaigns, and run voucher, referral and spotlight promos. Awareness always fades — the marketing never stops.

🏙️ A city that lives without you

Households have budgets, cravings and daily rhythms. Restaurants open where demand runs hot, thrive on good reviews, franchise across town — or go bankrupt and leave a vacant unit for the next dreamer. From shawarma joints and pizzerias to sushi bars, delis and fine dining — 12 venue types, plus groceries and banks that will happily lend you the rope.

🎲 Trouble on the road

36 random incidents keep every run honest — a slammed kitchen, a food influencer at the door, a spilled drink, an allergy scare. There are no clean answers, only trade-offs: which stat can you afford to lose, and which one do you want to win?

🏢 From scooter to empire

Hit 100 reputation and found your headquarters, then choose the traits that define your operation: full-time hiring, marketing muscle, ghost kitchens that cook the cuisines you can't sign, auto-dispatch, customer support, sharper negotiators. Rent vacant units, open your own restaurants, and franchise your name across the map.

Features at a glance

  • Play a real city — anywhere on Earth
  • Couriers that ride the actual road network with live routing
  • Sign, negotiate and poach restaurants from two+ AI rivals
  • Hands-on 911-Operator dispatch, or automate it at scale
  • Deep marketing: flyers, billboards, targeted social, campaigns
  • A living economy of households, reviews, franchises and bankruptcies
  • 12 venue types, plus groceries and banks
  • 36 trade-off order events
  • Build an HQ and specialize with strategic traits
  • €/$/£ currencies and adjustable starting capital

Wishlist Takeout Mania and start your first shift.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gather your crew and prepare for battle! Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort is an intense 1-4 player co-op defense game where teamwork is your only hope against endless hordes of invading pigs.

Work Together or Fall Together
Communication and coordination are key. You and your friends must constantly run around the fort to keep your defenses operational. Load turrets, activate shield, and swap powerful crystal upgrades on the fly. When things get out of hand - and they will - you'll need to drop everything to extinguish spreading fires before your fort burns down!

Choose Your Goblin
Every member of your crew brings something unique. Find the playstyle that fits your team's strategy:

  • Gizmo: The reliable jack-of-all-trades. Good at a bit of everything, making him a perfect all-rounder for any situation.

  • Swizzle: The agile scout. Lightning fast with a handy double jump and quick ladder climbing, but his turret firing rate is severely reduced.

  • Enji: The resource manager. Excels at ammo management and climbs ladders slightly faster, though he suffers from a slower walking and shooting speed.

  • Hoovee: Heavy weapons guy. He walks and climbs at a snail's pace, but unleashes a devastating five-projectile spread (he eats through ammo much faster, though!).

Key Features:

  • 1-4 Player Co-op Chaos: Play solo or team up to protect the fort. Perfect your synergy to survive the panic.

  • Dynamic Defense Mechanics: Manage limited resources, juggle ammunition, and keep your fort's machinery running under pressure.

  • Unleash the Goblato: Turn the tide of battle by activating devastating ultimate ability when things get out of hand.

  • Endless Pig Invasions: Face off against wave after wave of varied, aggressive enemies trying to tear down your walls.

  • Dark Fantasy World: Experience the frantic action set against a striking visual style full of gloomy, eccentric charm.

store_data.about_the_game:
You open your eyes in a hospital that has no one else in it.

The only thing you cannot remember is why you came here.

You start walking, looking for a way out.
The corridor stretches on, and every turn shows you the same hallway again.

Or does it? A doorway that wasn't there. A light that should be off. Footsteps that shouldn't exist.

Every chart, diary, and belonging you examine throughout the hospital looks slightly different each time
— and slowly, an answer to "why am I here?" begins to take shape.

And when you finally turn around — something is already there.

Like standing inside a haunted house, all you can do is hold your breath, stay silent, and let its presence pass.

Key Features

- A Corridor That Never Ends

Explore a looping hospital corridor in first-person as you search for a way out. The hallway looks the same each time you walk it — until you notice it isn't.

- Stay Silent, Uncover the Truth

This isn't just about being scared. By examining medical charts, a patient's diary, and belongings left behind throughout the hospital, you gradually uncover the answer to "why am I here?" — combining the tension of a haunted house with the satisfaction of solving a mystery.

- A Horror That Reacts to Your Voice (Microphone Required)

This game requires a microphone. Staying quiet — holding your breath, keeping silent — is itself the core of the gameplay. The enemy can sense the sounds and your voice, causing it to approach, and even the brightness of the candle in your hand can change.

- A Short, Focused Horror Experience

Estimated playtime: 30 minutes to an hour. A tightly-paced horror experience you can fully enjoy in a single sitting.

Atmosphere & Setting

Your own footsteps echoing down an empty ward. A sound you can't quite place. The Falling Hospital is a psychological horror experience built around isolation, unease, and the slow, creeping dread of a place that refuses to let you leave — not fast-paced combat or scoring systems. Unarmed and alone, all the protagonist can do is observe, remember, and run.

store_data.about_the_game:
The gods are real. They are jacked. And Sean must die.

Somewhere down there is a mortal who owes the world a game. Every god wants to be the one who collects. Only one of them gets to.

Slay Sean, Save The World! is a fast, funny comic-book AUTO-BATTLER: draft a team of gods, build a broken board in the shop, and let the fists fly. Every run is a fresh puzzle. On the ranked ladder you fight real players' boards, left behind as ghosts. Win the pantheon, earn the punch.

No downtime. Draft, build, battle, repeat.

⚡ Build a god-tier board

  • Draft up to 3 gods, each with a signature ability and its own comic-book personality.

  • Shop for skills, then buy 3 of a kind to FUSE them into higher, nastier versions.

  • LVL UP to train raw stats, and set your formation: bruisers up front, casters in the back.

  • Trigger RESONANCE synergies when your team shares the right skills and watch a good board become an unfair one.

👊 Fight real players, not bots

  • Async ghost PvP: every enemy army is a real player's saved board, ready 24/7. No waiting for a match.

  • Climb a live ranked ladder through four tiers: Mortal, Hero, Titan, Olympian.

  • Your winning boards become ghosts other players have to beat. Leave your mark.

  • Rock-paper-scissors to the core: read the field, rebuild every session and hard-counter the meta.

🏆 Three ways to play

  • RANKED: the online ladder. Every win climbs you toward Olympian.

  • GYM: an offline sandbox against the bots. Learn the combos, earn XP, unlock rewards.

  • PvP: challenge a friend to a private best-of-lives duel.

🎨 A living comic book

  • Bold ink-and-color art, screen-shaking signature moves, and cinematic "acts of god."

  • Short, punchy runs that fit a coffee break but pull you into "one more run" for hours.

  • Easy to learn, deep to master: the shop is simple, the combos are not.

Draft your gods. Break the meta. Slay Sean. Save the world.

store_data.about_the_game:
The End of the Sea, Last Summer is a short yet unforgettable visual novel that tells the story of a chance encounter and a farewell over the course of one summer.

"For my final piece of art, I want to paint you.”

Kou Hanezu is a young painter who continues to pursue his dream despite suffering from monochrome disorder, a mysterious illness that slowly drains all color from his vision.

One day, he meets Sora Tsukishiro, a genius biologist who appears as a young girl.

Free-spirited and impossible to pin down, her arrival gradually sets his stagnant life in motion once again.

Under the blue summer sky, they share carefree days, exchange playful banter, and talk about their dreams.

As the colors continue to fade, Kou must decide whether to accept the fate imposed by his illness—or defy it.

This is not a story about making dreams come true.

It is a story about the encounter that brings a dream to its end.

"I want to kill everyone!”

"Everyone who's better than me at painting, everyone who's sneered at me, everyone who's more popular than me, everyone who won't even look at my art, everyone who underestimates me,”

"All of them! I'll kill them all!”

---

- A fully voiced visual novel with a playtime of approximately 1–2 hours.

- Over 50 event CGs and variations, vividly bringing the story's most memorable moments to life.

- Lively character interactions and the nostalgic atmosphere of summer.

- 10 original soundtrack pieces, featuring beautiful piano melodies that perfectly capture the spirit of summer.

- Vocal themes for both the opening and ending, performed by a talented cast of singers.

- A heartfelt and bittersweet story centered on the themes of color and life.

- A quiet, lingering ending that stays with you long after the credits roll.

---

Perfect for players who:

- Love emotionally resonant stories.

- Enjoy natural, engaging character interactions.

- Love stories set in the summer.

- Want a story that stays with them long after they've finished reading.

- Want to immerse themselves in charming visuals and full voice acting.

Streaming & Video Guidelines

We welcome gameplay videos and livestreams of The Edge of the Sea and the Last Summer!

You're free to create and share videos or livestreams as long as you follow the guidelines below:

- Please do not upload recordings consisting only of the game's content without commentary, editing, or other creative additions that help showcase the game.

- Please include "End of the Sea, Last Summer" in the title of your video or stream.

- Please include xioxyix's X account (@ykio_xo) and the game's Steam Store page URL in the video description.

store_data.about_the_game:
A cursed forest. Once you enter, there's no way out.

Step into these woods, and the Headless Woman will be there—watching from the shadows, hunting you from behind. But she's not the only thing to fear. The forest is filled with strange rules—break one, and a curse will follow.

Rules include, but are not limited to:

  • Do not approach certain "people."

  • Do not turn back on certain paths.

  • Do not open certain doors.

  • Do not cross certain parts of the forest.

  • Do not speak to the woman in the swimsuit.

  • Do not go near certain lampposts.

  • Some fences only exist in daylight.

A couple crashes into this forest after a car accident.
The wife disappears.
The husband survives—but he's just an ordinary man.
No weapons. No special abilities. No backup.

He soon realizes: the forest is not what it seems.
Walls that cannot be crossed in this world may not even exist in another.
Dead ends that trap him in the present could be open paths in a memory.

He must move between two worlds—
One is bright and empty. The other is dark, but holds the answers.
A dead end in reality might be the only way forward in the past.

He presses on through the dark, crossing forests he was told not to cross,
passing lampposts he was told not to approach,
and at every crossroad where he's told not to look back—
he forces himself not to.

He doesn't know if he'll find her.
But he knows that if he stops, there won't be any hope left.

This is a first-person psychological horror game.
You'll switch between two worlds to survive.
Every lamppost is a temporary shelter—and a rift to another reality.
Every step into the dark could trigger an unknown curse.
Every choice you make will shape her fate.

Can you find your way out?

store_data.about_the_game:
Potion Drop is an arcade puzzle game where you match sets of crates containing colorful potion bottles. The higher the level you reach, the higher your multiplier, but the less time you have before the next crate of potions drops. Can you keep up and score high before the board overflows?

FEATURES

  • Get in the flow with a new twist on Match 3

  • Fast-paced matching in Arcade mode, with a high score leaderboard

  • Relax and match at your own pace in Zen mode

A NEW TWIST ON MATCH 3

  • There are 3 different ways to make a match:

Set of crates with 1 difference (different fill levels)

Set of crates with 2 differences (different fill, and different number of bottles)

Set of crates with completely different potions

  • Many different combinations can work, so long as there isn’t an odd one out.

If 2 of the crates have full bottles, the 3rd must have full bottles too or it’s not a match

If 2 of the crates have triangle bottles, the 3rd must have triangles too or it’s not a match

A small game made by humans, for humans. No generative AI was used in any part of this game’s development.

store_data.about_the_game:
You're the boss of a hot-dip galvanizing plant.
Steel comes in dirty. Customers want it out coated, on time, and on spec — and they'll send it back if you cut corners. Bid the work, staff the zones, and keep the line moving from degrease to kettle to shipping. Every load is money on the line.

Grab the pendant and dip it yourself.
Let the kettle run on autopilot, or take manual control and work the crane by hand — immersion, cook, and extract, each on the stopwatch. Time the phases right and you pull a clean coat every load. Rush it and you're stripping and re-dipping on your own dime. Upgrade from a shop-stock pendant to dual-speed and tech LCD controls as you go.

Staff the floor, manage the people.
Assign crew to zones by skill, watch attendance and friction, and handle check-ins, call-offs, and the occasional formal warning. A short-staffed shift drags the whole line — but the right people in the right spots keep the steel moving and the book in the black.

Run the business, not just the line.
Bid one-offs, rush jobs, and weekly accounts. Ship on time to keep your reputation. Grow building, line, and kettle tiers when the books allow it. Miss a deadline and you lose the account; deliver clean and the work keeps coming.

Features

  • Full galvanizing line — degrease, rinse, acid, flux, kettle, unrack, and shipping

  • Contract bidding — cents-per-pound jobs, weekly accounts, rush and squeeze offers. Collect Customers watch your ledger grow!

  • Plant growth — expand building, line, and kettle capacity over seasons

  • Crew & HR — zone staffing, attendance, friction, check-ins, and formal warnings

  • Overhead cranes — auto handoffs or manual kettle control with stopwatch dip phases

  • Zinc & quality — inventory, burn-up, under-coating, damage claims, and rework

  • Daily & books reporting — lbs/man-hour, cash, zinc, and what actually made (or lost) money.

 

Bid the work. Run the pickle line. Don’t run out of zinc.

content_descriptors.notes:
Galvanize Simulator is a workplace management sim set in an industrial plant. It contains mild comedic and workplace themes, including:

Alcohol references — a foreman character is depicted drinking beer as comic relief. No substance abuse is encouraged or simulated as a mechanic.
Mild language — occasional mild profanity in workplace dialogue and events, consistent with a real shop-floor setting.
Workplace incidents — the game includes plant incidents, shift events, and shop-floor crises as gameplay events. These may reference industrial accidents or hazards in a non-graphic, cartoonish way. There is no gore or realistic depiction of injury.
Character death (memorial) — one character passes away during the storyline as a memorial tribute. It is handled respectfully and is not graphic.

The game contains no sexual content, no depictions of sexual assault, no self-harm content, and no realistic violence.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the subject of an observation.

You wake in a room you have woken in before. A bed. A monitor showing chambers you cannot see with your own eyes. A door that was not there yesterday. You are told to observe. You are not told why.

OBSERVATION PROTOCOL is a first-person psychological horror built around a single question you are never quite allowed to answer: who is watching whom?

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

THE CYCLE

Every cycle is a sleep and a waking. The room remains, but the space around it does not — new chambers appear, filled with records left by those who came before. Eighteen cycles. Eighteen versions of a place that refuses to stay the same. On the last of them, a door opens onto a corridor that should not exist. You walk through it. Behind you, the way back is already gone.

DESCENT

Beyond the corridor, the facility unfolds — a labyrinth that follows you, an archive that rearranges itself, a hall of mirrors where your reflection turns to face the wrong way. Each place watches differently. Each place remembers.

THE OBSERVER

At first it is only a glitch in the feed. Then a shape at the edge of the corridor. Then something with a body, standing where a body should not be. It does not always chase. It does not need to. It is learning to take form, and every cycle it is closer to finished.

THREE ENDINGS

The system records everything — where you go, what you touch, how long you look. Nothing is neutral. How you observe is how you are judged, and the ending you reach is the one you have been writing since the first waking.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

THE PATTERN

Some players will finish the game and move on. Others will notice that the numbers are not random. That the same figures repeat across rooms that share no reason to. That the records speak to something older than the facility, and colder than its walls. There is a second game hidden inside the first — one the code does not know it is telling. It leads somewhere. Whether you follow is up to you.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FEATURES

  •  Atmospheric first-person psychological horror across five distinct environments

  •  A monster that does not merely appear — it forms, cycle by cycle

  •  Three endings shaped by how you play, not what you pick from a menu

  •  A hidden layer of numbers, records, and symbols for those who look closer

  •  Cold, monochromatic surveillance aesthetic and a soundscape built to unsettle

  •  Roughly 3 hours of descent — longer, if you stay to read

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The longer you observe, the harder it becomes to tell where the pattern ends and where reality begins.

store_data.about_the_game:
LEAP INTO THE INFINITE NEON VOID

NeonBound is a fast-paced, first-person procedural platformer engineered for high-speed precision, rhythm, and endless skill progression. Set against a neon aesthetic, you are thrust onto a never-ending path of procedurally generated floating platforms. Every jump counts, every fraction of a second matters, and one wrong move sends you plunging into the void.

KEY FEATURES

  • Fluid First-Person Parkour Physics

Experience tight, responsive 3D movement optimized with Godot Jolt physics. Perform advanced maneuvers like mid-air strafing, precise landing adjustments, and high-velocity leaps. Built-in coyote time and input buffering guarantee smooth, high-speed flow without frustrating input drops.

  • Procedural Endless Generation

No two runs are ever the same! Dynamic platform paths continuously generate with varying gap distances, elevation changes, and rotational offsets. Adapt on the fly to evolving obstacles and testing formations.

  • Precision Landing & Multiplier Streak System

Precision is rewarded! Target the exact center of every block to score Perfect Landings, triggering extra XP. Chain rapid successful jumps within the streak window to build massive streak multipliers and push your high scores onto global leaderboards.

  • Level Up & Deep Visual Customization

Gain XP with every jump and level up endlessly! Unlock a rich library of visual customizations to tailor your aesthetic!

  • Seamless Native Controller Support

Full automatic input detection for Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro, and Steam Deck controllers.

  • Accessibility & Auto-Move

Optional toggles for auto-forward movement and customized control sensitivity.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ice Coast Revival is a ski-resort tycoon game about bringing New England's forgotten mountains back to life.

A Real New England History

New England is full of hills that used to have chairlifts. In the years after World War II, veterans of the 10th Mountain Division and small groups of local skiers strung up rope tows on hillsides across Vermont, New Hampshire, Maine, and Massachusetts. Most of those places never had the money for real snowmaking or a big enough base to survive. One by one they closed. Some in the 1980s. Some later. A few just a handful of years ago. The trails grew back in. The lift towers rusted. This game is about going back to one of those hills and starting over.

Build Your Mountain

Clear the terrain by hand. Ski runs take shape on the ground you actually open up, and you can draw, name, and rate your own signature trails. String up lifts as your budget allows, from a surface T-bar to double chairs, quads, and gondolas. Build a snowmaking fleet, groom at night, light the hill for night skiing, and watch the weather like your season depends on it, because it does.

Run a Real Business

Underneath it all is a real economy, not a score counter. Every skier on your hill is an individual who picks their own line, gets tired, gets hungry, and leaves reviews. Ticket, rental, food, and parking revenue land in their own ledger lines. Demand bends to your prices, your reputation, the weather, and the holidays, and a demand analyst on your team will tell you when you're pushing your luck. At season's end you sit down with the full books: an income statement, a balance sheet, and a statement of cash flows, plus a banker's valuation of what your mountain is actually worth. Loans charge real interest. Wages, electricity, and maintenance don't care that it hasn't snowed.

The Base Village

Down at the base, build a village that feels lived-in. Rentals, restaurants and cafés, bars, shops, a skating rink, and a lodge that grows from a warming hut into the kind of place people plan a trip around.

Play as a Founder

Play as one of ten founders, each with their own reason for showing up to the auction, their own strengths and baggage, and their own legacy to chase.

A Rival With Deep Pockets

And you won't be rebuilding in peace. Apex Summit Collective, the megapass conglomerate that consolidated the rest of the region, has noticed you. They poach your staff, spread rumors through the valley, and price lowball buyout offers straight off your own balance sheet. You can take the check. The game goes on either way, because in New England, closed doesn't always mean finished. Staying independent is the hard way, and the point.

Career Mode

Take it further in career mode. Acquire and restore real, historically lost ski areas across a New England region map, through purchases, legal settlements, petitions to the legislature, and inherited debt, with caretakers keeping your other hills alive while you work the next one.

Key Features

  • Terrain clearing where ski runs take shape on ground you've actually opened; draw, name, and rate your own trails

  • Lifts from T-bars and double chairs up to quads and gondolas

  • Snowmaking, night skiing, weather, and a grooming operation you run yourself

  • Persistent skiers who decide, tire, eat, and review your hill as individuals

  • Dynamic pricing with demand elasticity, player reviews, and a demand analyst

  • Full end-of-season books: income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow, plus a banker's valuation of your mountain

  • A base village economy with rentals, restaurants, cafés, bars, shops, and a skating rink, and a lodge that grows with you

  • Ten playable founders with their own goals, stories, and personalities

  • An acquisitive megapass conglomerate that poaches your staff and prices buyouts off your own books

  • Career mode across real New England lost ski areas, including acquisitions, legal settlements, and petitions on a region map

  • An original soundtrack with a theme for every hill, plus the in-game Mountain Radio

  • Daily Challenge and weekly cups for quick sessions

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the most relaxing corner of deep space! You find yourself on a damaged ship drifting in the void, but there is no reason to panic. This is your chance to exhale, spend some time with yourself, and turn a cold station into a warm, fully customizable "hygge" sanctuary.

Meditative Catching Process
Arm yourself with friendly futuristic guns and step out into open space to catch supply containers flying by. No timers, deadly threats, or penalties — just you, the endless vibrant cosmos, and complete freedom of action.

Maximum ASMR and Tactility Bring your loot into your cabin and put your tools to use: saws, lasers, and hammers styled as colorful gadgets. Every action you take — picking a lock, sawing through metal, or melting armor — is accompanied by incredibly satisfying visual and sound effects. It is an audiovisual pleasure comparable to playing with kinetic sand.

Furnish Your Space Home
As you open crates, you will find not only resources to upgrade your tools but also decor cards. Gather a complete collection of furniture and decorate the cabin to your liking: set up an aquarium, hang neon lights, add a disco ball or a pink flamingo. Turn a dull compartment into a place you will never want to leave!

Gradual Ship Repair
As you progress through the game, you will find rare quest parts. With their help, you will be able to repair life support systems, unlock new station compartments, and gradually restore the main engine to safely return to Earth in the finale.

store_data.about_the_game:
VERDANTIA

Pronunciation: vur-DAN-chee-uh

"Welcome to Verdantia — a world where nature and civilization thrive together in harmony."

Verdantia is the living world of the Eucalyptus Edge universe—a vibrant continent where towering eucalyptus forests, crystal-filled caverns, frozen mountain ranges, bamboo coastlines, and the sunbaked outback have shaped unique animal civilizations for generations. Every region has its own traditions, heroes, and stories, yet all share a deep respect for the natural world they call home.

Here, nature is more than scenery—it is the foundation of life. Ancient trees preserve history, rivers carve kingdoms from stone, the changing seasons shape entire cultures, and every festival celebrates the bond between civilization and the wild that surrounds it.

United by that shared respect, the regions gather once each year for a celebration unlike any other...

Welcome to Verdantia.

THE MEGABLAST FESTIVAL

FOUR FIGHTERS. ONE SCREEN. ONE WINNER.

Once every year, the greatest champions from across Verdantia gather for the MegaBlast Festival—the loudest, wildest celebration the world has ever known. The banners rise. The crowds roar.

Then somebody plants the first bomb.

Drop a bomb. Sprint for cover. Set the perfect trap. Every match lasts only minutes, but every decision creates another unforgettable story. Whether you're celebrating a last-second victory or laughing after launching yourself into your own explosion, every round becomes part of the festival.

The festival begins the moment the first bomb drops.

THE RULES ARE SIMPLE. SURVIVING ISN'T.

  • Smash crates. Collect powerups. Trap your rivals in the blast. Last fighter standing wins the round. First to three rounds wins the match.

  • Easy to learn, endlessly competitive, and guaranteed to end with someone saying, "One more match."

  • A bot instantly fills every empty seat, and every bot can be replaced the moment someone picks up a controller. Nobody waits. Nobody sits out. Everybody plays.

Easy to learn. Impossible to put down.

EVERY FIFTH BOMB CHANGES EVERYTHING.

Chaos never announces itself. Roughly one bomb in five mutates the instant it touches the ground—and nobody knows what's coming next.

  • GRAVITY — Pull nearby rivals before the blast.

  • CHAIN — Spawn a surprise quick-fuse bomb.

  • GHOST — Hide the explosion until it's too late.

  • MEGABLAST — Double the blast power and tear through crates.

Expect the unexpected.

SEVEN POWERUPS. COUNTLESS WAYS TO WIN.

  • Bomb+ — Carry more bombs.

  • Fire — Extend your blast farther.

  • MAX — Reach maximum blast radius instantly.

  • Speed — Move faster than ever.

  • Pierce — Blast through crates.

  • Kick — Launch live bombs across the arena.

  • Fuse — Change bomb timing and create new traps.

Combine powerups to discover new strategies—or spectacular mistakes.

FIVE REGIONS. TEN ARENAS.

Every arena is handcrafted and inspired by one of Verdantia's five regions. Learn each layout, master every shortcut, and use the environment to your advantage.

  • Eucalyptus Summit — Open ridges and sweeping sightlines.

  • Crystal Caverns — Tight corridors where every bomb matters.

  • Bamboo Harbor — Busy pathways filled with ambush opportunities.

  • Frostpine Ridge — Frozen terrain where hesitation is costly.

  • Sunbaked Outback — Wide-open spaces with nowhere left to hide.

BECOME THE FESTIVAL CHAMPION.

Take on the Region Tour and battle through every region of Verdantia. Earn medals, improve your skills, and prove yourself worthy of facing the festival's reigning champion.

Choose from four difficulty levels—Sprout, Ranger, Champion, and Legend—whether you're learning the basics or chasing perfection.

FEATURES

  • Up to four players in local multiplayer.

  • Eight unique playable fighters.

  • Ten handcrafted arenas across five regions.

  • Versus, Region Tour, and Random Arena modes.

  • Drop-in, drop-out bot support.

  • Chaos Bomb mutators.

  • Seven collectible powerups.

  • 55 Steam achievements.

  • Steam Cloud support.

  • Original soundtrack with unique music for every region.

  • Full controller support.

Grab your friends. Plant the first bomb. Become the MegaBlast Champion.

Note: MegaBlast Mayhem is designed for local multiplayer. All gameplay takes place on a single shared screen. Online multiplayer is not included.

THE ADVENTURE BEGINS HERE

MegaBlast Mayhem is the first game set in the world of Verdantia.

The festival crowns a champion... will it be you?

OSCILLARIS is a text-command RPG that takes place inside of an oscilloscope. Type your way through its wireframe streets, talk to programs who live there, use your words to defeat rouge signals! The game wanted to be found, now its up to you.

SOMETHING WAS HERE BEFORE YOU

OSCILLARIS is built on the ruins of its predecessor. It's programs don't remember what came before, but the world does. If you know where to look.

FEATURES

  • Type commands to walk, examine and interact with the world

  • Explore the wireframe world and find secrets within it's glowing vector lines

  • Meet programs with their own personalities and story to unfold

  • Survive incoming signals with their own agendas with your spelling skills and letter play

  • Discover fragments of a past that remembers more about you than yourself

NOT EVERY SIGNAL IS FRIENDLY

An echo remains from the past, running somewhere in the code. Explore the BOOT sector, but don't go looking for something you won't want to find.

Good luck!

store_data.about_the_game:
DODGE. EVOLVE. SURVIVE.

Gemfire Survival is a minimalist, high-octane action roguelike where your only objective is to survive the neon grid. Pilot your core through endless, escalating waves of geometric enemies, dodging incoming fire while your auto-blaster clears the path. Collect the emerald gems left behind by shattered enemies to level up, stack temporary upgrades, and create unstoppable, screen-clearing builds.

MASTER THE 60-SECOND CYCLE

The grid doesn't give you time to breathe. Every 60 seconds, a massive Boss—like the devastating Nova Barrage—spawns into the arena. You must balance clearing out the smaller swarmers with dealing focused damage to the boss before you get overwhelmed.

INFINITE META-PROGRESSION

Death is just a currency. Every gem you bank during a run is yours to keep. Head to the Neon Skill Tree between runs to spend your banked gems on permanent upgrades. Want to start with a faster fire rate, magnetic gem pickup, or reactive armor? You can. Best of all: every branch can grow forever. There are no level caps on your permanent progression.

CORE FEATURES

  • Deep Synergies: Combine dozens of Common and Rare upgrades during your run, from Phase Skates to Orbital Shields and Focus Lenses.

  • Uncapped Upgrades: Spend banked gems in the Neon Skill Tree on stats that scale infinitely.

  • Relentless Bosses: Face a new, escalating threat every single minute.

  • Hard Mode: Ready for a true challenge? Toggle Hard Mode for faster spawns, tougher enemies, and higher scores.

  • Arcade Aesthetics: Crisp neon visuals, satisfying particle explosions, and a pulsing synthwave soundtrack to keep you in the flow state.

store_data.about_the_game:
Kubo is a three-dimensional puzzle game about rebuilding fractured paths through space. Place route cards onto the faces of a cube, rotate each piece into position, connect the stars, and fill every required Kube to restore the network.

Each level presents a different arrangement of stars and a randomized set of route cards. Straight paths, corners, crossings, tunnels, and edge-wrapping routes must be placed in the correct locations and orientations to create one complete connection.

The rules are simple, but the puzzles steadily expand across multiple layers and all six sides of the cube. Later levels require you to think around corners, through the interior, and across several faces at once.

Key Features

  • Solve 50+ handcrafted spatial puzzles.

  • Place and rotate route cards on a fully three-dimensional cube to connect stars and fill every required Kube.

  • Master straight routes, corners, crosses, tunnels, and angled edge pieces.

  • Replay completed levels to improve your times.

  • Enjoy a PSX style pixel-art presentation set against a drifting cosmic backdrop.

The fractured cosmos is waiting. Every route must connect, and the stars will not find each other without you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Minesweeper Inc. crosses classic minesweeper deduction with an incremental economy. Dig cells, earn cash, end your shift, spend it all on gloriously irresponsible upgrades — then dig again, bigger and richer.

RUN SHIFTS, NOT MARATHONS Shifts are short and punchy. Hit a mine? Insurance covers most of it — losses are a line item, not a game over. Clear the whole field for a fat clean-shift bonus.

SEVEN FLOORS OF QUESTIONABLE GEOLOGY Your company tower is the world map. Each floor is a new biome with its own minefield, its own skill tree, and its own way to hurt you:

  • Garden — honest dirt, honest money. Learn the ropes.

  • Quarry — ride gold veins for stacking chain multipliers; extract gems flawlessly and the appraiser pays five times over.

  • Glacier — ice hides anything. Crack it and find out. Free gamble.

  • Volcano — open a magma vein and lava spreads cell by cell. Flags are your dam. Don't let it reach a mine.

  • Deep Space — three starfield squares, one decision: BANK the pot, or GO AGAIN at a hotter tier. Bust the pot, not your shift. Constellations pay cash on the side.

  • Data Center — bring six servers online by routing open corridors, and pass row audits fully flagged for a VERIFIED ×2.

  • The Casino — three locked clearance rings, scratch cards with the odds printed right on them, and a MEGA JACKPOT slot machine waiting in the vault. The house pays you. Mostly.

AUTOMATE AND DELEGATE Hire apprentice scanners that dig for you — cautious analysts or reckless gamblers, you set the policy. Buy the floor above and your old floor keeps earning in the background, shift after shift, even while you're away.

GO PUBLIC Prestige by selling your progress for Shares. Shares buy permanent board-level perks and new floors. Fill the corporate museum with 66 excavated artifacts — set bonuses included, duplicate protection included, dignity not included.

RISK IS A DIAL, NOT A DICE ROLL Set your own mine density between shifts. Higher density, higher pay, shakier hands. Wander into the dark zone — cells far from anything you've revealed — for a danger premium. And when deduction feels too honest, the Metal Detector will flag you a guaranteed safe cell. Limited charges. Expense it. The spreadsheet doesn't judge. It multiplies.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE UTENSILS HAVE TURNED. WHO KNOWS WHY. THEY JUST HAVE.

One day the forks were fine. Then the whisks got weird. Eventually the knives started to stare a bit too long. Now the entire kitchen wants you peeled, diced, mashed, or fried, and honestly at this point nobody remembers who started it. You're just here to survive it as a potato. Or a chicken. Or a steak. Look, we didn't overthink the lore either.

DartPotato is a fast, ridiculous action roguelike where you throw darts and occasionally dash through a rolling pin's aggro range. Build a run out of a growing pile of stacking upgrades — Ricochet, Explosive Impact, an array of rouge Orbiting Utensils that just vibe near you and attack enemies — before THE CHEF shows up to finish what the forks started.

FEATURES

  • Play as 5 different foods (Potato, Pork, Pie, Chicken, Beef), each in 3 "cuts" that fight completely differently — try clearing a city Nimble, then again as the Tank, just to see how much worse your life gets

  • 50 cities. Throw down in Peeladelphia, Tottsdale, Jacksongrill, Shangpie,  Chickago, Searacuse, and many more! Each one has its own opinions about how it wants to prepare you (swarm! fire! elite rush! a mallet with a vendetta!)

  • Hit up the Pantry where you can trade in your gathered resources for upgrades, reroll, hoard your favorite pick for when you have the goods, and slowly turn food into an unstoppable war crime

  • Get your name on the leaderboards for biggest lifetime score, highest wave conquered, and longest chain

  • 16 achievements, including one for tapping into your inner spuddy sense

  • Gamepad support, because hours of WASD just gets tiring

Hold the counter. Or wind up as dinner. There is no third option.

store_data.about_the_game:
G-Hell is a fast-paced sci-fi action roguelike that blends massive survivor-style horde battles with strategic inventory management. Every run sends you into a different world being devoured by a cosmic entity. Create powerful strategies through item combinations and embrace a mission with no return!

Fight and Endure!

You and your ship Aegis have one goal: fight through the hordes of the damned and kill the very god that is slowly killing humanity back on Earth. With the help of Aegis' automated weapon systems, you need to kill many different species of hostiles, decimate their eldritch brood nests, and find a way into the god to kill it from the inside out. No two journeys will ever be the same!

Strategise and Synthesise!

Loot the remains of the dimensions you are travelling through to build new and ever-changing combat strategies within the Aegis to stay on top of waves of enemies. Synergise different items and weapons amongst each other for even stronger effects. Continuously adapt to the challenges of each dimension and overcome what is before you!

Navigate and Advance!

Find your way through sprawling environments, evocative ruins, and hordes of flesh! The deeper you venture, the harder traversal becomes. Chain together the Aegis' movement capabilities to outsmart your enemies and to buy time to strategise. Don't lose sight of your objective!

Are you ready for your mission?
