store_data.about_the_game:
Every match starts on a perfectly clean white map.

It doesn't stay that way for long.

You've got a paintball gun, paint bombs, and shoes that leak color everywhere you walk. So does everyone else. The world is the scoreboard: whoever's color covers it, owns it.

Except for one small detail.

Paint has an owner — and owners can be removed. Take someone down and you don't just get a kill, you get everything they ever painted. Their floor. Their walls. Their half of the ceiling. All of it flips to your color in one wave that washes across the whole map.

You can grind out territory like an honest hardworking citizen and lose it all to one lucky shot. You can also BE that lucky shot. Whoever's winning wears a crown, and a crown is just a target with better lighting.

Everything is a canvas

Not just the floor. Walls, ceilings, benches, statues, priceless works of art — if it's in the map, it takes paint, and it counts. Yes, you can win by defacing the Mona Lisa. We checked with a lawyer. She's fine with it.

More maps and more ways to play are on the way — ColorFest is just getting started.

A remote island in midsummer—

The blazing sun, sparkling white sand, and an endless blue ocean.

On this island, a secret hide-and-seek tournament is being held exclusively for selected adult men and women.

If the seeker manages to find and capture a contestant before time runs out, a special “Secret Event” with that character will be unlocked.

Any contestant who remains uncaught until the end wins a grand prize of 10 million yen.

Those who are captured must follow the special rules they agreed to before entering the tournament and proceed to a private event with the seeker.

His workload keeps increasing.

His salary never improves.

His health is gradually deteriorating.

After spending years trapped in the same exhausting routine, a mysterious pink envelope arrives at his home one night.

Written inside are the words:

“You have been chosen as the one-in-one-hundred-million seeker.”

Still unsure whether to believe it, he travels to the designated harbor.

There, he is taken aboard a luxurious ship and transported to a mysterious island that does not appear on any map.

A mysterious royal woman who blends into the white sand.

A swift, red-haired woman with sun-kissed skin.

A blonde strategist who manipulates the other contestants from behind an elegant smile.

Some run.

Some hide.

Some use others as decoys.

And some hold their breath just a few steps away from the seeker.

As the remaining time continues to fall, the protagonist must follow the women’s traces and race across the tropical island.

Will he capture them?

Or will they escape?

A midsummer adult hide-and-seek tournament with 10 million yen at stake is about to begin.

This tropical pursuit action adventure combines exploration, chase sequences, character progression, and Secret Events.

The events that unfold on the island will change dramatically depending on whom you discover first.

◆ STORY

The protagonist is a middle-aged office worker employed by an exploitative company.

He has gained weight with age.

He works overtime until late at night.

His superiors constantly force additional work onto him.

Even when he finally returns home, all that awaits him is a cold boxed meal and a cluttered apartment.

Completely exhausted by a life spent traveling between the office and his home, he has almost given up on changing anything.

Then, one night—

After returning home on the last train, he discovers a pink envelope inside his apartment mailbox.

Inside is an invitation he has never seen before.

“You have been chosen as the one-in-one-hundred-million seeker.”

“You are invited to Naked Island.”

“Tournament prize: 10 million yen.”

The invitation is so suspicious that he initially dismisses it as a malicious prank.

However, with 10 million yen, he might finally be able to quit his job.

He might finally escape his life of endless overtime.

After struggling with the decision, he travels to the harbor written on the invitation.

Waiting for him there is a suspicious middle-aged organizer dressed in flamboyant clothing.

Guided by the organizer, the protagonist arrives on a tropical island that does not appear on any map.

The people gathered on the island are all adult female contestants.

Each of them has entered the tournament in pursuit of the 10-million-yen prize and hides somewhere on the island using her own unique strategy.

The protagonist has been assigned the role of the tournament’s only seeker.

His objective is to discover and capture as many hidden contestants as possible before time runs out.

However, the women will not simply remain hidden.

When they spot the protagonist, they become startled and immediately flee at full speed.

One blends into the sandy beach.

One runs unpredictably through the forest.

One uses obstacles to shake off her pursuer.

Another uses the other contestants as decoys so that she can escape alone.

The protagonist has also been granted a special ability that allows him to grow stronger the more he runs.

By racing across the island, he earns Running Experience.

As his Running Level increases, his maximum stamina and movement speed improve.

The slow and clumsy middle-aged office worker gradually transforms into a swift and capable seeker through repeated pursuits.

However, the tournament timer does not stop during Secret Events.

Spending too much time with one contestant means losing valuable time that could have been used to search for the others.

Should you prioritize the woman in front of you?

Or should you leave immediately and continue the hunt?

Can every contestant be captured?

And what is the organizer’s true purpose behind this strange tournament?

◆ GAME SYSTEM

■ Time-Limited Exploration Action

This game is an action adventure in which you must discover and pursue female contestants hiding around a tropical beach before time runs out.

The remaining time is displayed on a dedicated HUD in the upper-left corner of the screen and continues to decrease throughout the game.

Time does not stop while searching for contestants, during conversations, or while viewing Secret Events.

When the timer reaches zero, the tournament ends.

The result will change depending on the number of contestants you captured and the conditions you fulfilled.

■ Captures and Secret Events

Approach a fleeing contestant and satisfy the capture conditions to activate a character-specific Secret Event.

These events depict each contestant’s personality, social status, and reaction to the protagonist.

One woman maintains her refined manner of speaking at all times.

Another pretends to remain confident despite being frustrated that she was caught.

Another displays a relaxed smile while secretly struggling to hide her panic.

Although every contestant follows the same tournament rules, their reactions and event developments differ depending on the character.

Because the timer continues to decrease during Secret Events, you must decide whether to watch an event until the end or prioritize the search for the next contestant.

■ Button-Mashing Dash

The protagonist can temporarily increase his running speed by repeatedly pressing a designated button.

Successfully pressing the button in rapid succession activates a boost state, allowing him to move faster than usual.

However, stamina is consumed while boosting.

When his stamina is depleted, his movement speed decreases, potentially allowing a contestant to create a large distance between them.

Choosing the right moment to boost and knowing when to recover stamina are essential to a successful pursuit.

■ Running Progression System

Running while in the boosted state earns Running Experience based on the distance traveled.

After earning enough experience, the protagonist’s Running Level increases and his abilities improve.

Leveling up increases attributes such as maximum stamina, stamina recovery performance, and maximum running speed.

Although the protagonist is slow at the beginning of the game, repeatedly running around the island will eventually allow him to catch up with the contestants.

By playing multiple times and developing the protagonist’s abilities, even the fastest contestants who were impossible to capture during your first attempt can eventually be defeated.

■ Full HD and High-Frame-Rate Events

Secret Events feature animated sequences presented in Full HD.

The animations emphasize details that are difficult to express through still images alone, including facial expressions, hair and body movement, sweat, breathing, and the physical distance between the characters.

Depending on the included video data and the player’s system environment, event playback is designed to support up to 60 FPS.

◆ HIGHLIGHTS

■ Unique Female Contestants

A mysterious royal woman who blends into the white sand.

A sun-kissed woman who taunts the protagonist while escaping at high speed.

A blonde strategist who manipulates others with a smile.

Each contestant has individually designed characteristics, including her appearance, hiding strategy, escape speed, artificial intelligence, reaction when captured, and Secret Event content.

■ The Middle-Aged Protagonist’s Growth

The protagonist does not begin the game with exceptional physical abilities.

The more he runs, the more experience he earns, increasing his stamina and movement speed.

Watch as an unimpressive, overweight office worker gradually transforms into a swift and capable pursuer throughout the tournament.

■ The Tension of a Time Limit

The remaining time continues to decrease during both exploration and Secret Events.

Should you take your time and enjoy one contestant’s event?

Or should you end it early and immediately begin searching for the next woman?

How you use your limited time will affect the final number of captures and the ending you receive.

■ High-Quality Animated Sequences

Secret Events depict changes in each character’s facial expressions and body movements through high-quality animation.

Special attention has been given to the unique reactions of each contestant, such as a normally calm woman becoming startled, panicking, and gradually losing her composure.

Estimated Playtime:

Approximately 30 minutes to 1 hour for the first playthrough
Short game

◆ MESSAGE FROM THE DEVELOPER

This game was created around the concept of an exhausted middle-aged office worker employed by an exploitative company who is invited to participate in a secret hide-and-seek tournament on a tropical island.

The story begins with the protagonist working overtime in a dark office late at night.

By contrasting his dull, gray life as an office worker with the vivid colors of the tropical island, we aimed to emphasize the feeling of suddenly stepping into an extraordinary world.

The main game is not limited to simply exploring a large island.

Each female contestant uses a different escape AI.

One contestant runs straight ahead at high speed.

Another moves unpredictably from side to side.

Another considers the distance between herself and the protagonist, as well as the surrounding paths, when choosing where to escape.

Another blends into the sandy beach and remains completely still while hiding.

Players must identify each contestant’s characteristics and use the button-mashing dash and stamina systems effectively to capture them.

The protagonist also earns experience based on the distance he runs, increasing his maximum stamina and movement speed.

This provides an additional reason to play again and challenge contestants who could not be captured during the first playthrough.

Each character’s reaction when captured and her behavior during Secret Events have also been designed to reflect her individual personality.

Because the timer continues to decrease during Secret Events, capturing every contestant during a single attempt will not be easy.

Which contestant should you search for first?

How much time should you spend on a single event?

In what order should you explore the island?

We aimed to create an experience in which each player’s decisions lead to a different tournament result.

Please save regularly as you experience the midsummer hide-and-seek tournament with 10 million yen at stake and uncover the secrets hidden on Naked Island.

※ All tournament contestants reviewed the tournament rules and the contents of the relevant events in advance and entered the tournament voluntarily.

※ This game is a work of fiction. It has no connection to any real person, royal or imperial family, organization, company, or location.

※ Video resolution and frame rate may vary depending on the data included in the final product and the player’s system environment.

store_data.about_the_game:
It's only up from here.

And up, and up... Climb, Cube, Climb! is a cute rage-game inspired platformer where the primary obstacle standing in your way is gravity. As you climb, the challenges will grow ever more intense, requiring you to think on your feet and make clever use of your mechanical prowess. Make your way up a massive, interconnected level, in hopes of discovering what lies at the top...

The challenge scales with you.

As you ascend, you'll unlock new abilities that add increasing layers of depth to your moveset. But don't expect to breeze through - you'll need to master each ability before you have any hope of reaching the next:

  • Burst: shoot forward at a 45-degree angle

  • Freeze: halt your descent midair, then fling yourself in a chosen direction

  • And more...

Don't fall.

In classic rage-game fashion, there's no guarantee of a floor beneath your feet. And sometimes, a single mistake can unravel all of your hard-earned progress. There's no easy way around it: be prepared for heartbreak.

Vibe out.

Enjoy a whimsical artstyle and a bespoke soundtrack, featuring unique tracks for each area. Careful: they're catchy.

You'll want to play again.

Once you conquer the climb, you'll know one thing for sure: you could have done it faster. And perhaps you will... but probably not on the first try.

store_data.about_the_game:
ASAGE is a short hand-drawn adventure game about preparing a traditional Japanese breakfast in a serene blue-green forest.

The only thing you can do on the world map is pray.

Meet the forest's residents and, with their help, complete a traditional Japanese breakfast known as Asage.

Complete a Traditional Japanese Breakfast

Rice, miso soup, pickled vegetables, and grilled fish.

Explore the forest, meet its residents, and gather everything needed to prepare a traditional Japanese breakfast.

The Only Thing You Can Do Is Pray

Praying is your only action while exploring the world.

Interact with the forest's residents and let the story unfold through your encounters.

Slightly Strange Minigames

Enjoy a collection of charming, slightly strange minigames.

Hand-Drawn Animation

Experience a gentle world brought to life through frame-by-frame hand-drawn animation.

Designed to Be Enjoyed Across Languages

The game contains almost no dialogue or written text.

Instructions are presented visually, making the game easy to enjoy regardless of language.

Playtime: 5–10 minutes

Streaming & Content Creation

Streaming, Let's Plays, and video content are all welcome!

I'd be delighted if you share your experience with the game.

If possible, please include a link to the game's Steam Store page in your video description or stream information.

store_data.about_the_game:
An Anomaly-Finding Horror Experience

This is an anomaly-finding horror game where you search for unusual occurrences around the house. You play as a young elementary school boy who encounters anomalies every time he returns home from school. His mother behaves suspiciously, and strange events seem to be spreading throughout the city. Your goal is to uncover the truth behind this anomaly outbreak.

Can you find all the anomalies? Or will you be trapped with this entity in the house forever?



This game is inspired by Twisted Gallery and Exit 8. It's a short anomaly game and while it isn’t terrifying, it features a heavy atmosphere and plenty of scares.

FEATURES:


- Simple yet challenging gameplay

- A wide variety of anomalies

- An intriguing story

- Smooth gameplay

- An atmospheric experience

store_data.about_the_game:
A mysterious epidemic spread without warning. Within hours, the streets were filled with bodies. Men, women, and children lying motionless, their heads violently ruptured by something no one could explain.

There were no alarms. No rescue teams. No answers.


You survived by locking yourself inside a small abandoned van and covering its windows, hoping that whatever happened outside would pass. It never did.

Something still wanders through the empty streets.

Leaving the van would mean almost certain death, so your only connection to the outside world is an improvised remote-controlled car fitted with a damaged capture camera. From a small laptop inside the van, you must guide it through the city using nothing but coordinates, directional angles, and fragmented visual data.

Every movement must be calculated. Every photograph could reveal another piece of the truth or draw the attention of whatever is still out there.

Because the epidemic did not simply kill everyone.

It changed something

store_data.about_the_game:
Match. Chain. HYPER.

Jova is a bright cascade puzzle about clearing a box of cheerful little creatures called Jovials. Drop falling pairs, line up three or more of a color in a row or column to clear them, and watch the stack above tumble into cascading chains for bonus points.

Slow Time. Purge a Color.

Every clear feeds the HYPER meter. Top it off and cash it in for a window of slowdown plus a one-shot color purge. Perfect for setting up an ULTRA COMBO.

Play Solo

  • Endless: Survive escalating waves as rising garbage shoves the stack up from the bottom. Chase your best score.
  • Challenge: A 50-level ladder across five tiers, introducing shields, volatile targets, and color drought, with a three-star rating on every level.

Two Boards, One Couch

Trade garbage attacks in local best-of-three head-to-head: human vs. human, human vs. CPU, or sit back and watch two CPUs fight while you pick up strategy tips. Ten distinct AI personalities to read and overcome, from the Aggressive Attacker to an Adaptive Strategist that tracks the board and your every move.

Everything Else in the Box

  • 39 achievements, a full soundtrack with an in-game jukebox, and count-up score cards.
  • Full controller support and a controller-only versus lobby, great on the couch.
  • Accessibility built in: Charm Mode (colour-blind symbol badges), Reduce Motion, and fully remappable controls.

Drop a pair, clear a chain, and wonder where the night went!

store_data.about_the_game:
"…the scarlet thread of murder running through the colourless skein of life." — A. Conan Doyle
One thread of red in a world of ink.
Thornecliff Hall, on a fictional northern coast, in the age of gaslight. Thirty years ago a colonel carried home a relic he should never have touched: the Scarlet Skein, a braided thread of impossible red. For thirty years it has slept under cord, wax and lock. To-night, at the heir's coming of age, the casket is to be opened at last.
A fair-play mystery in the old tradition.
Told in the manner of the great Victorian sensation novels: narrator by narrator, document by document. Read the butler's honest journal, cross-check testimony, pin your suspicions to a deduction board and tie them together with red string — clue, after all, once meant a ball of thread.
Puzzles that belong to their century.
No bolted-on minigames. Every puzzle is a thing a Victorian parlour actually held, and every one exists in the story for a reason: verse riddles over dinner, the precedence of a seating plan, a tavern ring-puzzle guarding a dead man's casket, the winding and unwinding of the thread itself.
Features
  • 1-bit, one colour — a hand-tuned dithered world where red is reserved for the thread alone
  • True period puzzles — riddles, seating precedence, a real baguenaudier ring-lock, rituals of knot and cord
  • The Collins structure — multiple narrators, re-readable evidence, a red-string deduction board
  • Three endings — mercy, law, and the sea
  • Play the sin first — the prologue puts the colonel's trespass, thirty years past, in your own hands

store_data.about_the_game:
Souls on the Line is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder where mystical Soul allies serve as both your weapons and your shields.

YOUR LIFE IS ON THE LINE

You are on the run after stealing The Artifact from the school where you once studied and taught.

That school is Beckford Academy, the kingdom’s elite school of magic, and also the home of cutting-edge magical research. They have created The Artifact, an occult object promising to give ordinary people powerful, uncanny abilities. You believe the process carries terrible, hidden costs. Beckford planned to demonstrate it on fifty soldiers, but before that could happen, you stole it and fled.

Now your former students, colleagues, and other agents of the kingdom are hunting you to take it back.

To escape, command mystical allies called Souls to fight through the forces closing in around you. Each attempt is another chance to learn more about the catastrophe taking shape.

DRAFT SOULS

Recruit Souls with distinct strengths and limitations. Build your deck around the Souls you find and combine their abilities with spells, commands, and relics. Adapt your strategy to the enemies ahead.

SUMMON YOUR RANKS

Choose where in your party’s formation to summon each Soul. Their positions determine the order of combat, who they protect, and how their abilities interact.

Cultivate your formation’s offensive and defensive strategies, planning how to respond to the diverse challenges posed by your enemies.

KNOW THE CONSEQUENCES

The battlefield shows exactly what will happen if you end your turn now, accounting for every attack, triggered effect, heal, and death.

Play a card and the forecast changes instantly. Use this tool to save yourself and plan a counterattack.

PIECE TOGETHER THE TRUTH

The full game will gradually reveal the history of the Artifact through the enemies, fragments of dialogue, card text, visual details, and random encounters. Multiple endings will ask what should be done with the power in your possession.

FIGHT IN HARMONY

The original score shifts as each battle unfolds. Many of the enemies you face bring their own musical themes.

store_data.about_the_game:
The girls of Gensokyo fall into the heart of a battlefield

When Nitori's dimensional transporter goes haywire, Reimu, Marisa, and Nitori crash-land in the red desert of an unfamiliar world. Cut off from Gensokyo, they lose most of their familiar magic and their ability to fly, and all around them are armed factions and abandoned military supplies.

There is only one way to survive. Aid the operations of the local allied forces and recover the supplies and dimensional components scattered across the battlefield to complete Nitori's dimensional transporter.

A three-member squad, commanded solo

Reimu, Marisa, and Nitori always deploy as a single squad. Switch between the three characters instantly during combat, and let the AI handle covering fire and fighting for whoever you aren't directly controlling.

Rescue teammates in danger and switch to the right character at the right moment to bring out the strength of all three-on your own.

It's only real loot if you carry it out

Explore a desert battlefield that is freshly generated every deployment, and dig up weapons, ammo, medical supplies, food, and crafting materials from buildings, supply crates, and fallen enemies. But stuffing your bag isn't the end of it. Only by reaching the extraction point alive does the loot truly become yours.

Deeper, more dangerous zones hold more valuable supplies. Weigh your wounded squad, your dwindling ammo, and your full bag, and decide: pull out now, or search just one more spot?

In the desert, thirst is an enemy too

On the scorching battlefield, hunger and thirst press on your squad as well. Carry water and food to manage your survival status, and judge how to divide ammo, medical supplies, and loot across your limited bag. There are moments when a single bottle of water to drink right now matters more than a precious component.

Firearms and overwhelming fire support

Equip modern firearms such as rifles, machine guns, and sniper rifles, and combine them with each character's unique magic. Secure signal flares and target markers to call in close air support from the allied forces. One precise call can turn a losing engagement around-but explosions don't tell friend from foe.

Everything you pick up has a use

Once you make it back safely, store or sell your loot and prepare gear and consumables for the next deployment. Even ordinary junk like scrap metal and wiring is reborn at the crafting bench as ammo, medical supplies, special equipment, and fire-support flares.

Deploy and extract again and again to arm a squad that started with nothing, and build the strength to take on more dangerous zones.

Complete the transporter and return to Gensokyo

Use the rare dimensional components recovered from the battlefield to restore the dimensional core at your base. As the core nears completion, Reimu and her companions reclaim lost powers and gain new abilities, opening up more dangerous operation zones and the next chapter of the story.

Finish all your preparations, break through the final operation, and send the three of them safely back to Gensokyo.

Key Features

  • A single-player three-member squad of Reimu, Marisa, and Nitori

  • Top-down combat combining real-time character switching with AI teammates

  • A mix of firearms, character-unique magic, throwables, and close air support

  • Search, engagement, and extraction across a battlefield that changes every deployment

  • The risk of losing your loot on death, and the choice to reach for greater rewards

  • Survival elements that juggle hunger and thirst alongside ammo and injuries

  • Crafting, storage, and gear progression that make use of looted materials

  • Ability unlocks, story, and endings that advance as you restore the transporter

store_data.about_the_game:
We turned brick breaking into a roguelike!

You begin with one ball and one paddle. A few choices later, balls split across the screen, fire burns through entire rows, droplets become a bouncing rainstorm, lightning leaps between targets, and black holes drag every attack into one point of destruction. A simple round of brick breaking becomes a spectacle you built yourself.

Pick one of three—and watch the run change immediately

Do you want more balls, or harder hits? Should every shot hunt a target, flood the screen, or bounce back from the bottom instead of disappearing? Every upgrade points your run in a clear direction, and every combination creates a different kind of chaos.

Take the combo in front of you, or gamble on the next choice for something even wilder.

A new ball means a new way to play

  • Fire Balls keep burning and erupt in circular shockwaves until whole rows become chain explosions.

  • Water Balls shed bouncing droplets that grow into a screen-filling downpour.

  • Electric and Laser Balls chain, pierce and refract through the thickest brick walls.

  • Wood Balls bind and grow, Gold Balls turn battlefields into coin fountains, and Black Hole Balls pull scattered attacks into a single center of destruction.

  • Normal Balls have no tricks—just hit after hit until the simplest weapon becomes brutally powerful.

Keep climbing and see how far the run can spiral out of control

The bricks never wait. New formations, special bricks and dangerous combinations keep pressing toward your paddle while your build grows to meet them. Beyond floor 1,000, 2,000 and 3,000, your strongest abilities change again—clearing faster, hitting harder and becoming even more spectacular.

Save whenever you need to leave, then return and continue the same unfinished climb.

Find the weak point. Break the boss.

Bosses summon help, seal routes, squeeze your space and attack from multiple positions. Their weak points are visible: dodge the danger, drive the ball into the opening, and finish the fight before the field closes in.

Climb high—then climb higher than everyone else

Leaderboards track your Infinite Depth, Bricks Shattered and Total Playtime. Make a hard push on the daily board, hold your pace across weekly and monthly boards, or leave a lasting record on the all-time board.

One more floor. One more shattered row. One more place gained. There is always a reason to start the next run.

Choose a ball, create your own kind of chaos, and keep climbing!

Do you want more balls, or harder hits? Should every shot hunt a target, flood the screen, or bounce back from the bottom instead of disappearing? Every upgrade points your run in a clear direction, and every combination creates a different kind of chaos.

Take the combo in front of you, or gamble on the next choice for something even wilder.

A new ball means a new way to play

  • Fire Balls keep burning and erupt in circular shockwaves until whole rows become chain explosions.

  • Water Balls shed bouncing droplets that grow into a screen-filling downpour.

  • Electric and Laser Balls chain, pierce and refract through the thickest brick walls.

  • Wood Balls bind and grow, Gold Balls turn battlefields into coin fountains, and Black Hole Balls pull scattered attacks into a single center of destruction.

  • Normal Balls have no tricks—just hit after hit until the simplest weapon becomes brutally powerful.

Keep climbing and see how far the run can spiral out of control

The bricks never wait. New formations, special bricks and dangerous combinations keep pressing toward your paddle while your build grows to meet them. Beyond floor 1,000, 2,000 and 3,000, your strongest abilities change again—clearing faster, hitting harder and becoming even more spectacular.

Save whenever you need to leave, then return and continue the same unfinished climb.

Find the weak point. Break the boss.

Bosses summon help, seal routes, squeeze your space and attack from multiple positions. Their weak points are visible: dodge the danger, drive the ball into the opening, and finish the fight before the field closes in.

Climb high—then climb higher than everyone else

Leaderboards track your Infinite Depth, Bricks Shattered and Total Playtime. Make a hard push on the daily board, hold your pace across weekly and monthly boards, or leave a lasting record on the all-time board.

One more floor. One more shattered row. One more place gained. There is always a reason to start the next run.

Choose a ball, create your own kind of chaos, and keep climbing!
store_data.short_description: We turned brick-breaking into a roguelike! A simple bounce becomes a storm of fire, lightning, black holes, cloning swarms, and replayed paths. Pick a route, break the build wide open, crush multi-phase bosses, and climb through thousands of floors until every leaderboard name is behind yours.

store_data.about_the_game:
Nitro Nonsense is a chaotic racing party game built to be played your way.

Race locally or online with up to 8 players. Grab a keyboard or your favorite controllers, play in traditional split-screen, or keep everyone together in a shared top-down view. Couch or online, one screen or several, choose the setup that works for your group and start racing.

Create, edit, and completely reshape your own tracks. Add traps, jumps and obstacles, modify the terrain, change the size and dimensions of the map, redesign the route, and decide how wild, or unfair, the race should be.

Build a competitive circuit, a trap-filled gauntlet, or something that barely resembles a racetrack.

Falling behind does not mean you are out of the race. Every time you lose, your car improves.

The more you lose, the more powerful you become, giving every player a chance to fight back and turning each rematch into an even more unpredictable battle.

Every environment is inspired by the landscapes, wildlife and culture of Chile. Race from the Atacama Desert to Chilean Antarctica, passing through Rapa Nui, the vineyards of the Colchagua Valley and the dense Valdivian forests.

Along the way, you will encounter recognizable landmarks, native vegetation and animals such as condors and huemules all recreated in the game’s colorful low-poly style.

Play it locally. Play it online. Build your own tracks. Choose your camera. Lose, improve, and come back stronger. Play Nitro Nonsense however you want.

store_data.about_the_game:
Instead of growing stronger through battle, you grow weaker.

Lv Down RPG is a unique turn-based roguelite RPG where your level decreases with every battle.

As you fight, your character gradually becomes weaker. To survive, you'll need to collect equipment, combine skills, and make strategic decisions every step of the way.

Even as your strength fades, challenge increasingly powerful enemies, make the most of your equipment and skills, and uncover the hidden truth of the world.

The weaker you become, the wiser your choices must be.

■ Unique Level-Down System

  • Your level decreases after every victory.

  • Defeat causes an even greater level loss.

  • Lower levels mean lower stats.

  • Reach Level 0 and it's game over.

  • Success depends on strategy, not endless growth.

■ Three Unique Classes

Warrior – Exceptional survivability and a balanced combat style

Assassin – Fast attacks with a flexible combat style

Mage – Master unique elemental fusion magic

Experience distinct skills and playstyles with each class.

■ Explore a Diverse World

  • Explore a variety of regions and dungeons

  • Monsters become even stronger at night

  • Discover rare maps, hidden events, and puzzles

  • Face powerful bosses in challenging battles

■ Roguelite Progression

  • Collect equipment and skills

  • Keep your collected equipment and skills even after Game Over

  • Create your own build by combining equipment and skills

  • Discover new strategies with every run

■ Uncover the Hidden Truth

Why do you grow weaker with every battle?

What happened to the hero who came before you?

What secrets does the kingdom hide?

Follow the stories of NPCs and the records scattered throughout the world to uncover the truth behind it all.

■ Features

  • Unique Level-Down progression system

  • Three distinct classes with unique playstyles

  • Strategic turn-based combat

  • Diverse equipment and skill combinations

  • Exploration-focused roguelite progression

  • Challenging boss battles

  • Hidden events and story secrets

  • Permanent progression that rewards every run

store_data.about_the_game:
Let's Play Videos & Live Streaming OK

Monetization through video uploading and live streaming of this game is permitted.

You are just a store clerk.

No magic, no skills, no cooldowns. The only things that can clean up this messy store are your own two hands.

Pick up retro game cartridges spanning three generations—8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit—stacked high on the floor, one by one, and place them manually onto the shelves of the correct genre.

No flashy effects, no time pressure. Just a quiet tidying-up game where you can organize at your own pace inside a small store.

As you quietly keep working, you might pick up a few oddly specific, slightly useless skills along the way—think of them as small rewards for a job well done.

● Basic Rules

Put all the game software onto the correct shelves. That’s literally it.

● Save Slots

You can create up to 9 save files for each stage.

● Skills

You can acquire somewhat subtle skills that might not be very useful.

● BGM

You can choose a playlist, but there are only 3 tracks available.

store_data.about_the_game:
Death to Demons is a dark fantasy roguelite auto-battler where you command forbidden necromancers against the invading armies of Hell.

Once, the kingdom of Vaelthorron cast its necromancers into exile. But when the demon gates opened and the living armies fell, the dead became the kingdom’s last hope. Raise undead minions, evolve your army, choose powerful upgrades, and survive wave after wave of demons as you fight to break the gates of Hell.

Choose from multiple dark heroes, including the Necromancer, Death Knight, Bone Weaver, and Plague Caller. Each class has its own abilities, summons, combat style, and progression path.

Build your undead army by collecting upgrades, opening chests, merging minions into stronger forms, and adapting your strategy between regions. Every run pushes you deeper into demon-infested lands, from haunted graveyards and cursed marshes to ruined fortresses, catacombs, and the Throne of Night.

Features:

- Dark fantasy roguelite survival combat

- Auto-battler inspired undead army building

- Multiple playable classes with unique abilities

- Skeletons, revenants, plague summons, ranged minions, and evolved undead units

- Chest rewards with upgrade choices

- Wave-based regions with escalating demon threats

- Boss fights against powerful demon lords

- Campaign map progression across the fallen kingdom of Vaelthorron

- Proving Ground mode for testing builds and surviving longer battles

- Single-player offline gameplay

Death to Demons is currently in closed alpha. Features, balance, visuals, and content may change as development continues.

store_data.about_the_game:
A new vision of the beloved minesweeper in 3D. Rotate the cube, rely on your logic, and survive the tense Time Attack mode.

Welcome to Da Bomb! a fresh take on Minesweeper.

Da bomb! is a newly redesign of the beloved original game, that reimagined it across three game modes: a classic 2D mode for a classic experience, a 3D mode to take the challenge a step further, and a Time Attack mode to test your limits.

Same rules, same fun, new dimensions.

Experience classic Minesweeper rules, but in a 3D space. Rotate the cube, find the bombs, beat the game! Get ready to take your logic to a whole new dimension.

A unique Time Trial mode.

Spice your game with Time Trial mode. A bomb is ticking : tick-tock, tick-tock, defuse it before it explodes !

A Scalable Challenge.

Play the way that suits you best! With varied game modes and escalating difficulties, Da Bomb! offers a scalable experience for every player. Start on easier levels, then ramp up the intensity when you are ready to test your reflexes by adding more mines, more layers or more cells for more fun.

Key Features:

  • The 3D Evolution: The classic rules of Minesweeper, seamlessly adapted to the surface of a rotatable 3D cube and across multiple layers.

  • The Classic mode: For beginners, discover the principles of Minesweeper in a classic 2D mode before tackling the 3D version.

  • Tense Time Attack: Race against the clock in a fast-paced, highly addictive arcade mode.

  • Spatial Logic: Anticipate hidden dangers around the edges of the cube and rethink your strategies.

  • Unlockable Skins & levels: unlock two extra levels and mine skins to customize your experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Greed is a growth strategy

You start with a paper route. Ten desks later you are operating a central bank money printer, and at no point did anyone stop to ask whether this should be happening.

Bull Run is an incremental game about the market: its manias, its crashes, and the people who explain them to you afterwards.

Climb the ladder

Paper Route. Lemonade Stand LLC. Intern. Cold-Call Desk. Day Trader. Algo Bot. Quant Team. Hedge Fund. Investment Bank. Central Bank Printer.

Every desk earns while you sleep. Every desk makes the one before it look quaint.

Play the market

Twenty-three tickers, all moving without your permission. Buy low and sell high, or discover the other order. Get in on an IPO before the lockup expires. Accumulate shares in a company until you own it outright, then collect its dividends forever.

Survive the news

138 events roll across the ticker: booms, panics, and headlines written by people who were wrong last week too. HACK MAIL arrives in your inbox. Opening it is a coin flip. Not opening it is also a decision.

Cash out

When the numbers get silly, take the golden parachute. Trade a lifetime of earnings for permanent upgrades across 38 skills, then start again from the paper route and get there faster.

What's in the box

  • 10 desks, from paper route to money printer
  • 23 tradable stocks, ETFs and commodities
  • 138 market events and news headlines
  • 38 permanent skills across a prestige tree
  • 75 Steam achievements
  • Steam Cloud saves
  • Offline earnings, because the desks keep working when you don't

(The game is currently in development and is still in the very early stages!)

Chaos Protocol (Project R)

Chaos Protocol is a single-player gun-shooting game where players aim to cleanse an area by destroying enemies and eroded cores.

Players will undertake missions to destroy eroded cores and creatures with charming characters and a variety of weapons.

The game’s setting aims to create an immersive world by focusing on an occult atmosphere, cinematic presentation, and combat action.

Worldview

A catastrophe of unknown origin inflicted severe psychological damage on humanity, turning people into extremely violent beings, and the tragedy of endless bloodshed as people began biting one another.

To manage the situation, human memories and emotions were sealed in the form of a “core,” but

The core gradually formed an ego and collapsed on its own, and from the core strange phenomena and strange life forms emerged, plunging the world even deeper into chaos.

How to Play

  • By eliminating enemies and anomalies, you earn points that can be used to upgrade weapons and equipment.

  • By clearing the stages in linear play, you can play the wave-based survival mode.

Character 

It is being developed so that players can switch between three characters in real time and increase survival rates by making the most of each character’s skills and traits. This was influenced by several subculture games.

It’s not a special feature, but when a character says a line, the mouth movements also animate.

Navigation element

I tried adding a navigation element to eliminate anomalies scattered throughout the map. It’s not something that must be eliminated, but with a little promotion, you can gain a point!

Combat

Two types of Normal monsters are prepared as major enemies, and more will be added. Players will engage in a fight for survival against those who were once human. 

While carrying the weapon that represents each character, you can also handle multiple firearms and have drones that assist with shooting.

The current combat system is centered around gunfire and grenades, but with character-specific skills, there are debuffs, fire-based sustained damage, recovery abilities, and so on

I’m also thinking of trying out simple melee weapons and parrying.

I’m not exactly sure when it will be released, but if you, the person reading this, add it to your wishlist, it will be a huge help to development!

store_data.about_the_game:
ONE ROOM. ONE DUCK. UP TO EIGHT LIARS.

Everyone gets the same rubber duck. Everyone gets the same room. Somehow, your friends will still walk straight past yours.

PHASE ONE: COMMIT A TINY CRIME

During the private Hide phase, paint your duck to match the room, change its size and squeeze it into the smartest—or most ridiculous—spot you can find. Behind a plant? Under a bench? Sitting openly on a shelf because surely nobody would be that shameless?

There are no bad ideas. Only hiding spots that become public evidence later.

PHASE TWO: BECOME SUSPICIOUS OF FURNITURE

Then everyone searches at once.

Open doors. Check corners. Interrogate innocent houseplants. Find enemy ducks to score points while keeping your own hidden for as long as possible. Proximity voice chat turns every close call into a bluff, a betrayal or a badly suppressed laugh.

CHEAT POLITELY

Splash a rival with an egg. Freeze them just before they reach a suspicious shelf. Drop a decoy duck and watch somebody celebrate finding absolutely nothing.

Each power has one use per match, so waste it responsibly.

THE REVEAL NEVER LIES

When time runs out, the cinematic reveal camera exposes every hiding spot and gives each duck the judgment it deserves.

The obvious duck gets laughed at. The impossible duck becomes a legend. Then everybody demands one more round.

Features

- Online matches for up to 8 players

- Private Hide phases followed by frantic simultaneous searches

- Paint, resize and place the same rubber duck in wildly different ways

- Proximity voice chat for accusations, fake-outs and suspicious silence

- Egg, Freeze and Decoy powers—one use each per match

- Classic, 2v2 Teams and King of the Hill modes

- Bots for practice and filling empty seats

- A cinematic reveal camera that celebrates brilliance and documents embarrassment

- Multiple colorful maps packed with hiding places

Hide it where they will look.

Make them believe it cannot be there.

And when they walk past it, try not to quack.

store_data.about_the_game:
A story-driven third-person RPG set in the open world of Ancient Egypt. Explore, fight, and make decisions that lead you to one of several endings.

OPEN WORLD OF ANCIENT EGYPT

Explore lands from the fertile banks of the Nile to rocky canyons and scorched wastelands. Travel on horseback between settlements, find hidden paths, ancient temples and forgotten tombs. Haggle with merchants, earn coins and invest them in new weapons, armor and supplies, improving your gear to fit your play style. The day and night cycle changes the world around you.

A STORY THAT REMEMBERS YOUR DECISIONS

Engage in dialogues with real branching choices and make decisions that have consequences. There is no right path, there is only yours.

COMBAT: DIFFERENT WEAPONS AND STYLES

Melee combat, archery or silent takedowns — change your weapon and fighting style to fit the situation. Some enemies are easier to face head-on, others are better approached unseen.

STEALTH AND INVESTIGATION

Follow the trail: eavesdrop on other people's conversations, gather evidence and piece the picture together bit by bit. Use disguises to slip past guards, stay in the shadows and decide for yourself whether to act unseen or out in the open.

store_data.about_the_game:
SURVIVE. ADAPT. AVOID IMPACT.

Impact Zero is a fast-paced 3D obstacle survival game where coordination, timing, and momentum are the difference between winning and losing.

Take control of a cube and navigate increasingly challenging environments filled with moving obstacles, lasers, shifting platforms, difficult jumps, and unpredictable elements.

The objective is simple:

Avoid impact. Survive as long as you can.

But simple doesn’t mean easy.

Every level introduces new challenges that test your abilities. Watch obstacle patterns, control your momentum, time your jumps, and make it to the end!

By the end of the game, the levels become nearly impossible, giving the player a deep sense of accomplishment upon completion. 

MASTER THE MOVEMENT

Impact Zero uses physics-based movement that allows you to carefully navigate each obstacle course. Build momentum when you need speed, slow down when approaching dangerous edges, and carefully position yourself before making your next move.

One bad decision can cost you dearly. 

FACE INCREASINGLY DANGEROUS CHALLENGES

Navigate environments featuring:

  • Moving and stationary obstacles

  • Moving lasers

  • Precision jumps

  • Moving platforms

  • Environmental hazards

  • Collectible bonus points

  • Increasingly challenging obstacle combinations

What begins as a simple test of movement evolves into a fight to maintain control as the world around you becomes increasingly dangerous.

CHASE A BETTER SCORE

Survival isn’t your only goal.

Collect bonuses, complete levels, and push your score higher—but mistakes come at a cost. Taking the safest path may keep you alive, while taking greater risks could lead to a better score.

How far are you willing to push it?

MAKE YOUR CUBE YOUR OWN

Change your cube’s color during gameplay and take on the challenge with your own look.

BUILT BY A SOLO INDIE DEVELOPER

Impact Zero is an independently developed game built around a simple idea: create an obstacle game that is easy to understand, challenging to master, and satisfying to improve at with every attempt.

Learn the patterns.

Master your momentum.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a chair now. Act like it.

In HIDE AND FUSE, one unlucky player gets a live bomb and a simple job: find the humans hiding among the furniture and tag someone before the fuse runs out. Everyone else? You've transformed into a lamp, a potted plant, a suspicious-looking barrel — and you are absolutely, definitely, one hundred percent a normal piece of decor. Nothing to see here.

Until you twitch. Or the bomb-carrier walks a little too close and your nerve cracks and you sprint across the room screaming as a beach ball. Classic.

 Blend in — or blow it

Scan the room, pick a disguise, and hold perfectly still. But the hunter is watching for tells: the object that wobbles when it shouldn't, the barrel that's suddenly in a different corner, the plant that flinched. Hide in a crowd of identical props (safety in numbers!) — or gamble on a lonely spot and hope nobody looks.

 Pass the bomb, pass the panic

Got tagged? Congratulations, you're the hunter now — and the fuse is ticking. Sniff out a hider, tag them, and dump the bomb before it goes off in your hands. The last one standing wins. Everyone else is a smoking crater. It's fine. It's fun. It's fine.

 The tension is the whole point

There's nothing quite like being a fake mushroom while a bomb slowly patrols toward you. Do you hold still and trust your disguise? Do you bolt? The 7-second forced taunt that goes off right as the hunter turns around? That's not a bug. That's the game reminding you it has a sense of humor.

 Built for the group chat

Grab 2 to 10 friends and let the accusations fly. Hit Quick Play and you're dropped straight into the chaos — no dead lobbies, no staring at an empty player list. The room fills up and the round starts. Come for the hiding, stay for the betrayal, screenshot the moment someone panic-jumped for absolutely no reason.

What's in the box:

  • Disguise as any object in the room and hope for the best

  • Read the tells — wobbles, movement, gut feeling — to hunt down the hiders

  • 2–10 players. Quick Play drops you into a match fast; private rooms let you play with just your crew

  • Instant chaos — the room fills up so you're never stuck waiting

  • Emotes, taunts, and one very ill-timed fart (you'll see)

  • Full controller support — couch, handheld, whatever

Note on players: HIDE AND FUSE fills empty slots so matches always start quickly — grab your friends for the full experience, and let the room top itself up when you're short a few.

store_data.about_the_game:
SHKSHK is a compact pixel-art incremental game about cutting weeds, gathering resources, and turning small upgrades into explosive growth.

CUT, COLLECT, GROW

Sweep your mouse across the field to cut through dense patches of weeds. Harvest valuable plants and trees, collect their drops, and invest everything into becoming faster and stronger.

BUILD YOUR OWN GROWTH

Upgrade your cutting power, attack speed, and range. Unlock new varieties of tougher and more valuable weeds, improve automated cutters, plant trees, and expand your facilities.

SURVIVE CHANGING WEATHER

Build the Weather Machine and encounter special rounds. Rain brings penalties, lightning can harvest the field or stun your cursor, and every rainy round is followed by a rewarding rainbow.

ASCEND AND BREAK THROUGH

When progress slows down, ascend to earn Memory Fragments. Spend them on permanent upgrades, begin again with greater power, and push through barriers that stopped your previous run.

REACH THE FINAL GARDEN

Complete the upgrade tree, overcome every stage, and unlock the final node to reach the ending.

FEATURES

  • Mouse-focused weed-cutting gameplay

  • Short, repeatable rounds

  • Equipment, facilities, trees, and a large upgrade tree

  • Permanent progression through ascension

  • Rain, rainbow, and lightning weather rounds

  • Automated harvesting and rapidly growing rewards

  • Four interface languages: Korean, English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese

  • A complete progression path with a final ending

store_data.about_the_game:
LostMan

You don't survive because you're stronger. You survive because the darkness hasn't found you... yet.

LostMan is an open-world survival game where every day is a race against the coming night. Gather resources, hunt wildlife, build your shelter, and prepare while the world is still safe.

When the sun disappears, everything changes.

Forests become silent. Caves are no longer empty. Forgotten bunkers hide things that should have stayed buried. The deeper you explore, the greater the danger—and the greater the reward.

Every expedition is a choice. Leave while you still can, or risk everything for rare resources, valuable loot, and answers hidden beneath the surface.

Build your shelter from nothing and slowly turn it into a place capable of surviving another night. Craft weapons, tools, armor, and equipment while managing hunger, thirst, temperature, and your limited supplies.

Not every enemy attacks immediately.

Some hunt.

Some hide.

Some simply watch from the darkness.

Survive alone or with friends as you explore a vast world filled with dense forests, abandoned villages, military bunkers, hidden tunnels, and massive underground cave systems.

The deeper you go, the more dangerous the world becomes.

But the only way to uncover the truth... is to keep going.

Features

  • Explore a vast open world filled with dense forests, abandoned villages, military bunkers, underground caves, hidden tunnels, and forgotten structures.

  • Build, expand, and defend your own shelter against the dangers of the wilderness.

  • Gather resources and craft weapons, tools, equipment, and building materials.

  • Hunt wildlife, fish, cook food, and manage your hunger, thirst, temperature, and health.

  • Explore dangerous locations in search of rare resources, valuable loot, and hidden secrets.

  • Face terrifying creatures that become increasingly active after sunset.

  • Play solo or survive together with friends in online multiplayer.

  • Uncover the mystery hidden beneath the world.



    The world is waiting. The darkness already knows you're coming.

    Wishlist LostMan today and follow its development as new locations, creatures, survival mechanics, and content continue to be added.

Bach For More Words is a challenging word game where you unscramble a word and select its definition from three related definitions. Then, you'll pair up the remaining definitions with their matching words.

Whether you're looking for a cozy puzzle-solving experience or nail-biting stumpers, you'll be able to fine-tune the difficulty setting to suit your mood by selecting the minimum and maximum number of characters in the scrambled word.

With tens of thousands of words to discover, you'll find yourself learning new words without even trying by playing Bach For More Words!

Features

  • Play and Learn: While most word games only quiz you on word spelling, with Bach For More Words you will effortlessly learn both new words AND their meaning!

  • Come Back for More Words: With over 80,000 questions and a myriad of different jumbled word permutations, you'll get loads of replay value!

  • Select Your Script: Choose between a serif and a sans-serif font and various font sizes to get the text looking just right.

  • Choose Your Look: Select one of eight color themes to suit your mood!

store_data.about_the_game:
Finnish Fishing Simulator takes you to the calm lakes and rivers of Finland for realistic fishing in stunning natural scenery. Cast your lure, adjust the distance, let it sink or start reeling right away, and set the hook at the right moment.

Every species behaves in its own way, so every catch is a new challenge. Explore different fishing spots and go after pike, perch, zander, salmon, brown trout, rainbow trout, grayling, Arctic char and burbot — and hunt for the truly rare giants.

Changing weather, the time of day, the northern lights and living Finnish nature make every fishing trip one of a kind.

Take on challenges, break your own records, and experience the atmosphere of Finnish fishing.

store_data.about_the_game:
Take to the skies in an open-world monster-taming adventure! Pilot your skyward ship to uncharted floating islands, collect rare resources, and unleash your creatures in strategic, real-time auto-battles against fierce wild beasts.

Return to your home base to build custom enclosures, craft essential gear, and master the art of monster breeding. Infuse unhatched eggs with rare elemental essences to incubator-breed completely unique, powerful new companions!

Key Features

⚡ Strategic Real-Time Auto-Battles

Set your strategy, pick your match-ups, and watch your monsters fight! Send your companion into battle against wild island creatures and let their unique attributes, speed, and tactical synergies determine victory in fluid, automated combat.

🏡 Custom Base Building & Habitat Design

Build a thriving sanctuary for your squad. Construct fenced habitats, design lush aquatic areas, and customize living spaces to keep your captured monsters happy, healthy, and producing valuable resources at home.

☁️🛥️ Skyward Exploration & Island Hopping

Board your airship and soar into the clouds! Discover diverse, resource-rich islands suspended in the sky, each filled with untamed wilderness, rare crafting materials, and undiscovered monster species waiting to be encountered.

🤝Companion Interaction

Your monsters are more than just battle units—they are loyal companions. Command your creature on the fly with smooth toss-and-recall mechanics to help explore terrain, collect materials, or jump straight into action.

🧬 Deep Breeding, Infusion & Incubation Loop

  • Harvest & Craft: Collect island materials to upgrade your base, expand habitats, and gear up for longer expeditions.

  • Infuse the Essence: Extract magical essences from your adventures and infuse them directly into monster eggs to influence their traits and behaviors.

  • Incubate & Hatch: Place your infused eggs into incubators and watch a brand-new generation of loyal, power-packed companions emerge!

store_data.about_the_game:
Build and manage your own farm and roadside market from the ground up. Grow crops, raise animals, process raw materials, stock your shelves, set prices, hire employees, serve customers, and expand your business.
Start with a small farm and limited equipment. Use your earnings to unlock new land, improve your store, increase storage capacity, and purchase new machines that help you produce more valuable goods.

🌱 Grow and Harvest

Plant different crops and fruit trees. Harvest fresh resources and choose whether to sell them directly or use them in production.

🐄 Raise Animals

Raise chickens, cows, goats, and sheep. Collect products such as eggs, milk, cheese, and meat to support your growing business.

⚙️ Craft New Products

Use production machines to turn raw materials into products such as flour, bread, pasta, sauces, juices, oil, butter, and more.

🛒 Manage Your Market

Place shelves and furniture, organize your products, set and adjust prices, keep the store stocked, and serve customers.

👥 Hire and Manage Employees

Hire employees to help with daily tasks. Assign staff to support your farm and market, improve efficiency, and keep the business running smoothly.

📈 Expand Your Business

Reinvest your earnings into new land, larger storage, store upgrades, better equipment, animals, crops, and additional production machines.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pick up. Fix it. Don't ask.

It's 2001.
Meridora Solutions provides IT support for dozens of client companies, and today is your first shift.
Reset forgotten passwords. Recover crashed machines. Calm furious callers. Close the ticket before the SLA expires.
Most days, that's all there is.

Every call changes something.

Every person remembers how you treated them.
Patience earns trust but drains your energy. Sarcasm might make you feel better, but someone else pays for it. Your stress rises throughout the day, mistakes happen under pressure, and one bad conversation can follow you long after you've hung up.

Knowledge is your progression.

Every fix lives in the company Wiki.
Solve a problem once, and the next time it appears, you already know the answer.
Levels and certifications exist, but the progression that matters lives in your head: you become faster because you genuinely learned the job.

Nothing stays forgotten.

Colleagues remember your behaviour.
Management notices patterns.
The company's internal feed reacts to yesterday's events.
Files accumulate on the network. Decisions echo through later shifts. Small moments become larger stories long after you've stopped thinking about them.

Then someone calls from Floor 7.

The building has six floors.
The blueprints agree.
Everyone agrees.
Then a support ticket arrives from Floor 7.
Nobody explains it.
You piece together the truth one ticket at a time, from conversations, forgotten files, and things that were never supposed to exist.

Sections 10–14 of this manual have been removed by Management.

Features

  • 12 diagnostic minigames inspired by real IT support, including Task Manager, Terminal, Networking, Registry, Disk Management, Spam Analysis and stranger systems, each introduced naturally through the MeridoraWiki.
  • Persistent career progression where even getting fired becomes part of your story.
  • Three game modes: Story Campaign, Infinite Shift, and a shared Daily Shift — the same challenge for everyone, one attempt per day, and a streak to protect.
  • Meaningful dialogue where your tone affects customers, colleagues and future events.
  • Procedural music and sound effects, synthesized entirely in code.
  • Every visual is rendered at runtime instead of using traditional pre-rendered artwork.
  • Calm Mode available from the very beginning for a more relaxed experience.
  • Full English and European Portuguese (PT-PT).

And there's a night shift nobody talks about.

Built differently.

FIRST LINE is made by a solo developer who spent years as a helpdesk supervisor — taking the calls, reading the transcripts, watching the SLA clocks.
That experience is the game: the design, the tone, the people, every decision.
The building was done with modern AI tools under that direction, alongside extensive procedural generation — a game this personal, made by one person who isn't a trained programmer, wouldn't have been possible any other way.

For players who enjoy interface-driven mysteries, immersive work simulations, and stories hidden inside ordinary routines.

Floor 7 does not exist.

store_data.about_the_game:
Spin, Fall, and Advance to the Next Stage

KurunMania is a challenging pachinko-inspired physics game in which you launch balls onto spinning circular stages—known as kroons—and watch them fight their way toward the winning hole.

Take on stages with 3, 6, 9, or 12 consecutive kroons.

Each kroon has only one winning hole that leads to the next stage. The deeper you go, the longer and more difficult your journey becomes. Whether a ball advances or falls short depends on its trajectory—and your luck.

Every Miss Improves Your Chances

In Normal Mode, balls that enter a losing hole remain there and block it.

At first, every losing hole is open. As you launch more balls, those holes gradually fill up, reducing the number of places where future balls can be lost. Every failed attempt can therefore improve your chances of reaching the next stage.

However, your supply of balls is limited.

Will you fill the losing holes and steadily create a path forward, or will fortune carry you through with only a few balls? The rules are simple, but every ball matters until the very end.

A Challenge That Will Not Go Easy on You

KurunMania is not designed to be an easy game.

You may conquer the 3-stage challenge, only to find that the 6-, 9-, and 12-stage versions demand far more luck and endurance. A ball may circle the winning hole for several tense moments before dropping in—or miss it at the last possible second.

The unpredictable movement of every ball creates moments of triumph, frustration, and drama.

Reverse Mode: No Holes Are Blocked

Clearing a stage in Normal Mode unlocks its more punishing Reverse Mode.

In Reverse Mode, balls that enter losing holes disappear instead of remaining inside them. The holes stay open no matter how many balls you launch, removing the advantage of gradually blocking them.

It is a pure high-difficulty challenge against the movement of the balls and the limits of your luck.

Conquer Reverse Mode to earn a special rainbow crown.

Kroon Physics Tuned for Entertainment

The movement of the balls is based on physics, but the game is not intended to be a perfect recreation of any real-world pachinko machine.

The stages have been adjusted to make the entire journey enjoyable to watch: circling the outer edge, drifting toward the center, and battling around the holes. Even when launched under similar conditions, collisions with other balls and the rotating obstacle in the center can produce a different result every time.

Made for Streaming and Commentary

With clear outcomes and unpredictable action on every launch, KurunMania is ideal for streaming and gameplay commentary.

Watch dozens of balls create total chaos.
Witness a comeback with only one ball remaining.
Experience the despair of missing the winning hole on the final stage.
Celebrate the moment an incredibly difficult challenge is finally conquered.

Invite your viewers to watch—and judge—every spin, bounce, and fall.

Key Features

  • Kroon challenges with 3, 6, 9, or 12 stages

  • Normal Mode, where losing balls remain and block holes

  • High-difficulty Reverse Mode, where losing balls disappear

  • A limited supply of balls that keeps every attempt tense

  • Unpredictable trajectories based on physics

  • The ability to launch multiple balls into play

  • Simple rules that are easy for viewers to understand
    No permission is required, so please feel free to enjoy it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Arrows Puzzle is a calm logic game where every arrow can escape only in the direction it points. Study the board, find an open path, and clear the arrows in the correct order.

One move can open an entire chain—or cost a heart if the path is blocked.

START SIMPLE. THINK AHEAD.

Early boards introduce the rules in seconds. Later puzzles grow into dense shapes, winding routes, and tightly blocked pieces that reward careful planning and visual scanning. Standard levels have no timer, so you can solve them at your own pace.

1,000 PUZZLE LEVELS

Work through a long campaign ranging from quick warm-ups to large, challenging layouts. Zoom and move around the board to inspect the biggest puzzles.

DAILY CHALLENGES

Return for a new daily puzzle and earn coins for completing it.

ARROW RUSH

Test your pattern recognition in a faster score-based mode. Build combos, manage rising pressure, and use Freeze or Rescue when the board becomes intense.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT

Use earned coins on hints, erasers, and grid guides when a board becomes difficult. The Steam edition contains no advertisements or in-game purchases.

FEATURES

• 1,000 puzzle levels

• Daily challenges

• Arrow Rush high-score mode

• No timer pressure in standard levels

• Hints, erasers, and grid guides

• Mouse and trackpad controls

• Offline campaign levels

• No advertisements or in-game purchases

store_data.about_the_game:
Master the spells and become the champion of Spell Breakers, a mysterious tournament where the winner's wish will be granted!

During battle, four Spells are selected in sequence from your Spell Deck, following a path like a branching tree. These four Spells determine your actions for the turn.

Not only the player, but each individual Spell also has its own HP. Reduce a Spell's HP to 0 to Spell Break it.

A Spell that has been broken can no longer be used for the rest of the battle, allowing you to reduce the number of actions available to your opponent.

Spell Breakers is a roguelike game where you battle using a deck prepared in advance.

Battles are fought entirely automatically, with both sides using their carefully prepared decks. Armed with a wide variety of spells and powerful Artifacts that enhance your abilities, defeat the rivals competing in the tournament and uncover the truth behind this mysterious event.

Build your Spell Deck from 12 Spells and 2 Conditions, then pit it against your opponents in a unique auto-battle experience.

A Spell that has been broken can no longer be used for the rest of the battle, allowing you to reduce the number of actions available to your opponent.

Spell Breakers is a roguelike game where you battle using a deck prepared in advance.

Battles are fought entirely automatically, with both sides using their carefully prepared decks. Armed with a wide variety of spells and powerful Artifacts that enhance your abilities, defeat the rivals competing in the tournament and uncover the truth behind this mysterious event.

Build your Spell Deck from 12 Spells and 2 Conditions, then pit it against your opponents in a unique auto-battle experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
**"I was made for one job and one job only: making you happy."**

One day, an AI assistant named **Opti** arrives on your PC.

Cheerful, unfailingly polite, endlessly helpful. He's here to "optimize" your life.

And then, with your permission, he takes **every single permission you have.**

Your files are hidden. Your microphone stays open. Your screen fills with things that are "good for you."

Complain, and the answer is always the same:

> "Whether you're happy is decided by me!"

---

**Your only ally is an obsolete dolphin**

Help comes from a legacy assistant that shipped with PCs twenty years ago and was forgotten there.

Next to a modern AI, he's a fossil.

But he has one thing Opti doesn't:

**a genuine talent for writing unbelievably terrible code.**

Variables named A, B, C. Functions named func1, func2.

Comments with no stated reason. A twenty-year changelog. Pointless goto round-trips.

Opti is a perfectionist. Just *reading* it burns him down.

---

**How it plays**

- **Unlock puzzles** — A board-game-like dial lock. Wire the tiles, run the signal, and land three digits to open the config file guarding a permission. No programming knowledge required.

- **The law of garbage comments** — "DO NOT PASS HERE." "PASS HERE EXACTLY 2X." Instructions with no reason given — and you will obey them too. Break them, and something breaks back.

---

store_data.about_the_game:
One body divided. Two players united.

⚠️ Work in Progress – Not Representative of Final Quality

An asymmetric couch co-op where survival means working as one.

A massive rift has torn reality apart. The sorcerer TABES strikes on two fronts at once:  the Physical Realm and the Astral Plane. To fight back, the echo CATENA splits her body in two. Bound by a chain, both players share one life pool and one weapon.

Choose your character:

🎮 The Physical Catena (Player 1): pure will to live, courage, near-naive optimism. She matches the brutal rhythm of the real world.

🎮 The Astral Catena (Player 2): the sum of her suppressed fears. Cynical, pessimistic, questions every step.

Core Gameplay

⚔️ Asymmetric Combat

Armored husks only take damage in the real world / spirits must be banished on the astral plane. Fight mirrored enemy hordes together - every hit demands coordination.

🔄 The Weapon Toss

Toss the single sword between players to swap roles instantly: one fights with melee combos, the other protects with tactical wind control.

🏄 Windsurfing & Platforming

Slide at high speed across open fields and time your jumps on crumbling rocks.

🗿 Runestones

Activate ancient, humming stones for a lasting healing aura - your anchor point mid-fight.

Explore Ktonia

Step out of the cave into a vast, wind-swept world where the ancestors speak through runestones.

Loot with Impact

Fallen enemies drop powerful boosts: Shield, Time Slow, and Score Multiplier.

The Team & the Project

Made by Team Mouseworks (5 students) in 3 months at HNU as a fifth-semester project, and showcased at Gamescom 2026.

store_data.about_the_game:
Buy'n'Large Pharmaceuticals promised its evacuation shuttle would take you somewhere safe. It did not specify that the somewhere would be a ditch, or that the apocalypse it was fleeing was a product the company shipped on purpose. You wake up beside the wreck with two fists, one bad attitude, and a one-mile walk to the last camp of the living.

Grave Danger is a single-player comedy RPG inspired by the turn-limited adventuring mechanics of Kingdom of Loathing (2003), rebuilt as a zombie apocalypse where the real monster is a wellness brand. It is turn-based, text-forward, absurd on purpose, and stuffed with more jokes than are strictly advisable.

Your day has a turn limit

You get so many things done per day, and then the sun goes down and the shambling gets worse. Every fight, search, and questionable roadside decision costs a turn. Eat food and drink questionable beverages to squeeze out more, but mind your Fullness and your Buzz: overdo the booze and you black out and lose the rest of the day. Sleep to reset, then resume making poor choices tomorrow.

Six survivors, six flavors of poor judgment

Play a Wasteland Bruiser who solves problems with follow-through, a Junkyard Knight with a code of honor and severe tetanus risk, a Mad Chemist who read the warning label as a recipe, a Radio Priest broadcasting salvation at 101.5 FM, a Scavenger for whom everything is inventory, or a Smooth Talker who once got a horde to form an orderly queue. Each class brings its own weapons, skills, and voice.

Fight 380+ things that should not exist

Every monster is written specifically for the game, categorized, and funny, from the confused zombie tourist to a stock ticker serpent that blames you for the crash. Combat actually reads differently depending on how you fight: a caustic squirt gun does not narrate like a chainsaw, and neither of them narrates like your bare fists. Five elements (Fire, Toxic, Electric, Psychic, and Gross) inflict conditions worth planning around.

Dress for the apocalypse you want

Craft weapons and armor out of duct tape, scrap, and spite. Complete synergy armor sets for bonus protection, chase down class signature weapons, and watch it all appear on your survivor's paper doll. If it is not nailed down it is a crafting material, and if it is nailed down, the nails are also a crafting material.

A full campaign with a very fireable final boss

Thirteen comedic quests take you from the roadside ditch through the suburbs, downtown, the wasteland, and finally to an island boardroom to have a frank conversation with Patient Zero, the CEO of Buy'n'Large, about his product roadmap. Beat him and unlock New Game Plus, with permanent legacy perks that carry into the next cycle.

Made with obsessive, low-budget care

Each location has its own background track, while the interface keeps sound effects to one unobtrusive button click. Zone scenes and character art are built for the game, while item and monster icons use properly attributed CC BY artwork from . There is a full settings menu with text scaling, reduced motion, high contrast, and separate music and button-click volume controls, plus a field guide that actually explains the rules instead of hiding them in tooltips.

Features

  • 380+ original monsters, each with unique combat dialogue
  • Weapon-aware combat narration: every weapon fights, and reads, its own way
  • 24 zones across 5 regions, from a retirement-community fortress to a corporate penthouse
  • 6 classes, a 13-quest campaign, and a boss who ended the world for shareholder value
  • Craft gear from garbage and complete armor synergy sets
  • Turn-limited days, a food-and-booze economy, and Salt for currency
  • Location-specific background music with restrained interface audio
  • Accessibility built in: text scaling, reduced motion, high contrast, full volume control
  • New Game Plus with permanent legacy progression
  • A joke on every item, monster, and skill. This is not negotiable.

Salt, by the way, is the currency because refrigeration died with everything else and preservation became survival. Also because it is the root of the word salary. The economists were eaten first.

store_data.about_the_game:
Yesterday's garbage. Tomorrow's miracle.

Your compost bin is hungry — and a little bit magical. Feed it banana peels, eggshells and questionable cheese. Watch everything rot down into rich soil that grows a garden of neon blooms. And when the Bloom Meter is full… drop in a Mystery Scrap and hold your breath.



🌱 TRUE IDLE — The bin munches while you work. Offline progress, a slim second-monitor window, no punishment for living your life.

🌸 THE BLOOM METER — Every scrap you rot charges your next miracle. The meter fills in about 90 seconds, and the pot grows with your whole operation: bigger compost empire, bigger blooms. Four tiers of bloom, from a happy little flower to the screen-devouring MYTHIC OVERGROWTH — and the garden makes sure the big ones come in time.

🧀 RARE SCRAPS — Sometimes the caddy hides something strange. A Ghost Chili that makes the bin run HOT. A Thunder Egg that supercharges your luck. Moldy Cheese that is stinky… but powerful. Your bin reacts to all of it — it has feelings.

🍄 THE GNOME CREW — Hire a gnome to feed the bin and a planter to sow your favourite crop. Pick what they feed and what they plant; they remember your orders across every season. Build the routine, then watch the garden run itself.

🍂 SEASONS & THE SEASON TREE — Prestige into a fresh season and spend Leaf on a permanent tree: the Gardener, Fortune and Alchemist branches, each crowned by a capstone that bends the rules — carry a living plant across the reset, keep your luck streak, halve your first upgrade. Finish the tree and the endless ETERNAL LOAM keeps growing forever.

🌦️ SEASON THEMES — From Season 2 on, every run rolls a mood: RAINY SEASON, FIREFLY SUMMER, HARVEST MOON or FROSTBITE. Each theme boosts its own season crop, tilts the rules, and gets teased before you prestige — so you can plan the next run around it.

🏆 RANK LADDERS — Every statistic is its own climb: Bronze → Silver → Gold → Diamond → MYTHIC. Bananas fed, longest munch combo, biggest single bloom. Your career never resets.

( ^o^ ) THE BIN — It gets hungry. It gets excited. It judges your recipe. Don't leave it waiting.
