store_data.about_the_game:
Read the tape. Ride the wave. Die by leverage.

GOD CANDLE is a real-time trading roguelite. You get a $1,000,000 book and ten trading days to retire. Each day is a 45-second sprint through market hours — go long, go short, lever up, and clear the closing-bell target, or the margin clerk shuts the desk down.

Every run is a different market

  • Choose your ticker each morning from a shortlist with volatility and behavior readouts — ten of them, from sleepy $GLD to pure-chaos $GME.
  • Nine market-event bosses: Earnings Day, FOMC, Squeeze Watch, Flash Crash, Melt-Up, Quad Witching, Circuit Breaker, OPEX Pin, and The Bear.
  • Ten daily market conditions on top — Volatility Storm, Algo Chop, Data Blackout, Gamma Ramp, Zero Commission Day, and more.
  • Shuffled boss order, jittered targets, rerolled tickers. No two runs play the same.

Build a gloriously broken trader

  • Four classes, each with an exclusive two-power kit: The Chad rides 5x leverage, The Quant sees six ticks into the future, The Cockroach refuses to die, The Insider gets a free tip line that rings four times a day.
  • 29 relics and 16 powers. Draft one of three after every bell, or perma-install tools with Street Cred so they're live from day one.
  • Relics that reward a style — scalping, diamond-handing, hot streaks — and light up when you pair the right ones.
  • Print the GOD CANDLE: a divine, screen-shaking vertical candle straight into your position.

Read the tape, not the headline

  • Earnings follow guidance, not the EPS print. A beat can tank. A miss can rip.

store_data.about_the_game:
BUILD THE GYM. FORGE THE FIGHTER. OWN THE NIGHT.


Take charge of an ambitious MMA gym in a deep pixel-art management simulation where every prospect, payday and corner decision can reshape your legacy.

Scout a changing world of fictional fighters across eight weight divisions. Study their styles and hidden weaknesses, negotiate salaries and fight contracts, assign training and recovery, manage diets and dangerous weight cuts, and decide which opponents are worth the risk.

MANAGE MORE THAN A RECORD


Fighters age, improve, decline, suffer injuries, lose confidence and eventually retire. Their morale, relationships, loyalty, health and finances matter. A perfect camp can still unravel through a missed weight cut, a bad press conference, a short-notice call or a spectacularly ill-timed personal crisis.

WORK THE CORNER


Watch fights unfold in a stylised 2.5D octagon. Change tactics, rally morale, treat damage and offer advice between rounds. Run normal speed, double time, or skip to the next round. Attribute matchups, preparation, Intel and your decisions all influence the result—without guaranteeing it.

RUN THE BUSINESS


Pay trainers and fighters, improve facilities with once-off construction costs, attract paying gym members, manage food and medical expenses, chase sponsors and endorsements, and protect cash flow through good weeks and bad. Popularity brings opportunity, but fame also brings scrutiny.

CHOOSE THE RISK


Pad a record with a tune-up or gamble on a ranked opponent for reputation. Haggle over purses, win bonuses, PPV points and clauses. Accept a desperate short-notice headliner. Build hype through press conferences and face-offs—or take illicit underground money and risk injuries, police attention and sponsor backlash.

A LIVING FIGHT WORLD


Four fictional promotions, persistent divisional rankings, title paths, rival results and world events continue around your gym. Careers produce champions, cautionary tales and strange retirement epilogues long after the final bell.

  • Eight weight divisions and four fictional promotion tiers
  • Generated fighters with extensive skills, potential, style, morale, health and career arcs
  • Live simulated fight nights with tactical corner input
  • Training, recovery, nutrition, weight cuts and injury management
  • Opponent scouting, reports, rumours and risk/reward matchmaking
  • Contract negotiation, staff payroll, memberships, sponsorships and gym expansion
  • Press conferences, weigh-ins, hype, rivalries and unpredictable weekly events
  • Offline single-player with local autosaves

All fighters, promotions and events are fictional. No real athlete or promotion endorses this game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Climb, explore, and push your limits in a fully dynamic world built for movement. This game delivers a physically driven climbing experience where every hold, wall, and route is handcrafted or procedurally generated to challenge your technique. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, the world features dense vertical environments, reactive surfaces, and a stamina‑based movement system that rewards precision, planning, and creativity.

You’re free to climb almost anything you can see. Grip strength, body positioning, and route choice matter—every ascent becomes a puzzle. Whether you’re scaling natural cliffs, navigating complex indoor walls, or tackling massive architectural structures, the game adapts to your style with dynamic zones, randomized layouts, and progression systems that evolve as you improve.

Master advanced movement like dynos, mantles, wall runs, and controlled descents. Manage your stamina carefully, search for rest points, and use momentum to reach holds that seem just unreachable. The higher you climb, the more the world opens up—new routes and new challenges.

With rich lighting, detailed environments, and responsive physics, this is climbing reimagined as an immersive, skill‑driven adventure.

Key Features

  • Physics‑Driven Climbing System—Every move is calculated: grip strength, stamina, and body positioning define your success.

  • Procedural Route Generation—Endless climbing possibilities with dynamic zones and randomized hold layouts.

  • Stamina-Based Gameplay—Plan your ascent, find rest spots, and push your limits without falling.

  • Advanced Movement Abilities—Dynos, mantles, wall runs, jumps, and controlled descents.

  • Unreal Engine 5 Visuals—Nanite geometry, Lumen lighting, and high‑fidelity environments.

  • Exploration‑Focused Progression—Unlock new areas, discover hidden routes, and challenge increasingly complex climbs.

store_data.about_the_game:
One Warden against the swarm

Wardenmark is a real-time survivors roguelite set in the Orenvalt shared world. You lead a single Concord Warden — sworn to keep the peace the four crowns signed and never meant — into short, frantic arena missions along the contested border-marks. Your spells fire on their own; your job is to move, to read the field, and to choose what you become.

Draft the storm

Cut down the swarm, gather the experience the fallen drop, and level. Every level offers new auto-casting spells and passive upgrades — build wide for omnidirectional coverage, or reserve picks to deepen one spell toward mastery. Five wardens each open on a different signature: the Soldier's cleave, the Archer's volley, the Mage's homing bolt, the Trickster's chaining spark, the Engineer's auto-turret. No two runs draft the same storm.

A campaign with carry

Missions chain into six-node expeditions — your build and your health persist from node to node, so a run is a growing story, not a string of restarts. Survive the tour to face the faction warlord at its end. Clear campaign stages to unlock new wardens and reshape later runs with stage modifiers.

Then the Dread never stops

  • Twelve biomes — greenwood to stormpeak, each with its own faction swarm and telegraphed hazards.
  • Readable pressure — every threat is telegraphed and contact damage is paced, so a death is a misplay you can learn from, not a coin-flip.
  • Faction warlords — a distinct boss caps each faction's tour.
  • The endless Dread tail — past the campaign, an unbounded escalation with a boss every fifth node, for as far as you can push.
  • 61 achievements — from your first kill to a level-60 legend and clearing the whole campaign with every warden.

store_data.about_the_game:
MIDNIGHT CLASS

The evening class has begun.

The school is so quiet. The classrooms are too familiar. Everything seems to be exactly normal.

At least, for now.

As you move through the school, something begins to feel wrong.

A familiar classroom has changed.

Something is missing.

Something is different.

Something is where it should not be.

Find the anomaly.

Then decide which way to go.

OBSERVE. REMEMBER. CHOOSE.

In Midnight Class, your surroundings are constantly changing.

When you encounter an anomaly, you must carefully observe the environment and decide how to proceed. Choose the correct path and continue deeper into the night.

Make the wrong choice, and you will be sent back to where the journey began.

The school is a maze of familiar places that refuse to remain the same.

The clock keeps moving.

FROM EVENING STUDY TO MIDNIGHT

At 7:20 PM, evening study begins.

As the hours pass, the familiar school gradually becomes something else.

At midnight, every light goes out.

But the night is not over.

You must continue exploring through the darkness until 6:00 AM.

Only then can you hope to escape.

If there is still a way out.

A STORY HIDDEN IN THE ANOMALIES

The strange things you encounter are not random.

As you explore the school, you will begin to witness fragments of another story.

A girl.

A classroom.

A series of memories that should have been forgotten.

But the school remembers.

The classrooms remember.

And perhaps, someone is still waiting for you to remember too.

FEATURES

• Explore a mysterious school through a first-person perspective

• Carefully observe your surroundings and identify anomalies

• Make decisions based on what has changed — and what should not have changed

• Choose the correct path to continue your journey

• Make the wrong choice and return to the beginning

• Experience a night class that progresses from 7:20 PM to 6:00 AM

• Explore the darkness after every light in the school goes out

• Uncover the story of a girl through fragments of the past

• Experience an atmospheric psychological horror story about memory, bullying, and the things that refuse to disappear

THE NIGHT IS NOT OVER.

It's 7:20 PM.

Night Class is about to begin.

At midnight, the lights will go out.

At 6:00 AM, the night should finally be over.

So why are you still here?

And if you finally make it out...

Are you sure you really escaped?..

store_data.about_the_game:
You decide who history keeps.

 

The year is 2050. You're a teenager flunking two subjects at once — History and P.E. Your teacher's solution? Drop you into an ultra-realistic AI simulation of the past, where the only way to pass is to run, catch, and judge the people who shaped the world.

 

TWO SUBJECTS, ONE CHASE

Every map grades you on two report cards at once:

• P.E. — how many marked figures you physically chase down and catch.

• History — whether you catch the RIGHT ones. Pull a net-negative figure out of the timeline and the simulated world heals; remove a pillar and it crumbles.

 

HISTORY THAT PUSHES BACK

The people you meet are real — Caesar, Cleopatra, Cicero, Socrates, Pericles — tangled in a living web of cause and effect. Remove Crassus and Caesar's rise falters. Remove Cicero and the Renaissance loses a voice. There are no heroes and villains, only trade-offs — and over-correcting the past costs as much as leaving it alone.

 

READ BEFORE YOU JUDGE

Open the in-game Codex and read a rich, illustrated biography of every figure before you decide their fate — a real history encyclopedia hiding inside a chase game.

 

A TOYBOX OF GADGETS

You're inside a simulation, so you don't fight — you hack it. Dash, freeze time, scan through walls, throw bubble-traps, drop decoys, lasso your targets. Abilities are scattered across each map, Quake-style.

 

CUTE ON THE SURFACE, SERIOUS UNDERNEATH

A bright, storybook world any kid can enjoy — carrying questions that don't have easy answers.

 

FEATURES

• Catch-and-judge gameplay across historical eras (Rome, Athens — more to come)

• A counterfactual grading system where your choices ripple through a causal network

• Real historical figures with full illustrated Codex entries

• Four difficulty modes — from a relaxed sandbox to a merciless run

• Build your own maps in Custom Game

store_data.about_the_game:
Nocturnal Echoes is a dark fantasy 2D action RPG set in Elaris, a world where memory, corruption, and ancient magic are bound together by forgotten Wards.

After receiving a mysterious book from a strange robed figure, you are drawn into the village of Gloamford — a quiet place watched over by a broken bell tower. The bell still rings, the dead do not rest, and something ancient speaks through dreams.

Explore haunted villages, cursed forests, flooded barrows, ruined towers, Vigil camps, corrupted sanctuaries, and forgotten places where memory itself has begun to rot.

Fight undead, corrupted creatures, tragic guardians, and enemies shaped by the failing Wards of Elaris. Collect weapons, armor, relics, potions, and rare gear as you uncover the truth behind the Hollow Codex.

Choose your path through a story of grief, memory, sacrifice, corruption, and ancient powers that were never meant to wake.

Features:

- Explore a dark fantasy world built around memory, corruption, and ancient Wards

- Fight undead, corrupted beasts, tragic bosses, and supernatural enemies in 2D action RPG combat

- Choose your starting class and grow into ranged, melee, light magic, or dark magic builds

- Collect weapons, armor, relics, potions, and rare gear

- Discover lore through the Hollow Codex, journal entries, bestiary updates, and environmental storytelling

- Experience cinematic pixel-art cutscenes, voiced supernatural encounters, and a haunting original soundtrack

- Make choices that shape your relationship with Elaris, the Vigil, and Seraphyne

store_data.about_the_game:
A fast-paced action roguelite where food is your lifeline and cardio is your greatest enemy.

Inspired by John, a real-life overweight street cat, Fat Cat Survivors throws you into the paws of a grumpy, food-obsessed feline battling endless waves of animated exercise equipment inside a chaotic home gym.

Forget traditional health bars. Your survival depends on staying well fed by collecting food dropped from defeated enemies while crafting increasingly powerful weapon combinations. Between waves, spin the slot machine to unlock upgrades, shape your build, and discover game-changing synergies that make every run feel fresh.

Arm yourself with a ridiculous arsenal of over-the-top weapons, survive relentless enemy waves, and see just how long John can keep dodging cardio.

Features

  • Battle endless waves of animated exercise equipment

  • Master a unique hunger-based survival system instead of a traditional health bar

  • Create powerful builds with randomized upgrades and game-changing synergies

  • Unlock outrageous weapons and experiment with countless combinations every run

  • Fast-paced roguelite action built for endless replayability

Stay fed. Avoid cardio.

store_data.about_the_game:
Enter Sudoku Mansion

The invitation arrives without warning.

No name.

No seal.

Only a few hurried lines about missing servants, unstable rooms, and an invention that may have reached somewhere it should not.

Two sentences have been underlined twice:

"I have found a way to reach beyond the grid. I no longer know whether that is our salvation or our ruin."

Step inside a mysterious mansion where every room is a handcrafted Sudoku variant. Unlock hidden passages and uncover forgotten inventions as you unravel a mystery hidden deep beneath the mansion.

Every Room Teaches Something New

Sudoku Mansion is built around a simple idea:

Every room introduces exactly one new concept.

What begins with familiar Sudoku principles gradually evolves into increasingly sophisticated puzzles. New mechanics are introduced one at a time, allowing every discovery to feel earned while constantly expanding the possibilities.

Every puzzle has been handcrafted to teach, surprise, and challenge. 

There are no randomly generated levels.

Only carefully designed moments of discovery.

Built for Comfortable Play

Logic should be the challenge. Not the interface.

Sudoku Mansion includes a variety of accessibility options to help you focus on solving puzzles your way. Adjust text sizes for comfortable reading, choose alternative color themes, enable colorblind-friendly visuals, and customize the appearance of puzzle elements to suit your preferences.

Whether you're settling in for a quick puzzle or an evening of exploration, the mansion is designed to be comfortable to navigate.

Knowledge Changes the Mansion

As you explore, you'll unlock powerful puzzle classes that completely change how you interpret familiar rooms.

A puzzle once solved as a German Whisperer may later reveal an entirely different solution as a Region Sum Ambassador. The layout remains unchanged. But the rules, the logic, and your approach transform completely.

And those are only two of the disciplines waiting to be discovered.

Each new class unlocks another perspective, encouraging experimentation and rewarding players who revisit earlier rooms with fresh eyes.

Secrets Hide Behind Every Door

The mansion rewards curiosity.

Hidden passages.

Locked vaults.

Secret rooms.

Optional discoveries.

Some puzzles exist only for those willing to question what they've already learned.

The greatest mysteries are never placed on the main path.

A Mystery Beyond the Grid

The mansion was never built to contain ordinary puzzles.

Its servants have vanished.

Its rooms refuse to remain still.

And an invention hidden within its walls may have crossed a boundary that should never have been crossed.

Piece together journals, conversations, and forgotten experiments as you uncover the truth behind Sudoku Mansion.

Some questions are better left unanswered.

Features

🧩 Over 50 handcrafted logic puzzles

🏰 Explore a mysterious interconnected mansion filled with hidden secrets

🎓 Unlock multiple puzzle classes that transform familiar challenges into entirely new experiences

🔑 Discover secret rooms and hidden vaults

👑 Solve unforgettable boss encounters that test your mastery

🎙️ Fully voiced narrative

🎵 Atmospheric original soundtrack

What Lies Beyond the Grid?

Every locked door opens another mystery.

Every puzzle teaches another language.

Every discovery changes the way you see the mansion.

The invitation is waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE HUNT HAS BECOME PERSONAL

Hawke hunts monsters for a living. Bluebell Bonnie has decided to hunt her back.

A Binding Unmade is a story-rich point-and-click adventure set in the Crosshollows, a strange realm connecting the many Domains of the Arcadian Empire.

Take the role of Hawke, a veteran Guardian charged with tracking down Bluebell Bonnie, a powerful and elusive hag whose command of the Crosshollows makes her exceptionally dangerous.

What begins as another hunt soon becomes a prolonged game of cat and mouse. Bonnie leaves traps, messages, and destruction in her wake, drawing Hawke deeper into the pursuit. As the two enemies come to understand one another, the hunt grows increasingly personal, and increasingly difficult to escape.

INVESTIGATE THE CROSSHOLLOWS

Explore locations throughout the Arcadian Empire, search for evidence, gather useful objects, and uncover the trail left behind by your quarry.

Pay attention to your surroundings. The smallest detail may provide the clue needed to proceed, or reveal something about the creature waiting ahead.

SOLVE PUZZLES AND UNCOVER SECRETS

Progress through a mixture of narrative exploration, environmental puzzles, hidden-object scenes, and other point-and-click challenges.

Each location forms part of the wider mystery, bringing Hawke closer to Bonnie and revealing more about the strange worlds connected by the Crosshollows.

FEATURES

  • A story-rich, character-driven point-and-click adventure

  • A tense game of cat and mouse between a monster hunter and her quarry

  • Environmental puzzles, hidden-object scenes, and investigative gameplay

  • An unusual protagonist and an original science-fantasy setting

  • Hand-crafted artwork and an original musical score

  • A standalone introduction to the Crosshollows universe—no prior knowledge required

  • Solve a wide variety of riddles, puzzles and minigames. 

  • Repair and restore retro objects from the 80s and 90s.

  • Unveil the truth about your brother and why you had never met his friend Destiny.

• Story-driven linear levels
• Mutated creatures with varied forms and attack patterns
• Objectives involving enemy elimination, access-item retrieval, and the containment of hazardous areas

store_data.about_the_game:
Your club. Your tactics. Your football story.

HALFTIME Manager is a classic football manager in a modern guise. You take charge of a club, pick your eleven, fine-tune your tactics and guide your team over the years from the lower leagues all the way to the European cup. Every matchday is staged as a compact TV broadcast: a 2D pitch, live ticker, stats panel and a half-time dressing room where your team talk and your substitutions make the difference.

Six nations, three league tiers per country, one shared European cup and a simulation that stays reproducible on every save: your decisions matter, not luck.

Features

  • Live match as a TV broadcast - a big 2D pitch with highlight direction, commentary, a live ticker and real match stats (possession, xG, shots, corners). Weather from sunshine to snowfall shapes the atmosphere and the crowd.

  • Half-time dressing room - team talk, tactical changes and substitutions at the break and during the match.

  • Tactics with depth - formation, mentality, pressing and playing style, adjustable live from the touchline at any time.

  • Six-nation world - Germany, England, Spain, France, Italy and Portugal, each with three leagues, promotion and relegation, a cup and a shared European cup.

  • A living transfer market - transfer fees, signing bonuses, contract lengths, free agents and a market that moves week after week.

  • Build your club - expand the stadium and infrastructure (tiers, roofing, floodlights, shops, lounge, fitness, training ground), main and secondary sponsors, ticket prices and finances to keep in check.

  • Squad & youth - training, talent development and special player abilities.

  • Local multiplayer (hotseat) - up to four managers, each with their own colour; the interface switches to whoever is on the clock.

  • Five difficulty levels - and free UI scaling from 70 to 200 % for small and large screens alike.

  • Fully localized - German, English, Spanish, French, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese.

  • Steam achievements and cloud saves.

Football your way

HALFTIME Manager favours clarity over a flood of tables: simulate matchdays at speed, or follow every minute when it gets tight. The included leagues, clubs and players are entirely fictional. If you want your own football world, import your own data and shape leagues and squads to your taste.

store_data.about_the_game:
Road Queens

Overtake your rivals, wreck their cars, upgrade your ride, and conquer the most dangerous queens of the road.

From Rust Bucket to Road Royalty

Your car can barely start, your rivals laugh in your face, and reaching the finish line alive is already a challenge. There is only one solution: step on the gas, earn cash, and turn your rusty wreck into the most dangerous neon machine on the road.

Every race makes you stronger. Overtake dozens of opponents, fight for first place, and choose your own driving style: carefully slip through traffic or ram your competitors and turn their wreckage into extra profit.

Road Queens is an incremental arcade racing game with combat elements. Take direct control of your car, dodge attacks and obstacles, manage fuel and durability, activate nitro, and do everything you can to survive until the finish line.

Race, Earn, Upgrade

Return to the garage after every run and invest your earnings into an extensive upgrade tree.

Improve your:

  • top speed;

  • armor and durability;

  • fuel capacity;

  • nitro power and recharge rate;

  • handling;

  • pickup efficiency;

  • rewards for overtaking and destroying rivals.

Unlock critical ramming attacks, regeneration, additional track pickups, and new ways to earn even more money through aggressive driving.

The stronger your car becomes, the deadlier the tracks, bosses, and rival drivers will be.

Queens of the Road

Freya, Azumi, and Alice have no intention of giving up first place without a fight.

Defeat each queen on the road, meet them inside the garage, and unlock new conversations, collectible illustrations, and explicit animated scenes.

Winning the race is only the beginning. Your real reward awaits beyond the finish line.

Features

  • Three tracks: Neon Highway, the dark Cyber City, and the dangerous Mountain Pass

  • 28 upgrade nodes offering multiple paths for developing your car

  • Nitro boosts, side dashes, ramming attacks, critical hits, and exploding rival vehicles

  • Aggressive traffic, bosses, obstacles, rockets, and a constant fight for first place

  • Full third-person vehicle controls

  • An explorable first-person garage with characters and conversations

  • 79 collectible illustrations

  • 9 explicit animated videos

  • Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad support

  • An optional setting that hides adult content during recording or streaming

Adult Content

This game is intended exclusively for adult audiences.

Road Queens contains nudity, explicit illustrations, and fully animated sexual scenes involving fictional adult characters.

Adult content becomes available only after age confirmation. It can also be disabled in the game settings for video recording or live streaming.

store_data.about_the_game:
There's been a security breach at Fuzzball Incorporated 's secret lab, and now you're the only one keeping a bunch of monstrous test creatures from escaping out into the world... no pressure. Watch over the situation with the security cameras, protect the exits with your control panel, and don't forget to protect yourself should the need arise.

You are a security guard, stationed in a surveillance/control room overlooking the forest area that the lab is built under, and you have access to a number of useful tools, that will hopefully allow you to make it through this horrific night. Your room has a monitor in it that allows you to view the security cameras placed in the woods and keep an eye on the escaped creatures as they come up to the surface. You also have a control panel that allows you to move an automated defense system into the path of the test creatures before they leave the area, unfortunately it can't be in multiple places at once and it's repellent chemical spray needs to be regularly refilled. You also might want to watch your back, as a creature may try to climb up to your room, thankfully you have your own portable can of that spray. There might be more things to worry about as the night goes on, but you can probably handle it.

store_data.about_the_game:
ENTER TOKYO. EXTRACT ALIVE.

Dead Extraction is a top-down pixel-art extraction survival game set in a Tokyo devastated by a catastrophic infection. Enter hostile zones, search for weapons, equipment, and essential supplies, then reach an extraction point alive. Every extra room could contain something valuable—but the longer you stay, the greater the risk of losing everything.

EVERY OPERATION DEMANDS A DIFFERENT APPROACH.

Fight through ruined city streets, dangerous night zones, forests, and military facilities. Face infected swarms, armed scavengers, elite PMCs, and powerful bosses. Search-and-extract raids are joined by convoy operations, sniper missions, helicopter assaults, and large-scale battles.

SURVIVAL REQUIRES MORE THAN FIREPOWER.

Read enemy movements, control your firing angles, use cover, and choose your battles carefully. Health, infection, stress, hunger, and hydration must all be managed alongside limited ammunition and inventory space. If you die during an operation, the equipment and loot you were carrying will be lost.

BUILD A SHELTER WORTH RETURNING TO.

A successful extraction is only the beginning. Bring recovered supplies back to your shelter, manage food, water, electricity, and storage, and expand your defenses. Build walls, gates, and automated turrets, repair damaged structures, and prepare for attacks from infected hordes and hostile armed forces.

EVERY SURVIVOR HAS A STORY.

The survivors living in your shelter have their own personalities, abilities, emotions, and relationships. Morale and mental stability influence their behavior, while affection, resentment, crime, and punishment can reshape the entire community. Watch their personal logs, manage internal conflicts, and keep the shelter from collapsing from within.

WHAT YOU BRING HOME IS WHAT MATTERS.

Killing the most enemies does not make an operation successful. Know when to keep searching, when to fight, and when to escape with what you have.

Survive Tokyo. Secure what you need. Extract alive.

store_data.about_the_game:
CardAndDungeon is a roguelike deckbuilding RPG that combines first-person, grid-based dungeon exploration with party-based card combat. Assemble a party of three heroes and face new dangers and rewards on every procedurally generated expedition.

Your Party Is Your Deck


Each hero brings unique cards and a distinct combat role. Your party composition defines your starting deck and available strategies, allowing you to combine different classes into a deck engine of your own.

When a hero falls, their cards lose their normal effects and become Soul Binding actions. Keep fighting to bind your companion's soul back to their body—but those who return from death carry lasting Soul Trauma.

Explore Dangerous Dungeons


Navigate grid-based dungeons from a first-person perspective and discover monsters, treasure chests, traps, shrines, ruins, shops, and other encounters. Choose your route, manage gold, keys, and disarm tools, and descend toward more dangerous floors.

Dungeon layouts, encounters, and rewards change between expeditions. Take the safer path or risk your party for greater rewards.

Master Turn-Based Card Combat


Read enemy intents and targets, then make the most of your limited AP. Combine Attack, Defense, Control, and Party cards with each hero's abilities to overcome your enemies.

Acquire new cards, upgrade existing ones, and refine your deck during the expedition. Relics and Blessings create new possibilities, while Curses and Soul Trauma make the journey increasingly dangerous.

Survive the Soulwell


Your party composition, card rewards, Relics, Curses, and exploration choices persist throughout the run. If the entire party falls, the expedition ends. Adapt your deck, preserve your resources, and brave the ever-changing depths of the Soulwell.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dwarves have chosen you. Will you lead them?

A new land, a new opportunity. Will you build a settlement, a fortress, a Mountainhall? 

Mountainhall is a first-person colony sim. Most games in the genre hand you a cursor and a view from above. This one drops you inside the fortress. You play the overseer, on foot. You help dig the tunnels. You set down the workshops. And when the goblins arrive, you'll lead them into battle. 

A home worth fighting for

Your dwarves look to you, but they have lives of their own. They make friends and pick fights, fall in love and hold grudges, celebrate and grieve. Lead them well and one might vanish into a workshop for days and return with an artifact the whole hall remembers for generations. Lead them badly and, well, you'll find out what dwarven temper looks like.

The mountain will test you. Water goes where water wants, so open the wrong seam and you'll be bailing out the bedrooms by dawn. Magma waits in the deep. Granite laughs at a copper pick, but forge a steel one and follow the right vein, and you'll pour your first bar of bronze from ore you dug and smelted yourself.

Above, the seasons turn. Traders come to haggle. Winter comes to see if you were ready. And some seasons the goblins come to see if you're worth conquering.

Build it. Then hold it.

The mountain never stays safe for long. A hard winter can cost you as much as an enemy. Beasts stalk the deep dark and the woods above. And the greater your hall grows, the more the goblins decide it ought to be theirs. There's no finish line here, only the fortress you keep raising and the threats that keep testing it. Every great hall becomes a story, remembered as much for how it fell as for how it rose. What will they say about yours?

Early Access

Mountainhall is early. The simulation underneath already runs deep. What's still being built is the shell around it: a tutorial, real settings, and a longer game to sink into. Early Access is where the rest gets made, shaped by the people playing it. Play it, break it, tell us what you love or hate, and that's what gets built next.

store_data.about_the_game:
Our planet is getting invaded, and the Defenders are relying on you, the Commander, to lead them to victory.

As the invasion mounts, so will your decisions. From the type of defenders you use to allocation of resources to summon said defenders, every action you take will have an impact on the outcome of the battlefield.

Battle increasingly difficult enemies and earn new Defenders across multiple locations in Summon Defenders Now!, an action packed, lane based tower defense game.

Game Features:

Control Your Earnings - Earn resources by killing enemies. The more you kill, the more you get. Some defenders can even influence the amount of resources you can earn. You control the rate of earning, and long waits for resources to spawn before you can get the action going are a thing of the past.

Unique Defenders - From Snipers that can target almost anyone on the battlefield, to Protectors that can offer protection to surrounding defenders and fire devastating projectiles, rest assured that there will always be a defender for every situation.

Relentless Enemies - The Defenders are powerful, but the enemies are no pushover either. From Volatilers that explode if not eliminated promptly to Ghosts that are spawn underlings when killed, every enemy present will be sure to keep you on your toes.

Interactivity Upgraded - Some of the Defenders have abilities that can be manually activated or managed, while some enemies have weakspots that can be exploited, weakening them or may even turn them into walking explosives, turning the tide of the battle.

Hand-crafted Levels - Every level has been painstakingly hand-crafted, with new Defenders and enemies being introduced at consistently to keep things fresh.

Captivating Mini Games - Fancy a quick breather and shake things up? Some levels have been designed to change the gameplay loop and offer new ways to play.

Knowledge At Your Fingertips - Forgot what a Defender or enemy does or know its detailed stats? Visit the Database and you’ve got all the information you need at a glance. As your encounters and experience grow, so will your Database.

So what do you say, Commander? Are you up to the task?

store_data.about_the_game:
Story
As a romantic gesture, you're going to Japan with your Girlfriend. She doesn't know that you plan to propose to her.

You booked a private onsen. You ate a bit too much (well, the food was that good so you couldn't help yourself).

When you wake up, you find her acting somewhat strange.

This is a choice driven visual novel. The choices you make contribute to different stats in the game, which lead to different endings.

Characters

1) Girlfriend: Sweet and loving, she is the reason you exist.

2) Brad: Went to college with your Girlfriend. Somehow he's always around.

3) Omakase Chef: A very interesting character

Choices

Make choices that contribute points to these 5 traits:

A) Trusting
You are a trusting Partner. Whatever your Girlfriend does, you adore. Of course she will never cheat on you!

B) Simp
You adore your Girlfriend will all your heart. Your Girlfriend doesn't care. You crave validation and love from her and it's the only reason you keep going.

C) Gaslight
You plant seeds of doubt into the mind of your Girlfriend. You enjoy it when you manipulate her into doing crazy things.

D) Cheeky
You make moves that are playful. What's a little mischief in the relationship? Hehe.

E) Unflappable
You are a rock. Nobody can affect you, and you have no emotions.

The game will progress towards one of the 5 endings, depending on the Traits that you maximize towards.
A guide will be available in the Community Page upon release.

Features
1) Animated characters.
2) Animated scenes. Trying to make it like a TV show.
3) Hilarious comedy which some may find offensive or inappropriate. But hey, we have to draw the line somewhere.
4) For adrenaline driven folks, we made a mini game for you. Can't reveal more, explore yourself.
5) Around 10+ H-Scenes, most of which are discovered through a crack of the door. What you don't see turns you on.
6) A map where you can choose to visit 5 different locations.
7) Objects that you will eventually discover.
8) Time based progression (you start the day at 5am and be done by the night).

store_data.about_the_game:
Cozy Paper Sudoku · Pure and Simple

Enjoy classic 9×9 Sudoku wrapped in a warm, handcrafted paper look. With a soft soundtrack to match, pour yourself a cup of tea and sink into a puzzle session that's all your own.

■ 500 Levels, Gently Rising
From easy beginnings to expert brain-benders, 500 levels climb smoothly from easy to hard — each with a single unique solution, so you keep getting better.

■ Endless & Relax Modes
Want to keep going? Endless mode serves up a steady stream of new puzzles, while Relax mode is untimed and unhurried — take all the time you like.

■ Daily Challenge
One shared puzzle for everyone, every day.

■ Medals & Achievements
Campaign levels award Bronze, Silver, or Gold based on how fast you solve them, alongside 60 achievements to collect.

■ Comfortable Controls
Pencil notes and instant duplicate highlighting; choose a radial dial or side buttons, and turn on hints in the settings whenever you need them.

■ 12 Languages
English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Polish.

■ Made Your Way
Resolution, fullscreen, sound and music volume, rounded corners, vignette… tune it all to your taste.

store_data.about_the_game:
The bell rang. And everything fell.


In the 78th year of the Third Covenant, the red dragon Agnar's horde burned the monastery of Saint Guardian to the ground. As the last bell tolled over the ashes, five monks slipped out through a hidden passage — carrying not gold or relics, but seeds, ledgers, scripture, and a battered cooking pot.

The Five Monks is a settlement simulation about rebuilding a broken world. Lead the five survivors on a pilgrimage across the continent, gather the companions scattered far and wide, and raise a new sanctuary from the ashes.

One World, Endless Beginnings

  • World Generation — Shape a different continent every time with adjustable seeds, biomes, terrain noise, and POI density. No two journeys are ever the same.
  • Settle & Manage — Chop, mine, cook, and build. Watch over each monk's hunger, sleep, and morale — a community only survives if its people do.
  • Explore & Fight — Cursed forests, fallen cities, mountains under a dragon's shadow. Stand against the dark with a blessed hammer, healing light, and a staff of purification.

Raise What Was Lost

This is a journey not of conquest, but of inheritance. A story of people who build the bell tower before the wall, the shared granary before the vault, a single seed before a statue. The sanctuary you raise becomes a bell that tells every soul in need: the door is open.

Every Companion Has a Story

A guardian who stands at the front despite his fear. A healer who weighs a king's life and a beggar's on the same scale. A cook who fills an empty pot with water and waits for tomorrow. A keeper who guards spring with a single seed. And an elder who walks at the front when all others are lost. Dozens of companions join your journey, each carrying their own wounds and convictions. To gather companions is to gather their stories.

The Law of Saint Guardian

"The light exists to protect, and those who protect do not retreat — even if they are the last to stand."

The monastery has fallen. But as long as one who remembers the law still lives, Saint Guardian is not yet ended.

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO MECCHA ROGUE!

A competitive PvP painting roguelite where you paint yourself into increasingly difficult scenes, build powerful upgrades, and sabotage your friends before the clock runs out!

BATTLE YOUR FRIENDS!

Two players! One scene! One clock!
Race to blend yourself into the target image while watching your opponent struggle beside you in competitive battles!
Clear a level, receive a random perk, then choose a curse that makes your opponent's life miserable for the next level!
  • STEAL THEIR TIME!
  • INVERT THEIR CONTROLS!
  • SUMMON ENEMIES!
  • DESTROY THEIR CONFIDENCE!
Every round gets harder! Timers get shorter! Scenes become more complex! The last brush standing wins!

MASTER THE SINGLE-PLAYER ROGUELITE!

Tired of beating your friend and making them sad? Take on 50 increasingly difficult levels across five brutal difficulty tiers in single-player mode!
Study the scene, mix your colours, paint yourself into the environment, and reach the required similarity score before time runs out!
Every level gives you points to spend!
  • 186 permanent upgrades!
  • More than 50 discoverable relics!
  • Random perks on every run!
  • Enemies, hazards, and final bosses!
  • Progression that carries into multiplayer!
Everything you earn can be used against your friends later!

COMPLETE ALL 50 LEVELS AND WIN A GRAND PRIZE!

We hid something inside this game, and it is not part of the game.
Not a cosmetic. Not an achievement. Not a leaderboard placement.
Something real.
The first eligible player to find it and satisfy the official contest rules KEEPS IT!
Finding it takes two things: a very good eye and the curiosity to notice what does not belong.
You have probably already ignored the first clue.

A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPERS

MECCHA ROGUE is a colourful little painting game about matching backgrounds.
The characters are not sentient.
The paint is just paint.
The symbols mean nothing.
The voices are lying.

Please enjoy the game.
Please do not look too closely.

store_data.about_the_game:
A seed-driven roguelike deckbuilder about looting a sinking wreck with up to three friends and getting out while there's still a way back.

Every dive starts with a seed. Every seed builds the same waters for everyone who runs it. Go alone, or bring a crew and split the risk.

One wreck is never the whole run. The water is always rising.

Build the Deck as You Dive
You don't plan a build between runs, you find one. Cards come off the map as you push deeper into the wreck, and salvage cards modify what you already hold, turning a hand you settled for into a hand you meant to have.

Chart the Crossing
A run is a voyage, not a single dive. Clear what's guarding the wreck and you surface with a choice: where to sail next. Every stretch of water has its own character, its own wrecks, and its own way of killing you, from silt-choked shallows to trenches where the light gives out. The route is yours to pick, and two crews can share a seed and still come home with completely different stories.

The Tide Takes the Floor
The wreck floods one tile at a time. Flooded ground doesn't stop you, it just costs you, and every step through it takes a bite out of your health. Early on there's always a dry way around. Later there isn't, and the walk back to the surface is a bill you pay in blood. The question is never whether you can reach the exit. It's how much of you arrives.

The Hard Way Pays Better
Some parts of a wreck are sealed off, and you can always walk past them. Getting in takes the right tool card and puts you somewhere more dangerous than the route you skipped. It's also where the treasure and the rarest cards are. Every locked space is the same question: is this worth what it might cost your crew?

Your Tools Come Back With You
Tools are the one thing a run doesn't take from you. Everything else goes back to the sea, but the tools you recover stay in your kit, which means the next wreck opens up in ways the last one couldn't.

Every Run Has a Name
Runs are generated from a seed you can read, share, and challenge someone else to beat. Type a wreck's name into the Drowned Register and dive the exact same waters your friend just barely escaped: same rooms, same monsters, same tide. Compare hauls. Argue about who got greedy.

Four Divers, One Tide
Co-op for up to four. Spread out across the decks to cover more ship before the water rises, or stay tight and survive longer. The tide doesn't care how you split up.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the post-apocalyptic wasteland, Radiation Life, Origin Life, and Mechanical Intelligences stand divided; civilization has crumbled, order is gone, and killing is routine. How to preserve civilization and find hope in such despair? The answer lies in victories battle after battle—you must build a truly powerful team and forge ahead through blood and fire.

This is a character-collection game; dive into the wasteland, discover unique comrades, and make them your winning pieces.

Combat is turn-based, with dice allocation as the core mechanic: each turn you roll dice, then assign them to different characters based on the numbers to unlock each one's maximum power. Clever combinations of dice, relics, and character skills yield endless tactical possibilities, making every fight unpredictable.

At the same time, it's a Roguelike game. Each expedition takes your carefully trained team into unknown territory, where you may randomly find rare relics, meet unexpected new allies, or even enhance your dice abilities—every run is unique, every session fresh with randomness.

Where is civilization headed? The answer is in your hands. And that die quietly awaits your hopeful throw.

Gather valuable minerals and rare materials hidden deep beneath the earth using your trusty chicken team. Upgrade your mining equipment to dig deeper and unlock richer resource deposits faster.

store_data.about_the_game:
Howdy Partner!!

These darn CorpoRobots have been fixin' to remove me from my little garden shack, and I just can not stand that. 

Don't worry tho'! I have seeds to grow a handful of proficient lead spewin' non GMO Plant Weapons, just need y'ur help getting them off my garden!

Use and handful of home grown weapons to stand up to big corporations trying to take away a hard working person's honest grounds.

These weapons range from a repeating corn assault rifle to a short range tea zapper!

These guns can be upgraded during a run to offer different frames. Turning a once repeating corn cannon into a full auto monster!
Don't forget your trusty shotgun! it can be used to finish off low health enemies or aim at the ground while in the air and get a jump boost!

The weapons ain't the only finely tuned monster on the field, you are too! With the ability to dash and rush past enemies when you see an opening, there is a heavy focus on moving around and keeping yourself mobile!

Speaking of monsters, the robots themselves come in 3 variants and with them an adapting take to each run, such as the higher the round the more deadly these metallic monsters will become.

The seeds when fully grown give you money! Although, that amount is determined by the number of hay stocks you keep alive!

This is your seed plot!

The main goal is to grow seeds, unlocking new weapons and sending in new waves to get you for growing! And to finally get the deed to your farm! But you can continue on past that! 

Some say the old farmer left a dangerous seed though, that enrages the robots to no end, but is massively profitable.

Each run is different! With this being a short 30-45 minute game that focuses on the old massive wave training and making sure you watch your step! A real shut your mind off and just enjoy this short little piece of art.

store_data.about_the_game:
The last day of the school year. Tomorrow is summer. There are three months ahead, which seem like an eternity.

And this whole day, the longest day of the year, belongs only to you.

DETSTVO is a game about that day that everyone remembers, but no one can bring back.

The world of the game

Paneled five-story buildings, faded carpets on the walls, shell garages, poplar fluff in the entryway. A dusty playground with a rickety swing and a rusty spider-web climbing wall. Grocery store with an iron door and bell. The construction site behind the houses, where it is forbidden to go, means you have to go.

What can I do?

School

Wake up at the last lesson

Raise the chairs one last time

Write your wishes on the blackboard or draw a picture.

Run from school to race with your best friend

Yard

Play Hide-and-Seek, Hopscotch

Score a goal

Poke around the garages

House

Have a delicious soup, just like in your childhood

Watch cartoons

Burn on the board

Play snake on that indestructible phone

Remember about Tetris

Disassemble the matryoshka doll and much more.

Features

A lively atmosphere. Dynamic full-day lighting, the soundscape of the courtyard, interior details recreated from photographs and memories.

The soundtrack. Original music, stylized for the era: a guitar from the next window, a tape recorder on the windowsill, the sound of the radio in the kitchen.

A quiet story. There are no monsters and weapons here, but only your imagination and the impression of your happy DETSTVO.

The final

Meet your parents and hug them tightly.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dynambrynth is a stylized, low‑poly dungeon crawler built around tactical combat, deliberate decision‑making, and dynamically generated labyrinths. At the start of each run, a new maze is created—its rooms, paths, and encounters arranged into a fresh layout for you to explore.

Choose your class — Warrior, Mage, or Archer — and master their distinct combat styles. Every strike, spell, and shot matters as you navigate tight corridors, dodge traps, and battle creatures lurking in the depths. Combat rewards timing, positioning, and awareness rather than frantic button‑mashing, creating a clean and readable action experience that feels both accessible and satisfying.

Explore handcrafted and procedurally‑generated rooms, uncover secrets, and push deeper into the heart of the maze. Each run offers a new configuration of challenges, but the labyrinth itself remains stable until you fall—or choose to dive back in for another attempt.

Escape the maze—if you can.

Engage up close with a Fighter:

Take down enemies from afar as an Archer:

store_data.about_the_game:
Borders of Chernobyl is a border officer horror game set in an alternate timeline where the Chernobyl reactor never suffered its catastrophic meltdown. It survived, and so did the secret agenda behind it.

The government has been quietly leaking radioactive chemicals into the water and food supplies throughout Chernobyl and its neighboring districts. The lingering effects are beginning to show, and it’s your job to stand on the front line.

SURVIVE THE SHIFT

You play as Sam, a border officer assigned to check documents at the checkpoint. Your objective is straightforward, but dangerous:

  • Review Passports: Inspect identification and official travel papers.

  • Control the Gate: Grant entry to valid citizens while denying those with fraudulent or missing documents.

  • Spot the Contaminated: Keep an eye out for travelers who don't seem quite right... or quite human.

SURVIVE THE NIGHT

Your compensation? A run-down, 500-a-week apartment that is slowly falling apart around you. Between your shifts, you'll need to manage your personal life to stay functional:

  • Keep your Hunger in check.

  • Manage your Sleep schedule.

  • Preserve your dwindling Sanity.

Step into the booth, double-check the papers, and try not to lose your mind in the shadow of Chernobyl.

store_data.about_the_game:
Stingray Sanctuary is a cozy idle/incremental game about raising stingrays on your own tropical island. Hatch eggs, care for your rays, and build an ecosystem where every creature earns its keep, even while you're away.

RAISE STINGRAYS FROM BIRTH

Buy an egg from the fishmonger and keep it warm, calm, and cared for. How you treat it before it hatches shapes the ray it becomes. Every ray grows in real time from hatchling to adult, with 5 stats shaped by how you raise them and a personality all their own. Will you hatch an Earner, a Breeder, an Athlete... or something rarer?

BUILD A SELF-SUSTAINING ECOSYSTEM

Money comes from unique interactions between everything you add. Koi both create and fetch stray coins, while songbirds gang up on thieving vultures. Penguins brood your eggs, and toucans sniff out treasure. The capybara just radiates calm (it helps, trust me). Assemble the right mix of creatures, plants, and curios, and the sanctuary starts paying for itself.

EXPAND AND UPGRADE YOUR SANCTUARY

Grow from a tiny 3-slot nursery into a thriving island paradise. Unlock new shop stock, research permanent upgrades for your favorite species, and decorate with palm trees, lanterns, paper boats, and a radio for beach tunes.

PROGRESS WHILE YOU'RE AWAY

The sanctuary keeps earning while you're gone, and there's always something to come back to. No timers screaming at you, no pressure.

store_data.about_the_game:
Manus Sors is a story-driven 2D adventure with elements of мистicism and psychological horror.

After her grandmother's death, Kristina returns to her apartment to sort through the family's remaining affairs. Surrounded by familiar belongings, old photographs, and fading memories, she begins to notice things that should not be there.

Cryptic notes draw her deeper into her family's past, while the familiar apartment gradually reveals a passage to Nav—a cold, distorted reflection of the world where the past refuses to stay buried.

When Kristina suddenly stops responding, her younger brother, Artyom, sets out to find her.

Together, they must uncover the way back home—and discover why their family is bound to this place.

TWO SIBLINGS. ONE FAMILY SECRET

Kristina is Artyom's older sister. After their parents' death, she took it upon herself to protect him, carrying every burden alone and hiding anything that might hurt him.

Artyom is tired of being protected. When Kristina disappears, he sets out to find her on his own, unaware of where the trail she left behind will lead.

They experience the world differently, notice different details, and confront fear in their own ways.

But only together can they find their way home.

EXPLORE A WORLD WHERE EVERY DETAIL MATTERS

Travel through atmospheric 2D locations, search abandoned rooms, and interact with the objects around you.

Old letters, faded photographs, clocks, mirrors, and family heirlooms may all be pieces of a much larger mystery. Sometimes the clue is right in front of you. Sometimes it can only be seen through your phone's camera. And sometimes the most important clue is something that shouldn't be there at all.

Observe carefully, connect the pieces, and uncover the story one fragment at a time.

ROOMS THAT REFUSE TO LET YOU LEAVE

During her journey, Kristina finds herself trapped inside anomalous rooms where every exit has vanished.

To escape, you'll need to study your surroundings, decipher hidden clues, and understand the strange logic that governs each puzzle.

Every room is tied to the grandmother's past, revealing another piece of the family's history.

But the more answers the siblings uncover, the more unsettling one question becomes:

Who truly wanted them to walk this path?

PUZZLES ARE PART OF THE STORY

Every puzzle in Manus Sors is woven into the environment and the events of the past.

Read forgotten notes, discover hidden patterns, connect symbols, listen carefully to the sounds around you, and examine every object.

Mistakes are met with unsettling visual and audio distortions, while every correct solution reveals another piece of the truth.

Here, finding the answer isn't enough.

You have to understand what it means.

YOUR PHONE IS YOUR MOST IMPORTANT TOOL

Use your phone to light the darkness, preserve important discoveries, and reveal details invisible to the naked eye.

Its flashlight, camera, filters, notes, and other features allow the siblings to explore Nav and uncover things that cannot be seen through ordinary eyes.

Kristina has a deeper understanding of family heirlooms and memories.

Artyom is more adept with technology, sounds, and symbolic clues.

Their strengths complement one another, offering different perspectives on the very same events.

FEATURES

  • Story-driven 2D adventure focused on exploration and environmental interaction.

  • Two playable protagonists: Kristina and her younger brother, Artyom.

  • Atmospheric puzzles deeply connected to the environment and the family's past.

  • Anomalous rooms with no obvious escape.

  • Smartphone mechanics including a flashlight, camera, filters, and notes.

  • Dark, hand-crafted visuals with richly detailed 2D environments.

  • Immersive sound design, unsettling visual effects, and carefully placed jump scares.

  • A story told through letters, photographs, memories, and environmental details.

  • Inspired by Slavic mythology, featuring an original interpretation of Nav.

  • A complete narrative about family, loss, and the consequences of choices made long ago.

SOME SECRETS SHOULD NEVER BE INHERITED

Kristina wanted to protect her brother from the truth.

Artyom wanted to prove he was capable of protecting his sister.

Now they are trapped in a place where every answer brings them one step closer to escape—and one step closer to uncovering the secret their grandmother chose to take to her grave.

Explore Nav.

Solve its mysteries.

Piece together your family's story.

And help Kristina and Artyom find their way home.

Maze of Doors

Every door leads somewhere... but not every place wants you to leave.

You wake up inside a mysterious maze filled with endless rooms, strange illusions, and impossible environments. The only way forward is through the doors — but each one hides a new challenge, puzzle, or terrifying encounter.

Explore a constantly changing maze where reality breaks apart. Walk through rooms where gravity shifts, time freezes, water rises, and the world glitches around you. Solve puzzles, survive unexpected events, and discover the secrets hidden behind each door.

But be careful...

Some rooms are not meant to be explored.

Features

🚪 A Maze Full of Mystery

  • Discover unique rooms with different mechanics, puzzles, and challenges.

  • Interact with your surroundings and find your way through rooms designed to test your observation and creativity.

The doors keep changing.

Open the next door... if you dare.

store_data.about_the_game:
一段循序漸進展開的故事

故事從一隻背負巨額債務的貓娘開始

為了償還債務，她加入冒險者公會，接受一件又一件看似平凡的委託。然而，隨著旅程展開，雪山深處的禁地、神秘的債務水晶，以及跨越千年的秘密逐漸浮現，一切都開始超出原本的想像

沒有突如其來的救世使命，而是在一次次冒險與委託中，慢慢拼湊出世界真正的樣貌

每個委託都不是填充內容

每份委託都與角色、村莊或世界觀有所連結

玩家將透過這些故事逐漸認識各個地方的人們，理解他們的生活、煩惱與選擇。有些看似不起眼的小事件，也可能成為後續劇情的重要伏筆

世界會記住你的抉擇

你的行為，會被觀察

偷走村民家中的物品、做出不同的選擇、甚至一些看似不起眼的行動，都可能影響角色對你的態度，以及後續事件的發展

世界並不只是等待玩家前進，而是會記住你曾經做過的事情

探索值得被獎勵

除了寶箱之外，世界中還藏著各種值得探索的內容

首次與 NPC 互動、隱藏道具、特殊事件、地圖角落，以及散落各處的世界資訊，都可能帶來特殊獎勵或新的故事

輕鬆幽默，卻逐漸走向更深層的故事

故事前期充滿輕鬆幽默的吐槽、日常互動與冒險生活

然而隨著劇情推進，角色背負的過去、世界運作的規則，以及各方勢力真正的目的，也將一步步浮現

當再次回頭看最初發生的一切時，許多曾經平凡的事件，都將擁有截然不同的意義

store_data.about_the_game:
Your last incantation went haywire, the cauldron exploded and you plunged the magical alchemy shop into absolute chaos, completely covered in alchemical ingredients. Only one way to fix it and escape the wrath of your alchemy master - clean the laboratory. Gather 1000+ ingredients, process them at multiple processing stations, brew almost 200 unique elixir recipes and plant them into proper shelves. Fully enjoyable alone or with friends.


Use your magic wand shine you way forward, levitate or throw any of the ingredients scattered around the laboratory. Everything you see is physics-based and can be controlled with magic.

You have the absolute freedom to enjoy the game any way you seem fit. Do you want to relax and slowly pick up the mess or optimize by streamlining your process of potion brewing be throwing stuff around wildly to save time? Maybe create a chain with your friends where you pass items to each other to speed everything up even more? Or just immerse yourself in the magical alchemy laboratory and enjoy your cleaning journey. It's totally up to you.

The laboratory begins as an absolute mess. Empty shelves hidden beneath ginormous piles of various ingredients covering up the ground and even the balconies. As you proceed, you see the whole laboratory transform - tiny and shiny whisps floating in the hall, birds fluttering and shelves covered in beautiful flowers upon being filled with elixirs.

You're not only cleaning up the space. You're transforming it into a place filled with beauty, peace and harmony.

The game is fully enjoyable solo or with friends in co-op. More hands mean more fun and more cleaning up. You can scatter around and fetch the ingredients individually, create chains where one player gathers ingredients, another processes them, the third brews the elixirs and the fourth places them in their proper shelving place. Or, should you want to, you can even cause some mischief. Whatever you choose, it's your journey.
store_data.detailed_description:
Your last incantation went haywire, the cauldron exploded and you plunged the magical alchemy shop into absolute chaos, completely covered in alchemical ingredients. Only one way to fix it and escape the wrath of your alchemy master - clean the laboratory. Gather 1000+ ingredients, process them at multiple processing stations, brew almost 200 unique elixir recipes and plant them into proper shelves. Fully enjoyable alone or with friends.


Use your magic wand shine you way forward, levitate or throw any of the ingredients scattered around the laboratory. Everything you see is physics-based and can be controlled with magic.

You have the absolute freedom to enjoy the game any way you seem fit. Do you want to relax and slowly pick up the mess or optimize by streamlining your process of potion brewing be throwing stuff around wildly to save time? Maybe create a chain with your friends where you pass items to each other to speed everything up even more? Or just immerse yourself in the magical alchemy laboratory and enjoy your cleaning journey. It's totally up to you.

The laboratory begins as an absolute mess. Empty shelves hidden beneath ginormous piles of various ingredients covering up the ground and even the balconies. As you proceed, you see the whole laboratory transform - tiny and shiny whisps floating in the hall, birds fluttering and shelves covered in beautiful flowers upon being filled with elixirs.

You're not only cleaning up the space. You're transforming it into a place filled with beauty, peace and harmony.

The game is fully enjoyable solo or with friends in co-op. More hands mean more fun and more cleaning up. You can scatter around and fetch the ingredients individually, create chains where one player gathers ingredients, another processes them, the third brews the elixirs and the fourth places them in their proper shelving place. Or, should you want to, you can even cause some mischief. Whatever you choose, it's your journey.
store_data.short_description: Catchemist: Brew the right potion is an alchemy cleanup game ejoyable solo or co-op. Clean up 1000+ ingredients, refine them at multiple processing stations, brew almost 200 unique recipes and place them into correct shelves to transform the laboratory into a place filled with harmony & peace.

store_data.about_the_game:
SLIMESHOT is an action roguelike about a climb that changes you. Ascend eleven

floors of a god's tower with a weapon that rewards timing over trigger speed,

heal only by devouring the dead, and grow a body you chose out of the things

you consumed along the way. The god narrates every floor of your ascent. It

 starts out charmed by you. It does not stay that way.

"god: i have a jar with your name on it. not a threat, a keepsake. climb, climb."

A Slingshot

Hold to draw. Release on the sweet spot. Every shot is a timing decision:

tapping is weak, overholding wastes the window, and a clean release kills. Your

primary fire is not a resource you spend but a skill you sharpen, and it keeps

paying out for as long as you keep improving.

Dodge through a projectile at the last moment and the world drops into slow

motion and refunds your dash. Mastery is the power curve.

Heal by Feeding

There are no health pickups, no potions, and no regeneration. Corpses are

the only way to heal. Every feast spikes HEAT, and everything still alive

comes at you faster for it. Healing is always a trade, and the tower knows it:

one enemy in the roster ignores you entirely and races you to the corpses,

raising your food before you can eat it.

Become the Build

Items in SLIMESHOT stack on your body, not just on your stat sheet. Grafts

accumulate in anatomical regions; enough weight in one region grows an organ,

an eye, a maw, a gland. Adjacent organs fuse into something new. Open the

anatomy screen at any time and study the creature you have decided to become.

It is a second build axis running beneath the item build, and it is why two

runs with the same items are never the same run.

The Climb

  • 11 floors across 10 hand-built biomes, from the Sunlit Warren to theDrowned Halls to the Clockworks to the Sanctum.

  • 209 items, each a distinct mechanic, including 23 run-defining legendaries. No filler stat sticks.

  • 58 encounterable bosses, most of them transforming between phases.

  • 80 enemies driven by 40 distinct behaviour patterns. Snipers relocate, strafers jink, phantoms work your rear arc.

  • 8 playable specimens, each a genuinely different creature with its own innate kit.

  • 7 endings, three of them sealed behind secret routes with their own bosses, arenas, and story films.

  • Your dead runs come back. Fall with a build and it returns as a crowned echo in a later run, wearing what killed you.

A Voice From the Top of the Tower

The god of the tower watches your whole climb and never stops talking:

intimate, petty, and increasingly honest. The commentary tracks what you eat,

what you grow, and how close you are getting. By the final floors it is not

narrating a pet. It is negotiating with a predator.

An Original Synthesized Score

42 bespoke synthesized sound effects and 28 authored themes, including a

distinct boss theme for every floor. Nothing is licensed from a library;

every cue was composed for this game.

The Ascent Is a Slingshot Ascent

Master the release. Eat what you kill. Wear it. Climb.

store_data.about_the_game:
Manage Your Own Blacksmith Shop and Equip Adventurers!

Medieval Fantasy Blacksmith Shop is a simple and enjoyable blacksmithing game set in a fantastic medieval shop. Manage your materials, forge swords, and try to pay your weekly rent and survive by selling the right weapons to the adventurers who come to your shop!

Featured Features

  • Sword Forging and Crafting: Fill your shop shelves with swords by combining basic materials such as iron, coal, leather, and wood.

  • Customers and Hunting Results: Your customers come to the shop and tell you the monsters they want to hunt. Suggest swords that suit their weaknesses. The more successful your client is in the hunt, the more gold you earn!

  • Shop Ledger and Shopping: Order new materials from suppliers, track your daily sales in the ledger, and plan your budget to pay your weekly rent.

  • Monster Information: Read information and rumors about monsters from your shop ledger. This way you can recommend the most suitable weapon to adventurers.

  • Economy and Eviction Risk: Take out an emergency loan during tough weeks. If you can't pay your rent regularly, you'll be evicted from the shop and lose the game.

  • A Legendary Final Adventure: Starting with ordinary weapons, become a master blacksmith who forges the sword of the legendary hero who will save the kingdom by crafting the rarest materials.

Easy Crafting, Fast Trading

Prepare your swords by combining the materials you receive at the beginning of the day in the crafting panel. Until closing time, offer customers prices that fit their budgets or reject sales that won't be profitable.

Rent and Budget Management

The key to keeping the shop open is financial balance. Save your gold to pay the accumulated rent at the end of each week. Overcome slow sales periods with borrowing mechanisms and protect your shop from bankruptcy.

store_data.about_the_game:
ONE PLAYER. ONE CAREER.
You're not shuffling spreadsheets — you're on the pitch. You call for the ball, you decide when to pass and when to shoot, and your weekend rating decides where you stand next week.

FROM THE BENCH TO THE FLOODLIGHTS
Your career starts on the bench of a fourth-division club, before you've even warmed up properly. Come on as a substitute, prove yourself, earn a starting shirt — then the offers arrive, the stadiums grow, and the evening games sell out. Every rung is a different world: wooden benches and fans behind the fence at a village ground; a towering stand, LED boards and a live big screen in the top flight.

EVERY CAREER IS ITS OWN WORLD
A generated country, four divisions, 74 clubs — each with its own crest, kits, city, stadium and pitch condition. No two careers are alike: the title favourites, your rivals and your own path all shape up differently in every new game.

THE SCOUT SEES EVERYTHING
Twenty visible abilities — pace, dribbling, shooting, first touch, positioning and more — plus seven hidden ones only the scout knows: ambition, sportsmanship, teamwork, bravery... They decide what offers you get and what you're worth. After every match the coach breaks down your performance from your REAL numbers and tells you exactly what to work on.

REAL FOOTBALL SIMULATION ON THE PITCH
Charged shots with curl, sharp-cut feints, sliding tackles, headers onto crosses — and if your back is to goal, the bicycle kick. Your teammates hold their shape, play you in behind and whip crosses from the wing; keepers narrow the angle, come for loose balls and dive only when they truly have to. Offside, corners, throw-ins, yellows and reds, referee and linesmen — all in place.

WEATHER THAT MATTERS
Sunny afternoons, floodlit evenings, rain, storms, fog and snow — the pitch, the light and the whole atmosphere change with it.

LIFE OFF THE PITCH
Spend your wages on houses and cars, from a small family home to a two-storey villa — and walk around what you bought in a full-screen view.

EARLY BETA
The game is in EARLY BETA: the core — career, match engine, training, transfers — is playable end to end, while content keeps growing and the balance is still being tuned.

store_data.about_the_game:
Paint. Hide. Seek.

Hide & Seek reinvents the classic game of hide-and-seek for online multiplayer. Every hider spawns as a blank white figure — and the world around you is your only camouflage. Grab your brush, paint your body to match the crates, walls, and props nearby, then freeze and pray the seekers walk right past.

HOW A ROUND WORKS

Lobby — Gather your friends and drop into a match.
Prep Phase — Hiders paint themselves and search for the perfect hiding spot. Seekers can already roam the same map, but the hiders stay invisible to them until the hunt begins.
The Hunt — When prep ends, every hider appears, and the seekers race to find and tag them all before the timer runs out.
Results — See who blended in best and who had the sharpest eye.

BECOME THE SCENERY

Hiding here isn't about ducking behind a wall. Use the in-game paint tools to hand-craft your own disguise — match the colors, copy the textures, and turn yourself into just another object in the room. The better your paint job, the longer you survive. New to painting? Switch on Camouflage Mode for a quick, automatic disguise.

EASY TO LEARN, TENSE TO PLAY

Simple controls, fast matches, and that heart-pounding moment when a seeker stops right in front of you. The perfect party game to play with friends.

store_data.about_the_game:
**PUSHBOX** is a modern take on the beloved Sokoban puzzle genre.

Your goal is simple: push every box onto its target. But with each level, the challenge grows. You'll need to plan every move carefully — one wrong push and you're stuck.

### Features

- **20 hand-crafted levels** — ranging from approachable introductions to genuinely tricky puzzles

- **Par system** — each level has an optimal step count; beat it to earn 3 stars

- **Undo & Reset** — step back any move, or restart a level instantly without penalty

- **Progress tracking** — your best step count is saved for every level

- **Level Select** — replay any unlocked level to improve your score

- **Clean pixel art** — crisp, readable visuals that keep focus on the puzzle

- **Keyboard friendly** — WASD or arrow keys, fully playable without a mouse

### Controls

| Key | Action |

|-----|--------|

| Arrow Keys / WASD | Move player |

| Z / Backspace | Undo last move |

| R | Reset level |

| ESC | Return to menu |

### Perfect For

- Fans of classic Sokoban / block-pushing puzzles

- Players who enjoy thinking before they act

- Anyone who wants short, satisfying puzzle sessions
