store_data.about_the_game:
Medieval Travelling Merchant is a focused trading simulation built around a living medieval economy.

Travel between villages, towns, cities, a great city, and the royal capital. Buy goods where supply is abundant, carry them across the realm, and sell where local demand creates a profitable opportunity.

There is no combat system, crafting tree, city management, or kingdom building competing for your attention. The core of the game is trade: observing markets, managing capital, choosing routes, controlling risk, and adapting when conditions change.

A Living Economy, Not a Random Price Generator

Markets do not simply roll arbitrary prices whenever you arrive.

Each settlement maintains its own stock, production, consumption, and demand conditions. Prices respond to the actual economic state of that market:

  • Local production increases supply.

  • Residents consume goods as time passes.

  • Population, occupations, wealth, and settlement type shape demand.

  • Player purchases reduce available stock.

  • Player sales increase stock and can create market saturation.

  • Rival merchants buy, transport, and deliver goods between settlements.

  • Seasons and local events can disrupt production, supply chains, travel, and demand.

This creates real relationships between supply, demand, scarcity, surplus, inventory levels, market depth, price movement, and diminishing returns.

A profitable market may become less attractive after a large delivery. A shortage may recover over time. A familiar route may lose its margin after repeated sales, while another settlement develops a new opportunity.

The economy continues to operate even when the player does nothing.

Buy Low, Sell High — But Watch the Margin

Every product has a market price shaped by current conditions.

Markets can show:

  • Surplus, where goods are plentiful and buying opportunities are stronger.

  • Balanced supply, where prices remain closer to normal.

  • Shortage, where demand may support more profitable sales.

Large trades are priced progressively. Selling twenty units is not the same as selling one unit twenty times at the same price. As the market absorbs your cargo, later units may earn a smaller margin—and excessive supply can eventually turn a profitable sale into a loss.

That makes quantity part of the decision.

Sometimes the best move is to sell only part of your cargo. Sometimes it is worth accepting a small loss to free capacity for a better opportunity elsewhere.

125 Goods Across 10 Distinct Markets

Trade a broad range of medieval goods, including:

  • Grain, flour, bread, meat, dairy, and preserved food

  • Timber, ore, metal bars, tools, and construction materials

  • Cloth, clothing, leather goods, and transport supplies

  • Wine, ale, tea, spices, oil, and glassware

  • Books, jewellery, gemstones, perfumes, noble clothing, and luxury goods

Each settlement has its own economic identity.

Farming communities, mining towns, forest settlements, ports, manufacturing cities, wealthy urban markets, and the royal capital do not produce or consume the same mix of goods.

Local culture and social structure also matter. Labourers, farmers, miners, craftsmen, merchants, guards, wealthy citizens, and nobles create different patterns of consumption.

The handbook inside the game explains these market identities without revealing exact hidden formulas or guaranteed trade routes.

Rival Merchants Compete for the Same Economy

You are not the only trader on the road.

Other merchants move across the world map using different animals, carts, capacities, route preferences, and economic profiles. They purchase goods, deliver cargo, reduce shortages, and sometimes reach a market before you do.

A route that looked profitable when you departed may be less attractive by the time you arrive.

Rival merchants do not exist only as visual decoration. Their completed trades change market stock and affect the opportunities available to you.

Four Seasons, Changing Conditions

Spring, summer, autumn, and winter change both the appearance of the world and the rhythm of trade.

Seasonal conditions can affect:

  • Agricultural and animal production

  • Availability of stored and processed goods

  • Demand for food, fuel, clothing, and supplies

  • Road conditions and travel delays

  • The reliability of certain routes

Seasonal tendencies create opportunities, not guarantees. Current stock, recent deliveries, local demand, and unexpected events still matter.

Manage Capital, Cargo, and Risk

Your money is not useful only while sitting in your purse.

Capital can be tied up in:

  • Cargo

  • Transport upgrades

  • Animals and carts

  • Escorts

  • Toll payments

  • Houses

  • Repairs and treatment

  • Jobs and contracts

Expensive cargo may offer higher potential profit, but it also exposes more wealth to the road.

Escorts reduce danger, but protection has an ongoing cost. Hiring two guards may save a valuable shipment—or may reduce your net profit on an uneventful journey.

There is no universally correct choice. A short, inexpensive route may not justify protection. A long journey carrying luxury goods may justify a larger security expense.

Upgrade Your Transport

Begin with limited carrying capacity and gradually improve your operation.

Different transport setups offer different balances of:

  • Cargo capacity

  • Travel speed

  • Cost

  • Durability

  • Weather resistance

  • Risk exposure

A larger cart allows larger trades, but only when your capital, route planning, and target market can support the additional cargo.

More capacity is an opportunity, not an automatic profit multiplier.

Jobs, Contracts, Houses, and Progression

Free trading remains the heart of the game, but additional opportunities are available.

Cargo Jobs provide sealed cargo and a fixed payment for successful delivery.

Trade Contracts require you to purchase the requested goods with your own money and deliver them before the deadline.

Houses act as long-term investments and progression milestones across the realm.

New settlements and wider trading opportunities open as your merchant career develops, but the game remains focused on the same central activity: building wealth through trade.

A Calm Game With Meaningful Decisions

Medieval Travelling Merchant is designed to be thoughtful rather than frantic.

Travel across seasonal landscapes, listen to medieval-inspired music and market ambience, watch other merchants move between settlements, and study how prices develop over time.

The atmosphere is relaxed, but the economy still asks you to make real decisions:

  • Is the margin large enough to justify the distance?

  • How much should you sell before saturation weakens the price?

  • Is an escort worth the expense?

  • Should you carry expensive luxury goods or safer everyday products?

  • Is the current opportunity strong enough, or should you preserve your capital?

Just trade. Just chill.

Why I Made This Game

I have loved trading simulation games for years, but I often struggled to find one focused entirely on trade.

Many games include trading as one system among combat, crafting, city building, survival, or role-playing mechanics. I wanted something different: a game centred on markets, prices, cargo, routes, risk, and a genuinely simulated economy.

I wanted settlements with real stock and consumption. I wanted supply and demand to react to player activity. I wanted rival merchants to participate in the same economy. I wanted repeated sales to create saturation instead of producing unlimited profit from a fixed route.

So I began developing Medieval Travelling Merchant as the trading game I wanted to play myself.

I later decided to release it on Steam in case other players were looking for the same kind of focused, relaxing, economy-driven trading experience.

Free trading remains the heart of the game, but additional opportunities are available.

Cargo Jobs provide sealed cargo and a fixed payment for successful delivery.

Trade Contracts require you to purchase the requested goods with your own money and deliver them before the deadline.

Houses act as long-term investments and progression milestones across the realm.

New settlements and wider trading opportunities open as your merchant career develops, but the game remains focused on the same central activity: building wealth through trade.

A Calm Game With Meaningful Decisions

Medieval Travelling Merchant is designed to be thoughtful rather than frantic.

Travel across seasonal landscapes, listen to medieval-inspired music and market ambience, watch other merchants move between settlements, and study how prices develop over time.

The atmosphere is relaxed, but the economy still asks you to make real decisions:

  • Is the margin large enough to justify the distance?

  • How much should you sell before saturation weakens the price?

  • Is an escort worth the expense?

  • Should you carry expensive luxury goods or safer everyday products?

  • Is the current opportunity strong enough, or should you preserve your capital?

Just trade. Just chill.

Why I Made This Game

I have loved trading simulation games for years, but I often struggled to find one focused entirely on trade.

Many games include trading as one system among combat, crafting, city building, survival, or role-playing mechanics. I wanted something different: a game centred on markets, prices, cargo, routes, risk, and a genuinely simulated economy.

I wanted settlements with real stock and consumption. I wanted supply and demand to react to player activity. I wanted rival merchants to participate in the same economy. I wanted repeated sales to create saturation instead of producing unlimited profit from a fixed route.

So I began developing Medieval Travelling Merchant as the trading game I wanted to play myself.

I later decided to release it on Steam in case other players were looking for the same kind of focused, relaxing, economy-driven trading experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
A tiny miner on your desktop

Toby floats on your screen with no background, wandering freely across whatever apps you have open. Your clicks pass right through him, so he never gets in the way of your work or your video. He just quietly swings his pickaxe in the corner of your screen. Glance over mid-task and you might catch him hauling up a golden carrot.

Dig and upgrade

Carrots, golden carrots, and treasure chests lie buried across the ground. Toby walks over, digs them up, and the carrots pile in. Spend them to boost your mining power, speed, and luck, or buy a better pickaxe. The stronger you get, the more valuable the things that surface.

The joy of collecting

Items from treasure chests can be logged in your collection for permanent stat boosts, or sold for carrots. Gather materials to craft special pickaxes — and rare finds that only those pickaxes can unearth. Dig, collect, grow stronger, dig deeper: a loop that never really ends.

Coworkers by your side

You're not alone out there. Recruit worker rabbits to dig alongside you, and fuse matching ones into rarer, more capable species. From shibas and foxes to otters and penguins, a whole cast of animal friends picks up a pickaxe beside you.

Move to a new patch

Once you've worked a patch enough, pack up and move to a new one. Sandy, rocky, hot-spring fields — each with its own quirks — hand you golden seeds and permanent buffs so you can start over, bigger.

Relax, at your own pace

No combat, no failure, no "log in or lose out." There are no offline rewards — instead, Toby is a real desktop companion who sticks around as long as you keep him running. Gentle sound effects, soft pixel art, and a light footprint make him easy to leave on all day.

Features

Transparent desktop overlay — just the character, right on top of your other apps (windowed mode too)

7 pickaxe tiers with enhancement, plus 7 upgradable stats

Deep progression through collecting, cataloguing, and crafting

Worker-rabbit fusion — 12 animals across grades

Endless prestige by moving to new fields

Dress Toby up with costumes · daily rewards · achievements

Korean & English · Steam Cloud · light on resources

store_data.about_the_game:
■ What is this game?

Pachinko machine + roguelike building.

Launch balls → hit the target score → power up at the shop → next round. The loop is simple. Every step is a trade-off.

Every ball you launch earns a ticket — the shop's only currency — while the balls themselves are your lifeline. Overflow the target by enough and you can skip an entire round for a massive ticket payout, at the cost of not launching a single ball. How you spend each round is the decision that shapes the whole run.

■ Building: Remake the Machine Your Way

  • Items: expand your resource caps and rewrite scoring rules.

  • Special balls: split, multiply — turn one ball into a storm.

  • Special pins: hammer them straight into the machine to change its physics and scoring logic.

Stack them with the combo system, and a single ball can set off an entire chain of payouts.

But the machine hides a catch: the more special pins you add, the lower your jackpot odds fall. Every upgrade is a trade. Finding the balance between raw scoring power and jackpot probability is the real puzzle of every run.

■ A Fully Realized Pachinko System

Kakuhen, Jitan, left/right shooting, the pity Ceiling — real pachinko's lottery mechanics run exactly as they should, with every rule open and calculable. Players who plan will always go further than players who pray.

■ Machines & Modes

  • Basic: learn launching, charging, and combos.

  • Advanced: every mechanic switched on. The main battleground.

  • The Swamp: a no-round-limit, high-stakes machine where your milestone points set your starting bankroll — and one obstacle is waiting for you to crack it.

  • ???: revealed at a certain milestone.

Plus Endless Mode for pushing your build to its limit, and Free Mode — no targets, no penalties, unlimited balls. When you just want to play pachinko in peace, it's here.

■ Progression & Collection

Every run's score becomes milestone points, permanently unlocking starting resources, item slots, machine skins, and hidden machines. The collection log records every item, every pin, every ball you've ever found.

Every run you lose is paving the way for the next one.

store_data.detailed_description:
■ What is this game?

Pachinko machine + roguelike building.

Launch balls → hit the target score → power up at the shop → next round. The loop is simple. Every step is a trade-off.

Every ball you launch earns a ticket — the shop's only currency — while the balls themselves are your lifeline. Overflow the target by enough and you can skip an entire round for a massive ticket payout, at the cost of not launching a single ball. How you spend each round is the decision that shapes the whole run.

■ Building: Remake the Machine Your Way

  • Items: expand your resource caps and rewrite scoring rules.

  • Special balls: split, multiply — turn one ball into a storm.

  • Special pins: hammer them straight into the machine to change its physics and scoring logic.

Stack them with the combo system, and a single ball can set off an entire chain of payouts.

But the machine hides a catch: the more special pins you add, the lower your jackpot odds fall. Every upgrade is a trade. Finding the balance between raw scoring power and jackpot probability is the real puzzle of every run.

■ A Fully Realized Pachinko System

Kakuhen, Jitan, left/right shooting, the pity Ceiling — real pachinko's lottery mechanics run exactly as they should, with every rule open and calculable. Players who plan will always go further than players who pray.

■ Machines & Modes

  • Basic: learn launching, charging, and combos.

  • Advanced: every mechanic switched on. The main battleground.

  • The Swamp: a no-round-limit, high-stakes machine where your milestone points set your starting bankroll — and one obstacle is waiting for you to crack it.

  • ???: revealed at a certain milestone.

Plus Endless Mode for pushing your build to its limit, and Free Mode — no targets, no penalties, unlimited balls. When you just want to play pachinko in peace, it's here.

■ Progression & Collection

Every run's score becomes milestone points, permanently unlocking starting resources, item slots, machine skins, and hidden machines. The collection log records every item, every pin, every ball you've ever found.

Every run you lose is paving the way for the next one.

One cat. One knife. Countless fish that don't know it yet.
Drawn in code. Incremental. Aqua Sushicat…

The Core Loop
Dive into the aquariums, hunt fish, and bring your catch home. Every dive makes you stronger, takes you deeper, and nets you more. An endless cycle — for as long as you can last.

The Skill Tree
Your arsenal decides how deep you go: a net that scoops up fish, water bombs that hit everything around you, little helpers that follow you into the depths, and much more. The tree grows with you. So do the possibilities.

The Bosses
At the bottom of every aquarium, something bigger than a fish is waiting. Something that isn't here by accident. Beat it — or find out what you really need that skill tree for.

Kitchen & Decor
Between dives, your kitchen awaits. Decorate it with bonsai, lanterns and wall art, exactly to your taste. And because the kitchen alone isn't enough, customize your character too — with different forms, colors and accessories. Set it all to your radio: play your own music or the iconic Aqua Sushicat tune. Every aquarium and every room has its own story. A world that grows with you.

The fish aren't getting any fewer. So what are you waiting for?

store_data.about_the_game:
Defend the flame. Hold the siege.

Ashfire Keep is an action defense roguelite where every run is a different siege: pick a class, defend the keep the game is named after, and decide, wave by wave, whether to charge the enemy or reinforce the walls.

The keep under siege

Generations ago, Ashfire Keep was built around a flame that never went out. That flame is now the seal you must protect: if the keep falls, the run ends. You're the one standing between the village and the wave that's coming.

Combat and survival

Combat is direct: swing an axe in melee, fire arrows at mid-range, or hurl arcane bolts from a distance, depending on the class you pick. Every wave adds more enemies and elite variants; some rounds bring bosses that test both your positioning and what you've built.

Building and defense

Between waves — and carefully, during them too — you can raise barricades, spike traps, and archer or arcane towers around the keep. Building costs Supplies, a resource you earn by clearing waves, killing elites, or defeating bosses: how much you build and where depends on managing that resource, not an unlimited menu.

Classes and playstyles

Three classes with their own identity: the Warrior holds ground and hits hard up close with an axe, the Mage punishes from range with arcane bolts despite being fragile, and the Ranger harasses and repositions with a bow, fast and lethal at mid-range. Each has an exclusive upgrade that changes how it plays.

Progression

During a run you level up and pick upgrades from a set of choices, with different rarities and some exclusive to your class. On top of that, every run — whether your keep stands or falls — earns Renown, permanent progression that carries over between runs and unlocks upgrades and options for the next one.

Maps and difficulties

Defend Ashfire Keep in Forest Village or Snowbound Outpost, two scenarios with their own visual identity, and choose between Normal, Hard, or Nightmare depending on how much punishment you're after. Each difficulty changes enemy health, damage, and speed, plus how much you repair between waves.

Compendium

A dedicated compendium collects every upgrade in the game, so you can check what exists, what you've unlocked, and what's left — even outside of a run.

Key Features

  • Defend a fortified keep against ever-growing waves of enemies.

  • Build barricades, traps, and towers to reinforce your defense.

  • Manage Supplies to decide what and when to build.

  • Choose between three classes with distinct playstyles.

  • Combine upgrades during each run, with rarities and class-exclusive picks.

  • Unlock permanent progression between runs through Renown.

  • Face bosses and elite variants.

  • Pick your difficulty: Normal, Hard, or Nightmare.

  • Play across two scenarios with distinct visual identities.

  • Browse a compendium containing every upgrade in the game.

  • Play in Spanish or English.

store_data.about_the_game:
Six seconds. One room. And a shadow that repeats your every move — one second behind you. Touch it and you die.

SIX SECOND SHADOW is a lightning-fast precision platformer set in a neon-soaked night city. Every room gives you just six seconds on the clock. Grab time crystals to stretch the timer, dodge saws, lasers and spikes, ride wind columns, bounce off springs — and never stop moving, because your own shadow is hunting you down.

FEATURES

  • 90 handcrafted rooms — every single one hand-checked end to end, so there are no impossible jumps. Ever.
  • The Shadow: a dark copy of yourself replaying your moves with a one-second delay. Standing still is death. Outrun yourself.
  • A six-second timer, stretched by time crystals scattered along the route.
  • Dash, springs, wind columns, moving platforms, crumbling blocks, teleporters, keys and locked doors, saws and timed lasers.
  • A difficulty curve tuned by data: rooms are ordered by measured completion times — from a gentle warm-up to finger-twisting finales.
  • Infinite lives. Death is instant, retry is even faster.
  • Arcade mode: endless procedurally generated rooms and a score chase.
  • 8 unlockable character skins.
  • Full localization: English, French, German, Spanish and Russian.

Every room is a door-to-door sprint: get in, grab what you can, get out — before the clock runs dry or your shadow catches up.

Choose from a roster of unique characters, each equipped with their own special abilities that can change the momentum of every rally. Receive powerful serves, make accurate sets, unleash devastating spikes, time your blocks, and outplay your opponents through skill, positioning, and teamwork.

Experience volleyball from an immersive third-person perspective that puts you directly on the court. Read the play, react to every touch, and execute clutch plays with precise player control.

Select Your Role

Play as a Left Hitter, Middle Hitter, Right Hitter, or Setter. Master each volleyball position, each with its own responsibilities and playstyle. Unleash powerful spikes, form solid blocks, deliver accurate sets, or keep rallies alive with perfectly timed receives.

Unique Characters with Special Abilities

Choose from a diverse roster of characters, each equipped with a signature ability that can turn the momentum of a match. Build team compositions and adapt your strategy around every character's strengths.

Mix up powerful spikes and roll shots, challenge blockers, defend against relentless attacks, and capitalize on your opponents' mistakes to win crucial points.

Multiplayer Volleyball

Work together with your teammates and execute coordinated combination plays to outplay the competition.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every hero needs a dealer.

In every fantasy tale, someone hands out the quests. That someone is you.

You've inherited a run-down adventurer's guild, granted by royal decree. Farmers, merchants, nobles and desperate widows walk through your door with problems they can't solve. Adventurers stumble in looking for work. You stand between them — matching the right hero to the right job, and taking your cut.

MATCH HEROES TO QUESTS

A goblin raid needs a fighter. A poisoned swamp needs someone who knows antidotes. Send the naive rookie and he's cheap — but he might not come home. Send the seasoned mercenary and your commission shrinks. Every assignment is a calculation.

GEAR THEM UP — OR DON'T

Potions, blades, torches, lucky charms. Equipment raises their odds of success, but it comes out of your pocket. Consumables are gone forever. That masterwork sword returns only if the hero does.

HEROES ARE PERMANENT

They grow. They gain experience, loyalty, and reputation. They remember how you treated them. And when one dies in a cave you sent them to, they're gone for good — along with everything you lent them.

THE CROWN IS WATCHING

Rent comes due. A royal inspector audits your record — too many failures and too many corpses earn you warnings. Three warnings and the guild is taken back. Keep the ledger clean, or lose everything.

BUILD YOUR LEGACY

Start in a crumbling shack with a cracked counter. Earn enough, and grow into a respected guild, then an elite institution, and finally a hall worthy of the crown itself. Better halls draw better heroes, and better heroes take on the quests that make legends.

Hear their problems. Seal the contract. Collect your fee.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tucked at the edge of a village, your alchemy shop is waking up. The cauldron's cold, the shelves are dusty, and the first customer is already wandering up the path. Time to light the fire.

Brew & Bottle is a cozy alchemy game about making potions with your own hands. Every potion is crafted by grinding, cutting and pressing ingredients. Then heat the cauldron, stir the potion and distil it in the bottle. Then sell it to the townsfolk who come knocking.

Read the recipe book

Lean over a book on the workbench and choose a recipe and decipher them carefully. Unlock new bases, study each recipe and work out what a customer is really asking for. Earn the town's trust one potion at a time.

Brew with your own hands

Every potion is made with your own hands.

Cut ingredients on the board.

Grind gems and dried herbs in the mortar.

Crank the press for the extract.

Stir the cauldron.

Follow the recipe perfectly to reach the highest potion quality.

Grow your ingredients

Plant, water and harvest your own garden. Watch crops rise over the days, then carry them straight to the pot.

Serve the village

A town full of characters comes to your counter, each with their own request. Listen to their needs and brew the potion right. The better you serve, the busier your shop becomes.

Discover recipes

Finish specific requests, send heroes on their adventures, find a recipe notes lying around in the village to unlock new potions.

Send heroes on adventures

Hire adventurers and send them out for ingredients you can't grow at home. They'll bring back new recipes, rare ingredients and gold. Just make sure they're prepared before they leave - they'll ask you for potions of their own.

Live a cozy life

Roam a warm village. Trade with vendors, take on errands, upgrade your workshop.

store_data.about_the_game:
Canyon Carnage

Canyon Carnage is a fast-paced FPS inspired by classic shooters, where movement, reflexes and mastery of your arsenal are essential to your survival.

Traverse hostile canyons overrun by hordes of monsters and face a wide variety of enemies, each with their own behaviours, strengths and weaknesses. Choosing the right weapon at the right time will often be the key to victory. Some excel against groups of enemies, whilst others are more effective against the most dangerous targets.

But survival isn’t enough. Canyon Carnage rewards players who strive to excel. Optimise your movement, discover shortcuts, find hidden secrets and refine your strategies to improve your performance and climb the global leaderboards.

Whether you’re looking for an explosive experience inspired by old-school FPS games or a new speedrun and score attack challenge, Canyon Carnage puts your skills to the test at every turn.

Features

  • Fast-paced, intense FPS action inspired by the classics of the genre

  • A wide variety of weapons suited to different combat situations

  • Numerous monsters with unique behaviours and weaknesses

  • Hordes of enemies to face in spectacular battles

  • Global leaderboards for scores and speedruns

  • Levels packed with secrets, shortcuts and hidden areas

  • Gameplay that rewards mastery, speed and optimisation

  • High replay value for record-chasers

Every second counts. Every shot counts. Every decision can mean the difference between mere survival and a place at the top of the leaderboard.

The vault is a mess. Banknotes and coins from eight different currencies are scattered everywhere, and each safe-deposit box has its own specific request. Pick up, count, sort, and place every piece of money into the correct box until all 42 are complete.

SORT 8 DIFFERENT CURRENCIES

Organize banknotes and coins from USD, EUR, TRY, GBP, JPY, KRW, CNY, and RUB.

ATTRACT COINS WITH THE MAGNET

Pull scattered coins toward you and quickly collect pieces spread across the vault.

MOVE CASH WITH THE BLOWER

Use the blower to push loose money across the floor and gather it into manageable piles.

COUNT EVERY STACK

Keep track of how much money you have collected and make sure each box receives exactly what it needs.

There is no timer and no furious bank manager breathing down your neck. Just you, a mountain of cash, and the oddly satisfying task of putting every last coin where it belongs. Grab your tools, take your time, and make the vault look like someone actually works here.

store_data.about_the_game:
[h2]Your forest. Your sawmill. Your hands.[/h2]

Kerf - Sawmill Tycoon is a first-person sawmill sim where nothing happens without you. Every tree is felled by your hand, every plank comes off a saw you operate, and every coin is earned at a counter you built up from nothing. Start with an axe and a quiet clearing at the foot of a waterfall, and grow it into a humming timber business.

[h2]Do the work yourself[/h2]

Fell trees and watch them crash down for real. Cut the trunks into logs, haul them to the yard and feed a growing chain of machines: the bandsaw, the chopping block, the chipper, the pelletizer and the furniture workshop. Machines are not menus here. Sawing planks, chopping firewood or lacquering a fresh tabletop is hands-on work where your precision decides the quality and the payout.

[h2]Master the wood[/h2]

Six wood species, from spruce and birch to oak and maple, each with its own look, its own price and its own best use. Turn logs into planks, firewood, wood chips, pellets, bark and made-to-order furniture. Logs are never sold raw: the profit is in the craft.

[h2]Sell it face to face[/h2]

Customers walk into your yard with real orders. Load a crate, carry it to the counter and close the deal. Build reputation to unlock pickier clients, better prices on a living market and furniture commissions: ten pieces, from small stools to full wardrobes, built in your own workshop.

[h2]Grow beyond your own two hands[/h2]

When the orders pile up, hire a crew: sellers for your counters and workers for your machines. Upgrade the sawmill level by level, buy bigger trucks for deliveries and drive your own pickup across a handcrafted valley with a town, a river and a mountain road.

[h2]Keep the forest alive[/h2]

Trees do not grow back on their own. Dig out stumps, plant saplings, fertilize them and watch new trees rise through four growth stages. A well-run sawmill never runs out of forest.

[h2]Your Twitch chat lives here[/h2]

Connect your Twitch channel and your viewers walk into the game as customers, with their nicknames over their heads and their chat messages in speech bubbles. Your community literally keeps your sawmill busy.

[h2]Key features[/h2]

[list]

[] Full production chain: logs into planks, firewood, wood chips, pellets, bark and furniture

[] Hands-on minigames for felling, sawing, chopping, lacquering and more

[] Six wood species with distinct products and prices

[] Orders, commissions and a living market instead of passive selling

[] A crew of hireable NPC workers and sellers

[] A drivable pickup and trucks on a handcrafted map with a town, river and waterfall

[] Day and night cycle

[] Twitch integration: your viewers visit the sawmill as NPCs

[] Relaxing pace: no combat, no pressure, just honest work

[] Interface in 15 languages

[/list]

store_data.about_the_game:
Trash Raccoon is a fast, juicy and chaotic rogue-lite arcade game about grabbing fruit before they turn into explosive bombs!

Collecting fruits charges your powerful Fruit Dash which can break anything!

Survive as long as you can, earn Can Lids and buy upgrades with them. Try multiple times until you unlock the next stage!

Charge The Fruit Dash

Fruit Dash is the key mechanic of the game. Use it to pop trash bins open, collect more bananas from the palm trees or do naughty tricks.

3 Zones, 9 Vibrant Stages

Backyard — you know it, you've been there. It's the neighborhood! Classic spawn location for any raccoon — but beware of rivalry around the trash bins!

Beach — it's the mandatory vacation episode, bring your rubber ring! Watch out for greedy seagulls, they WILL steal your fruit! For fruit lovers — there's always the banana palm trees.

Parking Lot — it's the bustling city zone. Full of danger for a raccoon, but also full of treasure (aka trash). Beware of cars, reckless drivers are throwing weird stuff out of their windows!

Amazing Events

Once in a while, bizarre things can start happening! Some might benefit you, while some might hurt you. Regardless, they make each run unique and full of fun.

Power-Up Upgrades

The score you get while playing will be converted into Can Lids. This is the hot new currency for raccoons who want to get stronger! Purchase stat perks or game-changing effects to earn even more score!

Vanity Collection

The holy grail of every raccoon — their favorite trash stash. Many unique items are hidden among the stages or locked behind various actions! Equip multiple items to show your crazy fashion sense!

What to expect:

  • A small and fun adventure for a couple of hours with amazing art style and animations

  • Cool soundtrack for maximum vibes!

  • A rogue-lite progression system

  • A game with universal appeal and depth

What not to expect:

  • A multi-hour campaign full of unique content

  • An enormous leveling system with full rogue-like experience

  • Deep lore

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Mars Station C7, an extraordinary home for the first colonists of the Red Planet!

You are a young and promising engineer who, thanks to your connections, has been assigned to oversee Station C7, where your sister currently lives. It is comforting to see other people in such a lonely place, but having someone close to you nearby makes it feel almost like home.

Everything could have been fine - if not for the VHR catastrophe on Earth.

No one knows exactly what happened. Communication with Earth is rapidly breaking down, and the final message received from our home planet reports that thousands of colonists are heading toward Mars in a desperate search for safety.

Can the situation really be that bad? What is VHR, and why were people willing to kill one another for a chance to escape Earth?

That is what you will have to uncover.

Gameplay:

This is a first-person horror game focused on exploration, stealth, and chase sequences.

Key Features:

  • An atmospheric and immersive environment.

  • A visual style inspired by science fiction and VHS-era films.

  • Messages and communications from NPCs.

store_data.about_the_game:
Enter the Spring Night: Forty-Five Days to Claim a Heart

Spring Nights: 45 Days in Zhaoque is a historical-fantasy romance raising visual novel. As a young woman entering Zhaoque, you have only forty-five days to navigate spring nights, wine-scented chambers, courtly schemes, and glances that linger a little too long. By day, build your reputation and gather leverage. By night, accept invitations, uncover secrets, and test the desires hiding behind polite smiles. Every whisper, approach, and refusal can push a relationship somewhere more dangerous and more intoxicating.

These are not innocent encounters. Some characters bury hunger beneath impeccable manners. Some wait for you to reveal your weakness with your own hands. Some would lose control, break their rules, and sink into Zhaoque's long night for you. Will you seek a safe place to return to, a possessive devotion that burns too hot, or a spring-night rendezvous you know may leave your heart in someone else's hands?

Key Features

  • Forty-five days of character raising: Plan actions across morning, night, and late-night phases while improving knowledge, grace, courage, restraint, sensuality, and mood.

  • Romantic tension and multiple relationship routes: Attend banquets, meet in private, tease, reject, indulge, and watch attitudes, intimacy, and later events change.

  • Intrigue entwined with desire: Collect clues, complete tasks, read between the lines, and search for the truth beneath tender words and dangerous bargains.

  • Limited resources, meaningful choices: Stamina, money, and actions are limited. Who you meet, trust, and move closer to always comes with a cost.

  • Branching endings and save support: Auto saves and manual saves make it easy to revisit how different choices reshape affection and fate.

store_data.about_the_game:
10k Generators: The Ultimate Idle Game

Welcome to the deepest idle game you'll ever play. Not just numbers going up—a sprawling economy where 10 unique currencies, 10,000 generators, and 10 prestige currencies intertwine. Prestige isn't a single button. It's a web of systems that let you reshape your entire progression.

Key Features

  • 10 Currencies, 10,000 Generators – Each of the 10 base currencies has its own 1,000‑generator tree, split into 10 tiers of 100. Master each tier to unlock new heights.

  • Deep Prestige System – 5 Upgrade Categories
    Permanently enhance your generators across five distinct prestige trees:

    • Generator Income – Earn more from every generator.

    • Generator Speed – Produce currency faster.

    • Max Generator Level – Push each generator beyond its normal cap.

    • Upgrade Costs – Make every improvement cheaper.

    • Base Generator Value – Increase the foundation of all generator output.

  • 10 Prestige Currencies & Converters – Each base currency has its own dedicated prestige currency. Use converters to turn your hard‑earned base income into these powerful prestige points. Every point matters.

  • Prestige Interest System – Your prestige points don't just sit idle. They accumulate interest over time, rewarding you for patience and long‑term planning.

  • Perk System – Unlock and equip perks that increase the amount of prestige points you earn from every conversion. Stack them for massive multipliers.

  • Evolution System – Evolve your prestige upgrades to amplify their power across the board. Each evolution makes every category stronger, creating a snowball effect.

  • Research System – Dive into a branching tech tree. Unlock new buffs and bonuses that enhance every aspect of the game—generators, prestige, converters, interest, and more.

  • Auto‑Purchase – Since prestige resets generator levels, the auto‑buy feature automatically repurchases upgrades after every reset. Set it and forget it—focus on strategy, not clicking.

  • Tier System – Increase overall difficulty to earn greater rewards. Higher tiers bring tougher challenges and bigger payoffs, keeping the game fresh long after you've mastered the basics.

  • Rebirth System – When you've pushed as far as you can, trigger a full reset for massive permanent bonuses. Start over, but stronger than ever.

store_data.about_the_game:
Two Legendary Genres. One Game. One High Score to Beat

Discover a unique fusion of Pinball and Pachinko! Master a three-tier Pinball playfield with realistic physics, precise ball rebounds, and a wide variety of gameplay mechanics. Score points, unlock bonuses, collect Pachinko balls, and climb to the top to access the Pachinko field, where the biggest rewards, powerful score multipliers, and the chance to set a new high score await. Every playthrough is a thrilling mix of skill, strategy, and just the right amount of luck as you chase the ultimate score.

Play Pinball

Master the three-tier Pinball playfield, hit a variety of targets, and unlock new ways to score. Trigger exciting mini-games, test your luck with the Slot Machine and Spin Machine, and activate bonuses and score multipliers. Collect special Pachinko balls—the key to unlocking the next stage and gaining access to the Pachinko field.

Climb Higher

Reach the top of the Pinball playfield to unlock the Pachinko field and turn a great run into a shower of points.

Play Pachinko

Use the Pachinko balls you've collected to fill the playfield and score as many points as possible. Hit Tokens, Tulips, and the Win Pocket, activate bonuses, collect multipliers, and trigger rewarding combo chains. The more efficiently you use your Pachinko balls, the higher your final score will be.

Score Thousands of Points. Beat the High Score. Do It Again.

Every new run opens the door to bigger combos, new bonuses, and even more points. Refine your strategy, improve your performance, and come back for another run to beat your own high score.

Unlock Pachinko.

Set a New High Score.

  • Bonuses, multipliers, and a variety of gameplay mechanics.

  • High replayability and an endless pursuit of a new high score.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE NIGHT SHIFT

It's just another slow night at the pizza shop. Strange customers, stranger conversations, and one old rule everyone seems to know but nobody explains: never put pineapple on the pizza.

You've heard the warning. You don't believe it.

Then someone offers you a lot of money to break it.

WHAT STARTS AS ORDINARY...

Bloody Pineapple begins as an ordinary night — sharp dialogue, oddball customers, and the kind of late-night humor only a graveyard shift can produce.

...DOESN'T STAY THAT WAY

Once the rule is broken, the shop stops making sense. Reality bends. What follows is a descent into something the game never quite explains — and something you'll have to survive to understand.

FEATURES

- A story that unfolds one night at a time

- Atmospheric environments that shift as the night goes on

- Puzzle-solving — some doors don't open for everyone

- A short, focused experience built around one unforgettable shift

- An ending you won't see coming

Some rules exist for a reason. You're about to find out why.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE GRAVE PROVIDES

You are Les Bones — a necromancer with a grudge and an army of one. Twenty stages stand between you and the throne of Ossuar, the Bone King. Your spells fire themselves; your only job is to move, position, and live. Everything you kill makes the next thing easier to kill... until it doesn't.

Les Bones is a fast, gothic bullet-heaven roguelite: one snowballing build, ten hand-authored bosses, and a horde that never stops pouring out of the dark.

ONE RUN. ONE BUILD. EVERYTHING ON THE LINE.

- A 20-stage descent — ten short survival stages, each capped by a boss. No stage resets. Your build carries the whole way down.

- Snowball or die — level up, draft 1 of 3 weapons, evolutions, or passives, and watch a trickle of bolts become a screen-clearing storm.

- Death ends the run — but your Bone Shards don't. Bank them, buy permanent upgrades at the Bone Shop, and come back meaner.

AN ARSENAL WORTH DYING FOR

- 10 weapons — Bone Bolt, Bone Spray, Orbiting Skulls, Grave Nova, Bone Whip, Bone Chain, Bone Traps, Bone Boomerang, the Grave Chill aura, and homing Wraith Skulls.

- Every weapon evolves — six levels and a signature evolution each. Hold up to six at once and stack them into overkill.

- 10 passives — lifesteal, projectile speed, faster ultimate charge, and more, to bend your build in a direction.

- The Bone Nova ultimate — charge it, then detonate a shockwave that flings the horde off you.

TEN BOSSES THAT HIT BACK

- Hand-authored, not recycled — Rattlejaw, Cinderlich, The Hollow Choir, The Pale Shepherd, and Ossuar the Bone King, each with its own name, look, signature attack, and last words for you.

- Readable, dodgeable danger — bosses fight in a rhythm of telegraphed windups and openings. Learn the tell, punish the lull.

- No camping — they smash through walls, and below 40% HP they enrage: faster, meaner, out of patience.

NORMAL OR HARD — YOUR CALL

- Two difficulty modes — cut your teeth on Normal, or take Hard for denser hordes and tougher, tankier bosses.

- Separate progression per mode — Normal and Hard each keep their own Bone Shards, upgrades, and records. Hard is a fresh mountain to climb, not a victory lap with a maxed build.

FIVE REALMS OF THE DEAD

From the Greenwood through a ruined Village, a bleached Desert, the Frostgrave, and down into the Crypt itself — every realm brings its own hordes, hazards, music, and mood.

FEATURES

- Fast, tactile bullet-heaven combat — auto-fire weapons, you own the movement.

- Deep build variety — 10 weapons × evolutions × 10 passives, no two runs alike.

- Two difficulty modes — Normal and Hard, each with its own separate meta progression.

- Persistent meta progression — Bone Shards, the Bone Shop, and lifetime records that survive death.

- Full controller support — play with a gamepad or keyboard; menus are controller-navigable.

- Accessibility options — adjustable difficulty, reduce screen shake, and reduce flashing.

- Steam Cloud — your progress follows you from one machine to the next.

- Pick-up-and-play, hard-to-put-down — short stages, long sessions.

The horde is patient. You don't have to be.

store_data.about_the_game:
One life. One d20. One very bad city.

Cyber Citizen is an idle life-sim RPG set in a neon sprawl that does not care whether you make it. You don't control every step — you set the direction, pick your angle when the moment comes, and watch the dice decide the rest. Jobs run whether you're watching or not.

Think Progress Quest's hands-off grind crossed with BitLife's cradle-to-grave decision-making, dressed in chrome and cheap neon.

Set your focus, live with it

Your character runs on three slots: a Primary and Secondary focus, plus a Support. Chase honest Work, grind down your Debt, build a Network — or run Theft, Burglary, Black Market and Chaos and see how long you last. Focus combinations unlock things a single path never will.

Ten classes and five types, from Hacker and Infiltrator to Droid Builder and Geneticist, each bending how the world treats you.

Crime is a career path

Steal it, fence it, and hope the mask held. Every illegal job you pull marks you CRIMINAL — and the law hunts a marked name harder. Get spotted and you're in pursuit: shake the tail, or take the cell.

Pay your bail, serve your sentence, or make a break for it and add five years to the tab. Kill someone and you're a MURDERER for life, with a twenty-five year sentence waiting the day they catch you.

Build a crew (and lose them) 

Friends lend you their profession's edge in the Support slot — a Medic halves the damage you take, an Infiltrator halves your odds of getting caught, an Agent slips the law entirely. Some of them have records of their own. Bring a known criminal along on the night you're arrested and the court adds it to your sentence.

Chase the impossible

Hidden stories wait behind the right focus pairings. Rob the Central Credit Vault. Break into a warlord's private hangar and leave with his spaceship. Find the crazy scientist in the basement and steal a magazine from a future that hasn't happened yet.

Die. Try again. Do better.

You age with every job. Gear wears out, luck runs thin, and one natural 1 in the wrong alley ends it. If you left an heir, your credits and your name carry to the next generation. If you didn't, the bloodline ends there — and the city doesn't notice.

Make it yours

A full in-game content editor lets you write your own activities, items and characters into the world. Drop-in music support and a mods folder mean the sprawl can look and sound however you want it to.

Features

  • Idle progression — activities resolve on their own, or push them along

  • d20 rolls with real criticals and real consequences

  • Ten classes, five types, and dozens of focus combinations

  • Five gear tiers from Consumer junk to one-of-a-kind Prototypes

  • Droid companions you can buy, steal, or hack off the street

  • Reputation, friendships, romance and generational legacy

  • A jail system with bail, sentences, escapes and pursuits

  • Built-in content editor and mod support

  • Day/night cycle with unlockable themes and soundtracks

store_data.about_the_game:
Sunlit Kingdom is a 3D tower defense set in a bright fantasy realm under siege. Goblins, orc warbands, and more are marching on the Sunlit Kingdom, and three legendary heroes stand in their way. Place them, upgrade them, and choose how they fight.

Three Unique Heroes

Command the Archer, the Mage, and the Holy Knight: a deadly marksman, a master of crowd control, and a stalwart healer-protector. Each hero has four unique abilities, but you can only choose one per hero. Multishot volleys or single-target executions? Freezing enemies solid or raining meteors? Every run, you decide what your defense becomes.

Every Ability, Three Ways

Each ability has three upgrade tiers that transform how it works. Combined with the one-ability choice, no two defenses play the same. Experiment, respec your strategy, and find the build that holds the line.

Know Your Enemy

No filler mobs. Every enemy type is unique, with its own abilities, resistances, and tricks: shield-bearers that block your arrows, warlocks that curse your heroes from afar, boars that charge when wounded, and bosses with their own agendas. Read their resistances, counter their abilities, or be overrun.

A Story-Driven Campaign

Fight through three distinct maps, from the flowered roads of Forest Pass to the gates of the castle itself. Each map features entirely different enemy factions. Uncover why the greenskins are truly invading, and the name they dare not speak.

Endless Adventures

South of the kingdom lie the desert ruins and the Curse of Anubis: an infinite-wave gauntlet with its own unique enemies. Survive as long as you can and carve your name into the global leaderboard, or play offline. New Adventures maps rotate in seasonally.

store_data.about_the_game:
Arrow Card Arena is a single-player, turn-based card strategy game. Choose your cards, read their arrow directions, and master elemental advantages and counterattacks to defeat your opponents on the board.

【ARROWS DETERMINE ATTACK AND DEFENSE】

Every card has arrows pointing in fixed directions. When a card is placed on the board, its arrows determine which adjacent positions it can attack. If an enemy card survives with energy remaining, it may immediately counterattack, so every move requires careful planning.

【ELEMENTAL ADVANTAGES】

Fire, Water, and Wood form a three-way elemental system:

・Fire defeats Wood

・Wood defeats Water

・Water defeats Fire

Using the right elemental advantage can make your attacks more effective, while a poorly planned move can quickly reverse the course of battle.

【A FIFTEEN-STAGE CAMPAIGN】

Fight through fifteen increasingly challenging stages featuring different opponents, guardian bosses, and a final boss. Each stage is played as a best-of-three match, and the first side to win two rounds claims victory.

【BUILD YOUR DECK】

Create an six-card deck and choose cards with different arrow patterns, elements, and energy values to suit your strategy. Defeat bosses to unlock special cards and discover new tactical possibilities.

【FEATURES】

・Single-player turn-based card battles

・Fixed-direction arrow attacks and counterattacks

・Fire, Water, and Wood elemental advantages

・A fifteen-stage campaign with boss battles

・Six-card deck building

・Best-of-three stage matches

・Interactive tutorial

・Auto-save and three manual save slots

・Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and English support

・A challenging timed New Game Plus mode after completing the campaign
store_data.detailed_description:
Arrow Card Arena is a single-player, turn-based card strategy game. Choose your cards, read their arrow directions, and master elemental advantages and counterattacks to defeat your opponents on the board.

【ARROWS DETERMINE ATTACK AND DEFENSE】

Every card has arrows pointing in fixed directions. When a card is placed on the board, its arrows determine which adjacent positions it can attack. If an enemy card survives with energy remaining, it may immediately counterattack, so every move requires careful planning.

【ELEMENTAL ADVANTAGES】

Fire, Water, and Wood form a three-way elemental system:

・Fire defeats Wood

・Wood defeats Water

・Water defeats Fire

Using the right elemental advantage can make your attacks more effective, while a poorly planned move can quickly reverse the course of battle.

【A FIFTEEN-STAGE CAMPAIGN】

Fight through fifteen increasingly challenging stages featuring different opponents, guardian bosses, and a final boss. Each stage is played as a best-of-three match, and the first side to win two rounds claims victory.

【BUILD YOUR DECK】

Create an six-card deck and choose cards with different arrow patterns, elements, and energy values to suit your strategy. Defeat bosses to unlock special cards and discover new tactical possibilities.

【FEATURES】

・Single-player turn-based card battles

・Fixed-direction arrow attacks and counterattacks

・Fire, Water, and Wood elemental advantages

・A fifteen-stage campaign with boss battles

・Six-card deck building

・Best-of-three stage matches

・Interactive tutorial

・Auto-save and three manual save slots

・Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and English support

・A challenging timed New Game Plus mode after completing the campaign

store_data.about_the_game:
Head office only sends the target number. How you hit it is your problem.

Sixteen tiles of land on an unfamiliar planet have just been assigned to you. The deadline

is fixed, and how this world actually operates is something you'll have to find out the

hard way. Push corporate value to the target and you move on to the next planet.

Fall short, and that's where it ends.


🗺️ Sixteen Tiles Is All You Get

Place buildings of the same theme side by side and adjacency bonuses kick in. Lining up

two tiles is something anyone can do. The real problem comes after. A building that only

performs at full capacity on volcanic terrain might reach your hand at any moment — or

never. Do you hold those two tiles empty and wait for it, or fill them now and lock in a

bonus you can count on? Sixteen tiles is far tighter than it sounds.

🔥 Burn It or Build It — The Incineration System

Every card carries two values: what it's worth placed, and what it's worth burned.

Incinerate a card from your hand and it converts straight into action resources. The card

you torched just to fill one more tile this turn may well be the final piece of the combo

you were three turns from completing. The harder a card is to burn, the more certain it is

that the moment will come when you have to.

🪐 Change the Planet, Change the Answer

Terrain layouts differ from planet to planet, and so does the way you score. The first thing

to read is what actually pays here.

And planets don't sit still. Output on a certain resource can spike and carry you toward the

target ahead of schedule — or a flood can roll in and shut your buildings down, or a volcano

can erupt and wipe out what you spent the whole run building. The strategy that solved the

last planet flawlessly will be the worst possible move on the next one.

⚙️ Production Lines and Corporate Assets

A building doesn't become value the moment it goes up. You produce resources, use those

resources to complete the building, and only then does it post to the books. Which line to

run first and which to push back — that decision is in a constant fight with the turns you

have left.

Then corporate assets bend the whole flow out of shape. Some raise output. Others tear up

how scoring works entirely. Once cards, assets, and placement start meshing like gears, a

target that looked out of reach suddenly starts looking trivial.

📋 Key Features

Placement puzzles on a 4x4, sixteen-tile grid

A deck and asset combination rebuilt from scratch every run

Terrain and rules that change completely from planet to planet

Place it or burn it — every card offers two options

Fail and you start over. The next run is a completely different planet

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a stained-glass war-flower. Break its rules. See how far it grows.

PRISMBLOOM is an automatic-combat roguelite engine-builder about assembling a six-weapon crystalline Crown in the middle of a hostile garden.

Enemies advance along six curling paths. Your Crown chooses its targets and fires automatically. You decide what weapons it grows, which colors they carry, how their effects connect, and whether the resulting machine becomes elegant, efficient, or completely unreasonable.

Every defeated enemy creates Threat. Earn enough and you bank a Bloom—a free card choice that waits until you decide to open it.

Add another weapon. Rank up one you already have. Make one color trigger another. Rewrite a global rule. Mutate a weapon into a new behavior. Accept a dangerous bargain. Then return to the battle and watch the consequences spread across the entire garden.

Every Crown starts small.

The best ones become difficult to explain.

BUILD AN ENGINE, NOT JUST A STAT SHEET

PRISMBLOOM’s upgrades are designed to trigger, repeat, convert, and compound.

A Blue effect can trigger Green poison and roots. Every root can release Purple chain lightning. Critical hits can start their own electrical storms. Poison kills can feed your Dew economy. Marks can absorb burning damage before they burst. One color can activate the next until the entire Crown becomes a self-sustaining loop.

Build with:

  • 12 distinct weapon forms

  • Seven mechanical color identities

  • 84 weapon-and-color combinations

  • 115 curated engine cards

  • Cross-color Laws

  • Global Perks

  • Weapon-specific Mutations

  • High-risk Omens

  • Branching weapon upgrades and final forms

  • Grafts that join neighboring weapons

  • Boss Relics that continue evolving across victories

The strongest builds do more than increase damage. They create systems that generate attacks, statuses, currency, shields, critical hits, and additional triggers faster than the enemy can contain them.

BUILD A SIX-WEAPON CROWN

Every weapon occupies one of six sockets around the Heart.

Fire precise needles, launch delayed seed pods, grow orbiting familiars, hold beams on priority targets, strike entire lanes with rings and fans, spread clouds of poison, throw returning Prismarangs, stitch enemies together, or drill into a boss until the whole engine overheats.

Weapon placement matters. Neighboring colors create seams with additional effects, while grafts combine two weapons into a driver-and-payload pair.

Specialize in one reliable tool or fill every socket with a different piece of machinery.

MAKE EVERY COLOR MATTER

Each pigment has its own combat identity:

  • Yellow creates Dew and rewards a thriving economy

  • Pink stores damage in marks before releasing it in delayed bursts

  • Blue slows advancing enemies

  • Red burns targets and spreads fire when they fall

  • Green poisons enemies and periodically roots them in place

  • Purple chains damage through nearby targets

  • White releases volleys carrying multiple colors

Build a monochrome Crown around one dominant behavior, connect complementary colors, or assemble a full spectrum where every effect starts another.

Your garden might become:

  • A poison engine that feeds on rooted enemies

  • A recursive storm of marks and lightning

  • A fortress of shields, control, and knockback

  • A rapid-fire factory powered by kills

  • A held-Dew economy that grows stronger the longer you resist spending

  • A six-color reaction that never seems to finish

GROW AT YOUR OWN PACE

Each run begins with one Opening Bloom before entering the Continuous Garden.

Survive five finite waves and a multi-phase boss. Auto Next keeps the garden moving after each visible transition, or you can turn it off and start the next wave when you are ready.

Ordinary wave clears never force another card or shop visit. Banked Blooms wait for you. Run upgrades, services, and risks remain optional.

During the run, temporary Dew can be spent on:

  • Six uncapped Run Upgrade lanes

  • Card rerolls

  • Heart repairs and shields

  • Individual weapon damage, speed, and critical improvements

  • New weapons and recoloring

  • Socket swaps and weapon grafts

  • Reward forecasting

  • Other deterministic Dewworks services

Open the live build drawer while the battle continues, reinforce a weak Crown, or save your Dew for effects that scale with how much you hold.

When you want more pressure, Rush the current wave to pull additional enemies into the garden immediately and earn bonus Dew if you survive.

TAKE RISKS WITHOUT STOPPING THE RUN

Optional one-wave risk offers appear during the Garden Cycle.

Accept a dangerous modifier for an additional reward or dismiss it and keep moving. Empower elites, accelerate the assault, compromise your defenses, or bet that your engine can handle a sudden change in the rules.

These decisions never block the garden. The run continues because you chose to push it—not because an intermission demanded an answer.

DEFEAT THE BOSS. THEN DECIDE.

Clear the five Garden Cycle waves and face your selected boss.

Bosses introduce phases, reinforcements, telegraphed attacks, and mechanics designed to expose weaknesses that ordinary enemies could not. Defeating one secures the victory and grants a Boss Relic.

Then choose:

End the run, bank your permanent Gold, and visit the Workshop.

Or continue with the same build into Overgrow.

Overgrow is an endless post-victory challenge built from four escalating ordinary tiers followed by a recurring boss on every fifth tier. Each defeated boss offers another Relic and another chance to continue.

The original victory remains secured.

Everything after that is about discovering when the machine finally breaks.

GROW BETWEEN RUNS

Dew belongs to the current run. Gold survives.

Invest permanent Gold across six uncapped Workshop lanes covering weapon power, attack speed, Heart, critical chance, Dew production, and defense. Every five ranks reaches a new milestone that strengthens the lane and unlocks additional possibilities.

Account progression also expands:

  • Starting weapons and colors

  • Guided build packages

  • Advanced run configuration

  • Boss and Boss Relic choices

  • A persistent Skill Tree

  • Ten disclosed Challenge Levels

  • New cards and services

  • Bloomarium discoveries

  • Build-defining permanent rules

The Bloomarium records every weapon-and-color combination you successfully bring to life, along with discovered cards, defeated bosses, and Boss Relics.

Permanent progression provides both new possibilities and lasting power. Later runs begin with more options—but still demand a coherent engine.

LEARN FROM EVERY CROWN

Detailed results explain what happened.

Review average and peak DPS, largest chain, waves cleared, Overgrow tier, Dew earned and spent, rerolls, services, permanent Gold, top damage sources, progression gains, records, and the event that finally broke the Heart.

Then decide what comes next:

  • Retry the same build with a new deterministic seed

  • Replay the exact same setup and seed

  • Return to setup and grow something completely different

Death is not the end of a build.

It is the moment you understand what it was missing.

DESIGNED FOR “ONE MORE RUN”

PRISMBLOOM combines the readability of automatic combat with the decision-making of a roguelite and the compounding growth of an incremental engine-builder.

Features include:

  • Automatic six-lane combat

  • A six-weapon customizable Crown

  • 12 weapon forms and seven pigments

  • 84 weapon-and-color discoveries

  • 115 synergistic engine cards

  • Laws, Perks, Mutations, and Omens

  • Voluntary banked Blooms earned through Threat

  • Temporary Dew and permanent Gold economies

  • Live Run Upgrades and Dewworks services

  • Optional risks and wave rushing

  • Multi-phase bosses and evolving Boss Relics

  • Endless Overgrow with recurring bosses

  • Permanent Workshop and Skill Tree progression

  • Ten escalating Challenge Levels

  • Detailed build and post-run statistics

  • Deterministic seeds and exact-seed replays

  • 1×, 2×, 3×, and 4× game speeds

  • Mouse, keyboard, and controller support

  • Accessibility and presentation controls

  • Reactive visuals and music that intensify with the engine

Build something elegant.

Build something excessive.

Then take it into Overgrow and find out where it ends.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE VEGETABLES HAVE HAD ENOUGH...

For generations, vegetables have been harvested... without mercy.

Now... It's time to revenge!

Revenggie is a fast-paced Bullet Heaven Roguelite where surviving the horde is only the beginning.

EVERY DECISION MATTERS

Craft your build.

Master your abilities.

React under pressure.

Surviving the horde requires more than powerful upgrades; it requires skill.

Victory isn't achieved by simply building an overpowered character and watching the chaos unfold.

Master intense Quick Time Events, react under pressure, make split-second decisions and prove that your reflexes are just as important as your build.

THIS ISN'T AN IDLE BULLET HEAVEN

Every mechanic was designed to keep you actively engaged.

Fast-paced combat.

Skill-based Quick Time Events.

Challenging boss encounters.

Multiple playable vegetable characters. 

Highly replayable progression.

YOUR BUILD ISN'T EVERYTHING

A perfect build can take you far...

But when a boss appears, only your concentration, timing and precision will decide whether you survive.

Every major encounter becomes a true skill challenge synchronized with the action and the music time.

No distractions.

No autopilot.

Just you against overwhelming odds.

EVERY RUN IS A NEW OPPORTUNITY TO BECOME STRONGER 

Death is never the end.

Every defeat makes you stronger.

Unlock permanent upgrades.

Plant permanent Seeds in your Farm and become stronger.

Unlock new Mutations and Fertilizers.

And push your abilities further every single run!

BUILD! FIGHT! EVOLVE!

And prove that vegetables aren't just part of the menu anymore.

Demo Features

Experience the beginning of Revenggie's journey through an early playable Demo featuring:

-Playable characters

-Progression systems

-The Farm Hub

-Mutations

-Quick Time Events

-Boss encounter

-Multiple enemy types

More content, characters, maps, systems and features are currently in development for the full release.

store_data.about_the_game:
A WORLD WITHOUT KINGS

Crownless: Reignfall is an open-world fantasy survival RPG set in a shattered world where kingdoms have fallen, old alliances have collapsed, and every race is fighting to shape what remains.

Explore dangerous procedurally generated lands, survive unpredictable encounters, discover ruined civilizations, and decide what kind of person you will become in a world with no ruler, no chosen hero, and no guaranteed future.

You are not a king.

You are not a legendary savior.

You are simply one of the few who survived.

EXPLORE A LIVING, UNPREDICTABLE WORLD

Travel through large wilderness regions filled with forests, meadows, mountains, rivers, ruins, settlements, caves, and forgotten battlefields.

Each land is shaped by its own terrain, wildlife, resources, factions, dangers, and events. Traders may cross your path. Rival groups may fight over territory. Animals hunt, migrate, flee, and react to the world around them.

Your journey will not always follow a scripted road.

EVERY JOURNEY CREATES A DIFFERENT STORY

The world is built around seeded procedural generation and dynamic encounters.

New regions can contain different terrain formations, points of interest, resources, enemies, travelers, camps, ruins, and environmental events. The systems of the world are designed to interact naturally, creating unexpected situations and personal stories.

A peaceful journey can become an ambush.

A forgotten ruin can become a temporary shelter.

A stranger can become an ally, an enemy, or something in between.

FOUR RACES. ONE BROKEN WORLD.

Humans, Orcs, Elves, and Dwarves once fought for power, land, and control.

Their hatred helped destroy the world they wanted to rule.

Now their surviving factions struggle over ruined kingdoms, scarce resources, ancient grudges, and the possibility of rebuilding something new.

You may trade with them, fight them, help them, betray them, or become trapped inside conflicts that began long before you arrived.

SURVIVE BY YOUR OWN RULES

Gather resources, build a house, craft equipment, hunt for food, explore hostile territory, and prepare for the dangers beyond the next hill.

Combat is dangerous, and every journey requires planning. Your equipment, supplies, injuries, surroundings, and decisions can determine whether you return safely or become another forgotten body in the wilderness.

BUILD YOUR CHARACTER THROUGH ACTION

Your character develops through the way you play.

Travel, survival, combat, crafting, exploration, and interaction with the world shape your progression. You are not forced into the role of a traditional hero.

Become a wanderer, hunter, warrior, scavenger, trader, explorer, or something created entirely through your own choices.

A WORLD THAT REMEMBERS

Your actions influence how the world responds to you.

Helping one group may anger another. Violence may create fear. Mercy may create loyalty—or weakness that others attempt to exploit.

The world does not divide every choice into simple good and evil. Survival, power, loyalty, fear, and ambition often exist together.

PHILOSOPHY WITHIN THE JOURNEY

Crownless: Reignfall tells its story through exploration, environmental details, encounters, and reflective moments inspired by political and philosophical themes.

As you complete meaningful actions and experience the world, you may be confronted with questions about power, leadership, destruction, loyalty, and the cost of rebuilding civilization.

In a world destroyed by those who wanted to rule it, what will you choose to become?

KEY FEATURES

  • Large open-world fantasy environments

  • Seeded procedural terrain and region generation

  • Dynamic encounters and unscripted world events

  • Humans, Orcs, Elves, and Dwarves with competing factions

  • Exploration, survival, crafting, progression, and combat

  • Wildlife that interacts with the environment and nearby threats

  • Ruins, settlements, camps, caves, roads, and hidden locations

  • Character development shaped by your actions

  • A dark fantasy world presented in a stylized low-poly visual style

  • Solo play with cooperative gameplay planned as development continues

NO CROWN REMAINS. YOUR STORY BEGINS AFTER THE FALL.

store_data.about_the_game:
Everyone had the same dream.

Everyone but you.

When Milo sleeps, something wakes up in another place.

Walk through a place that shouldn’t exist. The inhabitants who lived here disappeared a long time ago, but their machines are still running and something else was waiting ages to emerge from the depths.

Change the channel, change the dream.

Toggle between four channels to modify the world around you. Explore a colossal space station lost in time, use antique mechanisms, find secret paths and reconstruct a shattered tale through the traces of a civilization that tried to escape an unavoidable fate. Where every corner could hide a new character, a shortcut, a puzzle or an answer…

Puzzles blended into the world

The station was designed to keep functioning for eternity. Comprehend how their machines work is key to open new routes and discover what remains hidden.

A Combat where knowledge is survival

Each enemy perceives reality in a different way. During the fights you could change between the four channels in order to disrupt the combat features: invert attacks, boost damage, weaken enemies or abilities.

“She's coming, and the eternal sky will open her womb, spilling children that are not ours. What keeps burning must be smothered. What is still sleeping must be dreaming with her.”

From Sea to Counter! Fish Restaurant & Farming Simulator is a fishing, farming and restaurant management sim where you build your own seaside place from scratch. Explore a colorful coastal town! Head out to the pier to fish, grow your own ingredients in the garden out back, run machines to turn your harvest into better products, and cook the famous Turkish fish sandwich for your hungry guests. Build the place you pictured, decorate it your way, hire staff and turn your little grill stand into a five-star restaurant!

CATCH IT FRESH

Grab your rod, head out to the pier and cast into the turquoise water. Whatever you pull in today is what goes on the menu tonight. Fill your crate and carry it back to the kitchen.

GROW YOUR OWN

Work the garden behind the restaurant. Sow, water and harvest your own ingredients.

GRILL THE FAMOUS

This is the one they came for. Chop, grill and build the famous Turkish fish sandwich — then keep growing your menu.

MAKE IT FROM SCRATCH

Set up your machines and close the loop yourself. Harvest goes in, finished goods come out.

HIRE YOUR CREW

Hire staff and let your supply keep running on its own.

SERVE THE HOUSE

Open the counter and keep the orders moving. Guests line up and every plate earns you money.

MAKE IT YOURS

Decorate your restaurant in your own style and make every corner yours.

store_data.about_the_game:
Five biomes, open from the first turn of the key. Drive the family truck anywhere, creep up on wild critters, and cinch the loop. But watch out. Some things out there hunt trucks.


Cross anything with anything. A horse with a croc. A bull with cheetah. Every one carries a family tree generations deep, so you can trace exactly where the third eye came from. Stumped on a pairing? Buy your Ma a drink or two down at The Waterin' Hole.


Drill your critter in the pen at Mad Dog's till the buck sits mean. A raw catch has potential. A trained one has a purse comin'.

Give your critter a makeover at Purdy's Critter Spa. Any part, any look, no judgment. With over 60 MILLION different combinations, you can make your dream or nightmare critters come to life.


Place in events and haul home the purse. Bet legal at the racetrack, or shake hands out back with the Bookie. Sell your surplus of critters to Honest Hank, no questions asked. And when the purse runs thin, dig up what folks buried, run moonshine for the Still, and whatever the truck hits clean is yours to keep.


Ridin', racin', clownin', and the pull. Your animal is the athlete. You enter it and watch from the fence while real physics does the judgin'. Mind the mood, though. Some critters show up to the chute fired up. Some show up spooked. That's rodeo.

store_data.about_the_game:
Humans built the robots to serve. We called them Blinkers.
They chose to take over. They tried to wipe us out.

We fought back. Hard. And for a moment… we were winning. 
So the machines changed the rules.

Instead of finishing the war, they rewrote it—jumping across time to erase humanity before we could even become a problem. Past. Future. Anywhere we exist… they follow.

To counter this, humanity developed the technology to send a single man through the rifts of time to save us all.
They chose an elite agent of F.O.R.G.E — Field Operations for Robotic Governance Enforcement. A defense organization whose sole purpose is to wipe out the Blinkers

That agent is Jacksaw.

And this war… ends with him.

The Jacksaw Rift War is a late 90s/early 2000s-inspired first-person shooter with a modern edge, focused on combat and exploration, with light platforming and puzzle-solving. Battle through a fractured war across space and time, where machines dominate and every encounter demands precision.

Put your skills to the test in an action-adventure FPS where classic boomer shooter intensity meets methodical, Half-Like-inspired gameplay.

Explore open-ended levels with multiple paths—choose how you approach each encounter and uncover hidden routes

Traverse dangerous environments with light platforming and environmental puzzles that reward timing, observation, and curiosity

Discover secrets tucked away in every corner, from hidden paths to optional challenges and rewards

Master a varied arsenal of weapons, to take on anything the Blinkers can throw at you.

Play through a wide variety of levels across different time periods, each offering unique environments, challenges, and gameplay scenarios.

store_data.about_the_game:
Escaping the suffocating noise of the city, 25-year-old Ethan pours all his savings and his uncle's help into buying a quiet, single-story home at 87 Ashwood Ridge. A fresh start. A peaceful sanctuary for him and his cat.

Or so it seems.

As you unpack your belongings, clean up the neglected property, and settle into your new life, the quiet atmosphere slowly curdles into an oppressive weight. The realtor’s contract came with one strict, unyielding condition: The second floor is strictly off-limits until the agreement is fully completed.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Interactive Companionship: You are not entirely alone. Interact with your cat to find comfort amidst the growing tension, but pay attention — animals often notice things humans cannot.

  • Realistic Narrative Loop: Unfold the mystery naturally through phone messages, interactions with curious neighbors, and exploring the hidden corners of the house.

  • Immersive Audio & Visuals: VHS-style post-processing, realistic 3D binaural audio, and tactile gameplay mechanics designed to make every creak and whisper feel unnervingly real.

  • The Forbidden Threshold: Respect the contract and stay away from the upper floor... or succumb to your curiosity and uncover what is hidden in the dark.
