store_data.about_the_game:
A fallen kingdom, breached walls, and a single warrior remaining to protect the throne at the center of the arena... **Throneguard: Last Stand** is a 3D medieval action tower defense game that blends fast-paced sword combat with strategic defense mechanics.

Enemy hordes don't follow a set corridor—they spawn at random locations across the map, converging on the castle at the center from every direction. As the castle's final guardian, you must face this 360-degree threat by personally fighting on the front lines with your sword while building defensive perimeters around the throne.

## ⚔️ KEY FEATURES

* **360-Degree Perimeter Defense:** Enemies don't stick to fixed paths! Adapt to waves spawning randomly across the arena and protect every side of your central fortress.

* **Action Meets Strategy:** Don't just build towers and watch! Take direct control of your hero, slash through enemy ranks with your sword, and fight alongside your defense lines.

* **Freeform Construction & Preparation Phase:** Make the most of the time between enemy waves. Build barricades and defense towers around the central throne to block, delay, and dismantle incoming attacks.

* **Hero Progression & Leveling System:** Earn experience points (XP) in combat to level up your warrior. Upgrade your damage, health, and combat abilities to face tougher challenges in upcoming rounds.

* **Protect the Central Throne at All Costs:** Surrounded on all sides, the throne is the heart of the kingdom. Set your defenses, draw your blade, and fight to the very last breath!

store_data.about_the_game:
Nothing here is scripted. It's simulated.

Wreckcore is an open-world sandbox built around one idea: everything that breaks, breaks for real. Car bodies crumple panel by panel exactly where you hit them. Bullets punch real holes through sheet metal and shatter glass into flying shards. Every pedestrian is a full physical ragdoll — clip one with a bumper and the body rolls over your hood the way physics says it should.

A living city that pushes back

Commit a crime and the police respond: they'll chase you on foot, and if you escalate, they draw their guns. Earn stars, watch the search circle tighten on the map, and break out of it to disappear. Get caught, and you'll wake up at the station with lighter pockets.

Drive everything, wreck everything

[*] Four distinct vehicles — a rear-drive sedan, a stubborn little diesel, a heavy V8 luxury SUV and motocross bikes with wheelies and real traction limits

[*] An arsenal from pistol to minigun, plus a bomb with a visible blast radius that launches bodies, shoves cars and caves in their panels

[*] Two connected towns — the concrete blocks of Betongrad and the villa hills of Zlatni Brijeg — plus a village and open backcountry roads

[*] An in-car radio with original tracks, day-to-dusk streets, and a map that tracks the chaos

[/list]

No missions telling you where to go. Just a city, the laws of physics, and how far you're willing to bend both.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every Character Is a Card

What would you write with "口" and "天"?

In Tian Yu Su you never draw a finished spell — you draw radicals and strokes. Set them into the inkstone, compose a real Chinese character by hand, and let its meaning become an attack, a guard, a transformation or a chained verse. The same pieces can resolve into different characters, and a different character can reshape the whole turn. You are not searching your deck for the one prescribed answer; you are writing the answer this run needs out of the ink and the hand you actually have.

Let a Written Word Live Past the Turn

A completed character does not vanish when it resolves. Hang it on the inkstone and it can become material for the next word, or link with a later character to finish a line of verse. Borrow it, keep it, hold your brush, or gamble on an unfinished composition — every stroke leaves evidence for the turns ahead, and ink-born demons will hunt that evidence down.

Five Scripts, Five Ways to Build

  • Regular — stabilizes each composition and turns structure into protection.

  • Running — carries leftover ink and unfinished cards across turns.

  • Seal — stores what you have already written and reprints that power from the seal casket.

  • Clerical — records a verdict in vermilion and turns repeated auditing into execution.

  • Cursive — converts failed strokes into momentum and reconnects scattered meanings.

These are not stat swaps. Each script is its own character, with its own starting deck, signature relic and three-stage progression.

A Three-Act Codex You Keep Rewriting

Cross the Drought of Torn Scrolls, the Ink Prison of Eroded Steles and the Forbidden Court of the Celestial Codex. Each act boss is visible before you set out, so you choose between the safe line and the greedy line through battles, elites, events, bookshops, treasures, rests and character-forging stations. Beat the act boss, pick a seal with an explicit gain and an explicit cost, then carry the same living deck into the next act.

The Demons Attack Your Language

Enemies do more than cut your vermilion. They eat radicals, swallow hanging characters, stain your draw pile, dry your ink and copy the word you just finished. Read intents, order your targets and build enough redundancy that your engine can restart after it has been broken.

A Living Ink-Wash Scroll

Paper is the light. Corrupted ink is the enemy. Cinnabar is reserved for danger and judgment. Characters, demons, interface, verse cinematics and all three acts obey one tactile language of xuan paper, wet ink bloom and broken brush fibers, and every heavy hit, failed composition and completed verse reads back in brushwork.

The Codex Allows Only One Name for Each Thing

Every meaning it deleted bled out as corrupted ink, and the nameless came back through the gap. You are a character mender walking a three-act world painted on living paper.

Break glyphs into the inkstone. Let the written word become the spell.

This time you are not writing the standard answer — you are writing the stroke that gives the world its names back.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a murmuration. A hundred flying blocks wrapped around a controllable core.

Battle! Every hit shakes blocks loose. Every block that falls is one tick closer to zero. In MURMUR MURDER, you are the health bar: a living countdown swirling through the air, and everyone in the room is set on being the last one standing.

Made for the GMTK Game Jam.

Theme: COUNTDOWN.

The Flock Is the Clock

Your body is one hundred pieces, and the whole match is spent defending them and attacking your enemies.  Bleed the other flock faster than they bleed you. When the last block drops, so do you.

Couch Murder

1–4 players, local. Online support if this does well! Bring friends or feed slots to the CPU. Bots come in Easy, Normal, and Murderous. Stocks, timed matches, or first-to-X KOs, on procedurally generated stages that never repeat.

Move Like a Flock

Run, wall-jump, slide, slam, fly. Parry a bullet at the last instant and send it home. And when things get desperate: dissolve into the murmur itself and fly as a swirling flock of blocks that lays bombs mid-flight.

The Arsenal

Unique weapons! Pistol, machine gun, shotgun, rifle, and a sword that swings with your aim. If you find the gold orb, the GOD MURMUR: a golden flock with a gun to match. Health, shields, and slo-mo drop in as well.

Learn the Wings

A full tutorial walks you through every control, and training mode gives you a dummy with adjustable behavior, Smash-style, to practice against.

Features:

  • 1–4 player local versus: stocks, timed, or first-to-X KOs

  • Your health is a physical flock of 100 blocks that visibly scatters as you take hits

  • Survival mode: outlast waves of increasingly armed flocks, alone

  • Procedurally generated stages in shifting sunset palettes

  • Murmur flight, wall-jumps, slides, slams, parries, and mid-air bombs

  • Six weapons, four powerups, one gold orb that turns you into a god

  • Full tutorial + training mode with adjustable CPU behavior

  • CPU opponents from harmless to murderous

  • Online coming soon!

store_data.about_the_game:
Hold the line. Send the horde.

Bulwark Tower Defense is a competitive, team-based twist on tower defense. Build a wall of auto-fighting units to survive relentless creep waves — then turn the tables and spend your essence to send monsters marching into your rivals' lanes. Every creep that survives an enemy's defense hammers their team's shared King. Outlast the other side and victory is yours.

Two economies, one hard choice

Gold builds and upgrades your defensive wall. Essence buys sends — the mercenary monsters you unleash on opponents, which also grow your income. Do you play it safe and turtle up, or leak a little on purpose to snowball your economy and send harder? The tension between value and income is the heart of every match.

Key Features

  • Build & battle in real time — place your fighters during the build phase, then watch the wall hold (or break) as the wave marches in.

store_data.about_the_game:
Slow down. Gather. Rest by the fire.

Twigs & Firewood is a cozy first-person game about gentle days in an autumn woodland. There's no rush and nothing to fear — just the quiet pleasure of tidying a glade, tending a warm fire, and making each little camp your own.

Gather every twig

Wander sun-dappled clearings and collect the twigs, sticks and logs scattered across the ground. Sweep them into tidy piles with a rake or broom, and carry your firewood back to camp.

A warm fire and a full pot

Feed your campfire until it's a roaring blaze, forage mushrooms and vegetables, and cook hearty meals in the pot. Sell your firewood for coins — or keep it to keep the fire glowing. Every gentle day ends with a rest by the fire.

Make each place your own

Spend your coins in the camp shop on tools that make gathering easier, cozy comforts to decorate your camp — string lanterns, woven rugs, log benches, wind chimes — and whole new campsites to build in far-off areas.

Wander at your own pace

Travel between peaceful, themed areas — a babbling creek, a pine wood, a sunny meadow, an orchard and more — each with its own light and mood. Watch the day drift from bright morning to a firefly-lit evening.

Features

  • Relaxing, no-fail gathering — no timers, no enemies, no game-overs
  • Tend a living campfire and cook meals in the pot
  • A cozy shop of tools, comforts and campsites to work toward
  • Multiple themed areas to explore and tidy
  • Choose your time of day and unwind to gentle music and woodland ambience
  • Fully playable in 14 languages

Pull up a log, light the fire, and stay a while.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Battle of Olympus returns as a handcrafted Steam remake by its original creators.

Originally released in 1988, The Battle of Olympus is a side-scrolling action-adventure inspired by Greek mythology. Journey across a mythic version of ancient Greece, explore dangerous lands, fight monsters, discover divine items, and grow stronger as your path opens through the blessings of the gods.

This remake is being rebuilt by the original development duo behind the programming and graphics. We are personally recreating the code, redrawing the pixel art, and refining the game for modern PC players while preserving the spirit, atmosphere, and challenge of the original.

Features

- A classic side-scrolling action-adventure reborn for Steam

- Handcrafted pixel art redrawn by the original graphics creator

- Rebuilt game systems by the original programmer

- Greek mythology-inspired locations, monsters, and divine items

- Exploration, combat, platforming, and item-based progression

- A faithful revival of a cult classic from the 8-bit era

Early Access

The Battle of Olympus is being developed with care as our final major game project. By joining Early Access, you can support the return of this classic title while we continue rebuilding, polishing, and expanding the remake toward its full release.

store_data.about_the_game:
一根黑绳，量身循线。万死万生，只许自渡。

《黑绳话 · 西门庆》是一款以《金瓶梅》与《水浒传》人物世界为灵感的中式暗黑真人影像互动叙事游戏。

西门庆死后坠入黑绳地狱，却没有立刻得到审判的终点。普净命他重走生前最深的几道绳结：欲、财、气、酒。你不是来替他开脱，而是要亲手面对每一次窥看、纵容、欺骗与回头所留下的后果，并寻找被困于另一只魂瓶中的李瓶儿。

第一结 · 色宅

故事从潘金莲、武大郎、武松与王婆交织的旧局开始。窗里的一眼、桌前的一根绳、递出去的一包药，以及你是否愿意看完一场谋杀，都会把剧情推向不同方向。

你可能坠入温柔乡，也可能死在武松刀下；可能在亡宅里重看女眷私物留下的记忆，也可能在阳谷夜街遇见本不该仍在人间徘徊的魂。

核心玩法

• 观看电影化真人影像，在关键时刻作出选择。

• 让选择改变业障与净魂，并影响人物关系、死亡、重生与结局。

• 探索阳谷夜街，在王婆茶坊、雨伞铺、祠堂、酒楼、香烛纸马铺等地点追查旧事。

• 死亡后进入亡宅，解锁新的物件记忆，修补裂痕，再重走本绳。

• 收集魂的碎片，让魂瓶逐渐苏醒，并听见李瓶儿对旧情与旧债的回应。

• 反复游玩同一章节；已经发生过的事不会只是简单重复，人物状态与隐藏线索会改变下一次相遇。

选择不是答案，是留在绳上的结

游戏不会提前标明“善”与“恶”。有些看似救人的举动会毁掉另一个人的家；有些转身离开的选择，也可能只是把罪交给旁人完成。业障与净魂记录的不是分数，而是西门庆如何面对已经发生的事。

中式暗黑影像与声音

明代阳谷的夜雨、烛火、旧木、瓷器与黑绳共同构成游戏的视觉语言。配合角色对白、环境声、器物回响与书法 HUD，每一次选择都像翻开一页不能完全抹去的旧账。

当前试玩内容聚焦“第一结 · 色宅”的完整核心循环：进入旧局、作出选择、承受后果、死亡或重生、探索街区与魂的记忆，并在第一结结束处留下通往下一道绳的悬念。

store_data.about_the_game:
Hold the road. Defend the realm.

Crownhold is a cozy, storybook tower defense in the spirit of the classics. Goblins pour down winding forest roads, over river crossings and through moonlit swamps — and only your towers, your champions and a well-timed spell stand between them and the crown.

Raise Your Towers

Build four tower families — Archers, Mages, Artillery and Barracks — alongside gold-mine plots that fund your war. Upgrade each through three tiers, then commit to one of 12 powerful specializations: far-seeing Longwatch snipers, shield-wall Oathguard, meteor-calling Starfall spires and many more.

Lead a Champion

Bring one of three heroes to the field — a steadfast knight, a deadly huntress, or a healing friar — and march them wherever the line bends closest to breaking.

Command the Battle

  • Spells on tap — rain a meteor storm, roll an explosive barrel down a lane, or reinforce your soldiers mid-fight.
  • 21 hand-painted levels across sunny passes, twin-lane bridges, flooded causeways and haunted hollows.
  • Royal Upgrades — spend hard-won stars on a five-branch progression tree that grows stronger every battle.
  • Endless mode — unlock relentless survival waves on every map you conquer.
  • Three difficulties — relaxed Casual, balanced Normal, or punishing Veteran.

Cozy to Learn, Deep to Master

No twitch reflexes, no runs you can't come back from — just the satisfying loop of build, upgrade and hold. Playable with mouse and keyboard, translated into 14 languages, with Steam achievements and cloud saves.

Defend Crownhold. The realm is counting on you.

store_data.about_the_game:
At the age of twenty-seven, Bijia broke away from the crowded city and rigid institutional work, resigned quietly, and returned to her hometown alone.

store_data.about_the_game:
A long time ago, the gods fell, and their thrones shattered. Their divinity turned into grudges, and these grudges solidified into the Twelve Demon Kings, occupying every checkpoint in the mortal world. Over a hundred years, wave after wave of warriors went in—none returned. This time, it’s your turn.

‘Divine Descent’ is a hardcore top-down Roguelike action game with a ghostly and divine theme. You play as a nameless archer, stepping into this cursed land to face the 12 Demon Kings across 60 levels—each with a unique style: the bloodthirsty Fire Demon King, the soul-devouring Ice Demon King, the lightning-wielding Poison Demon King… Each has their own skills and weaknesses, so no two battles are alike.

There’s no mercy in battle. Fire continuously burns your flesh, ghosts strike from behind. Your job isn’t to rush in blindly—it’s to shoot while retreating, chain skills together, and predict their moves. Draw your bow, move, dodge, cast—every decision shapes the path of your next arrow and your own fate.

Each cleared level gives you a choice of three random rewards: upgrade a skill you already have, socket a rare gem, or get a red legendary item. After 60 levels, endless mode opens—stronger monsters, higher drops, and the glory that belongs to the true king.

Are you ready, archer? The heavens are dead, the ghosts reign supreme—and among mortals, only you can fight.

store_data.about_the_game:
FLICK. POCKET. CASH OUT.

DISCARD is a roguelike deckbuilder where you actually throw your cards. Every card is a physical object: the wind bends it, the rails bounce it back, the pockets pull it in.

THE WIND RUNS THE TABLE

Every round the wind changes strength and direction, bending every trajectory. First you learn to read it, with an exact physics tracer that draws the line for you. Then you learn to use it: a flat throw banks off the rails and knocks grounded cards into the pockets, a high lob clears everything and lands on another card to build a stack.

PUSH YOUR LUCK

Every pocket feeds the POT, every skill shot raises the MULTIPLIER: banks, caroms, rapid-fire sinks and card combos like pairs, straights and three of a kind. Watch the score explode throw after throw, then cash out. Too early and you leave chips on the table; one wrong pocket at the wrong time and you burn it all.

THE SLOT REWRITES THE TABLE

Clear the round and one spin reshapes the next: wider pockets, double chips, free cards... or drunken pockets, storms and earthquakes that scatter everything. Blessing or curse, the table is yours now.

25 DECKS, 16 SPECIAL CARDS

To go further you will have to change your deck: unlock a whole collection, and each one bends the rules its own way. Special cards like SWEEP, TORNADO, SNIPER, PORTAL and the wish granting JOKER turn a losing hand around.

ONE GAME LEADS TO ANOTHER

Rounds that last minutes, decisions that matter, the perfect bank shot when you need it most. You lose fast, you start over faster.

Built for Steam Deck first: full controller support, 60fps, native Linux and Windows. Fully localized in English.

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore Mecca Over 1,400 Years Ago

Step into a faithfully recreated open world inspired by Mecca during the earliest days of Islam. Discover iconic figures, uncover hidden stories, and witness events that shaped one of history's greatest civilizations.

Explore an Authentic World

Journey through a living recreation of 7th-century Mecca, inspired by authentic sources. Wander through bustling markets, historic districts, mountains, and iconic landmarks while experiencing dynamic weather, a full day and night cycle, and immersive horse riding. Meet inhabitants with their own routines and conversations, uncover hidden places, and immerse yourself in a city designed to feel alive at every moment.

Experience History Through Gameplay

Live the events instead of simply reading about them.

Follow a main quest inspired by the Sirah of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, complete side stories based on the Sahabah and real events, speak with the people of Mecca to uncover their stories, and interact with historical landmarks to learn about the city.

Take part in activities such as helping merchants, finding lost belongings, horse racing, combat challenges, quizzes, and more. Master parkour to reach hidden rooftops, discover forgotten parchments, and restore them by collecting verses from the Qur'an throughout your journey.

A Respectful Historical Experience

The Last Message is developed with great care to respect both Islamic values and historical authenticity.

To preserve this respectful approach:

  • No human faces are depicted.

  • No musical instruments or background music are used.

  • Events are inspired by recognized Islamic historical sources.

  • Locations, characters, and environments are recreated with respect and attention to detail.

Our goal is to offer an immersive experience while treating this important period with dignity and respect.

Key Features

  • Faithfully inspired recreation of 7th-century Mecca.

  • Main story inspired by the Sirah of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

  • Side quests based on the Sahabah and authentic events.

  • Dynamic day & night cycle and weather system.

  • Immersive horse riding.

  • Living NPCs with routines, conversations, and personal stories.

  • Parkour across rooftops and hidden areas.

  • Historical landmarks that reveal the city's past.

  • Activities including merchant tasks, horse racing, combat, quizzes, and more.

  • Discover and restore forgotten parchments by collecting Qur'anic verses.

  • In-game Codex recording the people, places, and discoveries made during your journey.

Begin Your Journey

Walk through the streets of ancient Mecca, discover the people who lived there, visit authentic locations, and experience the beginning of one of history's most influential periods through storytelling, discovery, and immersive gameplay.

store_data.about_the_game:
Stack cats and reach Mars!

A 2D physics game where you stack adorable cats and help them reach Mars.

Story

In the year 20XX, mysterious mutations caused mice to grow gigantic. Hunted by these enormous mice, the cats decide to leave Earth behind and build a new home on Mars.

Features

• Unique Cats

Each cat has its own size and weight. The order you stack them greatly affects the stability of your tower.

• Items

Stack the same type of cat repeatedly to earn Bells.

Use them to prevent your tower from collapsing and stack even higher!

• Hazard Events

Stack different types of cats to trigger hazard events such as Explosions and Freezing, dramatically changing the course of the game.

• Black Cat

The Black Cat is a powerful trump card that can earn a large number of Bells. Knowing when to use it is the key to victory.

Will you play it safe, or take a risky approach?

Help the cats reach Mars safely!

Videos & Streaming

  • Please include the game title in your video or stream title. (Required)

  • We'd greatly appreciate it if you could include a link to the Steam Store page in the description. (Optional)

store_data.about_the_game:
YOU ARE THE PEST


Every other game makes you the hero. This one makes you the thing people swat.

You're a filthy fly with a bandana and a bad attitude, and the entire insect kingdom has decided today is the day. Ants by the hundred. Honey bees that kite you. Armored beetles that lower their heads and charge. Medic ants healing the swarm faster than you can chew through it. And somewhere past the twentieth wave, something wearing a bottle cap as a crown.

Kill bugs. Slurp the XP. Draft revolting upgrades. Get filthier.

NINE DISGUSTING WEAPONS — STACK SIX


Acid spit. An ovipositor that fires eggs like a machine gun. Orbiting wing blades. A trailing cloud of miasma. Chain lightning that forks bug to bug. Arcing dung bombs. Homing stingers. A brood of maggot minions that chomp their own way through the horde. Honey traps laid down by your dash.

Take six into a run and let them all scream at once — then evolve the right ones into Tesla Swarm, Fecal Storm, and Hive Mind, golden versions that stop being weapons and start being weather.

EGG DEFENSE: HOW GREEDY ARE YOU?


Mid-fight, an egg drops. Hold a shrinking circle for ten seconds while the horde pours in on you, and the hatch pays out in Maggots and a burst of XP. Walk away and you get nothing. Every wave asks the same question, and running is always the safe, boring answer.

FOUR BOSSES WORTH LEARNING


A Tarantula that pins you in webbing. A Praying Mantis that telegraphs its pounce, then bursts in every direction at once. The Toad — not even a bug, and it doesn't care — lashing its tongue down the sewer and hopping clean over the canal. And The Crumb King: a bloated, crowned cockroach who zig-zags across the picnic blanket, vomits a trail of slowing jelly, and slams his shell hard enough to shockwave the table.

Every attack is telegraphed. Every boss is beatable once you learn to read it.

DIE. MUTATE. GO AGAIN.


Death is just the commute home. The Heap is your mound of garbage — a sprawling, fog-of-war mutation tree where Maggots buy permanent upgrades: thicker carapace, faster wings, sharper luck, extra rerolls, new weapons unlocked into the draft pool, and capstone mutations like Maggot Rebirth — a once-per-run revive that bursts every bug standing over your corpse.

Nothing is ever lost on death. You just come back worse.

THREE FILTHY ARENAS


  • The Picnic — a giant tabletop of baskets, spilled jam, toothpicks, and water glasses you can shatter into slowing puddles
  • The Dust Bowl — cracked desert earth, rock cover, and nowhere good to hide
  • The Undergut — a sewer split by a flowing canal; your XP gems drift downstream, fliers cross it, you don't

Each has its own boss, its own hazards, and Easy / Hard / Nightmare tiers that pay out more the deeper you're willing to go.

FEATURES


  • Play the pest — one filthy fly against the entire insect kingdom
  • 9 stackable weapons, 6 per run, 3 golden evolutions
  • 4 arthropod bosses with telegraphed, learnable attack kits
  • Egg-defense stands that reward greed and punish caution
  • The Heap — a trash-pile mutation tree of permanent upgrades that never resets
  • 3 arenas, 3 difficulty tiers, 10–20 minute "one more run" sessions
  • Slot-machine upgrade drafts, gib-bursting kills, screen shake with teeth, and an original soundtrack that rearranges its theme for every map

THE FREE DEMO


The demo hands you the complete Picnic: all nine weapons, every evolution, the full Heap progression, and the twenty-wave climb to The Crumb King himself. Beat him and you'll unlock the Botfly — the Broodmother — and she'll be waiting for you in the full game, along with every mutation you bought. Your Heap carries over.

5014770.name: 電工らぶ -ゼロから始める電気工事士-

movies.name: オープニングムービー

store_data.about_the_game:
45歳。俺の人生は、何も残らなかった。

孤独に生涯を終えたはずの主人公が目を覚ますと、そこは18歳の教室だった。
やり直せる。今度こそ、後悔のない人生を。
選んだのは——手に職をつけること。第二種電気工事士への挑戦だった。

物語を読むだけで、試験範囲が身につく

本作は「勉強がつらい」を変えるために作られた学習ビジュアルノベルです。
5人のヒロインとの青春を読み進めるうちに、第二種電気工事士の試験範囲が自然と頭に入る——そんな体験を目指しました。
続きが気になって読む。気づけば、覚えている。

収録コンテンツ

  • 過去問 1000問 — 試験実施団体が公表した令和元年〜令和8年の8年度分を独自に解説・構成。選択肢ごとの詳しい解説付きで、弱点を確実に潰せます。
  • CBT形式の模擬試験 — 令和5年度以降の本番CBT方式を模した模擬試験。画面で解く操作と時間配分に、本番前から慣れられます。
  • 暗記カード 428枚 — 配線図記号・規則・鑑別を、覚え方（語呂）とSVG図付きでスキマ時間に。
  • オフラインAI アシスタント（おまけ機能） — 端末内で動く学習アシスタントが、疑問にその場で回答。文章を生成せず、収録済みの検証済み教材データから該当箇所を探して示します。通信不要・GPU不要。※収録範囲外の質問には答えられません。
  • 黒板チャンネル — 頻出テーマを図解で深掘りする解説シリーズ38本を収録。
  • 本編シナリオ 約26万字 — イベントCG 84枚。

5人のヒロインが、それぞれの科目を教えてくれる

  • 安藤 理恵（電気理論・電気計算） — 幼なじみで、ちょっと理屈っぽい。難しい計算もこの子と一緒なら。
  • 黒川 凛（配線図の読み方） — クールで完璧主義。複線図を描かせたら右に出る者はいない。
  • 橘 ひなた（電気機器・工具・材料） — 元気いっぱいの後輩。工具のことなら何でも聞いて！
  • 桐島 沙織（施工方法・電気工事法規） — 頼れる法規の先輩。条文の根拠まで優しく教えてくれる。
  • 御堂 葵 先生（技能試験・実技指導） — 厳しくも面倒見のいい講師。実技はこの人に任せろ。

完全オフラインで動作

意味検索モデルまで同梱。インストール後は、ネット接続なしで学習を進められます。通勤中でも、現場の休憩中でも。
おまけ機能のAIアシスタントも、GPU不要・CPUで動作します。質問内容が外部に送信されることはありません。

こんな方へ

  • 第二種電気工事士の勉強を始めたいが、参考書で挫折した
  • 過去問だけでは理解が浅いと感じている
  • CBT形式（画面で解く試験）に慣れておきたい
  • スキマ時間に配線図記号・法規・工具を覚えたい
  • キャラクターや物語があるほうが学習を続けやすい

体験版で、まず試してください

プロローグから5人との出会いまでを収録した体験版を公開しています。

ご注意

本作は、試験実施団体が公表している過去問題をもとに、解説・演習機能を当社が独自に構成した学習コンテンツです。試験実施団体や公的機関が監修・公認した教材ではありません。合否に関わる重要事項は、必ず公式の試験情報でご確認ください。

5014840.name: Pixie - Desktop Pet That Mirrors You

store_data.about_the_game:
Your desktop just adopted a pet — and it's copying your face.

Pixie is a crew of 12 tiny pixel companions that live on top of your windows. Turn your head, blink, talk, smirk — your pet mirrors you live through your webcam. Not a filter, not a video effect: a little creature with its own life, sitting at the bottom of your screen.

It mirrors you, live

Head direction, eye blinks, mouth, smiles, even a raised eyebrow — 🤨 right back at you. Powered by on-device vision that never touches the internet.

It talks with its paws

  • ✌️ makes it dance

  • ☝️ drags it around the screen

  • ✊ a closed fist sends it to sleep

  • 🖐 an open palm wakes it up

Smart filtering keeps everyday hand movement from setting it off.

It reacts to sound

Sudden noises startle it. It is a little dramatic about this.

It chats back — and remembers you

Plug in your own AI key (Google Gemini has a free tier) and every character talks in its own personality. Optional local memory means your pet remembers your name, your jokes and your late-night sessions. All of it stays on your machine.

Twelve characters, twenty-four looks

Cat, dog, rabbit, panda, hamster, penguin, fox, owl, ghost, dragon, robot and slime — each with two themes and its own voice. The chat window recolours itself to match whoever you pick. Everything is included; there is nothing to unlock.

It has a life of its own

Moods that shift with the time of day, spontaneous naps (it yawns first), sudden zoomies, and a purr when you click it.

Privacy is the architecture, not a feature

Every camera and microphone frame is processed on your own computer by on-device models. No footage, no audio and no images ever leave your PC. The only network request Pixie can make is the optional AI chat, and only if you turn it on with your own key.

Made for streamers

Park it on your stream as a desktop buddy — it sits above your windows, mirrors your expressions, and your chat will be obsessed.

store_data.about_the_game:
⚠️ NOTE: This game is designed for STREAMERS to play with their AUDIENCE on TikTok or Twitch. Solo and Local Play modes also exist — local players join by scanning a QR code, no chat required.

Turn your chat into a room full of Sudoku rivals.

Raisin Sudoku turns the classic puzzle into a live, competitive game show. You share your screen — your viewers race to fill the grid, straight from chat. No app, no download, no account.

How It Works

You Host: Launch the game and share your screen.

They Solve: Viewers scan the grid for a cell they can fill.

They Type: Row, column, and number, in any order — like E4 7 or 7 E4 — to claim it.

Instant Feedback: First correct answer wins the cell, scores points, and builds their streak on stream.

Key Features

🎥 Multi-Platform Support — Connects to TikTok Live and Twitch chat out of the box.

🏆 Live Leaderboard — Real-time standings with a podium finish for the top three players.

🎨 Visual Themes — Multiple looks to match your stream's vibe.

👥 Local & Solo Modes — Play offline with friends in the same room via QR code, or practice solo.

Why Play This?

store_data.detailed_description:
⚠️ NOTE: This game is designed for STREAMERS to play with their AUDIENCE on TikTok or Twitch. Solo and Local Play modes also exist — local players join by scanning a QR code, no chat required.

Turn your chat into a room full of Sudoku rivals.

Raisin Sudoku turns the classic puzzle into a live, competitive game show. You share your screen — your viewers race to fill the grid, straight from chat. No app, no download, no account.

How It Works

You Host: Launch the game and share your screen.

They Solve: Viewers scan the grid for a cell they can fill.

They Type: Row, column, and number, in any order — like E4 7 or 7 E4 — to claim it.

Instant Feedback: First correct answer wins the cell, scores points, and builds their streak on stream.

Key Features

🎥 Multi-Platform Support — Connects to TikTok Live and Twitch chat out of the box.

🏆 Live Leaderboard — Real-time standings with a podium finish for the top three players.

🎨 Visual Themes — Multiple looks to match your stream's vibe.

👥 Local & Solo Modes — Play offline with friends in the same room via QR code, or practice solo.

Why Play This?

Viewers love being first. Raisin Sudoku rewards speed and logic in real time, putting your fastest solvers on screen and your slowest rounds under pressure. Whether you're running a competitive puzzle race or just filling downtime with your community, it turns "watching" into "playing."

store_data.about_the_game:
Line up your army. Watch the battle unfold.

Boardbound Heroes is a roguelike autobattler about raising an army while diving ever deeper into dungeons. Battles play out automatically—your job is everything that comes before: who to recruit, where to place them, what to equip. Command the board, and the board decides the fight.

Features

  • 3×3 tactical placement— Front row tanks, back row damage. With range and movement on the board, positioning itself is your strategy.

  • Classes & trait synergies— Knights, mages, summoners, whip masters and more. Collect distinctive classes and amplify them through trait combinations.

  • Reward card drafts— After key floors, draw 3 cards from a deck you built yourself. Heal now or power up? Your picks shape each run.

  • Equipment & smithing— Hunt gear across 5 rarity tiers, craft with materials, and chase recipes only bosses drop.

  • Idle-friendly— 4x battle speed and auto-farming mode make grinding painless, with a full loot summary when you return.

Your army is an investment

Nothing ends with a single run. Every hero you recruit, every weapon you forge, every card you collect stays with you—and your army grows stronger, step by step. From the monster king lurking beyond the grasslands to the Demon Lord's castle awaiting at the end: your heroes are ready when you are.

store_data.about_the_game:
Death Row

You are inmates sentenced to execution in a prison torture chamber. A relentless, deadly saw is advancing toward you, and your only chance of survival is to sever the main power supply feeding this machine.

You are here for a reason: the system wants to eliminate you, and you must break the rules to survive. Every second counts against you as you race against time to stop your execution and escape this cell alive. Your only goal: Disrupt the current, escape execution!

Role Distribution and Communication

Whether you fight for survival with your 2-player co-op team or race to escape before the rival team in the 4-player 2v2 competitive mode! The game is built on two distinct roles that are completely interdependent for survival:

  • Silent Guide: Sees how the circuits need to be solved but cannot speak. They must use limited guidance mechanics, such as head movements and hand gestures, to direct their teammate.

  • Circuit Solver: Cannot see the clues, but can interact with the control panel and circuits. They must correctly read the guide's directions, keep their nerves in check, and make the right move at the right time.

Solve the Circuits, Cut the Power!

The only way to stop the execution is to solve the electrical schematics on the control panel under the deafening noise and heavy psychological pressure of the approaching saw:

  • Direct the Current Correctly: Connect the cables to the right spots, balance the voltage, and divert the energy away from the deadly saw.

  • Combine Logic and Speed: Flawlessly overcome asymmetrical puzzles that grow progressively harder at every stage, from simple current matching to high-voltage maze schematics.

  • Make No Mistakes: A wrong connection or faulty current doesn't just cost you time—it increases the speed of the saw, bringing the lethal end even closer!

store_data.about_the_game:
The rent was cheap, the street was quiet, and the attic was supposed to be empty.

The house at the end of Sycamore

You're Riley. New town, new keys, a van full of boxes and a dog named Bean. Day one is unpacking: find the fuse box, figure out the stairs, wave back at the neighbor who's a little too curious about your attic. By the time the sun goes down, Bean won't stop barking at the ceiling.

Sycamore End is a short, story-driven first-person horror game told in chapters, watched through the soft rot of a worn VHS tape.

What you'll do

  • Settle in. Unpack the boxes, raid the fridge, mop the floors, learn which stair creaks under you. The house lets you get comfortable first.
  • Watch the phone. Mom checks in. Then a number you've never seen starts texting, and it isn't asking questions.
  • Hide. When something gets inside, you don't fight it. You kill the lights, fold yourself into a wardrobe, and watch the room through the slats while it searches for you.
  • Call for help. 911 works. But the only spot with signal is the middle of the front yard, out in the open, in the dark.

The tape

Everything plays back the way it would on a shelf-worn cassette: grain, tracking wobble, colors gone slightly wrong. There's no smartphone and no waypoint. If you want to know what's knocking above the bedroom, you climb up and open the hatch yourself.

Sycamore End is made by one person. It's an evening of horror with no padding, best played at night with headphones. Contains jump scares.

Logs must be hauled to the warehouse, processed on the machines and driven by trucks to the customs house or dock, where goods are finally sold. Every link in that chain can be automated: chainsaws, harvesters, log trucks, inter-island barges, machine operators and haulers running the logistics.

Grow the full production chain: log → board → lumber → dried lumber → product → furniture. Unlock alternative branches — a paper mill and a charcoal plant. Build roads, generators, fuel depots and ports, take bank loans, watch a market with floating prices and grab lucrative supply contracts.

But the forest is alive. Cut too greedily and ecology drops, trees regrow slower, the island empties out. Hire foresters, plant saplings and hold the balance between profit and regrowth. Seasons change, and with them the growth rate and fuel costs. Open new zones and neighbouring islands — from deciduous groves to mountain cedars and ancient relic giants.

The goal is simple and ambitious: turn a lonely plot into an industrial logging empire with a net worth of 10,000,000 ₽.

  • A FULL PROCESSING CHAIN. Log → board → lumber → dried lumber → product → furniture, plus paper and charcoal. Every stage adds value;

  • LIVING MACHINES & WORKERS. Loggers, haulers, operators and foresters; chainsaws, harvesters, log trucks, trucks and sea barges between islands — all driving, felling and hauling right in front of you;

  • ECONOMY & LOGISTICS. A floating market, contracts, a bank with loans, maintenance, fuel and electricity. Build three tiers of roads to speed up delivery;

  • ECOLOGY MATTERS. Logging lowers forest health; planting restores it. Keep the balance — or end up on a barren island;

  • AN ISLAND WORLD. 7 tree species, 4 biomes and separate islands linked by ports and barges. Unlock zones as you grow;

  • SEASONS. Spring, summer, autumn and winter change tree growth and fuel use;

  • 15 STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS;

  • TWO LANGUAGES: Russian and English, auto-detected on first launch.

From your first felled tree to a logging empire — the whole island is yours.

Start in mom's garage. End by changing the world.


AI Lab Tycoon puts you at the center of the AI race. What begins as a tiny team, limited compute, and one audacious bet can grow into an empire of compute, intelligence and business, but only if you can survive the burn rate, read the market, and stay ahead of rival labs.


Every decision is consequential

Do you spend on brilliant talent or the compute they need? Chase a risky research branch or polish the next product? Take investment now or hold out for better terms? Every decision shapes the lab you become, and how quickly the competition closes in. Manage your lab in a complex interconnected economy.


Turn breakthroughs into momentum

Train and release increasingly capable AI models, transform research into products, and watch the market react. A strong launch can change your trajectory. A mistimed bet can leave rivals racing past you.

Race for the frontier

  • Turn technical breakthroughs into market-ready products
  • Navigate funding offers, runway, equity, and reputation
  • Research a connected technology tree with meaningful prerequisites
  • Track rival labs and adapt as the competitive landscape shifts
  • Choose between multiple paths to victory

store_data.about_the_game:
The city keeps records. Somebody in them is lying.


You are Sam Halloran, night-shift technician at Bay City Municipal Data Services. You do not carry a gun. You do not kick down doors. You read the city's databases like witness statements - guest lists, parking logs, phone records, ledgers - and you find the one row that does not fit.

Query Noir is a detective game built around a single idea: the interrogation is a query. Every case is a real dataset. Every lead narrows it. The last row standing is your killer.

Ask questions, not syntax


There is no text field and nothing to memorise. You assemble every question from readable blocks and dropdowns:

  • SHOW ME the guest list WHERE Outfit is 'white suit'
  • AND Last Seen is after 23:30
  • CONNECT TO Vehicles - whose car used the alley gate?

As you build, the game writes the matching SQL next to your blocks and a plain English sentence underneath it. You solve the case first; the language arrives on its own. By the last chapter you are reading JOINs, GROUP BY and IS NULL without ever having been made to study them.

Sixteen cases, one conspiracy


  • Prologue - a missing receipt, and a guided first night on the job.
  • The Basics - six optional cases, each built around one new idea, where the new idea is always the step that breaks the case open.
  • The Syndicate - a murder outside a club pulls a thread through the whole city.
  • Checkmate - follow the money to the man who thought the records would never be read.

Every case opens with a hand-illustrated noir comic, hands you a client memo and a chain of leads, and ends at the accusation board: five faces, one name to say out loud. Say the wrong one and the file stays open.

Features


  • No typing, ever. Dropdown-only input. Nothing to install, nothing to configure, no syntax errors.
  • Real datasets. Every case is a small, hand-authored database you can actually explore, including the rows that lead nowhere.
  • Learn by solving. Filters, comparisons, ranges, sorting, limits, joins, grouping and empty values, introduced one at a time and always at the moment they crack the case.
  • Reputation and ranks. Close cases on truth, efficiency and independence to climb from Night-Shift IT Temp to The Query Detective.
  • Hand-drawn noir. Ink-and-wash comics and character portraits over a pixel-art night office, a CRT scanline filter, rain on the window.
  • A score that never repeats itself. Procedurally synthesised noir jazz, rain ambience and dry interface sounds.
  • Three languages. Full English, German and Turkish, including every case, comic caption and hint.
  • Three save slots, no timers, no fail states. Take the whole night.

Who it is for


If you like deduction games where the answer is genuinely in front of you, and if you have ever wanted to understand what a database query actually says, this is a case file with your name on it.

store_data.about_the_game:
As a weary contract killer in a dark cyberpunk underground, you must complete your final contract. You have to find a way to survive by defeating the enemies you face.

Gameplay Last Contract is a fast-paced 2D action game with a one-hit kill mechanic. With both you and your enemies dying in a single strike, you must rely on your reflexes to survive. Deflect bullets with your katana, close the distance with your dash ability, and eliminate enemies with your shuriken attacks.

About Last Contract The game focuses entirely on pure action with its pixel art style and cyberpunk atmosphere. There are no complex skill trees or grinding systems; there is only you, your weapons, and your reflexes.

Key Features:

  • Unforgiving one-hit kill combat system

  • 2D pixel art style and neon cyberpunk atmosphere

  • Melee combat and bullet deflection mechanics with a katana

  • Dash ability for instant repositioning

  • Shurikens for long-range attacks

  • 8-bit retro sound effects

  • Challenging progression based purely on skill and reflexes

content_descriptors.notes: Last Contract is a fast-paced neon action game where you fight through enemies using a katana, shurikens. Combat is frequent and lethal you and your enemies each die in a single hit but the violence is highly stylized: defeated enemies burst into bright neon particles and pixel-art sprites rather than realistic blood or gore. There is no dismemberment, torture, or graphic injury. The story follows a contract killer and touches on dark, melancholic themes (death, killing, weariness) through brief optional text dialogue. The game contains no sexual content or nudity.

The fate of the world is in your hands.

store_data.about_the_game:
🌸 Welcome to the Dream Meadows! 🌸

A world of pastel hills, sparkling lakes and adorable(!) monsters awaits~ But don't be fooled; those cute spiders bite, and those big fluffy bears hit HARD! (>﹏<)

Grab your oversized greatsword, gather up to 3 friends, and take the dream back! ⚔️✨

💖 What's Inside? 💖

🎀 4-Player Online Co-op — Steam lobbies: public, friends-only or password-protected! Invite, chat, fight together~

⚔️ Juicy Combat — 3-hit combos, Q/E/R skills, right-click blocking, stylish dodges, lock-on targeting and stuns!

🐻 15+ Enemy Types — Orcs, skeletons, giant spiders, warlocks... each with their own weapons and bad attitude!

🐉 Epic Bosses — URSA THE CORRUPTED, WARCHIEF GROMMAK, BROODMOTHER, and the sky-scorching CRIMSON WYRM! (๑•̀ㅂ•́)و

🏕️ Camps to Raid — Orc war camps, cursed ruins, spider dens... loot awaits the brave!

💪 Persistent Progression — Earn XP, level up, grow stronger! Your progress saves even in a friend's world~

💕 Pick Your Friends Up — Teammate down? Hold F and bring them back!

👗 Dress Up Your Warrior — Outfits, hair colors, faces, horns(!) and weapons~

🌧️ A Living World — Rain cycles, skittish deer, angry moose(!), birdsong and peace... until it isn't!

🎯 Training Dome — Perfect your combos on poor, innocent training dummies~

🌍 33 Languages — fully localized!

✨ Cute Alone, Cuter Together! ✨

Play solo or leave the door open for friends — they can drop in mid-game! Enemies scale with your party size, and there's loot enough for everyone~ 🍀

The dream is waiting, warrior. Bring your sword~ 💖

store_data.about_the_game:
There is a monster in the bay. His name is Gary.

You are one man in one small boat with one bow. Gary is roughly the size of a district. This

is not a fair fight, and everyone involved knows it — including Gary, who finds the whole

thing a little tedious.

So you do the only sensible thing: you row out, you shoot him until you drown, you file the

paperwork, and you row out again. Every arrow counts. The damage stays. Gary remembers. And

somewhere around your four hundredth drowning, you start to win.

MAN vs. GARY is an idle comedy boss-siege that plays whether you're watching or not —

a hand-illustrated storybook world where failure is the whole point and the sea monster always

dies mid-sentence.

What you're getting into

  • Lose, professionally. Death isn't a fail state — it's a filing. Every drowning paysout, advances the story, and stamps another Maritime Incident Report. The monster's HP neverresets; your worst day still chipped him.

  • A roster of seven things that want you gone. Gary the kraken. Ignatius, who is on fire and knows it. The Deep Sea Lurker, who is so sorry. Kevin & Kevin, a two-headed argument. THE BARONESS, who owns the seabed and resents being involved. THE COMMITTEE, which cannot kill you without a motion. And — after the gym montage — SWOLE GARY.

  • Idle that respects your time. The crew keeps rowing, shooting, and drowning while you're away. Come home to progress, a report, and a monster that's had hours to think about it.

  • Retire the Captain. When the wall is too high, hang up the bow and hand the boat to someone angrier. He inherits the grudge, the statue and every way you have died — plus a permanent damage bonus that stacks with every retirement. Monsters that took you hours start dying in minutes. Retiring isn't starting over. It's a promotion, and there's a certificate.

  • THE DROWNING BOARD. A global leaderboard that ranks the entire world by how many times they have drowned. Aim high.

  • A game that talks back.[/b] Hundreds of lines of deadpan monster commentary, bureaucratic death reports, a Committee that produces one (1) actionable insight, a gentleman gull who would never, and a mandatory tea break observed by both sides.

Built by one person, with care

Every arrow, every drowning, every terrible pun is the work of a solo studio. No microtransactions,

no energy timers, no nonsense — just you, a boat, and a kraken with a grievance.

The monster dies mid-sentence. That is a promise.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every compartment hides a secret. Every decision brings you closer to the truth.

You wake up aboard a mysterious train with no memory of how you got there. The only way forward is to carefully inspect each compartment and decide whether it is normal or affected by an anomaly.

Observe your surroundings, trust your instincts, and don't overlook the smallest details. A missing suitcase, an unfamiliar silhouette, or a subtle change in the environment could mean the difference between survival and failure.

But be careful...

Not every anomaly remains still.


FEATURES

🚆 Explore a mysterious train inspired by the early 1900s.


👁️ Find and identify dozens of unique anomalies.

📻 Use your limited radio device to detect hidden anomalies.

❤️ Three lives—every mistake brings you closer to death.

💀 Multiple unique death sequences.

🔍 Increasing difficulty with easy, medium, and hard anomalies.

🚪 Reach the final compartment and uncover the truth behind the journey.



Will you reach the conductor... or become another passenger lost forever?

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a war-band. Pack their bags. Feed the weak to the strong. Then throw your army at a REAL player's — saved as a ghost, matched to your strength, fought on your schedule. A thousand rivals are out there, and none of them know they're about to lose.

⚔️ PICK YOUR FACTION

Five armies with opposing fantasies and their own mechanics:

• HIGHCREST — a holy chivalric kingdom: elite knights vs a peasant levy swarm, clerics that bring the fallen back.

• THE BONE LEGION — marching undead: a cheap risen horde, a bone-armor wall, and necromancers that raise more mid-fight.

• THE BLOODHORDE — a savage monster warband: berserk rage, WAAAGH momentum, brute regeneration.

• ELDERWOOD — the moonlit elf court: crit-dancing moonblades behind a thorned grove wall, and a drake that grows up mid-run.

• IRONCLAW — dwarves whose runesmiths permanently forge their kin stronger every single battle.

🎒 THE BACKPACK IS THE BUILD

Every unit carries its own 3×3 backpack. Items have real shapes — pack a two-handed cleaver next to the right relics and adjacency combos light up. Craft items into stronger ones, hand a mage's soul gem to a footman and watch him cast, or build a carry around army-scaling gear.

🍖 FEED YOUR CHAMPIONS

Units level by CONSUMING other units — and absorb their traits when they do. Your army isn't a pile of copies; it's a handful of named veterans you've grown all run. Max a unit's level and it ASCENDS into an evolved form.

👑 COMMANDERS THAT GROW

Draft a commander, then draft their skills as you win — from economy engines to army-wide doctrines, including permanent, run-long growth that compounds every round.

🏆 CLIMB THE LADDER

Ranked runs settle Elo against the very armies that beat you. Seasons, per-faction mastery, and a ladder of real players' builds to study and counter.

A run takes 20–40 minutes. Lose, learn, and go again — the next build is always one more run away.

🌐 ONLINE BY DESIGN

Every opponent is a real player's saved army — so your army (and your Steam display name) travels to other players' battles, and anonymous match stats help us balance the game. That's it. No ads, no data selling, no tracking — your Steam ID never even leaves your machine. Questions or data removal: contact@n1ghtmarestudios.com.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pixel Airport Tycoon 3D

Plan, build and manage your very own airport – from your first small runway all the way to an international hub. Pixel Airport Tycoon 3D is the big evolution of the airport-building classic: experience your airport either in the classic top-down 2D view or in a full 3D world with a free-orbit camera, shadows and a day/night mood – switchable at any time with a single key.

2D & 3D – your airport, your perspective

  • Switchable view – Toggle any time between the clear top-down 2D view and an immersive 3D world.

  • Free 3D camera – Rotate, tilt and zoom freely around your site and watch operations from every angle.

  • Real 3D models – Aircraft, buildings, vehicles, towers and trees as detailed 3D objects with dynamic lighting.

Build your infrastructure

Construct terminals, runways, taxiways and aprons. Lay underground fuel pipelines and baggage belts, power everything up and connect your site to the outside world with a road network.

  • Over 40 building types – Terminals, runways, towers, fuel depots, service depots, hotels, parking garages, fire station, hospital, power plants and much more.

  • 3 runway sizes – Small, medium and large runways for different aircraft classes, each configurable for arrivals, departures or both.

  • 4 terminal tiers + interior design – From a simple terminal to a large hub. Place check-in desks, gates, security checkpoints, shops, duty-free, restaurants, lounges and restrooms inside.

  • Free placement – Build on a large grid with rotation, relocate buildings later and buy new land to expand.

Two airport types

  • Commercial airport – Terminals, passengers, cargo and full infrastructure all the way to a major hub.

  • Private propeller airfield – Small runways and private parking stands for propeller planes – the compact way in, with no terminal required.

Flight operations & air traffic

  • Different aircraft classes – Small, medium and large passenger aircraft plus private propeller planes, each with their own handling and runway-length requirements.

  • Towers & air traffic controllers – Three tower sizes determine how many aircraft you can handle at once; hire controllers to keep traffic flowing.

  • Arrivals & departures in real time – Track the landing queue and flight board as planes land, taxi to their stands, get serviced and take off again.

Cargo, special freight & customs

Build a complete cargo hub – far more than just cargo stands:

  • Cargo terminals & stands for small and large freight aircraft.

  • Special freight – Dedicated depots for refrigerated cargo, live animals, express freight and hazardous goods, each with their own vehicles and requirements.

  • Customs handling – Build a customs office and process international cargo by the book.

  • Cargo contracts – Sign deals with freight companies, build reputation and earn bonus payouts.

Staff, vehicles & logistics

An airport only runs with the right team and a well-drilled fleet. All vehicles navigate your service and road network intelligently.

  • Staff system – Build a staff center and hire fuel operators, baggage and catering crews, ramp agents, cleaning and de-icing staff, technicians, customs officers, air traffic controllers and more.

  • Plenty of service vehicles – Fuel trucks, baggage, catering, cleaning and wash vehicles, de-icing trucks, cargo haulers, customs vehicles and fire trucks.

  • Fleet manager – Keep an eye on every vehicle's condition, repair them and research upgrades to electric ground vehicles.

Weather & de-icing

  • Dynamic weather – Snow, fog, storms and thunderstorms affect flight operations.

  • De-icing – When it snows, every aircraft – passenger, private and cargo – must be de-iced before departure. Build de-icing depots, or operations grind to a halt.

  • Weather station – Get forecasts and prepare for bad weather in time.

Economy, airlines & finance

  • Fuel in liters – Realistic fuel levels and consumption; fuel prices fluctuate randomly (roughly $4,000–$12,000) with no predictable trend.

  • Many revenue streams – Landing and passenger fees, refueling, baggage, catering, cleaning, de-icing, maintenance, cargo, hotel, parking garages and terminal shops.

  • Flexible pricing – Adjust nine fee types individually (50–200%) and find the balance between profit and traffic.

  • Airline & cargo contracts – Negotiate with airlines and freight companies, meet their requirements and grow your reputation.

  • Banking system – Take out loans to grow faster and pay them back with interest.

Research & expansion

  • Extensive research tree – Unlock new terminals, runways, towers, parking stands, cargo types, services, fuel upgrades, and economy and technology bonuses.

  • Fleet upgrades – Increase the vehicle capacity of your depots across multiple tiers.

  • Land purchase – Expand your site zone by zone into a sprawling international airport.

Environment & energy

  • Power grid – Supply your airport with power plants, solar panels and floodlight masts – no power, no operations.

  • CO₂ balance – Keep an eye on your emissions, pay CO₂ tax or buy certificates.

  • Sustainability – Research sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), solar energy, recycling and electric vehicles to shrink your footprint.

Ratings, security & emergencies

  • Passenger rating (6 stars) – Boost satisfaction with hotels, parking garages, catering, baggage handling, bus stops and more.

  • Security rating (4 stars) – Secure your site with fencing, fire station, security building and windsock – only then can planes take off and land.

  • Emergencies – Handle emergency landings with fire trucks and a hospital, and keep operations running safely.

Atmosphere & comfort

  • Day/night cycle – Enjoy atmospheric lighting including runway lights at night – automatic or set manually.

  • Atmospheric music – 11 music tracks in rotation, plus a spoken welcome message.

  • Clean HUD & help system – All key stats at a glance, a getting-started checklist, notifications and a detailed in-game guide.

  • Comfortable controls – Mouse-wheel zoom, camera movement via WASD/arrow keys or screen edge, and right-click context menus.

Saving, languages & options

  • Multiple named save slots – Save and load as many airports as you like; save files can also be imported from disk.

  • 7 languages – Fully playable in English, German, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Russian, Spanish and French.

  • Four speeds – Pause, 1x, 2x and 4x for relaxed or fast-paced play.

  • Adjustable options – Screen-edge scrolling, interface size, 3D graphics quality and notifications.

Build your dream airport

Whether it's a cozy propeller airfield or a massive international hub with cargo, customs and airline contracts – in Pixel Airport Tycoon 3D you set the pace. Plan smart, invest wisely and make your airport the best in the world!

Whether it's a cozy propeller airfield or a massive international hub with cargo, customs and airline contracts – in Pixel Airport Tycoon 3D you set the pace. Plan smart, invest wisely and make your airport the best in the world!

store_data.about_the_game:
RUINSEND

Descend into the Underhold. Recover what was lost. Make it back alive.

RUINSEND is a first-person extraction dungeon crawler set beneath the abandoned frontier settlement of Hollowreach.

A generation ago, every expedition into the ancient Underhold disappeared. The settlement fell silent, its people scattered and its history was buried beneath the earth.

Now, you are the first adventurer willing to descend.

Prepare your equipment at Camp, enter procedurally assembled dungeon levels and explore dangerous handcrafted rooms filled with enemies, traps, resources, treasure and forgotten secrets.

Every movement and committed action advances dungeon time. Enemies react as you explore, making positioning, preparation and careful decision-making more important than fast reflexes.

The deeper you travel, the greater the rewards—but everything carried during an expedition is at risk. You must decide when to keep pushing forward and when to return to the entrance and extract.

Die in the Underhold and your expedition’s loot and equipped gear are lost.

Escape successfully and your backpack returns with you to Hollowreach, where recovered resources, equipment and relics can strengthen future expeditions and help rebuild the settlement.

Explore a Changing Dungeon

Each expedition assembles handcrafted encounter rooms into a new dungeon layout. Discover hidden passages, unlock sealed chambers, navigate environmental hazards and descend through increasingly dangerous regions of the Underhold.

Previously visited floors remain changed during your expedition, allowing you to backtrack through opened doors, defeated enemies and looted rooms.

Choose Risk or Survival

Better equipment and rarer resources wait deeper underground, but every additional room places your expedition at greater risk.

Leaving alive is a victory.

Greed is the danger.

Rebuild Hollowreach

Use successfully extracted resources to restore the ruined settlement and bring its specialists home. Reconstructed facilities unlock new services, equipment, supplies and ways to prepare for future expeditions.

As Hollowreach grows, the discoveries brought back from below begin to reveal what caused The Silence—and what the ancient Wardens were truly protecting.

Build Your Adventurer

Find weapons, armour, tools and unusual equipment with different properties and affixes. Identify mysterious items, manage hunger and status effects, discover hidden curses and adapt your loadout to the dangers ahead.

Key Features

  • Deliberate first-person dungeon exploration

  • Extraction-based risk and reward

  • Procedurally assembled handcrafted dungeon rooms

  • Persistent Camp reconstruction and progression

  • Equipment, affixes, identification and hidden curses

  • Hunger, traps and interacting status effects

  • Multi-floor expeditions with in-run backtracking

  • Enemies with readable behaviours and pursuit

  • Atmospheric environments, lighting and sound

  • A developing mystery told through ruins, relics and recovered history

Rebuild Hollowreach, uncover the truth behind The Silence and descend far enough to confront the presence buried beneath the Underhold.

store_data.about_the_game:
A market that remembers being flooded

Every market in Grey Market has real buyers. Not a price curve. A population. Sell into one hard enough and you exhaust the people willing to pay well, the price craters in front of you, and it stays down until they recover. Leave a market alone and it comes back.

That one rule is the whole game. Where you send product matters as much as how much you make.

Run the operation, not the numbers

Source, lab, stockpile, street. Product moves through a chain you can watch, and every stage tells you what is actually holding you back: the lab outpacing the street, the stockpile overflowing, a market you have already flooded. You fix the bottleneck, not the number.

  • Eight markets, each with its own buyers, prices and capacity, each recovering on its own clock.

  • Route your product. Push a market past its comfortable rate for less money per unit, or hold it and let its buyers come back.

  • Heat and busts. Dealing draws attention, and getting caught costs you time, not just cash.

  • Rival crews take territory you neglect. A rival eating your buyers costs you money with no coded penalty at all. The market simply has fewer people left to sell to.

  • A crew of specialists, each of whom takes a cut.

  • Twenty crews in the city, and a ladder to the top of it.

It runs without you

The operation earns while the game is closed, and it keeps earning for hours. Come back to a full stockpile, a payout, and a city that moved while you were gone.

The long game

Refine your product through seven grades. Take all eight markets. Climb to #1 in the city, then find out what happens when every crew below you starts paying tribute instead of taking territory, and the books can finally go legitimate.

content_descriptors.notes:
Grey Market casts you as a criminal running a contraband operation.
Producing, refining and distributing illegal product is the entire
subject of the game, and it is presented favourably in the sense that
you profit from it and the game does not moralise about it.

No specific drug is ever named and no drug use is shown. The product
appears only as purity grades and street names, and buyers are
abstract populations rather than people.

There is no depicted violence, no blood, no sexual content and no
profanity. Conflict with rival crews is resolved through menu choices
and lines in a text log, never shown on screen. Police pressure is
represented as a meter and a period of downtime.

store_data.about_the_game:
The fog has changed everything.

An old train has stopped at the edge of an infected sector. People are disappearing beyond the electrical perimeter, fragments of alien messages can be heard from the radio, and the automated MELISSA system continues to broadcast warnings, the meaning of which is becoming increasingly disturbing.

The engineer lives alone on the train and tries not to remember what happened before. But one day, a girl named Mia appears within the perimeter. She claims to be uninfected and asks for help.

Can she be trusted?

And can you trust your own memories?

The Last Train is an atmospheric story-driven game with elements of visual novel, exploration, and survival. You will explore the old train and surrounding areas, search for supplies, read diary entries, make decisions, and gradually reconstruct the events of the past.

FEATURES

  • Gloomy post-Soviet atmosphere.

  • Non-linear storyline and decisions with consequences.

  • Explore the train and abandoned locations.

  • Character relationship system.

  • A diary with entries, a map, items, and discovered clues.

  • Hand-drawn scenes, animations, and atmospheric sound design.

  • A story about memory, guilt, loneliness, and the struggle to maintain one's humanity.

  • Sometimes the worst things aren't just outside the perimeter.

store_data.about_the_game:
Set within the malfunctioning archives of the Svalbard Global Seed Vault, Lords takes players on a twisting voyage to the archive's dark heart as a rogue AI seeks to rewrite all of human history. 

Loosely adapted from the works of Joseph Conrad, the game contains over 100 (human) hand-drawn illustrations and cutscenes; more than 300 (human) recorded voice lines; and at least 13 (human) written fourth wall breaks and Star Trek references. 

Blending classic Tower Defence gameplay with a unique new general knowledge quiz mechanic, the game tasks players with helping the archive's curator, Marlowe, as he battles to regain control over the vault's archive and solve the mystery of its origins. 

Now in closed Beta, Lords will release to its target audience of 9 people (at least three of whom aren't direct relatives of the developer) in Q4 2026.

store_data.about_the_game:
Transform your curiosity into knowledge as you build circuits, solve challenges, and discover how electronics work in practice.

Maker Circuit is an educational simulation game where every challenge teaches a real electronics concept. Instead of simply reading about components, you'll experiment, test ideas, and learn by building your own circuits.

Take on the role of a young maker and use LEDs, resistors, sensors, buttons, motors, and microcontrollers to solve increasingly complex problems.

Every component has a specific purpose, and it's up to you to discover the best way to use it.

Connect wires, organize your workbench, and watch each circuit come to life in real time. If something doesn't work, investigate the problem, find the mistake, and try again.

Learning is part of the experience.

Each level presents a different problem to solve.

Throughout your adventure, you'll learn important concepts such as:

  • Electric current

  • Resistance

  • Polarity

  • Sensors

  • Digital inputs and outputs

  • Motor control

store_data.about_the_game:
《Boar Knight》 is a medieval turn-based looter RPG. You play as a lone black-iron knight, venturing deep into goblin lairs, skeletal graveyards, and web-choked abysses. Cut a path through them with sword, spear, and hunting bow, carry every piece of loot back to town, and forge yourself into someone capable of surviving the next expedition.

But combat works a little differently here: your skills are not buttons lined up on a hotbar, waiting for their cooldowns to end. Instead, they are dealt into your hand as cards at the start of every turn.

[h2]When Skills Become Cards, Every Move Becomes a Choice[/h2]

Each turn, the skills you have learned are shuffled back into your hand. You have 4 Action Points and a random set of possibilities to work with.

Quick Slash, Heavy Thrust, Whirlwind Arrow, Poison Coating, Iron Wall, Defensive Counter—what you play, the order you play it in, and where you spend those 4 points turn every round into a small tactical puzzle. You cannot simply repeat the same rotation, because every hand is different.

This is not a traditional card game. There is no complicated deckbuilding and no thick rulebook to study. The cards are simply your skills—only now, they force you to make meaningful choices.

[h2]Sword, Spear, and Hunting Bow: One Knight, Three Fighting Styles[/h2]

You carry three weapons and automatically switch to the appropriate stance whenever you play a card. Close-range slashes, mid-range thrusts, and long-range arrows can flow seamlessly into one another within the same turn.

Some skills reward you for constantly switching stances. Others encourage you to commit to a single weapon and keep attacking. Certain enemies may even begin to recognize—and punish—your habits.

[h2]Poison, Fire, Frost, and the Thrill of Combos[/h2]

Coat your next attack in poison, flame, or frost, causing enemies to bleed, burn, or freeze during their own turns. Chain duplicate cards together with Multi-Slash to unleash an entire sequence of attacks.

Recognize an opportunity that exists for only a single turn, then use it to wipe out an entire group of enemies at once.

[h2]Relics That Give Every Run Its Own Identity[/h2]

The relics you find are not merely another collection of percentage bonuses. They change the way you play.

One might make the first strike of every turn exceptionally deadly. Another may cause an elemental enchantment to last for the entire round. Some may even grant you an additional turn.

Once you assemble two or three relics, your build begins to take shape—and your next expedition may play completely differently.

[h2]Loot Is the True Long-Term Progression[/h2]

Every descent is an expedition. Branching paths lead to regular battles, elite ambushes, blessing chambers, treasure vaults, mysterious merchants, and a boss waiting at the end.

Weapons and armour wear down in battle, but new equipment can also be taken from fallen enemies. Every item you bring back to town remains in your collection, helping you travel a little farther next time.

Relics and temporarily learned skills disappear when an expedition ends. Your equipment collection does not.

[h2]Bosses That Fight Back Intelligently[/h2]

The goblins, undead, and spider swarms each have their own leaders—and they are more than ordinary enemies with larger health bars.

They summon reinforcements, adapt to your fighting style, and place unwanted cards into your hand. Defeating them requires changing your rhythm, not simply attacking more times.

[list]
[] Turn-based card combat where skills become cards and a new hand is dealt every turn
[] Seamlessly combine sword, spear, and hunting-bow stances
[] Poison, fire, and frost enchantments, plus multi-hit combo attacks
[] Run-defining relics that change how you play
[] Equipment drops, durability, crafting, and long-term loot progression
[] Branching expeditions across multiple regions with escalating difficulty
[*] A grim medieval art style and mechanically distinct boss battles
[/list]

Failure does not leave you with nothing.

Return to town. Repair your sword. Then descend once more.

store_data.about_the_game:
Brawlzerker throws you and up to three friends into a brutal, wave-based brawler built for the couch. Pick a hero, drop into the arena, and fight your way through escalating waves of enemies,  solo or with a full squad of four.

No one gets left waiting. Drop-in multiplayer means a friend can join mid-fight at any time: press a button, cycle through the hero roster in a quick corner picker, confirm, and they're in the action. No lobby, no pause, no interruption to the players already fighting.

Between waves, survivors head to the shop to gear up. Spend your earnings across loot, weapons, items, and stat upgrades — including a gacha-style loot pull for a chance at something powerful.

Every player resolves their own offers and readies up independently, so the pace between rounds is as frantic or as careful as your group wants it to be. The moment everyone's ready, it's back into the fight.

With a growing hero roster, run-to-run loot variance, and the freedom to add or lose players on the fly, every session plays out differently. Whether you're grinding solo or piling four controllers onto one couch, Brawlzerker is built for chaotic, competitive, "one more wave" co-op.

store_data.about_the_game:
The surface has fallen. Down is your only way forward.

Dustfall is a single-player descent roguelite shooter. Alien life has overrun the surface, and a scanning front steadily pushes deeper underground. Once it locks onto you, hunters descend from above.

Blast through the strata, trigger cave-ins, and dive deeper. Every act of destruction may open a path to survival, or bring an entire ruin down on top of you.

THE TERRAIN IS YOUR WEAPON

The underground is made of pixels that flow, burn, explode, and collapse.

Ignite oil and let fire spread through the terrain.

Detonate powder caches to blast a route through solid rock.

Remove crucial supports and bring a collapse down on your enemies.

Every tunnel you carve and every cavity you blast open changes the battle and your escape route.

FROM A SINGLE SHOT TO A DISASTER

Choose starting payloads such as the Drill Round or Grenade, then shape your build through three-way upgrades during each descent: enhance your weapon, gain passive abilities, or switch payloads.

At the start of every descent, the surface scan begins to close in. Stay too close to the upper layers and you will be detected, drawing increasingly dangerous hunters. Dig beyond the scan's reach to earn a brief moment of safety.

Only by reaching the bottom of a layer and defeating its core can you fall into the next ruin.

SIX BURIED RUINS

Each of the six layers has its own terrain materials, environmental reactions, enemy ecosystem, and core boss.

The ruins and echoes buried in the strata tell of those who once searched for a place to live by digging downward, just as you do. The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to ignore one question: is there really a home beneath the earth?

  • Fully destructible, simulated pixel terrain

  • Roguelite builds with freely combinable payloads and upgrades

  • Constant descent pressure from the surface scan and alien hunters

  • Six layers and six core bosses

  • Three endings, plus Cataclysm Mode after the ending

store_data.about_the_game:
[h2]About Twenty One Point[/h2]

This is more than Hit and Stand. Built on classic blackjack scoring, you spend [b]Mana[/b] to cast skills that reshape your hand, the deck order, and the fight itself—deckbuilding and in-battle decisions matter equally.

[h2]Mana & Skills[/h2]

Manage your Mana in combat and fire skills at the right moment—turning “exactly 21” into a system you can play, not just hope for.

[b]Card Awaken Skills[/b]

Awakened cards can spend Mana to use suit-exclusive skills:

[list]

[*] [b]Demolition[/b]: Disrupt the enemy hand

[*] [b]Undercut[/b]: Discard and rewrite your own draw rhythm

[*] [b]Sheep Steal[/b]: Seize a key enemy card

[*] [b]Star Gaze[/b]: Peek at and reorder the top of the deck

[/list]

[b]Four Artifact Skills[/b]

Collect the matching artifacts to unlock active combat skills:

[list]

[*] [b]Strong Exchange[/b]: Spend Mana to trade cards with the enemy

[*] [b]Reforge[/b]: Spend Mana to discard a card and draw another

[*] [b]Insight[/b]: Spend Mana on suit judgments to hunt better cards

[*] [b]Ingenuity[/b]: Draw multiple cards and keep the best one

[/list]

[h2]Core Features[/h2]

[list]

[*] [b]Blackjack Duels[/b]: Walk the line to 21, balancing bust risk against skill payoff.

[*] [b]Deckbuilding[/b]: Collect special cards and empower your deck through Awaken, Forge, and Burn.

[*] [b]Artifacts[/b]: Mix passives with the four active skills above to form distinct builds.

[*] [b]Roguelike Runs[/b]: Fight through the map—battles, elites, bosses, shops, and events.

[*] [b]Standard Mode[/b]: Jump into more direct matches whenever you want.

[/list]

[h2]Classes[/h2]

Choose a class to begin your run, each with a suit focus and playstyle:

[list]

[*] [b]Xuanfeng Ke[/b] — Spades, Attack-leaning

[*] [b]Chishi Wei[/b] — Hearts, Shield-leaning

[*] [b]Duobao Xian[/b] — Diamonds, Gold-leaning

[*] [b]Yantian Ke[/b] — Clubs, Mana-leaning

[*] [b]Junheng Shi[/b] — Balanced across all four suits

[/list]

Ready your Mana—and your next hand.
