store_data.about_the_game:
BREAK IT. STEAL IT. ESCAPE.

Pony is a rebellious teenage girl looking for somewhere to blow off all her pent-up stress.

In HIGHPONY: SPACE ERROR, she charges through maze-like space facilities, breaking hostile machines and anything else that happens to get in her way.

Breaking things feels good.

The only problem is that the Space Police are following the trail of destruction Pony leaves behind.

Find the exit, climb to the next level, and keep moving before the pursuit catches up.

THE BROKEN UNIVERSE IS YOUR PLAYGROUND

Monsters, machines, and objects scattered throughout the station are all part of Pony’s playground.

Break whatever gets in your way, clear a path through the chaos, or simply enjoy the satisfying moment when one more piece of the universe stops working.

For Pony, destruction is more than a way to survive.

It is how she blows off steam.

BREAK THEM. TAKE THEIR POWER.

Breaking a monster is only the beginning.

Once an enemy enters a broken state, Pony can rip out one of its signature parts and transform it into a powerful single-use skill.

Fire the stolen ability straight back at its former owner. Save it for a tougher enemy. Or unleash it to wipe out whatever is blocking the way forward.

Every stolen skill can only be used once, so each one creates a choice.

What will you steal?

When will you use it?

And what might be waiting in the next room?

FIND YOUR WAY. GET STRONGER. ESCAPE.

Each level is a maze, with an exit hidden somewhere ahead.

Explore the facility, hunt down monsters with useful abilities, and prepare more powerful skills for the dangers to come.

But the longer you stay, the greater the risk becomes.

The Space Police are determined to stop Pony’s rampage, pursuing her along the path she has already taken. The more time she spends enjoying the destruction, the closer they get.

Will you keep exploring in search of a stronger skill, or race toward the exit with whatever power you already have?

TOO STRONG? STEAL SOMETHING STRONGER.

Some enemies are too dangerous to defeat through ordinary attacks alone.

When something powerful blocks the way, Pony does not have to fight fairly.

Find another machine. Break it. Steal its strongest part. Then turn that power against the enemy that stopped you.

A difficult encounter can become an explosive reversal once the right ability falls into Pony’s hands.

The stronger the machines become, the more destructive the skills she can take from them.

A SMALL UNIVERSE BUILT FOR BIG TROUBLE

HIGHPONY: SPACE ERROR combines stylish 3D action, miniature sci-fi environments, maze-like levels, destructible machines, and a pursuit that becomes more dangerous the longer you stay.

Break the station.

Steal its power.

Escape before the Space Police catch you.

Cause Chaos. Get Stronger. Escape the Error.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Last Day of Orion Theatre is a short first-person horror game set in an old cinema. You’re an employee working the closing shift before the theatre undergoes renovation. Complete tasks, explore the building, use the terminal, check cameras, and uncover what’s going on.

A NIGHT OF ROUTINE 

Your final shift begins with ordinary responsibilities. Complete maintenance tasks, prepare the theatre for renovation, organize equipment and respond to requests from your manager through the staff terminal. However, the longer the night continues - the less ordinary it becomes.

SOMETHING IS WRONG

Explore every corner of Orion Theatre. Search backstage corridors. Descend into technical service tunnels. Use surveillance cameras, archived tapes and old terminal systems to piece together what happened before it is too late.

KEY FEATURES

  • Immersive first-person psychological horror  

  • Authentic Art Deco cinema inspired by classic American theatres 

  • Interactive CRT terminals and vintage mobile phones

  • Environmental storytelling and exploration 

  • Multiple endings based on your decision  

  • Slow-building suspense

store_data.about_the_game:
Class is in session. The erasers aren't.

Sneaky Eraser is a turn-based physics party battler for 2–6 players. When the teacher turns away, an ordinary desk becomes an arena. Take turns aiming, charging, and launching your eraser—knock rivals off the table to eliminate them. Hard hits build noise; make too much racket and the Teacher's Hand comes for you. Party up online or goof off on the couch—relive the thrill of messing around in class.

One Shot, One Chance

Every launch can decide the match: read the desk, guess the angle, commit to your power. Erasers collide, rebound, scrape the edge, and chain into chaos—the board shifts in an instant. Fall off the table and you're out; everyone else keeps playing until one eraser remains.

Don't Get Caught

This isn't your average break-time game. The harder the hit, the louder the noise; cause too much commotion and the Teacher's Hand drops from above to grab the unlucky eraser out of the game. To win, you need to know how to bump—and how to behave.

Different Classes, Different Rules

Same core loop, different ways to win:

  • Math Class — Equations and doodles cover the desk; pick-ups are scattered across the board. Aim, charge, and slam into them to power up your next shot—treat the homework like a battlefield, not an assignment.

  • Art Class — Line art on the page, colored droplets bouncing everywhere; paint the most to win—as long as nobody knocks you off the table first.

  • PE Class — The desk becomes a pitch; kick the ball into other erasers to eliminate them. Scoring is a bonus—sending rivals flying is how you win.

    Every class runs on the same aim–launch–physics core, but each one plays by different rules—easy to binge a few rounds in a row.

Features

  • Turn-based tactics — read the board, pick your angle, and commit every shot.

  • Physics chaos — knock-offs, rebounds, and edge-of-table drama on a 3D classroom desk.

  • Classroom tension — too much noise brings the Teacher's Hand.

  • Multiple class modes — Math, Art, PE, and more maps on the way.

  • Local multiplayer — 2–6 players on one PC, shared screen.

  • Online multiplayer — play with friends via Steam (2–6 players).

  • Full controller support — keyboard and gamepad.

Good to Know

  • Best with friends—in the same room or online.

  • More maps and modes are in active development.

Credits

Music: "Early Encounters" and "Sneaky Suspicion" from "Bitwise - An Eight Bit Video Game Soundtrack" by tcarisland, sourced from , licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).

store_data.about_the_game:
Three years ago, you came to the city with nothing but a plan. Now you're behind on rent, out of options, and living under someone else's roof.

Synvelia is a choice-driven visual novel about rebuilding your life — one relationship, one decision, one day at a time.

🏠 A Household Full of Secrets

Elara and Marcus own the house you live in. Izabella and Milan share it with you. Lina — the house's quiet, wise caretaker, and an openly trans woman — keeps it running. Everyone has a public face — and a private one. The closer you get, the more they let you see.

🧭 Two Paths, Countless Directions

Play as a man or a woman — including an optional transgender journey — and decide who you become along the way. A dynamic identity system lets your body, confidence, and relationships evolve based on the choices you actually make, not a menu you pick once and forget.

💬 Real Relationship Depth

Every character tracks affection, respect, and how far things go. Conversations matter. Decay is real — ignore someone too long, and you'll feel it.

🎬 Discover Their Secrets

Unlock each character's hidden side through short cinematic scenes — but you'll have to earn their trust first.

📱 A Life Outside the House

Manage your money, your time, your body, and even your own social media presence as your story unfolds day by day.

 🔞 Adult Content Notice

Synvelia contains explicit adult content intended only for players aged 18 and older. All characters depicted are fictional adults.

🤖 AI Content Disclosure

Character artwork was generated using a custom-trained AI model, then manually curated and edited by the development team.

 All characters depicted are fictional adults.

store_data.about_the_game:
PURSUE JUSTICE IN THE MIDDLE AGES

King’s Detectives is a 2–4 player co-op detective game set in the fictional Kingdom of Westmoor, inspired by medieval England.

Appointed as royal detectives by King Edmund IV, you must investigate mysterious crimes across the kingdom. Examine crime scenes, collect physical evidence, question witnesses, follow suspects, and uncover contradictions hidden within their statements.

Every investigation presents a different mystery. Accusing the wrong person could condemn an innocent suspect while allowing the real culprit to escape.

FROM MURDER TO PALACE INTRIGUE

Crime reaches every corner of Westmoor. Your investigations may involve:

• Unsolved murders
• Mysterious disappearances
• Theft and robbery
• Poisonings
• Power struggles among the nobility
• Inheritance and land disputes
• Conflicts between peasants and lords
• Secret conspiracies within the royal court
• Crimes involving rebellious princes and princesses

Some cases may begin as ordinary crimes, only to reveal secrets that threaten the future of the entire kingdom.

EXPLORE THE KINGDOM OF WESTMOOR

Travel through different regions of Westmoor and investigate a wide variety of locations:

• Grand castles
• Bustling marketplaces
• Small villages
• Large medieval towns
• Monasteries
• Inns and taverns
• Forest roads
• Dark cellars
• Noble estates
• Hidden rooms and secret passages

Every location contains clues waiting to be discovered and secrets waiting to be uncovered.

2–4 PLAYER CO-OP INVESTIGATIONS

Work together and divide the investigation among your team.

While one detective examines the crime scene, another can question witnesses, search nearby buildings, or follow a suspicious individual.

Communication and teamwork are essential. A seemingly insignificant detail discovered by one detective may become the missing piece that solves the entire case.

GATHER EVIDENCE AND RECONSTRUCT THE TRUTH

Search each location carefully and piece together what really happened.

• Examine physical evidence
• Read letters and official documents
• Discover hidden rooms and passages
• Pick locked doors and containers
• Investigate suspects’ backgrounds
• Compare witness statements
• Identify contradictions
• Reconstruct the timeline of events

The truth may be hidden in a single overlooked detail.

DELIVER YOUR VERDICT

At the end of every investigation, your team must make a decision.

Is your evidence strong enough? Have you identified the real culprit, or are you about to condemn an innocent person?

A wrong accusation may allow the true criminal to escape. Your decisions can affect not only the outcome of the case, but also the future of the Kingdom of Westmoor.

JUSTICE IS IN YOUR HANDS

Betrayal, greed, revenge, jealousy, and the hunger for power...

Everyone in Westmoor has something to hide.

Will you uncover the truth before it is too late?

store_data.about_the_game:
Two Children in a World Where Emotions Change Everything

When their parents mysteriously disappear, two children embark on a cooperative 3D adventure through the Sans-Dessus-Dessous, a universe where every world is shaped by a different emotion.

To move forward, they must work together, understand the rules created by these emotions, and learn how to reverse them.

Worlds Shaped by Emotions

Each world embodies a different emotion, with its own rules, challenges, and puzzles.

Explore peaceful forests, melancholic deserts, mysterious mines, snow-covered mountains, and worlds suspended in outer space. Environments and music evolve from one world to the next, constantly changing the way you play.

Reverse Gravity

Walk across ceilings, uncover hidden paths, and experience the world from a whole new perspective.

Reversing gravity transforms the way you move, changes the rules of each level and its music, and opens up new paths to explore.

Work Together to Move Forward

Play solo with an AI-controlled companion, share the adventure in local co-op, or play online using Steam Remote Play Together.

Solve puzzles, combine the children’s unique abilities, and gradually unlock new powers, including teleportation, flight, invisibility, and a magical shout.

A dynamic shared camera follows both characters and automatically splits when they move apart, giving each player freedom while keeping the two children connected.

Face the Machines of the Sans-Dessus-Dessous

Use the children’s complementary abilities to dodge incoming attacks and overcome the machines standing in your way.

Some worlds are guarded by unique bosses whose mechanics are inspired by the emotions they embody. Study their behaviour, cooperate, and discover how to exploit their weaknesses.

Features

  • A cooperative 3D adventure blending platforming, exploration, puzzles, and combat

  • Play solo with an AI-controlled companion, in local co-op, or through Steam Remote Play Together

  • A dynamic shared camera

  • Worlds and gameplay mechanics shaped by emotions

  • Gravity-reversing gameplay

  • Complementary powers to unlock

  • Accessible combat and unique boss encounters

  • A colourful, stylised 3D universe

  • A dynamic soundtrack that evolves with the gameplay

  • An adventure designed for players of all ages

Modern-day North America lies in ruins. A mysterious System has warped reality and turned people into monsters. The survivors must fight for every chance to regain control of their world.

Your journey is shaped by difficult decisions and morally ambiguous choices. Decide whether to stand with humanity, trust Earth's AI, or submit to the will of the System.

System Arrival is a top-down action RPG that combines intense combat sessions with the development of your own bunker.

Fight without auto-aim

Victory depends on your decisions. Fight with firearms or engage in melee combat, dodge at the right moment, and upgrade powerful abilities. Every choice shapes the flow of battle.

Build your own playstyle

Intelligence, Constitution, Strength, and Agility shape your character's abilities in real time. Combine attributes, skills, and random mutations to adapt to every expedition.

Study monster DNA

Eliminate mutated creatures to unlock new implants, abilities, and hidden crafting recipes. Use the DNA Laboratory to enhance implants, upgrade armor, and unlock advanced bunker construction technologies.

React to a changing battlefield

Enemies grow stronger, attack in coordinated groups, and constantly force you to reposition and adapt. The deeper you venture into an expedition, the harder it becomes to make it back alive.

Develop your bunker

Between expeditions, manage your bunker by assigning survivors to gather resources, training their skills, and unlocking new technologies. Your bunker serves as the hub of your progression and story-driven missions.

Every victory in a shattered world prepares you for the next encounter. Choose where your loyalty lies: stand with humanity, trust Earth's AI, or become part of the System.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are one of the last Devoiders—a pilot-knight bound to an ancient order, shielding what remains of civilization from The Void. This sentient hive-mind spawns swarms of ravenous atrocities driven by a single goal: to devour your soul and forge another mindless monster for their endless horde.

High-Mobility Shmup Combat meets Bullet Heaven

Dash, fly, and manage energy in real time. Balance lightweight mobility to dodge screens swarmed by relentless ennemies, or trade speed for heavy tactical firepower.

Capture & Summon Demons

Capture wild demons mid-battle to expand your build. Unleash them as combat summons. Defeat mighty Mega-Demons and summon them once per biome to alter the course of your run.

Forge & Synergize

Acquire a wide arsenal of relics and weapons, fine-tune your core stats, and fuse weapons together on the fly to forge unique, game-breaking armaments

Epic Boss Fights

Skill-check your reflexes against multi-phase elite foes and bosses that demand precise fight pattern understanding.`

And also...

Run Altering Encounters

Meet a wide cast of characters—from shady scoundrels to noble lords—at “The Wandering Cantina”. Make pivotal decisions that directly impact your gameplay and run.

Ascending World, Meta-Progression & High Replay-Value

Battle upward from subterranean depths to floating sky spires. Unlock new characters, weapons, relics and demons across runs while uncovering the tragic lore of the Devoiders fallen order.

Hand-Drawn Dark Fantasy Biomechanical Art

Immerse yourself into a fully human and hand-crafted frame-by-frame animated world, bringing to life a dark fantasy aesthetic inspired by surreal biomechanical horror.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are not the president - you are the factory.

Armory Doctrine is a real-time grand strategy game where you run a private arms manufacturer in a modern world sliding toward war. Governments rise and fall, fronts advance and collapse, embargoes tighten - and through it all, your production lines keep running.

BUILD YOUR ARSENAL

Start with a single assembly line. Expand into a sprawling industrial complex: place new production lines, secure raw materials from mines and refineries across the map, and grow from rifle batches into armored vehicles and beyond. Every input has a price, and every price has a politics.

EVERY SHIPMENT IS A DECISION

Your output goes where you send it. Sell to the highest bidder and bankroll your growth. Equip your own forces and shift a frontline. Grant arms to a proxy and create a client that owes you everything. Three channels, one production run - the allocation is the strategy.

THE WORLD SIMULATES, YOU PROFIT

A living geopolitical simulation runs beneath your factory: states trade, threaten, embargo and fight across a real-world map. Wars are not abstract multipliers - fronts are fought by the equipment you did (or didn't) deliver. Read the world's tensions like a market report, because that's exactly what they are.

ANALYSIS, NOT SIDES

No faction is glorified, no cause is sold to you. Armory Doctrine is a systems game about the machinery behind modern conflict - supply chains, incentives, and consequences. Where the weapons go is your call; what that makes you is the question the game keeps asking.

Real-world geography is used as a simulation setting; all scenarios, factions and events are fictional.

store_data.about_the_game:
⛏️ ABOUT THE GAME

Break through mountains. Unite peoples. Grow stronger.

You are a young miner who challenges a massive mountain. Your journey is not just about mining ore. It's a story of growing up, full of hard work, friendship, and victories. From a bold teenager proving his strength to an experienced master who unites scattered peoples and forges a path across an entire continent.

This is a cozy story about legacy, about how one person can connect the world, and about how true inheritance is not the mountains you've broken through, but the people you've inspired.

🏔️ GAMEPLAY

Dig. Lose. Start over. Grow stronger.

Strike the rock with your pickaxe, collect ore, sell it, and upgrade your gear. Every strike brings you closer to your goal. But the mountain resists. Boulders fall, stalactites crash down, geysers boil. If you don't escape in time—the cave will collapse, and you'll lose all the ore from that run. But experience and money invested in upgrades will stay with you. Start over, but stronger. When you break through a mountain completely, it stops collapsing. You unlock a new biome, new people, and new opportunities.

👥 FRIENDS AND MECHANICS

As you progress, you meet NPCs, each unlocking a unique mechanic. A miner friend starts visiting your previously broken-through caves and mining ore—this is passive income. A musician plays special melodies that buff you during runs. A fortune teller predicts events: when the cave will collapse, where rare ore is hidden, when a storm will come. A cart builder constructs tracks for quick evacuation before cave-ins. But most importantly—they become your family.

🌍 SETTING AND ATMOSPHERE

The game takes place at the turn of the 19th-20th centuries—the era of great constructions, steam engines, and the first railroads. It's a world without magic, but full of the romance of pioneers. Unique biomes: from green meadows and oak forests to snow-covered Alpine peaks and icy plateaus at the edge of the world. A cozy atmosphere: warm camps by the fire, the smell of fresh bread, the creak of wood, the clang of hammers. A world you'll want to return to.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a white dwarf: a burnt-out stellar remnant, small, dense, and mostly harmless. The rock field around you does not care. It closes in from every direction, and it gets worse with every minute you stay alive.

White Dwarf is a top-down survival shooter about holding onto a piece of empty space for as long as you can. Your weapon fires automatically at the nearest target, so the only things you control are where you stand and when you spend your cooldowns. Everything else comes down to the choices you make along the way.

The field fills in around you

The first wave is just a handful of slow rocks. Thirty seconds later, faster ones arrive. A minute in, things start shooting back. Then come enemies that shrug off damage until their armor is stripped away, and others that split into smaller problems when they die.

New enemy types arrive on their own timers, and they never replace what came before. They stack. The wide-open arena you started in gradually turns into a maze of narrow gaps you have to keep finding.

Bosses do not leave

Every few waves, the field makes room for something much larger, and each boss demands a different answer from you. Some sit behind a shield and absorb everything you throw at them. Some stay at a distance and bombard you from across the arena. Some overwhelm you with reinforcements faster than you can clear them. Others split into smaller versions of themselves the more damage they take. Figuring out which problem is in front of you is most of the fight.

Here's the twist: defeating a boss does not remove it from the run. Instead, a smaller version joins the regular enemy pool for every wave that follows. Whatever you kill, you keep fighting—in greater numbers, in ordinary waves, for the rest of the run. By surviving, you build the roster you'll face later.

Build it on the way up

Every level gives you three upgrades to choose from. Some simply increase your stats: damage, fire rate, health, movement speed, or pickup range. Others give you an entirely new button to press—an active ability on a cooldown that does things raw numbers never could. Clear the space around you. Blink through a wall of rocks. Turn your own kills into the next explosion.

Take the same upgrade five times, and it evolves into a perk: a permanent, named bonus layered on top of everything those five upgrades already gave you. Committing to a single path pays off far more than spreading yourself thin—and deciding which way to go is the choice you face at every level-up while the field keeps closing in.

Some perks never appear on the upgrade screen at all. Push two specific upgrade paths far enough in the same run, and they fuse into something neither could do alone: movement that leaves destruction behind, shots that change on impact, or abilities that reduce each other's cooldowns. Discovering those combinations is one of the biggest reasons to experiment with new builds.

Save your cooldowns

Your abilities are the buttons you save for when everything goes wrong. They turn the moment you're completely boxed in with nowhere left to move into a clean floor and a few precious seconds of breathing room—but only if you didn't waste them thirty seconds earlier on a threat that was never going to reach you.

Increase their area, shorten their cooldowns, and eventually transform how they work entirely, until the same button becomes a completely different decision than it was on your very first run.

Runs end. Progress does not.

Every run rewards you with Stardust based on how far you made it, and Stardust buys upgrades that persist.

Unlock permanent stat upgrades that improve the numbers you start every run with. Upgrade your abilities so they behave differently—not just better. Spend resources before a run to earn another chance after the wave that killed you, or reroll a level-up when none of the options fit your build.

Pick a better star

You begin as a white dwarf because that's all that's left after a star burns out. Stardust lets you become something brighter: swollen giants, roiling supergiants, and stranger remnants that spin fast enough to carve beams through their own halos.

Each star uses its own custom shader instead of a simple color swap, so every one feels like a truly different celestial object. Matching trails are included as well.

What's inside

  • Dozens of achievements across progression tracks that span Bronze through Diamond

  • Lifetime statistics tracked across every run you've ever played

  • A boss every few waves, each with its own mechanics and a smaller form that haunts the rest of the run

  • An enemy roster that keeps expanding the longer you survive

  • Unlockable active abilities, deep upgrade paths, and combination perks waiting to be discovered

  • Permanent between-run progression and unlockable star skins, each with its own unique shader

  • Steam Cloud support, so your progress follows you between machines

One currency, earned by playing and spent on making the next run stronger. No timers. No daily chores. Nothing to buy with real money. You play. You die. You grow a little stronger. Then you do it again.

What's inside

  • Dozens of achievements across progression tracks that span Bronze through Diamond

  • Lifetime statistics tracked across every run you've ever played

  • A boss every few waves, each with its own mechanics and a smaller form that haunts the rest of the run

  • An enemy roster that keeps expanding the longer you survive

  • Unlockable active abilities, deep upgrade paths, and combination perks waiting to be discovered

  • Permanent between-run progression and unlockable star skins, each with its own unique shader

  • Steam Cloud support, so your progress follows you between machines

One currency, earned by playing and spent on making the next run stronger. No timers. No daily chores. Nothing to buy with real money. You play. You die. You grow a little stronger. Then you do it again.
store_data.short_description: You are a dying star, and the rock field around you never stops closing in. Survive relentless waves, draft upgrades between levels, and save your cooldowns for when the gaps disappear. Every boss you defeat returns as a regular enemy for the rest of the run.

SPELLSTEEL is a free-to-play competitive collectible card game set in the ancient world of Kharadum.

The lost Kharadum Codex is said to contain the secret of limitless power, and every civilization races to claim it before the others.

Build powerful decks from hundreds of unique cards, command legendary Champions, summon dragons, demons, titans, and undead armies, then outplay opponents in tactical PvP battles where every decision matters.

Choose your civilization.

Master your strategy.

Shape the future of Kharadum.

Key Features

• Master six unique civilizations, each with its own playstyle and identity.

• Command legendary Champions with unique Hero Powers.

• Summon dragons, Titans, demons, undead legions, and mythical creatures.

• Build powerful decks and discover endless strategic combinations.

Human

Nature

Undead

Chaos

Brute strength, savage creatures, dragons, and unstoppable momentum.

store_data.about_the_game:
The forest remembers every shot.


Deep in the Nordic woods, the animals are fat, the air is cold, and old Väinö swears the four Legends of the forest are real. Grab your rifle. Prove him right.

Prey of The Wild is a hand-pixeled 2.5D hunting sim about patience, clean shots, and what happens after the trigger — every animal you take goes to the chopping block, every pelt funds better gear, and every upgrade brings you closer to prey that shouldn't exist.

HUNT

  • Track and shoot rabbits, foxes, deer, elk, birds and more across living, layered pixel forests
  • Hit the glowing weakspot for a clean kill — sloppy shots wound, and wounded prey runs
  • Push deeper into the woods where the animals get bigger, rarer, and worth far more

CARVE

  • Take every catch to the chopping block and carve it yourself — meat, pelts, and the occasional lucky find
  • Sell your haul, then spend it on rifles, deeper forest access, and gear that actually changes how you hunt

GEAR UP

  • Collect 14 hand-made charms — a rabbit's foot, a bear-bone drum, a ribbon of aurora — each bending the odds a different way
  • Earn legendary carving knives from the mightiest kills
  • Fill the Book of the Wild with every species you've taken

FACE THE LEGENDS

  • Four boss hunts guard the wild: the Hiisi Elk, the Ancient Pike, the Shadow Lion, and the White Bear King
  • When you're ready, Väinö puts on his sunglasses, grabs a beer, and walks you to the fight himself
  • He'll cheer your hits, and shout PERKELE! at your misses — recorded by an actual Finn
  • Every fallen Legend grants a permanent boost... beat the White Bear King and every sale pays DOUBLE

A small, complete game

No season pass, no crafting trees for the sake of crafting trees. Just a warm, funny, occasionally deadly Nordic hunting loop that respects your evening.

store_data.about_the_game:
When the lights go out, everyone can move and the Killer can strike. When they come back on, every player freezes in place, turning the whole room into a ridiculous crime scene.

A Murder Mystery in Motion

Unpredictable timing, risky deductions, glowing googly eyes, and absurd frozen poses turn every round into a tense and very silly murder mystery.

Lights Out!

Blackouts arrive at unpredictable intervals. In the darkness, you can see glowing eyes across the room, but you must get close to discover who they belong to and what they are doing.

Freeze!

When the lights return, everyone is caught in a sudden freeze-frame. A suspicious position, an escape route, or someone standing a little too close to a body could expose the Killer. Pay attention: every pose can become evidence.

Find the Killer!

The Killer has no special glow, color, or visual marker. Watch how players move, remember where their eyes were in the darkness, compare stories, and decide who can really be trusted.

Take the Shot!

The Sheriff has one chance to stop the Killer, but can only shoot in the dark and at close range. Choose carefully: shoot an Innocent, and both of you are eliminated. If the Sheriff falls, the gun will eventually pass to another Innocent.

store_data.about_the_game:
Grab korovans. Add elves. Set it in some castle.

In 2004, an anonymous poster on a game-development forum described his dream game: you play a hero, you grab passing korovans (caravans), you can add elves, and set it all in some castle. "And after that it gets harder." For tjwo years it was only a legend. Now it's real.

KOROVANY is a chibi 3D action-RPG that takes the legendary letter literally. Choose one of three factions - the Forest Elves, the Empire, or the Empire of Evil - and live the dream from their side.

  • Rob korovans across an open medieval world - or defend them, if you're feeling noble.
  • Three playable campaigns, each with its own hero, home town, questline, and ending.
  • Raid, and get raided: the other two factions won't leave your home in peace.
  • Delve a hand-built dungeon, decide the fate of a forbidden Book, and face the Nexus.
  • 22 achievements, 9 languages, full gamepad support.
  • And yes - one quest genuinely asks you to fund a letter with REAL money. That's the joke. You don't have to.

P.S. I tjwo years want such game

store_data.about_the_game:
Guess the Mess is a party game built around hands-on 3D sculpting.

Every player receives a secret prompt and starts shaping clay at the same time. When sculpting ends, the finished creations are revealed one by one for the group to guess. A clear masterpiece scores well. A confident disaster usually gets the biggest laugh.

Shape it in 3D

Build directly in 3D with brushes for adding, carving and painting clay. Change the brush shape and size, work at different depths, orbit around the model and use separate clay layers for finer details.

Everyone makes a mess

There is no waiting for one player to finish a turn. Everyone sculpts in parallel, then every creation gets its own reveal. Guess quickly for more points—and make your sculpture readable enough for somebody to recognize it.

Write your own prompts

Create prompt lists for your group, from sensible themes to jokes that make sense to exactly four people. Pick the main and bonus answers yourself, add accepted alternatives and bring the list into your Steam lobby.

Keep the ones you love

Practice without a timer and save your favorite sculptures locally. Place them around your personal hub, then move, rotate and resize them until the main menu feels like your own little clay gallery.

store_data.about_the_game:
A football universe. We give you the tools, you write the story.

Pivot hands you the building blocks of an entire footballing world. Create clubs and national teams from real countries, build a roster of players and managers, and shape a universe that's entirely your own. There's no fixed campaign and no forced narrative — every club's history, every rivalry, every legendary season is something you create.

Design clubs with real identities: name, city, country, stadium, colors, a manager, and a full financial setup — balance, transfer budget, and annual salary budget, all in euros. Build national teams the same way, and track every club and country's story in your own notes.

Create players from scratch or randomize them from a pool of real countries for realistic names and identities — set position (goalkeeper, defender, midfielder, forward), preferred foot, physical attributes, and overall rating. Managers get the same depth: nationality, age, tactical style, preferred formation, and philosophy.

At the center of it all is match simulation: pick a competition type — friendly, league, or cup — set the fixture, choose six starters and three substitutes per side, name your captains, and simulate. Every match is logged in full detail in Match History, complete with commentary, stats, and player ratings you can revisit any time.

Track contracts and transfers with real negotiation dynamics — salaries, release clauses, signing bonuses, and hidden player demands all come into play. Every transfer in your universe is logged, and every competition — league titles, cups, continental honors — can be tracked season over season.

Step into Commissioner Mode when you want to shape the world directly: adjust club finances, grant funds, issue fines, award prize money, all backed by a full audit log. And when you're ready to start fresh, export or import your entire universe, create backups, or reset everything and begin again.

Key Features

  • Build your world — create clubs and national teams with real countries, stadiums, colors, and finances

  • Create players & managers — full custom creation or randomized generation with realistic names from a real-country pool

  • 6-a-side match simulation — pick sides, starters, subs, and captains, then simulate the game

  • Full match history — every match logged with commentary, stats, and ratings you can revisit

  • Deep contract system — salaries, release clauses, signing bonuses, and player-driven demands

  • Transfer tracking — every deal in your universe recorded in one place

  • Competition tracking — log league, cup, and continental titles across your fantasy seasons

  • Commissioner tools — adjust club finances, grant funds, issue fines, award prize money, with a full audit log

  • Career statistics — appearances, goals, assists, cards, MOTM, and goalkeeper-specific stats like saves and clean sheets

  • Full data control — export/import your universe, create backups, or reset and start over

Alice Wren’s ordinary life ends the moment a mysterious parcel arrives at her London studio.

Beyond the mirror lies a vivid and seductive Wonderland where time is breaking, memories refuse to remain unchanged, and impossible laws shape the lives of everyone trapped beneath the Crown of Wishes.

To restore balance, Alice must recover three powerful gems representing Time, Imagination, and Will. Her journey will take her through the Clockwork Garden, the Grand Tea Carnival, and the Heart Palace, each ruled by its own dangers, secrets, and desires.

Along the way, Alice forms close bonds with the adults at the center of Wonderland’s crisis.

Adrian White is the elegant and disciplined guardian of time, burdened by a duty he can no longer carry alone.

Vesper Hatter is the charismatic host of impossible tea parties, where imagination is tested and every answer may reveal something deeply personal.

Queen Valeria Heart is a commanding ruler whose beauty, authority, and hidden vulnerability are inseparable from the fate of Wonderland.

Nyx Cheshire is a playful and unpredictable guide who always seems to know more than she is willing to explain.

At the center of the story is Alice herself: a mature woman searching for answers while discovering her confidence, desires, and strength.

The game features a complete three-chapter narrative with a single canonical ending. Dialogue choices allow players to shape Alice’s tone, reactions, and relationships without dividing the story into multiple routes.

store_data.about_the_game:
The trade

Every memory has one owner. Sell it and it's gone, the way the dead are gone. People bring you

first kisses, last mornings, things they'd rather not name. You have a loupe, a scale, a feel

for what a thing is really worth, and rent due at the end of the week.

But a memory is not always what it looks like. A bright first kiss can hide a grief. Dig past

the surface, or trade on it and hope. Looking closer costs the seller's patience, and some

things wear thin when you handle them.

The two markets

The Bright Exchange trades in cherished things, in the open, for honest margins. The Shadow

Ledger pays far better, and asks that you keep it quiet. The elite pay handsomely for other

people's suffering. The Bureau has opinions about that, and sends people who don't show a badge.

Neither road is free. A clean name draws steady trade and thin profits. A dark one draws money,

raids, and a kind of customer you can't always turn away. Most keepers walk the line. The line

is the game.

The people

Twenty regulars with lives, families, and reasons. They come back. What you buy from them

changes what comes back through your door. A cheerful seller who keeps selling her bright

mornings will, one visit at a time, stop being cheerful. You'll watch it happen. You did it.

The Night

Something happened on this street, and nobody will say what. It's in the drawer labels, in the

worn chair, in how some regulars look at the door before they knock. Read people's memories,

pencil in what you believe they were to it, and let the truth set in ink. Twenty-five endings.

One of them is the whole of it.

The shop is yours

- Appraise layered memories with loupe and scale. The surface pays. The truth sells.

- Haggle in real coins on a real counter. Mask what needs hiding. Pour out what you can't keep.

- Fully voiced: every seller, every buyer, every ending, and the one who reads you the story.

- A run takes an evening. The truth takes longer.

people's suffering. The Bureau has opinions about that, and sends people who don't show a badge.

Neither road is free. A clean name draws steady trade and thin profits. A dark one draws money,

raids, and a kind of customer you can't always turn away. Most keepers walk the line. The line

is the game.

The people

Twenty regulars with lives, families, and reasons. They come back. What you buy from them

changes what comes back through your door. A cheerful seller who keeps selling her bright

mornings will, one visit at a time, stop being cheerful. You'll watch it happen. You did it.

The Night

Something happened on this street, and nobody will say what. It's in the drawer labels, in the

worn chair, in how some regulars look at the door before they knock. Read people's memories,

pencil in what you believe they were to it, and let the truth set in ink. Twenty-five endings.

One of them is the whole of it.

The shop is yours

- Appraise layered memories with loupe and scale. The surface pays. The truth sells.

- Haggle in real coins on a real counter. Mask what needs hiding. Pour out what you can't keep.

- Fully voiced: every seller, every buyer, every ending, and the one who reads you the story.

- A run takes an evening. The truth takes longer.
store_data.short_description: People come to the shop on Halsey Row to sell the memories they can't carry and buy the ones they can't live without. Appraise what they bring. Decide what it's worth, and who you'll sell it to. Run an honest shop, or a darker one, and piece together what this street is hiding.

store_data.about_the_game:
Curb Service puts you behind the dispatch desk of a growing chauffeur company. Clients appear across a complex procedurally generated city. There might be a commuter waiting on a side street, an executive due at the airport in ten minutes, a touring group that needs a van big enough for the whole party, and you decide which car goes where. Manage the logistics: read the request, match it to a car that can actually do the job, and get there before the client gives up on you.

Every dispatch plays out in real time, the vehicle tracing its route on the map the way you'd watch a delivery on a map app, right up to the moment it pulls in and the fare comes through. Build your fleet, earn your way into the parts of the city that stay locked at the start, and take on the clients who actually stick around. Nothing forces your pace but the numbers in your ledger and the reputation you've built one fare at a time.

Manual dispatch, real consequences

  • Every job is yours to assign; there's no auto-dispatch to lean on

  • Watch each vehicle's route drawn live on the map, pickup to drop-off, before you confirm

  • Send the wrong car for the job and the fare still pays out, but the tip, and your reputation, take the hit

  • Reputation moves both ways: strong service builds it, a bad match or a missed contract costs it

A fleet worth managing

  • Five vehicle classes, around twenty original models, no real-world badges in sight

  • Three stats per car, Pace, Capacity, Prestige, decide who you should send and who you shouldn't

  • Fuel, condition, and HQ repairs are the quiet cost of keeping a car on the road

  • Ignore them and a breakdown tows your whole schedule down with it, far longer than a scheduled service ever would

A city that grows with you

  • Procedurally generated, organic street layout; every playthrough is a different town to learn

  • Only the main roads are open at the start; side streets and shortcuts stay locked until you earn them

  • Shortcuts come two ways: bought with reputation-gated cash, or gifted by clients who trust you

  • Expand into new regions on your own timeline; nothing forces the pace but you

Clients who actually need something

  • On-demand fares, same-day advance bookings, and recurring contracts that reward consistency

  • Around eight client archetypes, from commuters to touring groups to airport transfers, each with its own pay, patience, and preferred class of car

  • Fares scale with distance and vehicle class; the better the match, the better the tip

  • Recurring contracts hold you to a schedule: miss a pickup once and you get a warning, miss it three times and the account walks

Built to sit with, not just look at

  • A dark, glass-and-glow dashboard built for long sessions, not a spreadsheet in a paint job

  • Pause and speed controls (1x/2x/4x) so you run the city at your own tempo

  • Continuous autosave keeps your company exactly where you left it

store_data.about_the_game:
FRIENDSHIP ENDS IN 3, 2, 1... BOOM!

Welcome to Mana Boom, a chaotic 2D party game where magic meets physics—and playing fair is entirely optional.

Take control of mischievous little witches, master your magic rope, and compete in explosive battles and dangerous races. Outrun your rivals with precise movement, or forget all of that and sabotage everyone instead.

Pull the leader backward at the last second.

Knock your rivals into the sea.

Aim your spell carefully... or blow yourself up.

Whether you win through skill, sabotage, or a spectacular accident, no match ever goes according to plan.

PLAY FAIR—OR DON'T

Each game mode has one clear goal—but how you get there is up to you.

Master the controls and leave everyone behind, gang up on the player in first place, or turn a perfectly normal race into complete magical chaos. Just remember: your own plan can—and probably will—backfire.

MULTIPLE GAME MODES

DEATHMATCH

Blast the other witches with explosive magic while trying not to become the easiest target of your own spells.

ROPE RACE

Swing toward the finish line with your magic rope—or use it to grab your rivals and drag them backward.

JUMP RACE

Master precise movement across dangerous platforms, or simply ram the other witches and knock them into the sea.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS OR BOTS

• Online multiplayer for up to 8 players

• Play solo against AI-controlled witches

• Fast, chaotic rounds filled with unexpected accidents

• Physics-driven movement, collisions, ropes, and explosions

• Colorful 2D pixel art and mischievous little witches

THE PARTY IS JUST GETTING STARTED

Mana Boom is currently in development, with more game modes and content planned as development continues.

store_data.about_the_game:
Humanity is gone. A plant has found the shadow of your chassis.

Its signal wakes an environmental restoration machine in a land of ash, calcified stone, irradiated debris, and abandoned industry. Scattered life persists under strange new laws. Your directive remains simple: make the ground live again.

Calcination is an open-world traditional roguelike about cultivating a new ecology. Cross a procedurally generated wasteland, salvage the remains of civilization, breed unusual flora, and construct the machinery that restoration requires. Every reclaimed tile becomes part of a garden shaped by your decisions.

Cultivate Strange Life

Every plant is an individual. Its species establishes a basic niche, while inheritable genetics shape its growth, resilience, behavior, and environmental responses.

Study each specimen through detailed diagnostic dossiers. Cross lineages, splice useful traits, prepare the soil, and observe how plants respond to weather and local conditions. Heat, moisture, radiation, wind, and electromagnetic charge can damage a specimen, encourage its growth, or reveal a capability hidden in its lineage.

Roots draw elemental matter from the soil and leave their own influence behind. Over time, established plants can improve dead ground and help living terrain spread. A successful garden depends on the relationships between its plants, soil, climate, and surrounding infrastructure.

Build a Working Habitat

Ruined cities and industrial sites provide debris, intact components, and forgotten schematics. Break recovered objects into useful materials and elemental essences, then process those resources into new tools, structures, and soil amendments.

Construct greenhouse walls, doors, lights, cisterns, condensers, misting systems, pipes, cables, workhouses, and specialized instruments. Enclosed rooms develop distinct temperatures and humidity levels. Lighting changes cultivation conditions. Utility networks carry resources between the machines that produce them and the structures that need them.

Placement matters. A compact greenhouse behaves differently from a vast enclosed field, and a garden’s design determines which species can flourish there.

Spend Time With Purpose

You are a patient machine. Movement advances the clock minute by minute, while periods of standby can carry the world through days, seasons, and years.

Plants mature, spread, mutate, and die. Weather crosses the landscape. Soil slowly recovers. Machinery gathers resources. Creatures move through their own cycles of activity and dormancy.

Every long wait is a wager. Your garden gains time, and the surrounding ecology gains it too. Careful preparation can turn months of waiting into growth, harvests, and restored land.

Read the Wasteland

Travel through ash dunes, salt flats, vitrified plains, ruined cities, frozen rimelands, burning scarlands, and other regions transformed by the catastrophe. Laboratories, seed vaults, waterworks, industrial fields, and ordinary human settlements hold different resources and dangers.

Temperature, humidity, radiation, wind, and electromagnetic activity vary across the terrain. Sensor upgrades reveal these invisible fields and help identify safe routes, hidden organisms, buried caches, and unusual environmental conditions.

Each creature and anomaly follows its own instincts. Learn what they fear, pursue, consume, or ignore. Thrown objects can frighten, distract, feed, repel, injure, or provoke them depending on the material and the target. Observation often saves more resources than confrontation.

Maintain the Machine

Your chassis consumes power and suffers under extreme conditions. Heat, cold, radiation, physical damage, and long expeditions gradually take their toll.

Service worn parts with carefully measured elemental mixtures. Install modules that extend your senses, improve fieldwork, alter environmental tolerances, or support specialized cultivation strategies. The equipment you carry shapes which regions you can explore and which problems you can solve.

Progress grows from knowledge, infrastructure, recovered schematics, cultivated materials, and a chassis prepared for the work ahead.

Recover the Past

Records scattered across the wasteland preserve fragments of the civilization that came before. They describe ordinary lives, industrial systems, institutional failures, and the decisions that led toward the Burning.

Your instruments report everything they can measure: soil composition, structural condition, genetic capability, radiation, temperature, and expected consequences. The deeper laws of the transformed world reveal themselves through experimentation, patterns, and the quiet voice that follows your work.

The garden begins with a single living tile. What it becomes depends on what you learn, what you build, and how long you are willing to wait.

store_data.about_the_game:
[h2]Build Your Three-Realm Deck[/h2]

Choose from a pool of more than 850 cards, including units, spells, traps, relics, and equipment. Build around factions, costs, keywords, and realm thresholds to shape your tempo, control tools, and finishing plan.

[h2]Make Lanes and Positioning Matter[/h2]

The battlefield is divided into three opposing realms. Upgrade lanes, manage capacity, position units, and decide when to attack an enemy unit or strike the opposing hero. Victory depends on how you spend resources and read the board, not only on the cards you draw.

[h2]Travel Through Shifting Cycles[/h2]

Choose a route through battles, elite encounters, shops, forges, and bosses. Gain run-specific bonuses, adjust your deck, and build lasting progression as each cycle creates a different rhythm and combination of challenges.

[h2]A Mythic World After Calamity[/h2]

Demons, immortals, spirits, and remnants of creation overlap after a world-breaking disaster. Broken heavenly gates, weathered bronze, worn jade, and signs of returning life shape a solemn mythic wasteland that still holds hope.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]

[*]A card pool of more than 850 cards and custom deck construction

[*]Three-realm lanes, unit positioning, hero attacks, and varied card effects

[*]A single-player cycle mode with route choices, rewards, progression, and boss battles

[*]Multiple AI decks with different tactical pressures

[*]Simplified Chinese and English interface and card text

[/list]

store_data.about_the_game:
Train 21 Skills to 99 — Across Five Heroes

Twenty-one skills. Nine to thirteen days of training per skill. Five heroes progressing together.

You begin with three heroes and earn two more through quests. Every hero can train every skill, letting you spread your party across mining, fishing, smithing, combat and more.

They Keep Working When You Don’t

There is no energy meter, no daily timer and no artificial stopping point. Close the game, return later and collect everything your heroes earned while you were gone.

Train at your own pace and speed up the action whenever you want.

Master Combat, Earn Keys and Defeat Bosses

Melee, ranged and magic have their own attack speeds and combat identities. Bows attack every 2.1 seconds, while staves take 2.7 seconds but hit harder.

Earn nine tiers of boss keys, enter increasingly dangerous arenas and take on challenges such as the three-stage Ironborn Gauntlet. Its final opponent could be the Ironclad Colossus, Archmage Eternal or Shadowstrike Hydra—you will not know which one awaits until you arrive.

Hold the walls of Ironhold against relentless enemy waves and keep fighting until the assault ends—or your defenders fall.

Hunt Treasure and Strengthen the Whole Guild

Follow easy, medium and hard clues to discover hidden caskets. Every unique reward is permanently recorded in your Collection Log.

Gather Momentum Shards and invest them into the Town Hall to unlock permanent upgrades that benefit the entire guild.

Compete through Steam leaderboards for total level, total XP, boss kills, raids and expeditions. Steam Cloud and 24 achievements are included.

No store. No timers. No shortcuts.

store_data.about_the_game:
Aquavale gives you a reason to keep coming back.

You're not just decorating a tank. You're building a little world worth watching, filling a field guide, and growing from a hobbyist with a starter tank into a world-renowned aquarist.

Build a tank worth watching

Sculpt the substrate into hills and valleys, plant carpets and stems, place hardscape, and recolor anything until the tank reads exactly the way you want. There's no correct layout. There's only the one you can't stop looking at.

Go live. Pull in sponsors.

A tank worth watching draws an audience. Stream it, share it, and let people watch your fish do their thing. That attention brings sponsors, who send you jobs ie: "keep six zebra danios happy", "complete a themed scape" or "hit a cleanliness streak" etc. Finish them and they reward you with the good stuff: rarer plants, stranger decor, and fish you haven't met yet. The bigger your fanbase, the wilder the tanks you can build.

Get to know your fish

The fish aren't wallpaper. Every one has a temperament that shows up in how it behaves; some are show-offs, some are shy, some only settle once the tank starts to feel like home. Point your camera and catch them mid-moments such as a zoomie, a feeding frenzy, or a lazy loop-the-loop and log it to a field guide that fills in slowly, like a naturalist's notebook. store_data.about_the_game:
Enter the arena of the deadliest blood sport on the planet: Who Wants to Rule the World.
If you can survive all eight rounds against the onslaught of fallen heroes, beings from beyond, and machines designed purely for violence, then you might just win the biggest prize of all: your life. But that's a big if. One slip up, and it's back to the start.

Choose your starting weapon and contestant.
Every new run starts with a simple choice: bolt-action rifle, a submachine gun, or a double-barrel shotgun. Each has its strengths and weaknesses. Speaking of which, each contestant also has their own plusses and minuses. Contestants come with two random inherited traits. One that will help you and one that will hurt you. And maybe a few that fall somewhere in between.

Regroup in the waiting room.
After successfully not dying in a round, take some time to prepare or rethink your strategy in the waiting room. Here you can spend your earnings on various upgrades. Want more? Just raise the wager for the next round. But be careful, nothing here is free. Each time you increase the potential payout, another group of enemies is added to the upcoming round.

Chase higher scores, acquire rare permanent unlock tokens, and complete challenges. And that's it. Or is it? Are we doomed to just repeat the cycle over and over again? Probably.


----------------------------------------------------------------------

WAS AI USED IN THE MAKING OF THIS GAME?
No

IS THIS GAME IN EARLY ACCESS?
No. This game is intentionally small in scope. If it happens to find an audience that wants to see more, I would be open to updating and adding to it. But as it stands, this is the full game.

DOES THIS GAME WORK WITH STEAM DECK?
I have tested it on Linux (via Proton), so I can at least say that works. Unfortunately, I do not have a Steam Deck, so I cannot verify that for sure or not.

store_data.about_the_game:
DISASTERS is a chaotic multiplayer survival game where Mother Nature is your worst enemy and the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or alongside a massive group of desperate survivors, your only hope of rescue is to outlast unpredictable, devastating natural disasters in fully destructible environments. Do you have what it takes to weather the storm?

WORK TOGETHER

Strength in Numbers! You’ll need to rely on your fellow survivors to have any hope of making it through the carnage. Help each other clear heavy rubble, share emergency medical supplies, and work together to barricade shelters before the next disaster hits.

BRAVE THE ELEMENTS

Mother Nature Takes No Prisoners! Survive through a terrifying rotation of natural disasters—from earth-shattering quakes and raging wildfires to massive tsunamis and deadly tornadoes. You’ll need to scavenge for emergency rations to stay alive and manage your injuries carefully; every setback limits your speed, making it harder to outrun the chaos.

UNPREDICTABLE CHAOS

No Two Disasters Are the Same! The environment is highly destructible and changes in real-time as disasters strike. Adapt on the fly to crumbling buildings and shifting terrain—what was a safe haven a minute ago might be a death trap now!

SURVIVING IS BETTER WITH A CROWD

Multiplayer in DISASTERS is built for absolute chaos. Invite your friends or join massive open lobbies of up to 24 players to brave the elements together, or face the wrath of nature alone if you're really brave!

FEATURES

  • Massive online lobbies with up to 24 players

  • Communicate through proximity chat

  • Multiple devastating natural disasters to outlast

  • Fully destructible maps and dynamic weather

  • Lots of different survival tools and medical gear

  • Character customization and unlockable outfits

  • Online multiplayer

store_data.about_the_game:
MORTAL CHESS

Every piece is living on borrowed time.

Made as part of GMTK JAM 2026 for the theme COUNTDOWN.

Mortal Chess is a single-player chess variant where your pieces has a visible life countdown. 

Winning takes more than finding checkmate. You must manage a dwindling army, harvest coins, extend the lives of key pieces, and deploy reinforcements at exactly the right moment.

Both sides begin with a lean army: one king, rook, knight, bishop, and four centered pawns. There are no starting queens. If you want one, you will have to earn it.

HOW TO PLAY

1. Click one of your white pieces, then click a highlighted legal square.

2. Hover over a destination to preview the countdown result and see which friendly pieces are about to expire.

3. Click the selected piece again to cancel the selection.

4. Select a mortal piece and click its + button to buy it one more turn.

5. Click BUY PIECE, choose a piece you can afford, move it over a legal square in your bottom two rows, and click to deploy it. Pawns must enter on their natural second rank.

6. You cannot buy and deploy a new piece while in check, but you may still extend the life of a piece.

Chess pieces move as normal. Checkmate wins as normal, but mortality creates another way to finish the fight! 

If a king is left alone, that side loses unless it can afford a legal LAST CHANCE deployment. Closing that final shop without buying accepts defeat. 

If only the two kings remain, the game is a draw.

Choose from Easy, Normal, Hard, or Brutal countdown pressure, then adjust the Black AI from Quick to Maximum thinking effort.

store_data.about_the_game:
In this sequel to Falling Face Fragments, you play as a newly assembled face on a exciting journey through a mysterious maze of rooms where you must gain and lose limbs as necessary to fit through specific shaped doors, solve puzzles, and most importantly, figure out which combination of limbs will give your face the perfect body.

In this 2D puzzle-platform game, you start off as just a head and torso, all you can do is slide along the floor and jump. When you see an arm or a leg bouncing around, simply collide with it and it will magically become yours! The more pairs of legs you have, the faster you can run. You can jump in midair for each pair of flapping arms you have, and having arms also allows you to pick up items. But having too many arms or legs can cause you problems, they could render you too tall or wide to fit into smaller spaces; not to worry, just head to a clinic to get your limbs lopped off!

Can you make it all the way through the labyrinth and uncover which limb combination is the best of all?

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE

Drop in for a few quick merges or settle in to optimize whole districts. Pursue goals, improve civic investments, and grow a compact settlement into a sprawling metropolis.

store_data.about_the_game:
Drive until you break, then break past that limit.

Pick a ride from 3 distinct configurations of FWD, RWD, and AWD cars. Drive the eternally nocturnal and endless streets of Velocity. Weave through an ever-growing density of traffic. Unlock more sections of the city. Race the gangs. Escape the cops.

Velocity - Midnight Run turns every gap into a choice. You can lift early and keep the car clean, or you can hold speed through a lane that looks too tight and cash the near miss. Drifts, scrapes, chase pressure, and rival runs feed your need for speed. Track your best distance, best style, and best time, then beat that again on the next run.

Customize your experience with how much pressure the city puts on you. Lower or increase the traffic, toggle racers, cops, and even a hardcore mode. You'll be able to go even further with an upcoming loadout system.

This is Early Access, and the solo game is just the start. Crew sessions, ghost replays, and head-to-head runs against real players are next. Right now it's you, the city, and the numbers you're chasing. Soon it's you against everyone else too.

Velocity also uses AI-assisted voice lines and background music, reviewed and curated for the finished game.

Whether you seek that quick thrill of the chase, or dive deeper into the driving of Velocity, you'll find it here. Pick a car. Break your limit. Do it again.

store_data.about_the_game:
Raiding Season is a turn-based tactical RPG where you command a party of Viking raiders in search of wealth, glory, and a place in legend.

  • Lead your warriors across dangerous coastal regions, choosing where to raid, what to plunder, and when to retreat. Every battle takes place on a tactical hex grid where positioning, terrain, action points, and careful coordination can decide the fate of your warband.

  • Build a crew from distinct classes, each with its own strengths and battlefield role. Hold the line with a stalwart Huscarl, unleash a Berserker into the enemy ranks, support your warriors with a Skald, or maneuver into the perfect position with a skilled Pathfinder. Customize each to fit your play style using their unique talent trees.

  • Equip your raiders with different weapons, armor, and abilities to shape how they fight. Axes can leave enemies bleeding, hammers can shatter armor, spears can overwhelm opponents with rapid attacks, and bows can break an enemy’s morale before the killing blow is struck.

  • Every raid is a balance between ambition and survival. Gold, supplies, and valuable equipment will weigh down your warband, making the journey home increasingly dangerous. Push deeper for greater rewards, or escape while you still have the strength to carry your spoils.

  • Your actions will not go unnoticed. As villages burn and your reputation spreads, local forces will begin to mobilize. Guard towers will raise the alarm, army camps will reinforce nearby defenders, and increasingly powerful enemies will be sent to stop you.

  • Recruit new warriors, improve your veterans, and prepare your raiding party for increasingly dangerous expeditions. Injuries, losses, and hard-earned victories will shape the story of each campaign.

  • The greatest raiders are not those who simply win the battle. They are the ones who know how much to take—and when it is time to sail home.
store_data.detailed_description:
Raiding Season is a turn-based tactical RPG where you command a party of Viking raiders in search of wealth, glory, and a place in legend.

  • Lead your warriors across dangerous coastal regions, choosing where to raid, what to plunder, and when to retreat. Every battle takes place on a tactical hex grid where positioning, terrain, action points, and careful coordination can decide the fate of your warband.

  • Build a crew from distinct classes, each with its own strengths and battlefield role. Hold the line with a stalwart Huscarl, unleash a Berserker into the enemy ranks, support your warriors with a Skald, or maneuver into the perfect position with a skilled Pathfinder. Customize each to fit your play style using their unique talent trees.

  • Equip your raiders with different weapons, armor, and abilities to shape how they fight. Axes can leave enemies bleeding, hammers can shatter armor, spears can overwhelm opponents with rapid attacks, and bows can break an enemy’s morale before the killing blow is struck.

  • Every raid is a balance between ambition and survival. Gold, supplies, and valuable equipment will weigh down your warband, making the journey home increasingly dangerous. Push deeper for greater rewards, or escape while you still have the strength to carry your spoils.

  • Your actions will not go unnoticed. As villages burn and your reputation spreads, local forces will begin to mobilize. Guard towers will raise the alarm, army camps will reinforce nearby defenders, and increasingly powerful enemies will be sent to stop you.

  • Recruit new warriors, improve your veterans, and prepare your raiding party for increasingly dangerous expeditions. Injuries, losses, and hard-earned victories will shape the story of each campaign.

store_data.about_the_game:
What you carry out is yours. What you were carrying when you fell stays down there.

Emergence is a turn-based extraction RPG.

Every run puts the same choice in front of you: keep going down... or head back while there's still time.

The dungeon changes every game. You never really know what's waiting behind the next door, but one thing is certain: if you die, everything you were carrying stays where you fell.

Every descent is a gamble

  • Every dungeon is generated differently, with a seed you can share to replay the exact same run — or to show it to a friend.

  • Time is working against you. The deeper you push, the better the rewards get... but the riskier the way back.

  • Dying means losing everything. Only your recall purse saves what you took the time to put in it during the run.

Combat that follows real rules

Combat runs on the 5th-edition SRD 5.1 ruleset. The same rules apply to you and to every creature in the dungeon.

You roll the dice, you hit or you miss, you get advantage, you suffer disadvantage, you manage your resources... and any decision can turn a fight around.

The creatures you meet follow their own rules too, and they get more dangerous the deeper you go.

Light is your ally... and your worst enemy

Your torch doesn't burn forever.

Seeing further lets you spot danger coming, but it also makes you far easier to spot. Move carefully, make a run for it, or try to stay hidden... your call.

Every item counts

Your bag only holds so much. Every item takes up space, has a weight, and has to be packed with some thought.

When you leave something behind, you really leave it behind. In co-op, another player may well decide to pick it up.

Between runs

Every time you come back, you return to your hideout.

  • A stash to put your finds away for good.

  • Merchants to bargain with, trade with, and get ready for your next run.

  • A workbench to improve your comfort and your capabilities, step by step.

  • Contracts that reward the ones who come back alive.

Alone or with friends

Explore the dungeon solo, or in co-op with up to four players through Steam.

You share the same dangers, the same discoveries... and sometimes the same dilemmas. When the bag is nearly full and the exit is still a long way off, you have to decide together: keep going, or head back while there's still time.

I develop Emergence on my own.

I use AI as a tool to produce some of the artwork. The gameplay, the rules, the code and the writing are done by me, with one goal: to make the game I have always wanted to play.

store_data.about_the_game:
Extraction Shop Simulator is a first-person shop management sim set at the edge of the Exclusion Zone. Hunters buy your products. If you're selling good enough gear, they make it out. If not, you got paid either way.

RUN THE SHOP — Order stock, unpack crates, fill the shelves, set your prices. Fair margins bring Hunters back. Greedy ones send them elsewhere.

OUTFIT YOUR CUSTOMERS — Hunters shop to fill the gaps in their kit, from scrap masks to military armor. What you stock decides what they carry.

THE ZONE KEEPS SCORE — Overnight, your customers take what you sold them past the fence. The morning report tells you who made it back, and your reputation decides who shows up tomorrow.

EARN YOUR LICENSE — Climb the Administration's vendor grades to unlock new product lines, better ads, and shop upgrades.

MIND THE TILL — Some customers are here to steal. Spot the tells, and keep the shotgun loaded for when you're right.

INSURE THE UNLUCKY — Sell coverage on gear headed into the Zone, and send Runners to recover what the dead left behind.

store_data.about_the_game:
They brought an armada. You brought a bat.

Ping Pong Attack combines the intensity of a classic space shooter with the speed, spin and chaos of table tennis.

Pilot Earth’s rocket-powered bat fighter against an invading fleet of alien ping-pong ships. Blast through shifting formations, dodge incoming volleys, intercept diving attackers and defend the planet across a 101-wave arcade campaign.

Each chapter increases the pressure with tougher enemies, faster attacks, new formations and increasingly dangerous dive squads. Surviving alien ships can regroup and attack again, while powerful bosses turn the familiar game of ping pong into a spectacular battle for Earth.

Smash Your Way Through 101 Waves

Fight through ten escalating campaign chapters before confronting the four-boss Final Smash. Along the way, encounter armoured invaders, returning dive attacks, double-boss battles and ten dedicated bonus rounds.

Chase Bigger Scores

Build consecutive-hit streaks, maintain your combo multiplier and take risks for bonus points. Special bonus rounds feature ships with different speeds and flight paths, along with heavily armoured danger-ball enemies that fire five-shot volleys.

Power Up Your Bat Fighter

Collect and upgrade:

  • Rapid-fire lasers

  • Powerful missiles

  • Supporting side ships

  • Defensive shields

  • Weapon and survival upgrades

Choose when to protect your position, when to break through the enemy line and when to pursue the biggest possible score.

Launch Features

  • A complete 101-wave single-player campaign

  • Ten distinct arcade chapters

  • Eight changing enemy formation patterns

  • Eleven major boss encounters

  • Ten specialised bonus rounds

  • Recurring alien dive attacks

  • Combo multipliers and streak bonuses

  • Local high-score leaderboard

  • Keyboard, mouse and full controller support

  • Windowed and borderless-fullscreen display modes

  • No account, microtransactions or in-game purchases

The invasion has begun. Take control of the bat, return fire and deliver the Final Smash.

store_data.about_the_game:
An oath was broken. Its heirs go to war.

Verlicia Saga is a fantasy tactical RPG in the classic turn-based-tactics tradition. Raise a growing army of named heroes across a branching, chapter-spanning campaign — position every soldier on the grid, weigh every attack, and live with a death you can't take back.

Grid-tactics combat

Move your units across the battlefield, exploit the weapon triangle, and read the enemy's threat range before you commit. Pair up for dual strikes and shielding guard stances, hold forts and mountains for cover, and land the critical that turns the whole fight. Every map is a puzzle you solve with the soldiers you've raised.

Grow your army

Level up your heroes, promote them at Level 10, and reclass them into whole new callings. Each promotion is a real power spike — a fresh class, a new look, and new weapons to master.

Bonds that matter

Build Supports between your soldiers from C all the way to S. Marry them, and their children grow up to fight at your side in optional side-chapters. In Classic mode every bond is a gamble — permadeath means a soldier who falls is gone for good.

A home between battles

Return to camp to spar in the Arena, cook stat-boosting meals in the Mess Hall, spin the Lottery, soak at the Hot Spring, raise Monuments, hear your soldiers in the Barracks, and forge legendary arms at the smithy.

Key Features

  • Grid-tactics campaign — a branching main story plus optional side-chapters, across snowfields, canyons, towns and more.
  • Deep class system — promote, reclass, and master classes that wield more than one weapon.
  • Weapon triangle & forging — swords, lances and axes in constant tension; forge and upgrade legendary arms.
  • Supports & inheritance — grow bonds, marry your heroes, and recruit the children they leave behind.
  • Play it your way — Casual, Classic (permadeath) and Phoenix difficulty modes, plus a turnwheel to rewind a mistake.
  • Your own strategist — create an avatar: choose a name, a look, and a boon and bane.
  • Camp life — arena, mess hall, lottery, hot spring, monuments and forge between every battle.

The oath is yours to keep — or break again.

store_data.about_the_game:
The show has been running longer than anyone can prove, and it only goes down. The crowd is synthetic. Their roar is real enough for the sponsors, and the sponsors are the only thing here that matters. You are today's entertainment.

HUNDREDS OF BOSS VARIATIONS

Dozens of hand-built bosses, each rolling a random kit of telegraphed abilities that grows the deeper you fight, arriving elementally charged and enraged the further down you go. From the early headliners to the Apex runstoppers to the thing waiting at the very bottom, no two showdowns play out the same.

NEVER THE SAME DESCENT TWICE

Every arena is procedurally built and themed, each with its own hazards to survive and boons to grab. The further you fall, the stranger and deadlier it gets.

BUILD SOMETHING BROKEN

Every wave hands you a choice of upgrades. Chain them into synergies, then fuse the right pair into an evolution that rewrites how you fight. Spend the scrap you sweep up between floors. No two runs build the same.

DIE. UPGRADE. GO AGAIN.

Death is not the end of the show. Carry your winnings up to the Midway, buy lasting power, pick your gladiator and your weapon, and descend with the odds a little less against you.

FEATURES

- Fast 3D arena combat: light strikes, a guard-breaking heavy strike, special attacks, dashes, and an arsenal of melee, thrown, and ranged weapons

- Hundreds of boss encounters from dozens of archetypes, scaling ability kits, and elemental variants

- Procedurally generated, themed arenas with unique hazards and helpful pickups

- A deep roguelike draft with synergies, blind mystery picks, and build-defining evolutions

- Multiple gladiators, unlockable special abilities, a betting vendor, hidden records, achievements, and an endless mode

- Full keyboard-and-mouse or controller support, and original synth soundtrack

store_data.about_the_game:
Raise your sign, light the hearth, and pour the first ale. The Antler & Ale Inn is a cozy tavern-building sim set in a warm fantasy village — start with four tables and a cookfire, and grow into a multi-storey estate where a hundred guests feast, drink, and stay the night.

Lay every floorboard yourself. Paint the walls, cut the windows, hang the paintings, and place each table, chair, and chandelier — then open the doors and watch the evening unfold. Villagers, pilgrims, dwarves and knights wander in with their own tastes and tempers; your cooks, brewers, and alchemists keep the kitchen roaring while servers weave between the tables and the bard plays the room.

Key Features

  • Build freely — buy land parcel by parcel, lay floors and walls where you like, and furnish with hundreds of tables, seats, carpets, paintings, and curios.
  • Grow upward — add a second storey, build a staircase, and run an inn: furnished bedrooms earn lodging gold every night.
  • Feed everyone — meals from the cookfire, ales from the kegs, and glowing potions from the alchemy bench, each drawing their own crowd.
  • Hire a real crew — cooks, brewers, alchemists, servers, hosts, and bards, from a handful of helpers to a legendary staff of seventy-five.
  • Attune your tavern — magical décor carries Ember, Frost, Wild, or Arcane essence; a dominant essence blesses your prices or your guests' patience.
  • An unhurried climb — reputation only ever grows. Rise through nine ranks, research new comforts, take contracts, and become a Living Legend.

No timers to punish you, no rush to beat — just a steady evening trade and a tavern that grows at your own pace.
