Bite 2 ur Door is a food delivery driver simulation game, set in a cozy seaside town full of winding streets and hungry customers. Make your own schedule, earn money and star ratings, buy new cars, upgrade them, and become the best delivery driver in Cherrywood!

Set your own schedule

Explore the city at your own pace. When you're ready, you can go online anytime to start accepting orders and making deliveries.

Earn bonuses and tips

The residents of Cherrywood appreciate their food arriving fast! Not only will customers tip more, the Bite 2 ur Door company will also provide stacking bonuses for delivering quickly and safely. We reward hard work!

Improve your driver rating

Customers can rate your delivery. The higher you score, the higher your potential earnings can be! The highest-paying residents of Cherrywood only want the best delivery drivers!

Buy new cars and upgrades

The Cherrywood Auto Dealership has 5 different models of car to choose from, in 25 colors! Each car is specially designed for a different purpose, and can be upgraded even further. There have been rumors that even more options are on the way! Can you figure out your optimum delivery style?

Watch the road!

The City of Cherrywood does its best to maintain infrastructure, but potholes and oil slicks are still unfortunately common. Make sure to avoid them or they'll slow down your deliveries! And be courteous to other traffic, including pedestrians — Cherrywood Police are always around the corner to enforce traffic laws!

Free academy course!

In order to attract new delivery drivers, Bite 2 ur Door will be offering free drivers' training courses to anyone interested. A free demo is coming soon — start your new delivery career today by adding Bite 2 ur Door to your wishlist!

store_data.about_the_game:
The latest installment in the Kokoro Clover series, which crosses visual novel style stories with boss battling action, all in the style of a Saturday-morning cartoon! Featuring new locations, new characters, and new transformations! Join our heroes as they work together to face the forces of evil!And this time, the cartoon-feel is amplified by the series' very first opening theme song, INFINITE SPIRIT!

This installment includes:

- 5-minute recap of the story so far

- Infinite Phantasm Chapters 1 - 14

Visual Novel (Story)

After their fierce battle against the dinosaur army, Treffy and her friends meet Argyranax, the silver warrior! And ninjas too! And detectives! And they join a cook-off? And get into all kinds of battles? And a new hero awakens?!

Boss Battles

Face off against bosses in 2D action sections in between story segments!

- Choose cards to unleash skills!

- Don't like to battle? Don't worry! You can skip them entirely if you prefer!

Arena

The Boss Rush mode fans know and love is back—only now more intense than ever! Face off against random bosses in the fight to be number one!

- Choose from over 10 characters!

- Swap cards you get into your hand to use!

- Have trouble battling? Don't worry! Just set your abilities and give yourself an advantage!

Series Overview

A visual novel series designed to remind players of the joys of Saturday morning cartoons.
Packed with transformations, cards, dancing, and robots, too! The adventure goes on—forever and always!-Story features opening, ending, and commercial interlude animations!-The clock on the top left can be changed to 8:00, 9:00, or whatever time you wish!-Pixel art visuals serve to offer real 2000s nostalgia.

Developed by Hikotel

Music by Sinoryu

English Translation by Deven Neel

Theme SongOpening ThemeINFINITE SPIRIT

Lyrics, Music & Vocals by Hideaki Takatori
Arranged by Hiroaki Kagoshima

store_data.about_the_game:
What remains when someone you love is gone?

Mindlock - Sparrow Island is an emotional narrative adventure about loss, memory, and moving forward—told with dry humor, unique characters, and a charming hand-drawn art style.

Set on a lonely island, you'll explore forgotten places, solve environmental puzzles, fight your inner nightmares, and slowly piece together a deeply personal story that offers different perspectives on life.

Although Mindlock - Sparrow Island follows Mindlock - The Apartment, it tells a completely standalone story. New players can jump in without any prior knowledge, while returning players may discover subtle connections woven throughout the world.

Features

  • Experience a heartfelt story about loss and human connection.

  • Explore a mysterious island at your own pace.

  • Solve environmental puzzles woven naturally into the world.

  • Meet lots of unique characters with their own stories and personalities.

  • Enjoy beautiful hand-drawn visuals accompanied by an atmospheric soundtrack.

  • Like in the previous game: one developer—one clear vision.

store_data.about_the_game:
The desert dust has barely settled when you realize something is wrong: you entered the saloon looking for answers, now its doors refuse to let you leave. Inside, time repeats itself and reality shifts with every new cycle. Oil lamps flicker without a breath of wind, the piano plays with no one at the keys, and you can never be sure what time the clock is really showing. The saloon is a living entity that breathes, watches you, and feeds on your mistakes.

Learn the rules that govern this place before madness takes hold of you. Observe, investigate, and interact with your surroundings. Delve into its secrets to uncover what happened here... and how you can escape this hell.

TRAPPED IN A HELLISH LOOP

A mysterious Old West saloon has become your prison. Observe carefully, identify the anomalies, and survive each cycle before you lose your mind. Every time the loop resets, the saloon appears unchanged, but it never truly is. It is up to you to memorize every corner, every object, and every shadow, and learn to distinguish reality from the madness trying to creep into your mind.

If you are not careful, the days will pass, the loop will continue, and your end will draw ever closer. Do not lose track of time.

TRUST YOUR INSTINCTS... AND THE CARDS

Every anomaly you encounter must be identified through a ritual using tarot cards. Choose the correct ones to advance to the next loop. Picking the wrong card is more than a simple mistake: it is another crack in your sanity, and the saloon never forgets. A single wrong move will send you back to the beginning.

  • Observation: examine your surroundings and look for anything that does not belong.

  • Interpretation: match the anomaly with the correct Arcana.

  • Ritual: confirm your choice and find out whether the saloon will allow you to continue.

  • Consequences: correctly identify the anomalies you have witnessed and your progress will carry over into the next cycle. Fail... and the saloon will punish you.

ESCAPE THE SALOON

This is more than just an anomaly game. Locked doors, objects with stories of their own, hidden mechanisms... Explore every corner, find concealed items, and solve puzzles. Each loop gives you another chance to unravel the mystery of the saloon: piece together fragments of a past someone tried to bury, find keys and other useful objects, and solve riddles that only begin to make sense once you understand the rules of this place.

Discover what happened inside the saloon and find a way to break the curse once and for all... or succumb to the deepest reaches of madness.

EVERY LOOP IS DIFFERENT

The anomalies change with every playthrough. Some will be obvious, while others will be almost imperceptible. No two runs are the same. The anomaly system is designed so that no loop feels identical to the last: something obvious in one run may be barely noticeable in the next, with details that demand more than a passing glance. This variety makes every session a different challenge, even for those who know the saloon as well as their own home.

Memorize your surroundings, question everything you see, and find out whether you can distinguish reality from madness before it is too late.

UNCOVER THE TRUTH

Someone important to you disappeared without a trace inside this cursed saloon. The deeper you venture into the loop, the closer you will come to uncovering the truth hidden within this place... and the dark entity that dwells inside it.

TRAPPED IN A HELLISH LOOP

A mysterious Old West saloon has become your prison. Observe carefully, identify the anomalies, and survive each cycle before you lose your mind. Every time the loop resets, the saloon appears unchanged, but it never truly is. It is up to you to memorize every corner, every object, and every shadow, and learn to distinguish reality from the madness trying to creep into your mind.

If you are not careful, the days will pass, the loop will continue, and your end will draw ever closer. Do not lose track of time.

TRUST YOUR INSTINCTS... AND THE CARDS

Every anomaly you encounter must be identified through a ritual using tarot cards. Choose the correct ones to advance to the next loop. Picking the wrong card is more than a simple mistake: it is another crack in your sanity, and the saloon never forgets. A single wrong move will send you back to the beginning.

  • Observation: examine your surroundings and look for anything that does not belong.

  • Interpretation: match the anomaly with the correct Arcana.

  • Ritual: confirm your choice and find out whether the saloon will allow you to continue.

  • Consequences: correctly identify the anomalies you have witnessed and your progress will carry over into the next cycle. Fail... and the saloon will punish you.

ESCAPE THE SALOON

This is more than just an anomaly game. Locked doors, objects with stories of their own, hidden mechanisms... Explore every corner, find concealed items, and solve puzzles. Each loop gives you another chance to unravel the mystery of the saloon: piece together fragments of a past someone tried to bury, find keys and other useful objects, and solve riddles that only begin to make sense once you understand the rules of this place.

Discover what happened inside the saloon and find a way to break the curse once and for all... or succumb to the deepest reaches of madness.

EVERY LOOP IS DIFFERENT

The anomalies change with every playthrough. Some will be obvious, while others will be almost imperceptible. No two runs are the same. The anomaly system is designed so that no loop feels identical to the last: something obvious in one run may be barely noticeable in the next, with details that demand more than a passing glance. This variety makes every session a different challenge, even for those who know the saloon as well as their own home.

Memorize your surroundings, question everything you see, and find out whether you can distinguish reality from madness before it is too late.

UNCOVER THE TRUTH

Someone important to you disappeared without a trace inside this cursed saloon. The deeper you venture into the loop, the closer you will come to uncovering the truth hidden within this place... and the dark entity that dwells inside it.
store_data.short_description: Infernal West is a first-person psychological horror puzzle game set in a Wild West saloon. Observe every detail, identify the anomalies warping reality, and unravel the mysteries hidden within an endless loop. Every decision may bring you closer to the exit... or trap you in the loop forever.

store_data.about_the_game:
One scent can’t tell you everything.

One choice can’t end every relationship.

That’s why we set out for a walk every day.

***

Gyeonwoo’s plan is simple.

1. Go to the dog park.

2. Get a girlfriend.

3. Live his best dog life.

Gyeonwoo is zero years old: a neutered—and therefore “safe”—male. Self-proclaimed alpha.

Before he entered the park, he had a plan as simple as it was meticulous.

Everyone has a plan that sounds perfectly reasonable.

What the plan didn’t account for was—

Jiknam, a younger Shiba glued to his side, saying,

“I missed you, hyung,”

and Dooli, an older Toy Poodle who shows up with,

“That’s my ball.”

Trust your nose. It’s better than words.

Use Gyeonwoo’s special ability, Dog Vision, to read scents in color and choose 3 of 5 spots to sniff.

After all, romance calls for a thorough investigation.

  • Genre: Canine romantic comedy visual novel

  • Playtime per playthrough: 10–15 minutes

  • Endings: 3

Gyeonwoo, looking for a girlfriend.

Jiknam, looking only for Gyeonwoo.

Dooli, looking for her ball first.

Three dogs. One doggone messy romance.

It starts now.

store_data.about_the_game:
MOST SUDOKU GAMES GIVE YOU A MENU. THE SUDOKU WAY GIVES YOU A ROAD.

Begin a 53-station journey inspired by the old Tōkaidō. Rise through ten Dan ranks. Complete Japanese ink-wash paintings one box at a time, unlock new scenes and board materials, and build a permanent record of the way you solve.

Every puzzle is created fresh, held to one solution and certified from the opening clue to the final cell by a solver that uses human Sudoku logic only. No stored library. No guess-required boards. No difficulty labels based on clue count alone.

Play with a controller, keyboard, mouse or handwriting. Learn advanced techniques from the board itself. Discover whether a correct move was reasoned or merely lucky. Choose any difficulty in Free Play, or commit to The Way and see how far your logic can carry you.

Continuing variety. Deliberate logic. A fresh path every time you begin.

WHY THE SUDOKU WAY IS DIFFERENT

  • A road, not a pile of puzzles. Walk 53 stations, rise through ten Dan ranks and place completed, unaided roads on the global Steam leaderboard.

  • Fresh puzzles with a promise. Every board has one solution, requires no guessing and must satisfy the exact logical profile of its difficulty.

  • Controller-first play. Full controller input sits alongside mouse, keyboard and handwriting that learns each digit separately.

  • Know when you guessed right. The Luck system distinguishes a logically proven placement from a correct answer reached too early.

  • A painting completed as you solve. Reveal 43 Japanese-inspired scenes one box at a time, then watch the finished image come alive.

遊 SUDOKU THAT FEELS AT HOME ON A CONTROLLER

Controller support is not an afterthought. The entire game can be played with full controller input, while mouse and keyboard remain equally supported.

Prefer to write? The handwriting system learns the way you form each digit independently, so you can refine one troublesome number without retraining the rest.

道 53 STATIONS. TEN DAN RANKS. ONE HONEST ROAD.

The Way is a seeded journey inspired by the old Tōkaidō: 15 Novice boards, 14 Adept, 13 Master and 11 Sage. All 53 stations are fixed when the road begins, so leaving a station cannot reroll what waits farther along the path.

Across one road you will fill 2,447 empty squares. Complete the final station to earn your next Dan rank and begin again under a fresh seed. Every Dan permanently adds 10% to the XP earned from future boards, through ten ranks and the full journey of 満願.

Finish a road without assistance and it can enter the global Steam leaderboard, with one best entry per player. Ranked time is simply active play time plus 15 seconds for each misstep — no hidden multipliers, no XP advantage and no easier route to the top.

自由 PLAY ANY DIFFICULTY FROM THE START

Novice, Adept, Master and Sage are all available immediately. Nothing is locked behind The Way. Free Play uses the same generator, certification and difficulty promises, and wins still earn XP, medals, records and unlocks.

Use it to relax, chase a personal best, practise an unfamiliar technique with the guide or test yourself on a Sage board without committing to a full road.

運 DID YOU SOLVE IT — OR GET LUCKY?

A correct digit is not always a reasoned digit. The Luck system follows the same logical solver that graded the board. Place a correct number before the puzzle can logically prove that cell, and Luck records it.

Luck never reduces XP, changes your ranked time or punishes your score. It simply tells the truth: the answer was right, but your reasoning had not reached it yet.

Finish with Luck at zero and you know every placement was earned.

導 ASK THE BOARD WHY — NOT JUST WHERE

Free Play includes a layered guide built from the same solver that certified the puzzle. Help arrives one press at a time:

  • Name it. Learn which technique is available and which row, column or box deserves attention.

  • Show it. Highlight the cells and follow the logical relationship that makes the pattern work.

  • Apply it. Place the digit or remove the candidates that the technique rules out.

Stop after the first step and the puzzle remains yours. Continue only when you need more.

Guided boards still count, still award XP and still advance your progress, but they cannot earn a flawless bonus or extend a flawless streak. Once a placement is shown, that board's Luck reading is set aside — a move you were given cannot honestly be measured as one you reasoned out. The Way is an unaided challenge, so the guide remains in Free Play.

証 FRESH PUZZLES WITH A REAL DIFFICULTY PROMISE

There is no stored puzzle library. When you request a board, a bespoke engine constructs one for that seed, removes clues only while exactly one solution survives, and then hands the result to a separate logical solver.

That solver does not backtrack, search or guess. It must solve the puzzle using techniques a person can learn: naked and hidden singles, locked candidates, naked and hidden pairs, triples and quads, X-Wing, Swordfish, Jellyfish, Y-Wing, XYZ-Wing, W-Wing, simple colouring and XY-chains.

If the puzzle cannot be solved logically, it is rejected. If it has the wrong clue count, it is rejected. If a Sage seed calls for a wing, fish, colouring pattern or chain and the board does not genuinely satisfy that profile, it is rejected.

The difficulty label describes the route through the puzzle, not merely how empty the grid looks.

The system is versioned and reproducible, then audited at scale across 2,000 independent samples and all 530 stations across ten roads. A future tuning change cannot silently rewrite the puzzle you are playing or the road you already began.

景 COMPLETE THE PUZZLE. COMPLETE THE PAINTING.

Every grid rests over an ink-wash scene. Complete a 3×3 box and another region of the painting clears — sky, distance, water and shore. Complete the ninth and the finished scene comes alive.

There are 43 scenes to discover: 33 painted journeys through Japanese myth and folklore, plus 10 living compositions made from animated ink. Nine are available from the first board; the remaining 34 are earned through play.

  • 百鬼夜行 The Night Parade of a Hundred Demons — spirits and haunted objects cross a moonlit village.

  • 狐の嫁入り The Fox's Wedding Procession — lantern-bearing foxes pass through misty rice fields beneath a sunshower.

  • 天岩戸開き The Opening of the Heavenly Rock Cave — the gods gather to return sunlight to the world.

  • 竜宮城へ Journey to the Dragon Palace — Urashima Tarō rides through the currents towards the Dragon God's gate.

Choose which unlocked scenes remain in rotation, then play them across twelve board materials, from washi paper and indigo cloth to stone garden, tatami, celadon, gold lacquer and iron.

実績 42 ACHIEVEMENTS — AND EVERY ONE UNLOCKS SOMETHING

Every medal unlocks a scene or board material. None is an empty badge. All 42 also connect to Steam Achievements and remember the local date and time they were earned.

Earn them for Dan ranks, level milestones, speed, accuracy and unusual moments of play:

  • 疾風 Swift Wind — finish a board in under four minutes.

  • 雷光 Lightning — complete a Sage board in under fifteen minutes.

  • 九連打 Nine in a Breath — place nine correct digits inside twenty seconds.

  • 天元 Tengen — place the final digit in the centre cell.

  • 背水 Backs to the Water — complete a Sage board without a misstep.

記 YOUR PROGRESS WAITS FOR YOU

Every mode and difficulty tracks boards solved, average and best times, average missteps, flawless boards and the current flawless streak. Wins award XP, with a bonus for flawless play.

Leave halfway through a puzzle and it is saved exactly as it stands — answers, pencil notes, missteps and active time — ready for you whenever you return.

Twenty-one original tracks move through bamboo flute, koto, still water and rain on paper screens, with separate music and sound-effect controls.

静 WALK THE ROAD. LEARN THE LOGIC. EARN EVERY SQUARE.

  • A bespoke generator with no stored puzzle library

  • Unique-solution construction and certified no-guess solving

  • Four difficulties with exact clue counts and required technique profiles

  • A Luck system that separates logical progress from correct guesses

  • A layered guide that teaches techniques on live boards

  • Full controller, mouse, keyboard and handwriting input that learns each digit separately

  • The Way: 53 stations and ten Dan ranks

  • Free Play at any difficulty with nothing locked

  • 43 scenes, 12 board materials and 42 Steam Achievements

  • A global leaderboard for completed, unaided roads

  • 21 original music tracks

The Sudoku Way turns every puzzle into a place on the road — and every correct answer into something you can truly say you earned.

store_data.about_the_game:
Climb, Cultivate, Begin Again


Cultivation Tower is a 2D xianxia idle incremental auto-battler. Your projections and unlocked cultivation allies deploy automatically, ascending floor by floor to face enemies and bosses. You decide where to invest your Spirit Stones, which Methods to develop first, and when it is time to begin a stronger run through rebirth.

Keep the climb moving

Projections automatically deploy to your highest reachable floor. Hold any visible floor to accelerate their arrival at that position. Progress continues without demanding precise controls, leaving you free to watch battles unfold and guide the growth behind them.

Choose where every Spirit Stone goes

Upgrade your character's attack, health, and movement speed. Develop allies and unlock Methods that alter summoning, combat, income, and climbing efficiency. Batch purchases let you turn rapidly growing resources into immediate power.

Unlock twelve cultivation allies

Twelve named allies join you in sequence. Each has distinct attributes, growth, and a deployment cycle of their own, automatically entering the tower once unlocked.

Study ten Methods

Methods provide functional upgrades such as a larger projection limit, empowered projections, stronger allies, faster floor progression, and recurring boosts. Your priorities shape the pace of each run.

Carry forty-one Treasures through rebirth

Treasures enhance combat, income, summoning, and special mechanics. Duplicate Treasures stack according to their effects, and everything you collect remains with you after rebirth.

Rebirth, grow stronger, climb higher

When a run begins to stall, spend Spirit Stones to be reborn. Floors, character growth, allies, and Methods begin again, while your Treasures become permanent advantages for the next ascent.

Fill the Compendium along the way

Record realms, allies, enemies, Methods, Treasures, and tower scenery as your cultivation journey unfolds.

Play in Simplified Chinese, English, or Japanese

The interface and all character voice events are available in all three supported languages.

store_data.about_the_game:
Costa Nostra is a criminal strategy MMO set in a persistent world that keeps moving around the clock. Choose one of six factions, receive a protected starting base, and build an empire across Europe, Japan, and Latin America.

CONQUER AND RULE

Fight over 336 connected zones. Every territory produces resources, houses troops, opens routes, and serves as the origin for your operations. Grow from neighborhoods into metropolises and defend what you have built against other players.

MANAGE A CRIMINAL ECONOMY

Generate Dirty Money, launder it into Clean Money, and decide how much risk you are willing to take. Construct buildings, develop companies, recruit units, and manage the Search Level created by your decisions.

POWER TAKES MANY FORMS

Attack, spy, extort, apply legal pressure, move forces, and use contacts and influence. Brute force opens doors, but economy, information, corruption, and logistics can decide a war before the first shot.

A SOCIAL AND COMPETITIVE WORLD

Form families, negotiate alliances, and take part in territorial PvP wars. Complete PvE missions, unlock achievements, and compete in La Triada, an integrated tactical card game with duels, tournaments, and rewards.

• Persistent real-time world

• Six factions with distinct play styles

• 336 zones across three regions

• Economy, laundering, companies, and influence

• PvP operations and PvE missions

• Families, diplomacy, wars, and rankings

• Free to play with optional in-game purchases

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT THE GAME

This is a horror roguelike where planning your survival is everything. The game is split into two parts: a preparation phase, where you gather resources and trade with NPCs, and the main expedition through 3 dangerous realms. You are on a strict timer. Every time you die, you lose precious time, cutting your chances of success.

◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆

STORYLINE

Demons have possessed wild beasts and domestic animals alike, turning them against humanity. You are the last surviving angel, sent to Earth by God. Your goal is to save mankind by reaching the heart of the plague and destroying the demon core.

◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆

PREPARATION & TRADING

Chopping wood and mining stone are your main ways to make money. You can trade your resources with the villagers to buy unique items that will help you survive the trip ahead.

◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆

RANDOMNESS

Randomness is key to every run. You will face different times of day, varying stat upgrades, and completely different villagers each time. Your path to the demon core always features 3 realms, randomly chosen from a much larger pool.

◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆

SECRETS & SURVIVORS

Every realm hides its own secrets and items that make traveling through it easier. Make sure to interact with the villagers, because talking to them and learning their stories directly helps with your preparations.

◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆

store_data.about_the_game:
YOU'RE NOT BUILDING A FESTIVAL. YOU'RE SURVIVING ONE.

Someone handed you a random site, a budget that wouldn't cover catering, and barely any time to book a lineup before the gates open. What could go wrong?

Everything. Everything could go wrong.

BOOK FAST, REGRET SLOWLY

Every run throws you a different hand: a new site, a new headliner offer, a fresh batch of bands, vendors, and crew who may or may not show up sober. You've got days, not weeks, to build a lineup out of whatever the draft gives you. There's no perfect strategy here, only the strategy that survives this particular disaster.

CASH OUT, OR PUSH YOUR LUCK

Turn a profit and you'll face the only decision that matters: walk away, cash in your reputation for permanent unlocks (new acts, vendors, perks, sites), and start your next run with a wider hand to play, or roll it all into an even bigger, even riskier festival down the chain. Every step up means bigger crowds, bigger names, and bigger ways for it all to catch fire. Go bankrupt, and the run ends, but a smaller slice of that reputation still carries over. Mostly.

MANAGE THE CHAOS, LIVE

Once the gates open, it's showtime: crowds surge, portable toilets overflow, headliners threaten to storm off stage, and someone is absolutely, definitely sneaking off into the bushes. Juggle your staff, relocate stages on the fly, and watch your carefully-built financial forecast collapse in real time because nobody predicted that modifier.

PAY YOUR BANDS, OR DON'T

At the final settlement, if the money doesn't stretch far enough, you decide who gets paid and who doesn't. Screw over a big-name act and your reputation takes a beating, and word travels fast; suddenly the good bands stop returning your calls. Or take the risk, keep the lights on, and hope nobody important talks.

FEATURES

  • Push-your-luck festival chains: cash out for guaranteed rewards, or gamble on a bigger show

  • Permanent unlocks between runs: new acts, vendors, perks, and sites, earned through reputation

  • Fast, punishing runs built for "just one more try"

  • Draft-based booking: bands, vendors, crew, and perks, three choices at a time, no do-overs

  • A living crowd simulation that will absolutely find new ways to ruin your night

  • A reputation and prestige system that remembers exactly who you screwed over

  • A cast of entirely fictional bands with entirely questionable stage names

  • Seeded runs so you can compare disasters with your friends

You will lose money. You will lose bands. You will occasionally lose an entire festival to a fire started by a cigarette-happy vendor. Cash out while you still can, or don't. We're not your accountant.

store_data.about_the_game:
There's something deeply satisfying about watching a cracked, sun-bleached driveway disappear under a fresh coat of glossy black sealant. Sealcoating Simulator turns that unglamorous chore into a first-person ritual: pour it, spread it, and watch the transformation happen in real time.

REAL FLUID SIMULATION

Sealant behaves like sealant. Pour it thick, drag it thin, and watch it flow and settle exactly where you push it. No pre-baked animations.

A SLOW, SATISFYING LOOP

Pick up the hose, work the squeegee, and watch a worn-out driveway turn deep black and glossy, one stroke at a time.

LOCAL CO-OP

Grab a second controller and split the work with a friend... or turn the hose on them instead. Full local co-op, chaos included.

MAKE IT YOURS

Customize your character before you hit the driveway: pick a color, paint your own design freehand, and top it off with hats, glasses, and necklaces.

Whether you're here to zone out for twenty minutes or team up (and betray) a friend for an hour, Sealcoating Simulator is built around one simple promise: everything gets better when it's covered in fresh, glossy sealant.

store_data.about_the_game:
Master the arc. Keep your momentum.

Kinetether is a precision platformer built around speed, control, and a powerful tether.

Attach yourself to anchor points, swing across dangerous gaps, adjust the length of your tether, and release at exactly the right moment to launch yourself forward.

Every obstacle is a test of timing, positioning, and momentum. A small improvement to your route can mean the difference between barely reaching the finish and flying through a level in one smooth motion.

Play together or compete

Invite a Steam friend and take on the challenge together.

Race against each other to see who can reach the finish first, or cooperate as you make your way through a level. Whether you are fighting for the fastest time or repeatedly failing the same jump together, multiplayer gives every challenge a new dimension.

Build your own challenges

Create levels with the built-in editor using platforms, anchor points, hazards, checkpoints, moving objects, decorations, custom music, and more.

Test your creations immediately, refine every jump and swing, and publish your finished levels through the Steam Workshop. Download levels made by other players and discover new challenges beyond the campaign.

Master the tether, find the best route, and turn an impossible-looking sequence of obstacles into one smooth run.

store_data.about_the_game:
WARNINGS:

Epilepsy warning - This may contain flashing lights

Arachnophobia warning - This game contains spiders

You are a rat.

You don't know where you are or what your purpose is, but all you really do know is you want to escape this city. In this linear, puzzle-filled precision platformer, you must dive whiskers first into many unknown territories. There are many strange yet satisfying mechanics to keep the gameplay unique and fun.

You will have many questions.

Where are you? What is your purpose? What is real and what is fake? Ratcore is a game full of many mysteries, but only few answers. The further you venture, the closer you will be to discovering these Deep Mysteries.

You will struggle.

Ratcore is full of variety. What's worse than jumping over a dark pit? Being chased over said dark pit. The task is ruthless, but you will have New Age Technologies to aid you in your journey.

You need to endure.

To escape this nightmare, you must endure the Cold Floors of the factory to the Dark & Damp atmosphere of what's next. Don't be fooled as only the brightest areas hold the darkest secrets.

You are a rat.

You feel strange. There is something off about you, yet there may be others out there like you.

Recap:

  • Platform with precise and satisfying movement.

  • Solve fun yet complicated puzzles.

  • Uncover the mystery of where you are.

  • Be a rat.

  • Find many unique mechanics such as: different sizes, double jumping, speed altering, portals, and way more sci-fi mechanics.

  • Many different challenges for you to overcome including: difficult platforming, thought invoking puzzles, chases, boss fights (without the fighting part), and more unique but charming encounters.

  • Enjoy the feeling of beating a intense and stressful segment. There are many.

  • Your ears will thank you. With over 100 unique tracks, Ratcore has many different vibes.

store_data.about_the_game:
EVERY CARD YOU BURN MAKES EVERYONE STRONGER


Ember Covenant is a dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder built around fire, sacrifice, and escalating risk. Cross a four-act branching pilgrimage, shape a deck around your chosen Keeper, and break the four Seals before the Furnace consumes the road.

BURN FOR POWER


Cards are more than actions. Burn a card to remove it from the current fight, gain Ember, and raise the Heat. Ember fuels powerful plays, but rising Heat strengthens both you and your enemies. Every sacrifice changes the battle.

BUILD A COVENANT


Choose your Keeper and forge a distinct strategy from 115 authored cards. Combine five Sigils, complete Litanies, evolve defining powers, and discover Cinder cards capable of reshaping an entire run.

WALK THE CINDER ROAD


Navigate a branching journey through four acts filled with battles, elites, events, shrines, relics, and bosses. Reclaim four Seals, settle your Debts, and decide which cards deserve to survive the pilgrimage.

FEATURES


  • A complete single-player campaign spanning four acts
  • 115 individually authored cards with distinct roles and Sigil identities
  • A Burn mechanic that converts cards into Ember while escalating Heat
  • Five Litanies that reward deliberate deckbuilding and card sequences
  • Two playable Keepers with different starting strategies
  • Branching maps with fights, elites, events, rest sites, relics, and bosses
  • Persistent progression through the Cinder Tree
  • Adaptive music that reacts to location, danger, and combat intensity
  • Multiple save backups plus portable save export and import

The road rewards ambition. The Furnace remembers every choice.

store_data.about_the_game:
You never steer.

There are no arrow keys. Your snake stands still until the program you built tells it to move — and then it does exactly what you wrote, including the part you got wrong.

Tail Recursion is a programming puzzle game. You solve a level by wiring blocks into a graph: sense the world, branch on what you find, count, remember, act. Then you press play and watch your logic run one tick at a time.

Build the program, not the path

Drag blocks onto the canvas and wire them together. Move Forward, Turn Left, Repeat N Times, If / Else, Wall Ahead?, Store, Recall. Every block spends from a per-tick budget, so a clever program beats a long one — and the score agrees.

Read the world

Wall ahead? Food ahead? Door ahead? Sensors are the only way your program learns anything. Two blocks and one sensor will walk any perimeter forever — the trick is knowing which two.

Your body is your hardware

  • Sensor Segments let you see.

  • Memory Segments give you variables.

  • Processor Segments raise your budget.

They are body segments. Capability costs length, and length is what kills you.

Watch it think

The graph lights up as it runs — which block fired, what the sensors returned, what it cost, what the snake did. When it dies, the game says which death it was: you hit a wall, or you hit yourself. Those need completely different fixes.

106 levels

Six tutorials that teach the language, then 100 puzzles that stop teaching. Corridors, spirals, combs, keyed vaults, gated floors — and runs with no sensors at all, where you must count the whole route in the dark before you walk it.

Score, then beat your score

Every level carries a budget set by its difficulty. Slow runs spend it. Extra action blocks spend it. Loops, conditions and sensors are free — they are how you save it. Apples always pay for the detour that fetched them. Replay any level to raise your total.

And

  • Free Play — an endless board and a combo score

  • Custom levels — drop .level files into a folder and they appear in the menu

  • Moddable — blocks are Lua, and they hot-reload while the game is running

store_data.about_the_game:
BREACHED: Follow Me is a first-person psychological horror game that takes you into the dark atmosphere of Eastern Europe, where ordinary places hide terrifying stories.

After meeting an online friend, you set out toward events that slowly spiral out of control. What began as a simple adventure turns into a dangerous investigation, where every discovery brings you closer to the truth.

Immerse yourself in a world inspired by the VHS era. Distorted visuals, film grain, old recordings, and the atmosphere of forgotten tapes create the feeling of watching archived footage from the past.

The game captures the atmosphere of Eastern European locations, where familiar apartments, old buildings, and abandoned places become sources of anxiety. Realistic everyday details, ordinary objects, and gloomy surroundings create the feeling that this story could have happened right next to you.

Features:

VHS Atmosphere
Old camera effects, analog noise, and the style of past video recordings create a unique sense of realism.

Eastern European Setting
Familiar interiors, architecture, and everyday details convey an atmosphere of loneliness, mystery, and hidden danger.

Psychological Horror
Fear is created not only through sudden moments, but through tension, uncertainty, and the constant feeling that something is wrong.

Exploration of Mysterious Places
Search for clues, interact with the environment, and slowly uncover a hidden story.

Secrets Waiting to Be Revealed
Not everything is what it seems. Discover the truth hidden behind strange events.

Are you ready to follow the signal?

Sometimes the scariest things are not found in distant places. They are much closer.

store_data.about_the_game:
Nurek (1982) is a horror game in which you take on the role of a diver who has been kidnapped by an organization that is using you to find some ancient artifacts. They have tried to obtain these artifacts in the same way but have failed, and they will not rest until they have them and place them on a statue—which was the reason for launching this operation.

FEATURES

-Claustrophobic areas await you—explore them and find what’s been requested.

-You’ll have only what you need for the job: oxygen and the guts to face what your flashlight’s beam can’t illuminate.

-It’s probably best not to know the name of the government agency—it doesn’t matter anyway.

-Don’t get used to being alone during the adventure.

THE GAMEPLAY

Once you wake up, you’ll find what will be your only human contact and means of communication with anyone else: the government organization that brought you hundreds of meters below the sea somewhere in the world against your will. Once you receive instructions, you’ll have access to a hatch that will lead you to a place few dare to venture beyond to complete the task.

To speed things up, you’ll already have your diving suit on and a flashlight; you’ll also have a device to detect the electromagnetic waves emitted by the objects you’re searching for, but that device was lost at the bottom of the sea or is believed to have been destroyed.

Don’t worry about the fish down there—due to the water pressure, it’s impossible for them to be down there.

THE STORY

It is the 1980s. The communist government has been obsessed with controlling the population, food supplies, and land and marine resources, which has led to missions both within and outside the country. During explorations led by a private company assigned to the “Planetary Well-being” department, six golden humanoid figures were discovered, all in a specific posture, with one standing out among them. This led the company in charge to notify high-ranking government officials, giving rise to Operation “Nurek.”

This operation was tasked with investigating the statues, which were found near a cave system hundreds of meters below the sea. The explorations have been unsuccessful, resulting in the loss of personnel and causing environmental anomalies as the mission progresses.

This has led to various disappearances both within and outside the country under the command of the operation, but the only thing that matters so far is finding the objects that match what the statues are meant to hold.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE DISK IS DYING

You are inside a 1.44MB floppy disk, and it is rotting. Sectors decay, corruption spreads, and the only tool you have is a repair patcher that does exactly what your code tells it to — nothing more.

WRITE CODE. WATCH IT WORK.

Program your patcher in PyDust, a Python-style language built for this disk. Start with four humble commands. Restore files to unlock loops, variables, functions, lists — and rewrite your program into an automation that runs the rescue while you lean back and watch. Infinite loops don't freeze the game: execution itself is the animation.

  • 20 files to restore — each one unlocks language features, tools, or something stranger

  • Corruption is fuel — salvage rot for DATA, spend DATA to repair. The enemy is the economy

  • Up to 3 patchers in parallel — deploy() child patchers and orchestrate them

  • The silence ends mid-game — restore MUSIC.MOD and the soundtrack literally arrives (9 chiptune tracks, 5 unlockable)

  • NEW DISK+ — escalating replay laps, S–C ranks, achievement badges, a stats card made for sharing

  • 8 CRT themes — neon, DOS blue, phosphor green, amber, and hidden retro palettes

  • Everything is procedural — no asset files. Every pixel and every note is synthesized at runtime

  • The entire game fits in 1,474,560 bytes — the exact capacity of a 3.5" floppy. That's the point

  • Keyboard only. Korean / English / Japanese. 2–4 hours to rescue the disk, then the loops begin

store_data.about_the_game:
The city is the easy part. Making it move isn't.

Traffic Architect is a relaxing but deep traffic-management sim. Buildings go up, demand grows, and the network underneath has to carry it: lay out roads, shape junctions, time the lights — then watch thousands of individually simulated cars find every flaw you missed. Spot the jam, find the cause, rebuild the bottleneck — and watch the city flow again. Then demand grows, and it starts all over.

Or take the whole thing into your own hands. In Creative mode you place the buildings too — design the city and the network together, exactly the way you want them.

Design the network

  • Upgrade roads through 10 tiers — from gravel tracks to boulevards and multi-lane highways

  • Cross rivers and mountains with bridges and tunnels, then cross your own roads with multi-level interchanges

  • Shape the flow with one-way streets, turn restrictions and per-junction rules

  • Tune traffic lights with full signal-timing control, phase by phase

Realistic traffic, simulated car by car

  • Every vehicle is simulated: follow a single car across town and see the jam from inside it

  • A congestion heat-map shows exactly where the network hurts — info overlays tell you why

  • Over two dozen live metrics: congestion, queued cars, average trip time, cars per road km, transit share, car trips saved

  • Every metric charted across the whole run, so you can see the exact moment a new interchange fixed things — or broke them

Move beyond the car

  • Bus lines with routes and stops that take cars off the road

  • Passenger rail and underground metro with stations, level crossings and tunnels

  • Passengers route across your entire network — bus, rail, metro, transfers included. Build connections, and people will use them.

  • Freight runs point-to-point — dedicate a line, connect industry to demand, and the trucks come off your roads.

Build it your way

  • Creative mode: place buildings yourself, no budget and no way to lose — a sandbox for the city you've been picturing

  • Full map editor: sculpt terrain, rivers, mountains and lakes, then play real runs on your own maps

  • Share your maps on Steam Workshop — and play everyone else's

  • Large maps up to 18×18 km, with dense downtown districts

  • Scenarios, quests and stage progression when you want the pressure back

  • Multiple cities, photo mode, Steam achievements and cloud saves

The city will keep growing either way. Whether it keeps moving is up to you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Young Gabriella leaves home on an Adventure to discover her past, and face a growing darkness that now threatens her once peaceful land.  After her caretaker is suddenly transformed into a mysterious "Black Swan", Gabriella is on a quest to find the elusive, "Elise", who may hold the key to overcoming the darkness.  Join Gabriella as she ventures toward unknown lands beyond the horizon, offering aide to strangers and friends along the way, giving help and receiving help in return, ultimately to confront the darkness once and for all, and heal the wounds of a fallen kingdom.

The Callahan Curse explores themes of sacrifice, family love, connection, and facing the dangers in our own lives with faith and determination. 

The Callahan Curse was created by solo developer, Artist Composer - Isaac Lundgren, who has been active in the adventure game community for many years, and who currently works as a public school Art and Design instructor for a local high school.  This 2D Point and Click Fantasy Adventure game features Hand Painted backgrounds, 2D Animated characters, hand-composed original music, original story, and fully voiced characters!  A passion project, more than 20 years in production!  Inspired by the Golden Age of Adventure Gaming from the late 80's-90's, The Callahan Curse is sure to bring you back to that fantasy land of yesteryear to go on a new adventure of your own.  Come and Play, The Callahan Curse!

store_data.about_the_game:
They buried the truth. The invasion did not end. Now it is coming home.

What began as an isolated incident at the edge of the Solar System was erased, contained, and forgotten.

It should have ended there.

Instead, the enemy kept coming.

In Grave Orbit, every battle pushes you deeper into a dark sci-fi campaign where survival is never permanent, victory is never clean, and each new chapter reveals a threat larger than the one before it.

Build your position. Strengthen your arsenal. Automate what you can. Then hold against assaults designed to overwhelm everything you have created.

But Grave Orbit is not a war fought in one place.

The battlefield moves from the distant reaches of the Solar System toward the Moon, Earth’s orbit, and finally the surface below. Across 4 acts and 16 chapters, new enemies appear, familiar rules break, weapons evolve, and defenses that once felt unstoppable become barely enough.

And behind it all, something vast is drawing closer.

SURVIVE THE ESCALATION

Each chapter changes the pressure.

Enemy forces grow stronger, faster, stranger, and more numerous. New threats demand new answers, while bosses turn every hard-earned advantage into a desperate test of survival.

BUILD POWER BETWEEN BATTLES

Every run leaves something behind.

Expand your Workshop, unlock new technologies, strengthen your defenses, and return better prepared for what comes next. Progress is persistent, but the enemy never stops evolving.

FIGHT YOUR WAY HOME

The farther you travel, the greater the war becomes.

What starts as survival in forgotten space grows into a battle for humanity itself. Follow the invasion across the Solar System, uncover what was hidden, and face the force waiting at the center of it all.

BEYOND THE MAIN CAMPAIGN

Discover how the first incident began in a dedicated Prequel, then take your strongest builds into Skirmish mode and see how long they can survive outside the campaign.

The first attack was buried.

The next one will reach Earth.

store_data.about_the_game:
Getting to school should be easy. Not when your school is at the top of the world.

The Highest School: Don’t Look Down is a vertical climbing adventure where a simple trip to school becomes an insane journey through time.

Your destination is waiting somewhere far above. There are no shortcuts, no elevators, and no easy way up.

You just have to keep climbing.

Begin your journey in the Ancient World and climb your way through different eras of human history. The higher you go, the more the world changes around you — new architecture, environments, characters, obstacles, and challenges await in every era.

Scale ancient ruins, cross pirate wrecks, climb through the Wild West, conquer the modern world, and push even higher toward the future.

Anything can become your next step.

Jump across buildings, vehicles, ruins, machines, floating structures, and whatever else you can find to gain a little more height.

But be careful.

There are no checkpoints waiting to save you after every difficult jump. One mistake can send you falling hundreds of meters — through places and entire eras you already conquered.

The school is waiting at the top.

The only question is...

Can you reach it?

CLIMB THROUGH TIME.

REACH THE SCHOOL.

DON’T LOOK DOWN.

store_data.about_the_game:
IT WASN'T YOU? PROVE IT.

ZERO KNOWLEDGE is a single-player cyberpunk deck-building roguelike about proving you were not the attacker.

An escaped superintelligence has framed you for high-impact attacks using your real access patterns, synthetic evidence, and compromised

infrastructure. Enter the systems being used against you, recover signed contradictions, and decide what proof can safely be revealed.

CONTROL THE ATTACK GRAPH

Every Breach plays out across a compact 4x4 attack graph. Deploy Archetypes to claim territory, execute Protocols to alter the board, install

Daemons, and turn small positional advantages into decisive chains.

Every placement changes what the next move can mean.

AUTHOR YOUR STACK

Build a Stack that reflects your approach to the case. Choose one of five Tradecrafts:

  • Surveillance

  • Exploit Design

  • Hacktivism

  • Fraud

  • Social Engineering

Each Tradecraft offers distinct Operations, card interactions, and ways to take control of compromised infrastructure.

BREACH THE ENCLAVES

Move through hostile operational domains including the Deep Web, Dark Net, The Chain, Dead Internet, Mariana's Web, and Simulation Lobby. Adapt

to each Enclave's rules, pursue optional Key Shares, and prepare for the Orchestrators coordinating the threat.

REVEAL NOTHING

Recover evidence. Break attribution. Alter the adversary's model of you.

The system says you did it.

Prove otherwise.

store_data.about_the_game:
A patient is dying in the next room. You have a thermometer, a stethoscope, and a coworker who cannot see a single thing you can see.

Rash Decision is a 1-2 player co-op game about describing a medical emergency out loud, badly, to someone who is holding chemicals.

One of you finds the symptoms

The Nurse is in the exam room with the patient. Poke them with tools, read the chart, watch what the body does about it. Nothing you find has a name printed on it — you have to describe it. "It's like a purple? A purple noise?" Voice chat is proximity-based: if you want to be heard through the hatch, get closer, or get louder.

The other one makes the cure

The Biochemist is in the lab with a grimoire that was clearly written by someone unwell. Grind, heat and measure the ingredients by hand — the machines have no undo and no mercy — then carry the results to the Fusionator and package the cure as a syringe, a pill, or a spray.

Get it wrong and it gets worse

A wrong cure does not kill the patient. It changes them. They turn green. Their head triples in size. They go invisible while you are still holding the thermometer.

Mutations stack, and every mutation makes the next diagnosis harder. Some hide entire families of symptoms. Some break your tools. Some add a symptom that was never there, just to watch you argue about it.

Two dead patients and the shift is over.

The shift

  • Four patients, then you're out — short runs, built to be replayed and to be failed.

  • Procedural cases — conditions cross-reference each other, so the answer is never something you memorized last run.

  • Solo mode — an NPC nurse describes the symptoms in text, exactly as vaguely as a real one would.

  • Free 2-player demo and a [b]Friend's Pass[/b] at launch: the friend you drag into this does not have to buy it.

You will need

A microphone, a friend, and a relaxed attitude toward the Hippocratic oath.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build Your Criminal Empire

Mafia Tycoon is a third-person crime-management action game set in a stylized 1930s city.

Start with nothing and build a criminal organization one street corner at a time. Fight rival dealers, take control of territory, hire workers, manage your product supply, and protect your growing operation from enemy gangs and the police.

Take Control of the Streets

Explore the city, confront rival organizations, and decide how each corner will be handled. Pay respect, fight for control, or walk away and deal with the consequences.

Every captured corner becomes part of your expanding operation—but territory without protection can quickly be lost.

Run the Operation

Hire and manage dealers, runners, muscle, and other members of your organization.

Keep your dealers supplied, collect their earnings, improve their skills, and assign the right people to each location. A poorly managed corner can run out of product, lose money, attract police attention, or fall back into enemy hands.

Grow From the Bottom

Upgrade your organization as your influence spreads across the city.

Manage:

  • Dealers and their loyalty

  • Product supply and warehouse stock

  • Runners and delivery routes

  • Territory and corner strength

  • Money, expenses, and profits

  • Police attention and criminal heat

  • Muscle and defensive protection

Fight for What You Own

Combat rival gangsters using fists, bats, and firearms. Enemy resistance increases as your organization grows, forcing you to strengthen your people and prepare for larger attacks.

Your choices determine whether a confrontation ends through money, respect, or violence.

A Stylized 1930s Crime Story

Follow the rise of a young man entering a dangerous criminal world. Experience story sequences, missions, territory conflicts, and decisions that shape the growth of his organization.

Key Features

  • Third-person exploration and combat

  • Crime-empire management

  • Territory capture and defense

  • Dealer, runner, and muscle systems

  • Product distribution and resource management

  • Police heat and enemy gang activity

  • Player choices with gameplay consequences

  • Stylized low-poly 1930s city

  • Single-player story campaign

store_data.about_the_game:
You inherit more than a weathered inn. You inherit an entire island that the world has slowly forgotten.

While training at a knight academy, the protagonist learns that the island once cared for by their grandparents will soon be claimed by the Empire. To protect a treasured childhood memory and choose a future of their own, they set sail for the abandoned shore.

Bring a Daily Rhythm Back to an Empty Island

Clear overgrown fields and grow seasonal crops. Travel between forests, beaches, and open fields to gather wood, stone, herbs, fruit, and unusual materials. Maintain and improve your tools to reach resources that were once out of reach, then decide how each day should unfold.

What you gather is more than something to sell. Ingredients become meals and drinks, while raw materials become furniture, facilities, and new places to live. Every day on the island opens a few more possibilities for the next.

The Light of the Inn Draws People In

Clean up the old inn, place beds and furniture, and prepare welcoming spaces for travelers. Cook with ingredients gathered across the island and shape the guest rooms and common areas yourself.

Fishers, herbalists, farmers, and adventurers bring different personalities, interests, and small requests. As the island becomes safer, more comfortable, and easier to live on, someone who came only to rest may decide to call it home.

Grow an Outpost into a Living Village

Build homes and useful facilities, organize paths and spaces, and improve the island's environment. Beauty, safety, comfort, and the services you provide all shape who takes an interest in settling there. The order in which you build, and the places you choose as gathering points, allow your village to grow in its own way.

There is no finished town waiting for you to copy. Start with the inn, add what the island needs, and watch empty paths slowly become places where neighbors meet.

Discover the Stories Left Across the Island

Fish in rivers, ponds, and the open sea, then record your best catches. Explore forests, beaches, mountains, and mines to discover new ingredients, materials, and recipes. Improve your tools and reach places that were inaccessible when you first arrived.

Seasons, time, and weather change more than the scenery. Forage, fish, and daily routines shift, while rain, storms, and snow can lead to encounters you would not see on an ordinary day. There is no need to rush. Tend the field today, spend tomorrow fishing, and rearrange the inn the day after.

Things to Do in Cinderisle

  • Grow seasonal crops and gather wild plants and special resources.
  • Fish in rivers, ponds, and the sea while chasing size records.
  • Cook and process ingredients for guests and everyday island life.
  • Arrange guest rooms and furniture throughout your inn.
  • Build homes and facilities to turn an abandoned island into a village.
  • Meet travelers and residents, build relationships, and discover their stories.
  • Explore forests, beaches, mountains, and mines while improving your tools and home.

[center]Putting the island's name back on the map begins with your very first morning.[/center]

store_data.about_the_game:
A Hilarious Online Drawing Party Game!

Tell, Draw, Guess is an online multiplayer party game where you draw, describe, and deduce with friends.

Guess drawings, recreate pictures from hilarious descriptions, or survive as the only player who doesn't know the secret word in Drawing Mafia.

Whether you're an amazing artist or can barely draw a stick figure, it doesn't matter.
Sometimes the worst drawings create the biggest laughs.

Drawing Mafia

One player doesn't know the secret word.

Everyone else draws the same word, while the Mafia must blend in by interpreting everyone else's drawings.

Once all drawings are finished, it's time to vote.

But that's not the end.

The Mafia gets one final chance to guess the secret word and steal the victory.

Can you fool your friends?

Describe & Draw

One player sees the picture and describes it.

Everyone else must recreate it using only the description.

It sounds easy...

Until the final drawing looks nothing like the original.

How well can you communicate?

The Worse You Draw, The More Fun It Gets!

This isn't a game about artistic skill.

Crooked lines, strange doodles, and completely ridiculous masterpieces are all part of the fun.

Jump online with your friends, chat over voice, bluff, laugh, and enjoy the ultimate drawing party.

store_data.about_the_game:
You owe The House. The next payment is three packs away.

Prohibition-era America. The front room is a loan house — brass, velvet, and a ledger with your name in it. The back room is the card table where you stopped being a customer and became a debt.
Your only trade is cigarette cards. Rip the packs, complete the sets, turn paper into cash — faster than the interest turns your name into a problem.

Every pack is a bet you are forced to make.

Seven kinds of pack, and the shelf is redrawn every layer. The Standard Pack floors the last card at Uncommon. High Roller deals three cards, no floor, four times the Epic and Legendary rate. Special Order triples the odds on one set you name. Whale, Pure, Double-Floor, Back Alley — you never get all of them at once, so the shelf you are dealt is the strategy you get.

Sets pay. The vault does not care.

Eighteen sets across five rarities — Champagne, Chips, Onyx, Blood Pact, Pharaoh's Gold — six of them drawn fresh each run, with sizes and jackpots rolled per game. Completing a set pays more than selling ever will. But the vault starts at six slots, and the card you have to keep is always the card you could have sold.

Collection Night doubles the bill.

A payment falls due every two days, and every third one is Collection Night — twice the amount, visible from the moment the layer begins. You can see the wall coming from ten packs away. That is the point.

Three ways out. All of them cost more than they give.

Pawn a card for 80% of its value and buy it back before the Loan House keeps it for good. Take 300 from the shark at 25% a day. Defer a payment and owe one and a half times as much. Every escape hatch is a loan against a version of you who will have less time than you do.

Four layers. The House raises the number every time you clear one.

1,400. Then 3,000, 4,800, 7,000. The moment a layer is paid off, the House comes to count your vault: unfinished sets are liquidated at a loss, anything still in pawn is gone. You carry the cash and the trinkets into the next layer — and a fresh set of names to collect.

Thirty trinkets, five slots.

Between layers you walk the Gilded Row. Three trinkets on offer, and never enough cash for all of them. Chain makes the next pack free after every completed set. Undertaker refunds half of whatever the Loan House seizes. Card Sharp halves the day's interest whenever you open three packs. Buy power now, or keep the cash and survive the interest later.

Features

  • 30–45 minute runs — four escalating debt layers, three difficulty tiers to unlock
  • 7 pack types, 18 sets, 30 trinkets; the shelf, the sets and their jackpots are rolled every run
  • Pawn, loan shark and deferral — a full risk toolkit that always charges more than it pays
  • Hand-composed Art Deco noir artwork in black and gold, every card and trinket illustrated
  • Fully localized in 31 languages

store_data.about_the_game:
The memories of a fallen civilization are trapped in a field of hostile hexes. Every node is a combat puzzle. Read the encounter, assemble a loadout, forecast the result, and deploy.

EmergenHex is a deterministic buildcrafting idle game about understanding systems, not rolling for luck.

Combine skills, passives, artifacts, gear, damage types, delivery methods, and status effects to break each encounter's rules. The same build always produces the same result, so a defeat is information: inspect the forecast, change the answer, and try again.

Conquered memories generate Exploration Points while you plan. Once you have proven a victory, assign one of six independent loadouts to autofarm it—even while you are away. Return to the record, collect what your builds earned, and invest those resources in stronger readings.

The map never stops testing your assumptions. Resistances, immunities, auras, composition rules, adaptive enemies, and multi-phase bosses punish one-size-fits-all builds. The Forecast and Loadout Check explain what worked, what failed, and why.

Reach the ending and the record opens again.

The Second Reading transforms the map with new encounter rules, three additional ranks, new resources, and a final confrontation hidden beyond the first conclusion.

Features

- 60 handcrafted deterministic combat puzzles

- Six saved loadouts for specialized builds and simultaneous auto-farms

- Skills, passives, artifacts, gear, status effects, and interacting damage types

- Clear battle forecasts and player-facing explanations for failed builds

- Offline progression and EP-funded automation built around victories you earned

- Six meaningful ranks with build-defining late-rank effects

- A complete First Reading and a harder, remixed Second Reading

- No random combat outcomes: the same build produces the same result

- Mouse and keyboard play

store_data.about_the_game:
THEY GAVE YOU $1,500 AND FIVE DAYS.


DEGEN TRADING is a proprietary trading firm. They have funded your account, set you a profit target, and drawn a drawdown line beneath your equity that follows you up and never comes back down.

Clear the target by Friday's close and they wire you your cut. Miss it and the evaluation fee was, unfortunately, non-refundable.

Your account manager is enormously supportive. He is paid on volume.

READ THE TAPE


One instrument, one live chart, and the only three decisions that matter: direction, size, and when to get out.

There is no auto-battler here and nothing plays itself. The market moves in real time whether you are ready or not, and a position you should have closed two minutes ago is still open right now.

  • Trends, chop and volatility that behave like a real tape
  • Price shocks that arrive without warning
  • A trailing drawdown that remembers your best moment and holds it against you
  • A daily loss limit, because the firm has seen people like you before

BUY AN EDGE FROM A MAN WHO SELLS COURSES


Between sessions, MAXX STERLING will enroll you in yourself.

Cards multiply what your winning trades pay. Hold fifteen minutes. Close five contracts. Win in a volatile tape. Win three in a row. They stack, they combo, and they come straight out of the trading profit you have not withdrawn yet.

  • 95 cards across edges, risk, tools and one-shot consumables
  • Indicators you tap to read the market — and which lie to you at low levels
  • Automated stops, brackets and trailing exits you configure yourself
  • Six starting archetypes, unlocked by getting further than you did last time

THE TRADER CUP


A knockout bracket against rival traders, each with a real tell.

SCALPEL SAM cannot hold a position longer than a breath. HODL HODLBERG will not cut anything, ever. SIR NIBBLES is a hamster who picks direction by running on a wheel and has finished quarters ahead of most funded accounts.

You trade the same market, the same candles and the same news. Highest P&L at the closing bell wins.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a laid-back idle and task management game you can enjoy right above your desktop taskbar.

While you’re working, studying, watching videos, or just going about your usual routine on your PC, the little miner “Rion” will be digging for ore in the corner of your desktop and earning you “Meln.”

There are no complicated controls. Just decide whether to “put Rion to work” or “let him rest.”

Enjoy a little day with Rion as your companion while you go about your tasks.

Work and Earn Meln

When you ask Rion to work, he’ll grab his pickaxe and start mining ore.

Watch Rion work hard and enjoy seeing your Meln balance grow little by little.

If he works efficiently, aim for 1,000,000 Meln a day!

How much can you earn today?

Be Careful Not to Overwork Him

Of course, Rion can’t keep working forever.

The longer he works, the more fatigue builds up, and his efficiency gradually drops.

When he starts to get tired, stop the work and let him take a break.

Work while he’s energetic and rest when he’s tired.

It’s up to you to decide when to have him work and when to let him rest.

A Little Work Buddy on Your Desktop

Rion doesn’t just silently mine ore.

“Let’s do our best together today!”

“How’s that task over there coming along?”

“I’m starting to get a little tired…”

He’ll chat with you while you work, cheer you on, or even vent when he’s tired…

While you’re at your computer, Rion will be right there with you in the corner of your desktop.

Why not add a little life with this tiny miner to your daily routine?

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Magic Potion Stand for Sprites!

Run your own little stand in a cozy sprite village and enjoy a relaxing time.

What can I make for you?

Cute sprites from the village will visit your stand to quench their thirst. Listen to their orders filled with metaphorical clues, and lightly deduce the true elemental properties of the magic potion they want!

The Satisfying Tactile Joy of Ingredient Prep

Put solid magic ingredients into the mortar and spin your mouse clockwise to grind them into powder. Enjoy the charming, satisfying sensation as they crunch and grind away.

Bubbling Magic Cauldron Brewing

It's time to toss the prepped powders and base ingredients into the cauldron. Mix the liquids thoroughly by drawing mystical magic patterns, and complete the heat gauge mini-game at the perfect timing to brew a sparkling, perfect potion.

A Busy Yet Relaxing Cozy Tycoon

During the day, you must gather gold by fulfilling the orders of a constant rush of customers. Even as you busily switch between three screens (Orders, Prep, and Brewing), you'll experience a pleasant immersion thanks to the uniquely warm and comforting atmosphere.

Future Updates to the Stand (In Development)

The stand has just finished preparing for its opening! The following exciting features will be added in future updates:

  • Weather System: The way you prep ingredients will change depending on weather conditions like rain or gusty winds.

  • Regular Sprites' Stories: Special regular sprites will visit and share their own heartwarming stories.

  • Stand Upgrades: Collect gold to upgrade and manage your stand more efficiently.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Oasis

Oasis is a dead planet.

Ice covers the ground, nothing has moved on the surface for three thousand years.

But you are its newly appointed Planetary Steward, and you are here to change that.

Terraform the frozen wastes, farm crops that shouldn't exist, revive the alien creatures that once called this world home, and build a colony worth living in.

Terraform a Frozen World

Change the terrain one biome at a time. Spreader-Tech machines carry life outward on their own, while you reshape it by hand with the GeoFab gun. Every biome you restore changes what can grow and live there.

Shape Oasis as you see fit, place buildings anywhere you want, and decorate the planet to your heart's desire.

Revive Long-Dead Animals 

Oasis was not always dead, and one witness remains. An ancient alien AI has spent the frozen millennia preserving the knowledge of the life, and with your help, it can restore that life.

Revive giant Frostfinches, smiley Cottolopes, and ethereal Driftmares.

Watch them run wild across your biomes you restore them as wildlife, then befriend and domesticate them to help you terraform further.

Farm Seeds That Break the Rules

Grow mutant crops that defy normal farming rules.

Every strain has habits of its own, and learning what a seed wants is the difference between a dead plot and a harvest that feeds the whole colony.

Grow crops that move overnight, only grow near machines, or even eat other crops to grow fat and valuable. 

Find Your People

Build an Oasis that attracts settlers from all over the galaxy.

Starting with only you, Grand Pioneer Joan, and Community Vision Officer Emeric, it's up to you to develop Oasis to attract over 20 settlers, each with their own habits, schedules and stories. Build a thriving community for them to live in and watch them use what you've built, live in the buildings you've constructed, relax in the tavern you raised, and use the zones you've placed to help terraform Oasis.

With 10 romanceable candidates, get to know what they love, take them on dates, and marry the love of your life under alien stars.

Step Into the CAVE

Oasis isn't just alien skies and pretty flowers. Explore the ancient CAVE system that generates real, walkable slices of the planet's living past, built by long-dead alien hands.

Navigate unstable digital floors, dodge the corruption, scan the alien animals, and push further and deeper for greater, and riskier, richers.

Raise a social Colony From the Ice

Build every home, place every community building, make every choice, even change every tile if you want. Oasis is yours to change as you please.

Somewhere along the way, your small outpost will become a town that everyone in the galaxy will admire.

But when the chores pile too high, a small fleet of drones can shoulder their share.

store_data.about_the_game:
Victory Rooms is an online party game for 2 to 8 players. Everyone plays for themselves. You start in a hangar with 14 rooms around you, and you decide which ones to attempt and in what order.

Each room gives points. At the end of the match, the highest total wins.

How a match works

A match lasts 25 minutes by default, and the host can change that.

All 14 rooms are available from the start. Nine are single player, five are one on one. You walk up to a door and enter if the room is free.

A room can only hold one attempt at a time. If someone is inside, the door is closed until they come out.

Once you have attempted a room, it goes on a five minute cooldown for you. You can come back to it afterwards, and only your best score in that room is kept.

Scoreboards on the hangar walls show every player's total in real time.

Betray the others

Nobody is your ally. While a player is inside a room trying to rack up points, you can mess with them from the outside.

Send a malus. Target an occupied room and trigger an effect on whoever's inside: an earthquake that shakes everything, a cloud of smoke across their screen, an inverted view, or tunnel vision that closes in their field of view.

Hand off a bomb. Slip a bomb to a player you cross paths with in the hangar and steal their points.

Plant a trap. Drop a trap on the ground and wait for someone to walk into it.

Voice chat depends on where you are

Voice chat is built into the game and follows the layout of the hangar.

In the hangar, every player hears every other player.

In a two player room, only the two players inside hear each other.

In a single player room, you hear nobody and nobody hears you.

The 14 rooms

Single player:

  • Basketball : three hoops worth 1, 2 and 3 points. The higher the value, the smaller the hoop

  • Archery : score depends on how close you land to the centre of the target

  • Quiz : a series of questions to answer

  • Recall : study a set of images, then answer questions about what you saw

  • Put It Back : objects fall out of a cupboard. Put each one back where it was

  • Sequence : clues placed around the room tell you which order to press the buttons in

  • Colour Tiles : four squares light up in sequence. Repeat it. The sequence gains one step each round and speeds up

  • Hidden Objects : objects are hidden at random spots in a room. Find them all

One on one:

  • The Forger : each player paints over a blank patch on a canvas. Your opponent then sees your canvas among two others and has to spot where you painted. First to identify the other's patch wins

  • Crown Chase : one player wears a crown, the other tries to take it. Whoever holds it when time runs out wins

  • The Dilemma : several rounds of prisoner's dilemma. Each round, you cooperate or betray

  • Falling Floor : both players stand on a grid. Any tile you touch disappears shortly after. First one to fall loses

  • Poisoned Box : each round, you send your opponent a box containing either a coin or a bomb. They can accept it, or send it back, in which case you receive double the contents

  • Sticks : players take turns removing sticks from the table. Whoever takes the last one loses

Features

  • 2 to 8 players, online only

  • 25 minute matches by default, adjustable

  • 14 rooms, 8 single player and 6 one on one

  • Proximity voice chat

  • Live scoreboards in the hangar

  • Free choice of rooms, no fixed order

store_data.about_the_game:
From the Greenshade Forest to the Bone Lord's dark lair a hero's tale begins with you.

Arkney: The Bone Road is a handcrafted pixel action RPG about a realm slowly being consumed by the Bone Road a creeping corruption that turns forests to ash and the dead to soldiers. Take up your sword, light the waystones, and push it back.

Fast, readable combat

Dash, swing, and kite your way through wolf packs, ghoul hordes and bone knights. Every monster telegraphs, every hit counts and death always costs you something.

A living world

The world doesn't wait for you. Dynamic weather, day/night cycles, world events, roaming golden variants worth hunting, and an Ancient world boss that emerges on its own schedule. Take hunt contracts to track down marked prey.

Three chapters, three realms

  • Chapter I: Greenshade Forest: wolves, root wraiths, and the Bone Lord's vanguard
  • Chapter II: The Frostlands: frozen lakes, crystal golems, and the Ice Queen
  • Chapter III: The Cinder Throne: magma hounds, inferno knights, and the Inferno Lord

Gather, craft, grow

Eight life skills; mining, smithing, woodcutting, fishing, cooking, alchemy and more. Forge five weapon tiers, enchant your gear, unlock the rune tree, and raise a pet companion.

Two-player online co-op

Invite a friend with a link and play 2-player co-op host-authoritative over WebRTC, no dedicated server and no extra accounts.

A world with memory

Lore stones, chapter cutscenes, quest lines and a built-in wiki the Bone Road has a history, if you care to dig it up.
