store_data.about_the_game:
The Ancients have awoken...

The Ancients, Old Gods, Creators of the Realms have awoken from their centuries of slumber. The Realms, four alternate realities each created in the image of its maker, pulse with power once more.

  • The Abyss

  • The Void

  • The Black Forest

  • The Silence

Now awake, The Ancients have resumed their war and we all must choose a side. Pick your realm and pledge your loyalty.

Choose your leader, build your deck of powerful minions and spells and take on the other realms and in doing so win the favor of your Ancient to avoid annihilation.

Begin each run by choosing your Realm and leader. Each with unique powerful abilities to build around. Throughout your journey you'll face powerful enemies from opposing realms, but after each battle you'll get to upgrade your deck and improve your chances of survival.

  • Collect new minions and spells

  • Upgrade existing minions and spells

  • Remove unwanted cards from your deck

  • Purchase powerful relics from the shop

Take on waves of increasingly difficult opponents in each encounter. Use your spells and minion abilities to keep your leader safe and eradicate the enemy. 

Positioning matters, make sure you position your minions to protect vulnerable ones and avoid devastating effects from opposing minions. Be careful though, opposing minions can move too, you'll have to anticipate their plan to avoid getting blown out.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hallness is a virtual reality horror game you can play alone or in online co-op.

You wake up in a place that should not exist: corridors that seem to go on forever, abandoned rooms, and environments that make no sense. Explore, look for a way out, and stay alive while something moves through the halls with you.

HORROR BUILT FOR VIRTUAL REALITY

Hallness is built around making you feel physically present inside its liminal spaces.

Use your hands, move through tight corridors, and react when something gets too close. In VR, even a distant sound or a sudden movement can feel uncomfortably real.

You cannot simply look away from what is coming.

PHYSICAL INTERACTIONS

Everything around you can be handled.

Pick up, carry, throw, and move objects with your hands. Barricade doors, search dark rooms with a flashlight, and deal with physics and ragdolls when a careful plan falls apart.

The room around you can help you survive... or become part of the problem.

EXPLORE ALONE OR WITH OTHER PLAYERS

Enter alone or bring friends with you.

Stay in contact, search different areas, and help each other when things go wrong. Splitting up covers more ground, but it also makes everyone easier to isolate.

Player choices, physics, and the creature's behavior make every session play out differently.

A THREAT THAT REACTS TO YOU

The creature does not follow a fixed route.

It hunts, listens, and reacts to movement, noise, and mistakes. A dropped object, a flashlight beam, or a panicked sprint can give away your position.

Sometimes running is the only option.

Sometimes it leads the creature straight to you.

BEAUTIFUL PLACES ARE NOT NECESSARILY SAFE

Hallness moves between dark liminal corridors and surreal, colorful places that almost feel peaceful.

A quiet room can be a relief... or a warning.

Each area has its own atmosphere, mysteries, and dangers.

KEY FEATURES

  • VR horror for solo play and online co-op

  • Physical interactions built around your hands

  • Objects that can be carried, thrown, and used to barricade doors

  • Flashlights, darkness, and danger that reacts to sound

  • Physics and a ragdoll system

  • A creature that reacts to movement, noise, and player decisions

  • Liminal, dreamcore, and weirdcore environments

  • Sessions shaped by player actions and physics

FIND A WAY OUT

The corridors do not stay the same.

The sounds keep getting closer.

Sooner or later, you will have to turn around.

Welcome to Hallness.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Tribute to the Golden Era of Western Shooters

Step into the boots of a gunslinger in Wild Justice, a high-stakes first-person shooter inspired by the classic retro title The Wild Bunch by Firebird Software.

You have been hired by the local Sheriff to bring order to the frontier. Track down the most notorious criminals in the West and decide their fate: bring them in alive to collect the full bounty, or leave them face-down in the dirt.

Key Features

  • High-Stakes Combat: Master the art of the revolver in intense first-person shootouts and quick-draw duels.

  • Open Frontier: Explore a detailed 3D western world on foot or on horseback, culminating in an exciting high-speed train sequence.

  • The Outlaw Life: Need extra gold? Risk it all by robbing the town bank, or try your luck at the saloon poker table.

  • A Living Western Town: Visit the local store to gear up, grab a drink at the pub, and explore a world full of secrets.

Developer Note

Wild Justice is my debut title on Steam! The game is fully playable from start to finish, and I am committed to providing ongoing updates, feature additions, and immediate bug fixes. Buy it once, and enjoy all future content updates for free.

store_data.about_the_game:
Crystaria Online is a living, text-driven MMORPG — the depth of a classic MMO in a fast, readable interface. One shared realm. No patch downloads, ever: the world updates under your feet.

◆ A world with three skies. Explore the overworld, descend into the corrupted Underworld, then ascend to a sky of 70+ floating islands — and beyond it, the Voidheart, where the road runs to level 20,000. Earn your Sky Drone and fly the open air between the isles.

◆ 18 classes, endless builds. From Fighter to Astromancer, each with its own resource loop, weapon artes, spells and signature ultimates. Attunements, Mastery tiers, set relics and Ascension let you tune every point.

◆ Combat where every stat matters. A no-caps damage engine: your build is the ceiling. Elements, Signs and Resonance reward reading the fight — and every one of 81 dungeons carries a permanent identity that changes how you build for it.

◆ The Shifting Labyrinth. A realm-shared maze that reshapes every season. Fog-of-war floors, Keywardens, Vaults, Shrines — and Echo Delves that farm your conquered depth while you sleep.

◆ Guilds that go to war. Level your guild, shape its ranks, claim territory, raise a floating Skyhold — then declare war: nine automatic battles over three days, decided by crafted supplies. Gatherers and crafters win wars.

◆ A realm that lives by the week. Realm Events rotate the world's bonuses every week, guilds chase fresh objectives, and the whole server works toward a shared Realm Goal — clear it together and everyone starts next week stronger. Login streaks stack rewards, Sigils and titles for the faithful.

◆ Play in minutes. Jump in as a guest — no signup — and convert to a full account when you're hooked. Free. No purchases. Just the climb.

store_data.about_the_game:
At the core of everything in Lumiere is Light and Shadow. Journey as Soleil and Umbra as they embark on a mission to unite a beautiful world lost to darkness. With drop-in co-op play, a second player can join the adventure and uncover the mysteries of the land together.

Explore a Broken World

Command light and shadow in core gameplay like no other game play experience before as Soleil and Umbra and traverse a strange world sundered by cataclysmic events in Lumiere, a unique third-person action game.

Lumiere takes place in a world sundered by a cataclysmic event known as the Long Night of Fire, which brought flaming stones raining from the sky to wreak havoc across the land. Soleil, a girl born into a tribe of mages with the rare gift to create and manipulate light, ventures out to find the members of their family lost on a recent expedition and bring them safely home.

As quickly as her journey begins, Soleil meets defeat, forcing her to form a tenuous bond with Umbra, a shapeshifting being of living shadow exiled by his brethren. Umbra has his own issues to resolve, but both he and Soleil quickly realize that they share a common goal: to restore peace to the land.

At the Core of Everything is Light and Shadow

The world of Lumiere is a dangerous one, requiring unique and savvy uses of Light and Shadow abilities to traverse safely.

While you can simply battle with Soleil’s conjured weapons and Umbra’s shapeshifting attacks, using Soleil’s light generation abilities creates shadows which can be used by Umbra in creative (and sometimes devious) ways. Turn shadows into bridges to allow Soleil to cross chasms or create barriers to ward off enemies. Or make shadows hollow, turning them into bottomless pits for enemies to fall into.

The choice of how to battle is yours, and Soleil and Umbra’s unique abilities create near-endless possibilities, both to defeat enemies and to explore the furthest reaches of Lumiere’s twisted landscape.

Journey Together (Or Alone)

Through a simple real-time toggle system you can switch back and forth between Soleil and Umbra to use their ever-expanding abilities and power to battle enemies, access hidden areas, and discover hidden treasures to help you on your way!

And with drop-in co-op play, a second player can join the adventure, with each player controlling one of the characters to take on the world together.

Game Features

  • Innovative Light and Shadow Gameplay: Harness the power of light and shadow as core gameplay in never before seen ways! Use Soleil and Umbra’s abilities to battle enemies and to gain access to the furthest reaches of the twisted landscape.

  • Play Together: Journey in single player mode, or together with friends through seamless drop-in and drop-out co-op gameplay.

  • Skystone Trials: Enter the Skystone trials littered throughout the game world to unlock new areas and uncover the secrets of the land.

  • Grow Your Village: As Soleil and Umbra rescue lost Villagers on their expeditions, your home Village grows, and with it, access to new perks and upgrades.

  • Explore and Discover: There are treasures and secrets all across the world of Lumiere. Travel across a stunning landscape of variety, contrast, and wonder to uncover them all!

Apple Catcher is a motion-controlled arcade game that turns your webcam into the controller.

Lean left and right to move your basket, catch falling apples, avoid sticks, and build the highest score you can. Progress through increasingly challenging levels or test your endurance in Endless Mode as the game becomes faster and more demanding.

  • Simple, approachable gameplay — catch apples and avoid hazards

  • Play standing or seated using gentle left-and-right movement

  • Multiple levels with changing speeds, spawn rates, and challenges

  • Special apples that award bonus points

  • Endless Mode for players who want to keep chasing a higher score

Earth's magnetic field failed a long time ago. The solar wind has been peeling the atmosphere away ever since, and the water went with it, boiled off into space. What's left is a world of exposed seabeds, salt basins and mountain ranges that used to be coastline.

You have a ship, and nowhere to be.

Description

Built on real Earth elevation and seabed data, Waterline takes the sprawl of a classic space sim and folds it onto a single world.

Features (Game is in active development, but here is what is already completed)

  • "Old World" map spanning Scandinavia and Europe to Africa and the Mid-Atlantic Ridge built from real-world elevation and ocean-floor survey data

  • Land anywhere with finely-tuned physics that differ from ship to ship

  • Day-to-night lighting cycles 

  • Full ship purchase and outfitting with buy-back - jump drives, weapons, shields, scanners, cargo

  • Hire and fire named co-pilots

  • Trading, hauling, salvage, escort work, bounty hunting and piracy

  • Settlements with individual import/export economies

  • NPC cargo runners flying real routes between real settlements - and pirates hunting them

store_data.about_the_game:
No light reaches the bottom.

Claris,the nation of water. Its twenty-third city, Abyssaria,

is the poorest and darkest place in the country.

The people here have no names. Only Management Numbers.

Those who were never made into fishfolk — who remain trapped in human bodies — carry air tanks on their backs, take on the labor no one else will, and buy each day's breath with ration coins.

Every night, in a city like that, Shion closes the door to his basement.

He is raising jellyfish, a creature the state has outlawed.

Discovery means prison. He does it for one reason only.

To buy his friend Calen her chance to become one of the fishfolk.

-A salvation called the Aquatic Serum-

At the age of three, children shed their numbers and receive the Aquatic Serum.

They are given a body optimized for the water, a new name, and a life lived as fishfolk.

That turn never comes for a child born in Abyssaria.

The raw material is running dry. The price climbs by the day.

Two paths remain: spend a lifetime waiting to be scouted,

or post overwhelming results at the National Academy and graduate into a career.

Calen drives her pen toward the second one with the only arm she has.

Shion knows that future does not add up — not on paper, not with the numbers she'll be paid.

So he chose another way. Smuggling.

Features

Live2D character interaction

Click the characters on screen and watch them react.

In some scenes, where you touched becomes part of the story itself.

A meticulously built deep-sea world

The Aquatic Serum and Kairos cells. Management Numbers and ration coins. The fishfolk caste and its jellyfish aristocracy. The Death Zone that forms the ceiling of the world.

Every piece of this setting closes in on the choices its characters make.

Characters

Calen, who wields cheerfulness like a weapon. Shion, who cannot say what he feels. Dalia, the school nurse with no sense of personal space. Formo, the student council president counting down what's left of her life. And classmates who never quite back off.

Note on localization:

The English localization was AI-assisted and human-reviewed. Some phrasing may be imperfect.

※ This game is a text-based visual novel.

store_data.about_the_game:
KEEP THE MACHINES RUNNING

LAUNDRO is a 1–4 player co-op game about running a laundromat for as many shifts as you can survive.

Customers bring in bags of clothes. Unpack their garments, follow the correct wash and dry cycles, repack everything, and return each order before it expires. It sounds simple. Most shifts are not.

HIT THE QUOTA

Every run begins with basic equipment and a manageable quota. Money earned goes toward the quota first, while anything extra can be spent on upgrades between shifts.

Work faster, unlock more machines, and prepare the shop for the next day. The longer your run lasts, the busier and less forgiving the laundromat becomes. Miss the quota and the entire crew returns to Shift 1.

EXPECT THE UNEXPECTED

Not every customer is normal, not every bag contains what you expect, and not every shift ends peacefully.

Strange visitors, rare events, questionable garments, broken windows, and completely unnecessary chaos can interrupt business without warning. Sometimes the best plan is to keep folding clothes and pretend everything is fine.

WORK TOGETHER

Split the workload with your crew or create an even bigger mess together.

  • Online co-op for up to 4 players

  • Hands-on washing, drying, sorting, and packing

  • Shared quotas and run-based upgrades

  • Physics-driven garments, baskets and props

  • Proximity voice chat

  • Special customers and unpredictable shift events

  • Increasing difficulty

There is no final shift. Keep the laundromat running, keep the customers happy, and find out how long your crew can last.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE MAW ATE A KINGDOM. YOU ARE WHAT IT COULDN'T SWALLOW.

A living grave opened beneath the realm and took everything — cathedral, crown and court. Only the stone gargoyle on its roof would not digest.

Fifty single-screen arenas stand between you and the heart beating at the bottom. Clear each one by spitting stone at everything that moves, then take one of three dark gifts and descend again. Stand still and the maw remembers you are there.

SPIT STONE. DODGE. DESCEND.

  • Aim in three directions — hold up or down as you throw. Walls and platforms block your stone, so position is a weapon.

  • Evade dash — a short burst of invulnerability. Read the attack, commit, punish.

  • No safe corners — every stage runs on a timer. When it expires the maw starts taking hearts.

FIVE STRATA, TWENTY SPECIES, FIVE KINGS

Stone, ash, blood, hollow and gold. Each act is a different layer of the swallowed kingdom with its own palette, its own four monster species and its own king waiting at the bottom of it. Twenty creatures, and no two of them move alike — the ghouls of the upper crypt have nothing in common with the gilded dead below.

The kings do not share a silhouette, an attack or a way of moving. The Stone King buries the arena in rockfall. The Hollow King blinks out of reach and answers in radial fire. The Crypt God levitates over you and alternates fans with the ceiling itself.

DIE. BANK YOUR SOULS. GO DEEPER.

Every run feeds the Sanctum. Souls you carry out buy permanent unlocks — new cards in the pool, gargoyle skins, an extra heart to start with — and the Eternal Altar spends them on a stat tree deep enough to outlast many clears.

Reach the bottom and the maw simply opens wider: New Game+ loops with harder fiends and richer souls, as many times as you can survive.

FEATURES

  • 50 hand-built single-screen stages across five acts

  • 20 monster species with distinct behaviour, plus 5 unique boss fights

  • Roguelite card drafting with a persistent soul economy

  • Permanent stat tree and unlockables in the Sanctum

  • New Game+ scaling for as long as you last

  • Gamepad support with fully rebindable keys and buttons

  • Six languages: English, 한국어, 简体中文, 日本語, العربية, Español

store_data.about_the_game:
You wake up lashed to a few logs. No land. No boat. No memory of how you got here. Just water, in every direction.

Then a plank drifts past. You've got a harpoon. And from here on, the story is yours to write.

YOU'RE ALONE — UNTIL YOU'RE NOT

Gather wood. Fish. Don't die of thirst. Then, one day, you pull someone out of the water. They're alive. And just like that, survival becomes responsibility. 14 jobs are waiting to be assigned — fisher, blacksmith, guard, cook. Your people bond. They argue. They get sick. And you're the one who decides whether your logs become a town — or a wreck.

THE DEEP DOESN'T PLAY BY YOUR RULES

There's a whole world under your raft. Reefs. Wrecks. Fish flashing in the dark. But your air runs out before you've seen it all — and without goggles, everything blurs into murk anyway. Whatever you miss on the first dive is still waiting for you on the second.

EVERYTHING CHANGES WHEN THE SUN GOES DOWN

Boats come at night. Raiders hack through your walls while you sleep — or don't sleep, because you're standing watch instead. A shark circles your deck, patient, like it knows it just has to wait. A storm tears at everything you've built. And when your battery bank runs dry, the lights go out first — right when you need them most.

THERE'S AN ANSWER — IF YOU CAN FIND IT

26 research nodes give you the tools to actually survive, not just hang on. Debris fields drift by on the horizon — miss them, and they're gone for good. And somewhere in between, scattered across 24 message-in-a-bottle fragments, is the answer to the one question that's been nagging you since you woke up on those logs: why did the world drown in the first place?

At the end of it all, something is waiting. Bigger than your raft. Bigger than anything you've seen so far. The leviathan.

store_data.about_the_game:
Relyora is a dark-fantasy incremental roguelite RPG where every battle brings you closer to becoming unstoppable.

Choose your specialization, journey through corrupted realms, defeat powerful bosses, and transform their relics into lasting power. Shape your character through skills, artifacts, spellbooks, companions, professions, and permanent upgrades—then venture into the Infinite Dungeon to discover how far your build can go.

Choose Your Path

Master one of three distinct specializations:

  • Bastion — Endure devastating attacks and turn defense into strength.

  • Ravage — Unleash destructive arcane power and overwhelm your enemies.

  • Mirage — Strike with speed, precision, and deadly critical attacks.

Each specialization features its own equipment, combat identity, and progression options.

Create Your Own Build

Develop your hero through an extensive skill tree and combine powerful systems to create unique synergies.

Collect and equip artifacts, upgrade spellbooks, forge equipment from rare boss materials, and choose the bonuses that best complement your playstyle.

Power That Never Stops Growing

Your journey continues beyond the campaign. Rebirth allows you to exchange your current progress for permanent bonuses, opening the way to stronger and more specialized builds.

Every new attempt becomes an opportunity to push further, refine your strategy, and uncover new sources of power.

Explore a World Filled with Secrets

Beyond combat, Relyora offers multiple progression activities:

  • Three dark-fantasy campaign chapters filled with enemies, elites, and bosses

  • An Infinite Dungeon with increasingly dangerous challenges

  • Artifacts and equipment loadouts

  • Spellbook crafting and boss relics

  • Magical companions to collect and develop

  • Fishing, rare creatures, and mysterious vestiges

  • A bestiary and collection system

  • Permanent progression through Rebirth

Build your legend, master your specialization, and challenge the endless forces waiting beyond the portal.

store_data.about_the_game:
■ Mix the color — don’t pick it

PIGMENT LAB is a minimalist puzzle about recreating a target color with paint alone. No numeric sliders: scoop red, yellow, blue, black and white by eye, stir them together, and see how close you land.

■ Scored by color difference

Your mix is compared to the target using perceptual color difference (ΔE) and turned straight into a score. Near-misses and perfect matches both come back as one clear number.

■ A journey through the world’s colors

66 studies at launch: master the basics in the atelier, then recreate the colors of world flags and landscapes. More collections are planned.

■ Scoop Challenge

Random color trials: read the target and rebuild it in 1, 2 or 3 scoops. How long can your streak survive sudden death?

■ Quiet by design

Comparison hints when you’re stuck, achievements to chase, and a full Japanese & English interface.

store_data.about_the_game:
Essence Harvest is a survival burst incremental. Kill enemies, get their essence, spend it on upgrades, get stronger.

A unique combination of a classical incremental game with a more action based bullet heaven game. Short, 30-60 second runs, and a huge upgrade tree of about 200 permanent upgrades. Together with relics, boons and the other features, Essence Harvest hopes to capture this combination well.

THE GAMEPLAY

The arena floods, your weapons clear it, bullet heaven style, and when the timer runs out, everything you collected is currency for upgrades. Between runs, you feed the upgrade tree and drop back in stronger. Deeper in, runs stretch longer, threat and hazards raise the stakes and the payout together, and bosses stand in your way to the Finale.

Improve yourself with about 200 permanent upgrades on one huge, connected upgrade tree.

Find twelve relics with unique effects. Relics can drop from bosses and sometimes normal enemies.

Level up and select boons to become more powerful. Reroll the three-card offer, then choose one.

Increase the difficulty to increase the payout. Six threat levels that make the game

Hunt the five Primes, one per enemy tier, each dropping a powerful reward and unlocking new enemies.

Opt in to dangerous hazards for bonuses, up to three at once. Meteor fire, acid pits, collapsing floor, and more.

WHAT THIS GAME IS NOT

It is not a reflex test. It is also not a classical idle game where you can just go AFK. If you like a build that snowballs, and filling in an upgrade tree while the numbers climb higher and higher, this game is for you: a casual, relaxing incremental.

Upgrade and evolve your weapons and spells into deadlier new forms.

Exact your revenge upon the world across 10 acts spanning the kingdom, each ending in a challenging boss fight.

store_data.about_the_game:
One student. One manipulative parrot. Zero common sense.

Cade was having a typical lousy day: cockroaches devoured his dinner, he was still a long way from his scholarship, and his last cigarette slipped from his fingers in a dark alley. That's where he stumbled upon a parrot cage with a sign reading "For Sale. Urgent. Cheap."

That's how Cade met Colonel Pixel, a grey parrot who calls everyone "palefaces," dreams of the winds of freedom, and loves nuts. He had to part with a limited-edition quantum physics textbook for the bird. And in return, a promise of a meeting with a mysterious billionaire gardener whose garden is filled with golden pineapples.

And so Cade sets off across the city (and out of town, and back again) in pursuit of a reward that seems too good to be true. What awaits you

A journey through a crazy city—from stinking back alleys and an underground casino in a concrete factory to a vibrant neighborhood with masked musicians.

Multiple endings—from absurd dead ends to the finale of the story. One wrong choice, and the Colonel dies of fright; you go to sleep in the dorm or are left with nothing.

Mini-games and choices: play rock-paper-scissors with a cheating parrot, try your luck at poker and blackjack against a lady with a robot hamster, bargain, wriggle, and decide whether to trust your feathered companion.

Dialogues worth playing for—the constant bickering between Cade and the Colonel, where it's hard to tell who's the bigger misunderstanding. Colorful encounters: the mad sailor Krueger, grumpy street types, a man in a tin can mask, a driver with a bear's head, and other inhabitants of this crazy city.

Who is this billionaire gardener? Do golden pineapples even exist? And what is Colonel Pixel hiding?

One way to find out is to trust a bird. Although that might be the worst idea of ​​the day.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every Day with Mashumaro

Her skin is as white as her name, and her cheeks are soft and springy and impossibly squishy.

The whole neighborhood knows this first-grader as "Mashumaro-chan"—Mashiro plus marshmallow.

Endlessly curious, entirely without guile.

She gets her words wrong now and then, and that only makes her more lovable.

Watching over her, always close by, is her big sister Mio.

With their parents overseas, she looks after Mashiro day in and day out.

This is a slice-of-life comedy about the happy chaos these two get into.

Laugh, unwind, and once in a while, tear up

Everyday life with Mashiro, Mio, and all the people who fill their days.

A lot of laughing, a lot of comfort, and the occasional lump in your throat.

The kind of days that grow more precious when you look back.

Over 160,000 words of "days that come only once."

Bright little moments, stacking up until one day they're memories you'd never trade.

Cast

  • Mashiro — A first-grader with famously squishy cheeks, the neighborhood's beloved "Mashumaro-chan." Always honest, always full of wonder.

  • Mio — Mashiro's big sister. A good cook with her feet on the ground—and hopelessly soft on her little sister.

  • And plenty more. Friends, neighbors, and family—each with a personality all their own—color the two sisters' days.

What's Included

  • The main story (roughly 10–15 hours; chapter select lets you revisit any part at any time)

  • Opening movie and ending sequence, both with theme songs

  • Music Room (13 tracks—songs and BGM)

  • Gallery (19 event CGs)

  • 9 bonus extra scenarios (readable from the Gallery)

  • Auto, skip, backlog, 12 save slots, and the rest of the comfort features

This might be for you if you're looking to…

  • Laugh at something wonderfully silly

  • Be charmed by a little kid simply being herself

  • Settle into something warm and gentle

  • Rest, because life has been tiring

  • Read a little at a time before bed

  • This game is free. There are no in-app purchases and no paid content of any kind.

A routine night shift for security guard Vovan ends in disaster. He's fired over the phone, without even a hearing, while the millionaire owner's son attempts suicide right by the pool. The attempt fails in the most absurd way, but it's this very night that brings together four desperate people with nothing left to lose.

Vovan was discarded as a lost cause after ten years of service. Fugitive plastic surgeon Anatoly is being sought by creditors and a vengeful client. Natalya, the cook, will be killed if she doesn't pay off the family debts. And Eduard is a broken, wealthy heir, despised by his own father who has no intention of saving him. When life has driven everyone into a corner, a mad plan is hatched: kidnap Eduard himself and demand a ransom from his father, the millionaire Konstantin. After all, his reputation is worth more than his own son. Thus begins an absurd crime road movie through the Russian outback. A stolen pink van with the sign "Seductive Balls," roadside motels, a gunsmith with a cross around his neck, abandoned farms, chases, and explosions. And most unexpectedly, Eduard is ecstatic. For the first time in his life, he's been kidnapped, called names, and forced to truly live. For the first time, he feels needed.

But Konstantin has long arms and deep pockets. He's not used to paying and not used to losing, and anyone he meets is ready to sell out the heroes for a percentage. And only the three losers themselves—Vovan "Bang," Anatoly "Bubble," and Eduard "Enema"—gradually transform from random travel companions into the semblance of a family none of them ever had. Will they be able to outwit the millionaire and reach the end—or will another mistake leave them nothing but a rusty van on the side of the road?

This is an interactive dark comedy—a text-based quest where you read the story and make decisions for the characters.

At key moments, you face a choice: calmly explain everything or offer a bribe, kidnap the heir or retreat, trust a shady character or flee.

Each decision leads either further along the plot or to a fatal dead end with absurd and brutal credits, where the characters die, go to prison, or disappear without a trace.

A branching plot with multiple forks and endings—from catastrophic failures to an open ending.

Lively, sharp dialogue and crude black humor accompany you throughout.

Your choices determine who survives and who becomes just an urban legend. Don't screw it up.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a resilient data center company from an empty facility.

COLD AISLE: Data Center Tycoon is a first-person management simulation where every number has a visible cause. Order hardware, receive deliveries, move racks into position, install servers and GPUs, and connect power and networking yourself. Then turn the machinery into a profitable business.

BUILD THE FACILITY

Buy racks, servers, GPUs, switches, power distribution, cooling, and logistics equipment. Place infrastructure freely, fill racks, route connections, and expand capacity without creating new bottlenecks.

OPERATE REAL SYSTEMS

Compute, storage, power, network, and temperature are connected. Circuits can overload, infrastructure condition deteriorates, cooling consumes electricity, and incidents can violate SLAs. Plan reserves, test redundancy, maintain equipment, and react before customers lose confidence.

WIN AND KEEP CUSTOMERS

Negotiate price, duration, capacity, peak load, service level, and penalties. Schedule contract starts, run several jobs in parallel, handle follow-up offers, and earn detailed ratings based on measured reliability, performance, response time, value, and service.

GROW A COMPANY

Hire staff, develop specializations, delegate work, pay weekly expenses and invoices, and compete against 32 rival companies. When a competitor becomes insolvent, you can buy unknown lots of hardware from its liquidation.

CREATE YOUR OWN AI PRODUCTS

Use spare infrastructure for simulated AI products. Choose research goals, reserve computing power, set prices, build reputation, and balance this second market against the needs of your hosting customers.

FROM EMPTY HALL TO MARKET LEADER

Progress through company phases, unlock milestones, survive incidents, and build a business capable of challenging the largest companies in the market.

Single-player. No microtransactions. Liquidation purchases use in-game currency only.

store_data.about_the_game:
BUILD A NATION FROM ALMOST NOTHING

You begin with an empty artificial platform off the coast of Florida, a small treasury, and the extremely reasonable conviction that you should be allowed to found your own country.

Expand the platform tile by tile. Generate power, secure water and food, attract citizens, assign workers, research new technologies, construct industries, and transform a lonely slab in the ocean into a functioning sovereign state.

Platform Nation is a satirical single-player strategy game combining city building, resource management, political simulation, trade, diplomacy, and real-time combat.

MAKE THE PLATFORM FUNCTION

Every building is part of a larger system.

Build solar arrays and power plants to keep the nation running. Operate desalination plants, farms, factories, oil infrastructure, research facilities, banks, docks, tourism businesses, media operations, military defenses, and increasingly questionable nuclear projects.

Citizens must be assigned where they are needed. A brilliant economic plan can still collapse because nobody is operating the power plant.

Manage resources including:

  • Treasury

  • Materials

  • Power and fuel

  • Water and food

  • Research

  • Population

  • Stability

  • Followers

  • International relations

BUILD AN ECONOMY, OR SOMETHING RESEMBLING ONE

Trade for critical supplies. Mine cryptocurrency. Attract tourists. Refine petroleum. Manufacture goods. Build an offshore bank. Grow a global media following. Invest enormous amounts of money and confront the unsettling difference between a million, a billion, and a trillion dollars.

Platform Nation’s economy begins with desperate improvisation and can grow into a machine of extraordinary wealth, influence, or instability.

How that machine operates is up to you.

GOVERN THROUGH CHOICES AND CONSEQUENCES

Political crises, strange visitors, labor disputes, international demands, cults, financial schemes, humanitarian emergencies, and other complications arrive through illustrated choice events.

Your decisions can affect resources, citizens, diplomatic relations, future events, and the direction of the entire campaign.

Some choices solve a problem.

Others create a much funnier problem several months later.

DEFEND YOUR SOVEREIGNTY

Foreign pressure does not always remain diplomatic.

Build turrets and drone ports, train citizens as reservists, and prepare defenses before an intervention begins. Launch FPV drones directly, repel hostile gunboats, and protect the nation you constructed.

Combat is powerful, immediate, and destructive. Citizens can panic, buildings can be damaged, and violence can produce consequences that cannot be converted neatly back into numbers.

DECIDE WHAT POWER IS FOR

Platform Nation is not only about whether your country survives. It is about what kind of country you create.

Pursue wealth, influence, military security, nuclear power, philanthropy, technological progress, or some unstable mixture of all six.

Eventually, your civilization may construct the First Model, an artificial intelligence trained not by what you told it, but by what you repeatedly demonstrated.

Your campaign becomes its education.

What it learns determines what comes next.

FEATURES

  • Build and expand a fully 3D offshore micronation

  • Manage citizens, jobs, resources, infrastructure, and production chains

  • Research technologies ranging from cryptocurrency to nuclear power and artificial intelligence

  • Trade with the outside world through docks and shipping

  • Navigate diplomacy, political pressure, and international intervention

  • Control turrets, defensive drones, and player-piloted FPV drones

  • Make consequential choices through illustrated event chains

  • Pursue multiple economic, political, technological, and moral outcomes

  • Experience different endings based on how you used power throughout the campaign

  • Attempt to govern anxious primates from a platform in the ocean

content_descriptors.notes:
Platform Nation contains recurring stylized violence and gore. Combat may depict gunfire, explosions, red blood, visible corpses, and explosive dismemberment with detached body parts. Soldiers, civilians, and other human characters may be killed during attacks or as a result of player actions.

The game also contains dark political satire involving war, crime, capitalism, cults, authoritarianism, nuclear weapons, and other mature social themes. Violence is presented as consequential rather than celebratory.

The game does not contain nudity, sexual content, sexual assault, suicide, self-harm, or depictions of drug abuse.

store_data.about_the_game:
FROM RAW LOGS TO A THRIVING TIMBER EMPIRE

In Timberline Factory, you take complete control of your very own sawmill. What starts as a small craft workshop grows through your decisions into a highly automated wood-processing facility.

Experience completely physics-based timber logistics: logs aren't just rigid icons on rails—they roll, collide, and move dynamically across your conveyor belts. Design smart transport routes, solve mechanical bottlenecks, and decide for yourself which strategy will lead your business to success!

KEY FEATURES:

  • Physics-Based Logistics & Automation: Place machines, saws, debarkers, and roller conveyors freely to your liking. Watch as logs are transported with realistic physics, prevent expensive production bottlenecks, and unlock powerful automations like the Headrig Line to turn logs directly into valuable board packages without detours and stack them in the BoardStacker for sale.

  • Various Wood Types & Processing: Every wood type behaves differently! While standard spruce is easy to process, demanding larch yields significantly higher profits. Refine raw logs step by step all the way to dried quality boards to maximize your margins.

  • Wear, Maintenance & Repair: Where wood is sawed, sawdust flies—and machines break down! Keep an eye on the failure probability of your chains, repair defective equipment in time, and upgrade your machinery with the Titanium Upgrade to minimize downtime.

  • Dynamic Order & Goal System: Business never stands still. Complete long-term main goals to expand your plant and accept lucrative, time-limited side objectives. But watch out: unexpected events and daily maintenance costs will put your management skills to the test!

  • Research & Staff: Invest your profits into research to unlock new equipment like the Crosscut System or harder saw blades. When the workload gets too heavy, simply hire specialized workers like the repair service or the timber salesman to make your life easier.

Do you have the economic and technical skill to manage your sawmill efficiently and turn a profit every single day?

crystal heart against swarms that reach a million, on maps big enough to lose

them in.

Thirty towers, thirty machines

Towers don't share a weapon rack. A magma throat spits slag, a mycelium mother

lobs cauldrons of gas, a thorn blowgun fires a stream of spores, a hunger rose

plants itself in the swarm's own path. Picking the tower IS picking the spell —

each one built and animated as its own machine.

A million of them

Not twenty enemies per wave. Tens of thousands on screen at once, and the big

maps run to a million before they're done. The swarm fills the tunnel wall to

wall, thins where you burn it, and closes the gap behind.

Upgrade tree

Crystals earned every run, won or lost, unlock new spells, new towers and deeper

branches. The map doesn't get easier — you get heavier.

store_data.about_the_game:
The infection got in. You are what's left of the defense:

Get Outta My Gut is a tower defense fought inside a living body. Germs don't march down tidy lanes they pre-spawn in a stomach pouch, wriggle around, and wait while you build. When you're ready, you drag your scalpel across the membrane, cut it open, and the whole swarm floods the gut at once.

Your job: make sure none of it reaches the heart.

Draft your arsenal:

Turrets come as cards every third wave you draft one of three, each with a rolled rarity from Common to Legendary.

Fight the swarm, not the lane:

Hundreds of germs flow freely over open tissue like a river finding cracks. Wall them off, funnel them, dam them turret placement is terrain engineering, not slot-filling. Watch the horde split around your killzone and drown in goo, sparks, and lightning.

Upgrade trees that change everything:

Every single turret has its own upgrade tree with capstones that rewrite what it does! Bullets that fork into seeker swarms, beams that vivisect weakened germs, frost that shatters, clubs that devour the dead to heal your heart.

An economy with teeth:

ATP is life. Kill bounties, wave rewards, interest on your savings, perfect-wave streaks, and a combo meter that pays you for killstreaks every wave is an optimization puzzle, and S-ranks are earned, not given.

Die, Evolve, Go deeper:

Every run won or lost is harvested into stem cells, spent on a permanent Evolution tree: thicker heart lining, richer metabolism, faster antibodies, draft rerolls, and turrets that must be grown before they ever appear in your drafts. The body remembers. Next run, you're stronger.

10 organs and hundreds of waves:

Fight through the body with organs in different difficulty, from a fair fight to an always-mutated nightmare.

  • Fight massive hordes of Germs

  • Strategically cut the Membranes to control the intruders.

  • Multiple turret classes with unique per-turret upgrade trees

    Card drafts with 5 rarities and meta-unlockable weapons

  • Combo, rank, streak and interest systems that reward skillful play

  • Persistent Evolution tree every death makes the next run stronger

  • 10 organs, 100 waves, wave mutators, elites, bosses, endless mode

store_data.about_the_game:
DESCEND INTO THE ASYLUM

The Gentleman’s Rise is a 2D eldritch action Souls-like set within a corrupted 1930s asylum.

Armed with an eldritch scythe, the Gentleman must descend through ruined wards, confront the institution’s twisted inhabitants, and uncover what waits deeper within.

Death is expected.

What matters is what you learn from it.

FIGHT WITH PRECISION

Combat rewards patience, timing and deliberate positioning.

  • Chain together scythe attacks.

  • Dodge through dangerous openings.

  • Block to reduce incoming damage.

  • Parry at the right moment to stun enemies.

  • Interrupt and reposition threats with Eldritch Pull.

  • Adapt to melee attackers, ranged pressure and increasingly unnatural enemies.

The asylum is unforgiving, but its rules can be mastered.

DEATH IS PROGRESS

Defeated enemies leave behind Sanity that can be used to strengthen the Gentleman.

Invest in:

  • Strength to increase physical attack damage.

  • Vitality to increase maximum health.

  • Intelligence to strengthen eldritch abilities.

When the Gentleman dies, his carried Sanity remains where he fell. Return to recover it—or lose it permanently by dying again.

Completed levels can be replayed, allowing players to gather more Sanity, improve their skills or challenge the asylum without relying on additional upgrades.

HARNESS THE ELDRITCH

The Gentleman’s abilities expand as he descends.

Manipulate enemies with Eldritch Pull, control space with Eldritch Pool, survive desperate encounters through Eldritch Transformation, and corrupt distant targets with Eldritch Bolt.

These powers are not separate from the asylum’s corruption.

They are born from it.

FACE WHAT WAITS WITHIN

Each boss tests a different part of the combat system.

Learn attack patterns, recognize visual cues, interrupt dangerous actions and exploit the brief openings created by precise play.

Brute force may carry the Gentleman only so far.

Eventually, he must master himself.

RISE STRONGER

The Gentleman’s Rise is built around a cycle of failure, recovery and growth:

Descend. Die. Recover. Rise stronger.

How far will the Gentleman go before he finally understands what he has become?
